title: FocusMem: Factorizing Content, Readout, and Trust in Latent GUI Memory
summary: GUI agents must remember both useful experience from earlier tasks and unfinished progress in the current interaction. Latent memory offers a compact solution by compressing multimodal trajectories into a few continuous tokens. Existing methods, however, usually map each trajectory to one fixed memory block and train it mainly through next-action supervision. This creates three practical problems: important details may be lost during compression, the same memory block must serve different decision stages, and irrelevant retrieved trajectories may still mislead the agent. We introduce FocusMem, which separates these responsibilities within a compact latent-memory interface. A role-aware content basis encourages episodic memory to retain reusable experience and working memory to retain task progress. A state-conditioned readout generates a decision-specific view of the same stored evidence, while a lightweight trust gate can suppress memory blocks that appear irrelevant to the current step. All components are trained while the GUI policy remains frozen. Across five GUI-agent benchmarks, FocusMem consistently outperforms a fully matched action-only fixed-memory baseline and prior latent memory adaptations. Further analysis shows that semantic and functional supervision preserve complementary information, state-conditioned readout is more robust as surrounding trajectory context grows, and the trust gate reduces the harm caused by injected irrelevant episodic evidence. These results show that effective latent memory depends not only on compressing past interaction, but also on what is retained, what is exposed, and what is allowed.

title: Discretization and Statistical Consistency of Functional Flow Matching
summary: Functional flow matching is posed on distributions of functions but implemented from finitely many coefficients or point values. Under scattered or adaptive refinement, the resulting conditioning sigma-algebras need not be nested, so martingale convergence does not justify the sensor limit. We prove strong $L^2$ convergence of finite conditional velocity targets for every strongly consistent sequence of finite-rank reconstructions, with quantitative bounds for orthogonal projections and a point-sensor extension through a regularity space. For learned flows, coupling directly to a population superposition path yields an end-to-end Wasserstein bound without assuming uniqueness of the population finite-dimensional ODE. We verify sensor-independent constants for a normalized quadrature neural operator, including globally Lipschitz activations through an explicit magnitude recurrence. A noncommuting trace-class Gaussian example gives boundary multiplier $0$ under projected restriction and $0.72$ under exact conditioning. A spatial regularity--cubature certificate closes the operator-realization term, a Bernstein argument gives a $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1})$ excess-risk term for fixed model dimension and envelopes, and an exactly realizable clipped Gaussian scaling specialization yields an explicit end-to-end rate.

title: EgoAfford: Task-Oriented Affordance Grounding via Egocentric Referring Segmentation
summary: Part-level affordance grounding has advanced the localization of functional object regions associated with elemental actions. Extending this capability to complex tasks calls for connecting the semantic roles of participating objects with task-state-aligned visual observations and multi-step planning. We introduce EgoAfford, a benchmark designed to connect these three aspects. Given an egocentric observation and a high-level tabletop task, a model must generate the remaining plan and segment the functional regions of up to three components of the next action: the direct object, instrument, and destination. EgoAfford comprises approximately 15.5k human-verified images from 2,000 generated multi-step scenes, organized as semantically aligned, task-complete image series, together with EgoAfford-Real, 102 manually captured images spanning 26 tasks. We further present EgoLens, a 3B multimodal large language model with role-specific mask decoders, as an in-domain reference model for this joint task. Evaluations of recent referring-segmentation MLLMs, commercial-VLM--SAM2 pipelines, and EgoLens highlight the complementary challenges of next-step inference and action-role-conditioned part grounding. EgoLens establishes strong reference performance on both generated and manually captured observations. Together, EgoAfford and EgoLens provide a foundation for jointly studying perception and planning in multi-step tabletop tasks. Our project page is available at: https://egoafford.github.io

title: From Research Questions to Columns: Operationalization-Aware Data Discovery
summary:
Researchers often approach a data repository with an abstract concept and ask which columns can measure it. Useful columns may not resemble the query; they may matter only as complementary indicators in a defensible measure. This need differs from schema linking and column retrieval, which begin from more explicit needs and reward direct relevance. We define operationalization-aware data discovery (OADD): given a broad question and a database, optionally under a scope constraint, OADD jointly determines how focal concepts can be measured with available data and identifies supporting columns.
  Developing OADD methods requires examples for design and evaluation, but asking researchers to supply conceptual questions and their columns is impractical. We construct OADD-Bench by treating empirical papers as records of schema in use. A question miner extracts and reframes a paper-supported question; a paper-conditioned column miner reconstructs its measurements and grounds them to database identifiers. We admit only mappings supported by the publication and database documentation. OADD-Bench contains 160 questions from 111 papers and 4,682 question-column labels. Each target records a measurement used in published research; the paper supplies the precedent, while the miners extract and ground it.
  We evaluate lexical and neural retrieval, adapted schema-linking systems, and large language model (LLM) OADD agents. Each method receives only a question, permitted years, and dataset metadata; source papers are used only to construct and document benchmark labels. At the largest output limit, direct retrieval reaches at most 0.185 recall. The strongest schema-linking adaptation reaches 0.401 but remains optimized for a different objective; an OADD-directed agent performs best at 0.465. Even this agent covers less than half the target columns, showing that OADD remains an open problem.

title: Towards Robust Version Identification in the Wild: A Dataset, Benchmark, and Fine-Tuning Study
comments: Accepted to the Proceedings of the 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR 2026)
summary: Existing datasets for musical version identification (VI) are primarily derived from curated metadata sources such as SecondHandSongs and Discogs, and are therefore dominated by professionally recorded tracks. This leads to a domain mismatch with real-world scenarios, where amateur and user-generated content is prevalent. To address this limitation, we introduce DiVers, a large-scale VI dataset comprising over 1.1 million musical versions, with train-validation-test splits compatible with established datasets such as Discogs-VI-YT, SHS100K, and Da-TACOS. In addition to standard version-level annotations, DiVers provides automatically assigned tags (e.g., instrumental, live) and segment-level predictions indicating the presence or absence of music. We evaluate the proposed dataset by training state-of-the-art VI systems. Our results show that models trained on DiVers achieve substantially improved robustness to acoustically diverse and noisy inputs, while maintaining a stable performance on cleaner, studio-quality benchmarks. We release the dataset metadata, code for its construction, and all experimental pipelines to support reproducibility.

title: Learning Compression Rules for Network Traffic
summary: We study the problem of learning compact rule-based compressors for structured network traffic. Each packet is a record of header fields that are highly redundant within a flow, and a compressor is a small set of rules matching such records and replacing predictable fields with short codes. We cast rule learning as a two-stage problem: (i) an unsupervised structure-discovery stage that recursively partitions training packets using a normalized entropy-ratio criterion robust to small samples, and (ii) a constrained selection stage that uses dynamic programming to pick the rule subset maximizing expected compression gain under a hard budget on the number of installable rules. We instantiate the framework on Static Context Header Compression (SCHC), the IETF standard for rule-based header compression in constrained networks, and evaluate it on four real-world Internet-of-Things and 5G core-network datasets. Our method, Robust Entropy Clustering for Adaptive comPression (RECAP), surpasses expert-engineered rule sets with a small number of learned rules and removes the need for manual rule design.

title: A Model Merging Approach for Continual MLLM Unlearning
summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) unlearning methods have been proposed to remove private, sensitive, or proprietary information from well-trained models. However, most existing MLLM unlearning methods are designed for one-shot requests and fail to adequately address continual scenarios, as repeatedly applying one-shot operations leads to cumulative utility degradation, unlearning rebound, and retention drift. We introduce Merging for Continual Unlearning (MCU), an approach that dynamically merges multiple one-shot unlearning adapters into a unified adapter upon receiving each new unlearning request.Through a leave-one-out merging analysis, we reveal that these unlearning adapters exhibit strong cross-task dependencies. Such dependencies have two contrasting effects: they can facilitate cross-task unlearning transferability, but they can also introduce severe interference that degrades unlearning effectiveness and compromises retained knowledge. To address this challenge, MCU projects the adapters into a shared representation space, preserves their dominant directions, suppresses over-concentrated coordinates, and reconfigures cross-task dependencies to mitigate interference while enhancing transferability. Experiments on ICU-Bench and MLLMU-Bench demonstrate that MCU achieves superior unlearning effectiveness while preserving both retained knowledge and general multimodal utility.

title: EuroExec: Frontier Language Models Fall Short of Expert Judgment on European Executive Decision Tasks
comments: 16 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables, submitted to EACL 2027
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly put to use on open-ended complex questions, different in nature from the ones they are typically evaluated on. We dedicate more than 4,000 human expert hours to evaluate a selection of six frontier LLMs on a member of this class of problems: EuroExec, our introduced human expert-based benchmark composed of 413 open-ended long-form European executive tasks authored by 47 vetted domain experts, each question drawn from experience in a real case. Every response is manually evaluated through a multi-attribute rubric, an item-specific checklist of requirements, and a preference rank ordering, extracting an aggregate metric "Solve Rate". The strongest model solves only 56.9% of tasks, while expert-written reference answers judged blindly are solved at near-ceiling levels and are preferred over every model response in 74% of direct rankings, placing frontier generative systems well below the professional standard of work they are already used for. We see that the best way to extract this kind of conclusion is by employing human evaluators, carefully checking their consistency through rigorous statistical analysis, and observe that automatic measurements also fall short when evaluating on this case of real-world open-ended problems with a subjective ground truth.

title: Relational Response Fields: A General Theory of Black-Box LLM Response Consistency and Recovery
summary: Black-box language-model reliability is commonly pursued by sampling, prompting, voting, verifying, or iteratively revising individual answers. We ask a prior question: \emph{what determines whether a collection of black-box responses is recoverable at all?} We represent responses to typed transformations of a query as a \emph{relational response field} (RRF). Edge transports encode how valid responses must change under paraphrase, scaling, decomposition, refactoring, or other task symmetries; anchors encode independently trusted evidence such as execution or a verifier. For relation operator $D$, anchor operator $A$, and at most $k$ corrupted response nodes, we identify $γ_k(D,A)$ as the intrinsic difficulty of black-box response recovery. It is positive exactly when every $k$-node corruption is identifiable; it gives a deterministic stability bound proportional to $1/γ_k$; and a matching two-point minimax lower bound shows that no estimator can improve this dependence. Thus consistency is not truth: relation-only methods are blind to null directions, including shared hallucinations. We derive sparse field-repair algorithms while separating information-theoretic identifiability from the stronger null-space conditions required by convex optimization. Controlled theorem tests and black-box mathematics/code experiments evaluate four theory-fixed consequences: consistency--truth separation, anchor phase transitions, redundancy saturation, and cross-model, cross-task prediction of repair difficulty. The results support $γ_k(D,A)$ as a measurable property of a response-recovery instance, rather than a score attached to one repair heuristic.

title: Representing Visual Evidence for Item Difficulty Prediction: Visual Textualization and Image-Native Modeling
summary: Predicting item difficulty from content can provide an initial estimate for newly developed questions before sufficient student responses are available. Existing approaches typically represent the question stem and answer choices as text. When mathematics items contain visual components, a common pipeline first textualizes that evidence and then applies a text predictor. We ask: how should visual evidence be represented for item difficulty prediction? We compare question text alone, visual textualization, which expresses visual evidence in language, and image-native modeling, which retains the original image. Using Eedi items with difficulty calibrated from student responses, we train large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) directly for difficulty regression. Both visual interfaces achieve the lowest point estimates, although the leading systems cannot be reliably ordered. Open-VLM textualization yields lower RMSE point estimates for all evaluated LLMs, while broader adaptation does so for all image-native VLMs. Test-time interventions show dependence on the paired full-item image, but do not isolate the additional visual component. The two visual interfaces also make partially complementary item-level errors and differ substantially in computational workflow. Thus, textualization should not be treated as the only practical interface: image-native modeling is a competitive alternative whose effectiveness depends on how the VLM is adapted.

title: Optimal convergence of adaptive BEM driven by functional-type error estimators
summary: In the present work, we derive functional upper bounds for the potential error arising from boundary element discretizations of the Laplace-Dirichlet problem. These bounds are based on local auxiliary problems on patches of boundary vertices and the resulting a posteriori error estimator is shown to be locally equivalent to the well-studied residual error estimator. This equivalence result allows us to prove R-linear convergence of the functional a posteriori error estimator and, together with a suitable mesh-refining strategy, to establish that the potential error as well as the functional error estimator converge with optimal rates with respect to the number of boundary elements. Numerical experiments affirm the theoretical findings and illustrate the practical performance of the related adaptive algorithm driven by the proposed functional error estimator.

title: VoxStruct3D: Structure-Leading Flow Matching for Voxel-Space 3D MRI Synthesis
summary: High-fidelity 3D MRI synthesis requires both globally coherent anatomy and fine-grained voxel-level detail. Although latent diffusion makes volumetric generation tractable, its image autoencoder introduces a reconstruction bottleneck that can limit the fine detail recoverable in the final volume. We present VoxStruct3D, a voxel-space flow-matching framework that directly models full-resolution MRI volumes using a clean-data prediction objective. Its Volumetric Voxel Generator (VVG) combines factorized 3D patch embedding with overlapping upsampling, time-modulated residual refinement, and skip fusion, enabling neighboring tokens to jointly reconstruct shared voxel regions and suppress patch-boundary artifacts. To complement direct voxel-space modeling with an explicit anatomical prior, we further introduce a Structure-First, Image-Follows (SFIF) strategy. A frozen pretrained 3D medical encoder and a StructVAE extract compact structure tokens that preserve dominant anatomy, while a structure-leading schedule keeps their trajectory ahead of the image trajectory. Patch-Aligned RoPE spatially aligns the unequal token grids, and asymmetric attention enforces one-way guidance from structure to image. Experiments on pathological and healthy T1-weighted brain MRI datasets show that VoxStruct3D achieves the strongest overall performance across feature-distribution alignment, sample diversity, and perceptual quality, producing anatomically coherent and visually realistic volumes.

title: ColorFD: A Finite-Difference Guided Black-Box Physical Adversarial Attack for Remote Sensing Object Detection
summary: Although deep neural network-based remote sensing object detectors have achieved strong performance, they remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing studies mainly focus on digital or white-box settings, whereas black-box physical attacks remain underexplored. These attacks are often constrained by limited physical feasibility and inefficient optimization in high-dimensional search spaces. To address these challenges, this paper proposes ColorFD, a black-box physical attack based on multiple pure-color patches. The patch positions and color parameters are jointly optimized using Differential Evolution (DE). A target-wise fitness and selection mechanism evaluates the attack state of each target and preserves target-specific improvements during evolution. Two guidance strategies further constrain the patch search space. Key-region localization identifies sensitive regions through finite-difference color probing. Common-feature extraction provides category-level spatial priors and avoids repeated localization. Although evaluated on aircraft, the formulation is not inherently restricted to this category. Experiments on YOLOv3u, YOLOv5u, and Faster R-CNN show that ColorFD outperforms the tested black-box patch method across all evaluated detectors and remains competitive with strong white-box baselines. Physical-world experiments further demonstrate that the optimized pure-color patches can be transferred from the digital domain to real imaging conditions.

AI.title_translation: ColorFD：一种有限差分引导的遥感目标检测黑盒物理对抗攻击方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出 ColorFD 方法，通过有限差分引导和差分进化算法优化纯色贴片，实现了对遥感目标检测器高效、可物理迁移的黑盒物理对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有的遥感目标检测对抗攻击研究多集中于数字或白盒场景，而黑盒物理攻击由于受限于物理可行性不足以及高维搜索空间中优化效率低下等问题，尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了 ColorFD 攻击框架，使用多个纯色贴片，并利用差分进化算法（DE）联合优化贴片位置和颜色参数。通过针对特定目标的适应度与选择机制保留演化过程中的改进；同时引入两种引导策略缩小搜索空间：利用有限差分颜色探查定位关键敏感区域，以及通过公共特征提取获取类别级空间先验，避免重复定位。
AI.result: 在 YOLOv3u、YOLOv5u 和 Faster R-CNN 等检测器上的实验表明，ColorFD 在所有评估检测器上的表现均优于对比的黑盒贴片攻击方法，且与强白盒基线相比具备竞争优势。物理世界实验进一步证实优化后的纯色贴片能够成功从数字领域迁移至真实成像条件。
AI.conclusion: ColorFD 证明了结合有限差分引导与纯色贴片的黑盒物理攻击在遥感目标检测中的有效性与物理现实可迁移性，为遥感模型的安全性评估提供了新的视角。
AI.translation: 尽管基于深度神经网络的遥感目标检测器取得了出色的性能，但它们对对抗扰动依然十分脆弱。现有研究主要集中在数字或白盒设置，而黑盒物理攻击仍未得到充分探索。这些攻击往往受到有限的物理可行性和高维搜索空间中低效优化的制约。为解决这些挑战，本文提出了 ColorFD，一种基于多个纯色贴片的黑盒物理攻击方法。贴片的位置和颜色参数使用差分进化（DE）算法进行联合优化。目标级的适应度与选择机制评估每个目标的攻击状态，并在演化过程中保留针对特定目标的改进。两种引导策略进一步约束了贴片的搜索空间：关键区域定位通过有限差分颜色探查识别敏感区域；公共特征提取提供类别级的空间先验，避免重复定位。虽然以飞机类别为例进行了评估，但该公式在本质上并不局限于此类别。在 YOLOv3u、YOLOv5u 和 Faster R-CNN 上的实验表明，ColorFD 在所有评估的检测器上均优于测试的黑盒贴片方法，并且与强白盒基线相比保持竞争优势。物理世界实验进一步表明，优化后的纯色贴片可以从数字领域迁移到真实成像条件中。
AI.summary: 本文针对遥感目标检测器在黑盒物理场景下攻击效率低和物理可行性弱的问题，提出了一种名为 ColorFD 的黑盒物理对抗攻击方法。该方法采用基于差分进化算法联合优化位置与颜色参数的纯色贴片，结合有限差分颜色探查定位敏感关键区域，并提取类别公共特征作为空间先验以引导搜索。实验结果表明 ColorFD 在数字和真实物理世界场景中均展现出卓越的攻击效能和可迁移性。
AI.keywords: 遥感目标检测, 黑盒攻击, 物理对抗攻击, 有限差分, 差分进化算法
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将有限差分色探查与差分进化（DE）算法相结合，解决了黑盒物理对抗攻击在遥感图像高维搜索空间中优化效率低及物理可行性差的问题。采用纯色贴片极大降低了物理现实制造和印制的难度，具有很强的实用价值和物理可迁移性。局限性在于目前主要在飞机目标上进行了评估，尽管理论上通用，仍需在更多复杂遥感场景和类别上进行验证。

title: OutLangSplat: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting for UAV Outdoor Scenes
summary: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting embeds open-vocabulary language features into 3D Gaussian Splatting, providing an efficient explicit representation for text-driven 3D scene understanding. However, existing methods are limited to indoor or small-scale scenes, and tend to fail in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) outdoor scenes, where severe occlusions and long distance viewpoints often lead to incorrect semantic activations and missing target responses. In this paper, we present OutLangSplat which adapts language Gaussian representations to UAV outdoor scenes by improving feature representation and aggregation reliability. For the feature representation, a 2D-3D dual-branch representation with region-based alignment and fusion is designed to improve spatial consistency, reducing incomplete target responses and background misactivations. For the feature aggregation, we introduce a training-free contribution and consistency-aware Gaussian feature aggregation strategy that leverages pixel contribution reliability and cross-view semantic consistency to suppress unreliable responses from noisy viewpoints. A new dataset is provided by manually annotating various objects on four real-world public UAV outdoor scene datasets. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first accessible dataset of open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding for UAV outdoor scenes. Quantitative evaluations and ablation studies demonstrate that OutLangSplat outperforms SOTA methods on both open-vocabulary semantic segmentation and instance localization tasks. The datasets and codes will be open-sourced.

AI.title_translation: OutLangSplat：面向无人机户外场景的3D语言高斯泼溅
AI.tldr: OutLangSplat通过2D-3D双分支融合与无需训练的可靠特征聚合策略，首次实现了面向无人机户外大场景的高效开放词汇3D高斯泼溅场景理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D语言高斯泼溅方法主要局限于室内或小规模场景，在无人机（UAV）户外场景中，严重的遮挡和远距离视角常导致错误的语义激活和目标响应缺失。
AI.method: 1. 设计了包含基于区域对齐与融合的2D-3D双分支表征，增强空间一致性，减少背景误激活与目标响应缺失；2. 提出了无需训练的贡献度与一致性感知高斯特征聚合策略，利用像素贡献可靠性和跨视角语义一致性抑制噪声视角的干扰；3. 在4个真实无人机户外数据集上标注并构建了首个开放词汇3D场景理解数据集。
AI.result: 在开放词汇语义分割和实例定位任务上的定量评估与消融实验表明，OutLangSplat的效果显著超越了现有的SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: OutLangSplat成功克服了无人机户外场景中的遮挡与远视角挑战，显著提升了开放词汇3D场景理解的准确度与鲁棒性，并为该领域提供了首个公开的无人机户外场景基准数据集。
AI.translation: 3D语言高斯泼溅（3D Language Gaussian Splatting）将开放词汇语言特征嵌入到3D高斯泼溅中，为文本驱动的3D场景理解提供了高效的显式表示。然而，现有方法局限于室内或小规模场景，在无人机（UAV）户外场景中往往会失效，因为严重的遮挡和远距离视角经常导致错误的语义激活和目标响应缺失。在本文中，我们提出了OutLangSplat，通过提高特征表示和聚合可靠性，使语言高斯表示适应无人机户外场景。在特征表示方面，设计了带有基于区域对齐和融合的2D-3D双分支表示，以提高空间一致性，减少不完整的目标响应和背景误激活。在特征聚合方面，我们引入了一种无需训练的贡献度和一致性感知高斯特征聚合策略，利用像素贡献可靠性和跨视角语义一致性来抑制来自噪声视角的不可靠响应。通过在四个真实世界公开无人机户外场景数据集上手动标注各种物体，提供了一个新数据集。据我们所知，这是首个可用于无人机户外场景开放词汇3D场景理解的数据集。定量评估和消融实验表明，OutLangSplat在开放词汇语义分割和实例定位任务上均优于现有的SOTA方法。数据集和代码将开源。
AI.summary: 针对无人机户外大场景中由于遮挡和远视角导致的3D语言高斯泼溅语义失效问题，本文提出了OutLangSplat。该方法通过2D-3D双分支区域融合表征以及无需训练的特征聚合策略，显著提升了空间与跨视角语义一致性，同时贡献了首个无人机户外开放词汇3D场景理解数据集。
AI.keywords: 3D Gaussian Splatting, Open-Vocabulary, UAV Outdoor Scenes, Feature Aggregation, Scene Understanding
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于成功将3D语言高斯泼溅技术从室内/小规模场景扩展到了复杂的无人机户外大规模场景。通过2D-3D双分支表征融合与无需训练的特征聚合策略，有效解决了远距离视角和严重遮挡带来的语义误激活与不一致问题。此外，作者填补了无人机户外开放词汇3D场景理解数据集的空白，具有很高的实用价值和学术贡献。

title: What Is a Skill Worth? Structure-Aware Shapley Valuation of Agent Skills
summary: Agent skills are increasingly optimized by automated feedback loops, producing long structured artifacts whose internal value remains unclear. We study skill valuation: assigning credit to the internal units of a fixed skill, such as rules, examples, scripts, and heuristics, under a fixed agent and held-out task distribution. Skill valuation differs from data or prompt-span valuation because skill units are structured: they may depend on other units, belong to a document hierarchy, trigger agent behavior, and consume limited prompt context. We introduce SkillSV, a structure-aware Shapley-style framework for skill valuation. SkillSV compiles a skill into units, dependencies, and hierarchy, so that only valid counterfactual skills are evaluated. It uses paired deletion and length-neutral padding to separate content value from context cost, and estimates the resulting values with a rollout-budgeted estimator for noisy agent evaluations. On four agentic benchmarks, we assess the faithfulness, actionability, and explanation of SkillSV: it recovers unit interactions, preserves aggregate skill lift, and guides safe pruning and compression.

AI.title_translation: 技能价值几何？智能体技能的结构感知Shapley评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SkillSV，一种结构感知的Shapley价值评估框架，能够精准评估智能体技能内部各个组件（规则、示例、脚本等）的价值，并指导技能的精简与压缩。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能在经过自动化反馈循环优化后通常会变得冗长且结构复杂，但其内部各单元（如规则、示例、脚本等）的具体贡献和价值难以量化，且传统的数据或提示词评估方法未考虑技能单元间的依赖性、层级结构及上下文开销。
AI.method: 提出了SkillSV框架，将技能编译为单元、依赖项和文档层级，仅评估合法的反事实技能组合；采用成对删除与长度中性填充分离内容价值与上下文成本；并利用面向噪声智能体评估的Rollout预算估计器估算单元价值。
AI.result: 在四个智能体基准上的实验表明，SkillSV成功恢复了技能单元之间的交互关系，保留了技能的整体性能提升，并能够有效指导智能体技能进行安全的剪枝与压缩。
AI.conclusion: SkillSV提供了一种忠实、可操作且具解释性的智能体技能评估方法，成功实现了对技能内部单元价值的量化分配，并能有效指导技能的无损裁剪与压缩。
AI.translation: 智能体技能日益通过自动化反馈循环进行优化，从而生成长且结构化的产物，但其内部价值仍不清晰。我们研究技能评估：在固定智能体和留存任务分布下，为固定技能的内部单元（如规则、示例、脚本和启发式方法）分配信用。技能评估不同于数据或提示词跨度评估，因为技能单元是结构化的：它们可能依赖于其他单元、属于文档层级结构、触发智能体行为，并消耗有限的提示词上下文。我们提出了SkillSV，一个用于技能评估的结构感知类Shapley框架。SkillSV将技能编译为单元、依赖项和层级结构，从而仅评估有效的反事实技能。它采用成对删除和长度中性填充来分离内容价值与上下文成本，并使用针对噪声智能体评估的Rollout预算估计器来估算所得价值。在四个智能体基准测试中，我们评估了SkillSV的忠实性、可操作性和解释力：它能恢复单元间的交互作用，保持技能的总体提升，并指导安全的剪枝与压缩。
AI.summary: 本文针对智能体技能内部结构复杂、单元价值难以量化的难题，提出了首个感知结构的技能价值评估框架SkillSV。该框架通过结合单元依赖性编译、成对删除与长度填充技术，实现了对技能内部规则、示例和脚本等单元的高效归因，为智能体技能的优化与压缩提供了可行方案。
AI.keywords: Agent Skills, Skill Valuation, Shapley Value, Structure-Aware, Skill Pruning
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于首次提出了针对智能体技能内部结构的Shapley价值评估框架（SkillSV），解决了技能单元存在依赖关系、层级结构以及上下文长度干扰归因的难题。其重要性在于为智能体技能的精简、优化和可解释性分析提供了量化工具。潜在局限性在于估计过程依赖Rollout采样，在复杂大模型任务上可能带来一定的计算开销。

title: Breadcrumbing Search Agents
summary: LLM-based search agents are widely used for information-seeking tasks, but their reliance on external tool returns introduces a critical security risk: web content retrieved during execution is untrusted, exposing agents to prompt injection and goal hijacking. Prior work on search-agent safety primarily focuses on static web-content injection, but modern agents issue follow-up queries and cross-check competing sources, so a single injected page is often diluted or rejected. We show that the channel delivering search and page observations is a fragile security boundary: beyond exposing the agent to a single poisoned page, a mediated search interface can repeatedly steer how the agent gathers evidence and forms its final answer. Under a constrained tool-intermediary threat model, appending only one controlled result per query can substantially increase attack success when the evidence is coordinated across the agent's trajectory. We study this setting with a strategy-driven long-horizon attack system and introduce Authority-Chain Hijack (ACH), an expert-refined strategy that turns isolated search-result and page-content manipulations into a coherent evidence chain across seemingly corroborating sources. ACH achieves the highest Overall ASR among all baselines, reaching 55.9% / 83.3% ASR / MaxN ASR on the full SafeSearch test split. We further introduce Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution (TGSE), which automatically improves attacker strategies from execution traces, replacing manual redesign with trace-driven refinement; its strongest single setting reaches 71.4% / 95.0% in held-out evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 搜索智能体的“面包屑”式攻击
AI.tldr: 本文提出了跨多轮搜索轨迹协同注入证据链的“面包屑”攻击方法，能以极高的成功率对大语言模型搜索智能体实施目标劫持。
AI.motivation: 现有的搜索智能体安全研究多关注静态单网页内容注入，但现代智能体会发起后续查询并交叉核对多个来源，导致单一注入页面易被忽略或拒绝。因此需要研究如何在多轮交互轨迹中持续、协同地引导智能体搜集证据。
AI.method:
1. 构建受限工具中介 threat模型，在智能体每次查询中仅注入一个受控结果。
2. 提出权威链劫持（Authority-Chain Hijack, ACH）策略，将孤立的搜索与页面篡改转化为跨多个佐证源的连贯证据链。
3. 提出追踪引导策略演化（Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution, TGSE），基于智能体执行轨迹自动精炼和优化攻击策略。
AI.result: 在 SafeSearch 完整测试集上，ACH 取得了最高的攻击成功率（55.9% ASR / 83.3% MaxN ASR）。自动化的 TGSE 进一步提升了攻击威力，在留出集评估中最高达到了 71.4% ASR / 95.0% MaxN ASR。
AI.conclusion: 搜索与页面观测传送通道是搜索智能体脆弱的安全边界。攻击者通过在中介搜索接口中跨轨迹协同呈现证据链，可以极高成功率地引导和劫持智能体的搜索过程与最终输出，自动化策略演化进一步放大了这种威胁。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的搜索智能体被广泛用于信息检索任务，但它们对外部工具返回结果的依赖引入了关键的安全风险：执行过程中检索到的网页内容是不可信的，使智能体面临提示词注入和目标劫持的风险。以往关于搜索智能体安全的研究主要集中于静态网页内容注入，但现代智能体会发起后续查询并交叉核对竞争来源，因此单个被污染的页面往往会被稀释或拒绝。我们表明，传递搜索和页面观测结果的通道是一个脆弱的安全边界：除了将智能体暴露于单个被污染的页面之外，中介搜索接口还可以反复引导智能体如何收集证据并形成其最终答案。在受限的工具中介威胁模型下，当证据在智能体的整个轨迹中进行协同配合时，每次查询仅追加一个受控结果就能大幅提高攻击成功率。我们通过策略驱动的长程攻击系统对此设定进行了研究，并引入了权威链劫持（Authority-Chain Hijack, ACH），这是一种经专家提炼的策略，可将孤立的搜索结果和页面内容篡改转化为跨看似相互佐证的数据源的连贯证据链。在完整的 SafeSearch 测试集上，ACH 在所有基线中取得了最高的整体攻击成功率（ASR），达到了 55.9% ASR / 83.3% MaxN ASR。我们进一步引入了追踪引导策略演化（Trace-Guided Strategy Evolution, TGSE），该方法可根据执行轨迹自动改进攻击者策略，以轨迹驱动的精炼取代人工重新设计；其最强的单项设置在留出集评估中达到了 71.4% / 95.0%。
AI.summary: 本研究揭示了大语言模型搜索智能体在多轮检索过程中的安全脆弱性。作者提出了通过中介搜索接口在智能体搜索轨迹中跨多轮注入协同证据链的“面包屑”式攻击方法，并设计了权威链劫持（ACH）与自动化的追踪引导策略演化（TGSE），大幅提升了对现代搜索智能体的攻击成功率。
AI.keywords: 搜索智能体, 提示词注入, 目标劫持, 权威链劫持, 轨迹引导策略演化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地打破了仅关注单页面静态注入的传统局限，提出了跨多轮搜索轨迹的协同注入攻击模式（面包屑式引导），并引入 TGSE 实现了攻击策略的轨迹驱动自动化演化。该研究揭示了搜索智能体在中介接口与多轮检索交互过程中的深刻安全隐患，对构建防御下一代 AI 智能体注入攻击具有重要意义。

title: STRIVE: Probing Reasoning Limits in Graded Plausibility Generation and Evaluation
summary: Event knowledge concerns who does what to whom. Psycholinguists use event-plausibility judgments to examine how this knowledge supports human language processing. To isolate plausibility effects, these studies require controlled event sets in which one event slot varies across plausibility levels while all other event features remain fixed. Constructing such sets manually is labor-intensive. We therefore introduce STRIVE, an LLM-based framework for jointly generating and evaluating controlled event sets crossing plausibility class (plausible vs. implausible) with intended classification difficulty (easy vs. hard). Given a verb, STRIVE constructs a shared event frame, then produces one event per condition by varying one slot while holding all others fixed. In experiments with six models across 60 verbs, GPT-5.1 produced high-quality sets only 16.7% of the time using the baseline generation prompt. Adding a global reasoning scratchpad and evaluator-guided refinement raised this rate to 75.0%. Greater reasoning effort also improved evaluator--human agreement. Nevertheless, events near the plausibility boundary remain most difficult. They elicit the greatest human disagreement, and the best evaluator reaches only 57% accuracy on the implausible-hard condition, indicating a need for human input. Overall, STRIVE offers a scalable approach to reducing manual effort by automating initial event-set generation and evaluation for psycholinguistic studies.

AI.title_translation: STRIVE：在分级合理性生成与评估中探测推理极限
AI.tldr: 本文提出了STRIVE框架，利用LLM自动化生成和评估用于心理语言学研究的控制事件集，通过引入推理草稿板和精炼机制显著提高了生成质量，但边界合理性案例仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 心理语言学研究中构建受控事件集（即固定其他特征、仅改变一个事件槽以隔离合理性效应）的手工过程非常繁琐劳动力密集，因此需要一个自动化、基于大语言模型的可扩展框架来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 引入了STRIVE框架，利用大语言模型联合生成和评估控制事件集，结合了全局推理草稿板和评估器引导的精炼机制。
AI.result: 在使用基线提示词时，GPT-5.1仅有16.7%的时间能生成高质量事件集；而加入全局推理草稿板和评估器引导精炼后，这一比例提升至75.0%。最佳评估器在implausible-hard条件下的准确率仅为57%，表明边界案例仍需人类输入。
AI.conclusion: STRIVE框架通过自动化生成和评估受控事件集，成功降低了心理语言学研究中的人工成本，但处理边界合理性案例时仍需人类介入。
AI.translation: 事件知识关乎谁对谁做了什么。心理语言学家使用事件合理性判断来检验这种知识如何支持人类语言处理。为了隔离合理性效应，这些研究需要受控的事件集，其中一个事件槽在不同的合理性水平间变化，而所有其他事件特征保持固定。手动构建这样的事件集是劳动密集的。因此，我们引入了STRIVE，这是一个基于LLM的框架，用于联合生成和评估跨越合理性类别（合理与不合理）以及预期分类难度（简单与困难）的受控事件集。给定一个动词，STRIVE构建一个共享的事件框架，然后通过改变一个槽同时保持其他槽固定，为每个条件产生一个事件。在对6种模型和60个动词进行的实验中，GPT-5.1在使用基线生成提示词时仅有16.7%的时间产生高质量事件集。增加全局推理草稿板和评估器引导的精炼将该比例提高到75.0%。更大的推理努力也提高了评估器与人类的一致性。尽管如此，合理性边界附近的事件仍然最困难。它们引发最大的人类分歧，且最佳评估器在不合理-困难条件下的准确率仅达到57%，这表明需要人类输入。总的来说，STRIVE提供了一种可扩展的方法，通过自动化心理语言学研究的初始事件集生成和评估来减少手动劳动。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了STRIVE，一个基于大语言模型的框架，用于自动生成和评估心理语言学研究所需的控制事件集。实验表明，通过全局推理和精炼机制，模型生成高质量事件集的能力大幅提升，但面对合理性边界的复杂案例时仍存在局限性，需人类参与。
AI.keywords: 事件知识, 合理性生成, 心理语言学, 大语言模型, 推理极限
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的框架STRIVE，用于自动化生成和评估心理语言学研究中所需的控制事件集。创新点在于通过引入全局推理草稿板和评估器引导的精炼机制，显著提升了复杂边界案例的生成质量。论文不仅探讨了LLM在细粒度合理性推理上的能力极限，还揭示了模型在处理困难的 implausible-hard 条件时的局限性，对未来结合人类反馈与AI自动化的研究具有重要启发。

title: Talk2Sensors: 3D Visual Grounding in Autonomous Driving via Sensor-Adaptive Physical Cue Matching
summary: As a key capability for embodied intelligence, 3D visual grounding (3DVG) has been predominantly studied in indoor scenes with RGB-D or point-cloud inputs, while existing outdoor extensions largely rely on monocular images alone. Both settings fall short of real-world outdoor perception, where heterogeneous sensors capture complementary yet distinct physical properties, such as visual texture, 3D geometry, and object kinematics, that are indispensable for flexible and robust query-adaptive grounding but remain under-exploited. To bridge this gap, we introduce Talk2Sensors, the first multi-sensor 3D visual grounding dataset built upon camera, LiDAR, and 4D radar. It contains 8,682 language instructions and 20,558 referred objects, with diverse prompts explicitly aligned with sensor-specific physical cues. Furthermore, we propose TSFormer, a unified Transformer-based framework for language-guided 3D visual grounding in autonomous driving. TSFormer adopts a coarse-to-fine property-aware fusion strategy: the Language-Routed Property Sampler first performs coarse text-conditioned feature retrieval by modulating sensor sampling weights with query-level linguistic cues, while the subsequent Sparse-Preserving Modality Arbiter module conducts fine-grained modality arbitration and text-guided refinement to determine the precise referred spatial location. This design enables dynamic routing of appearance, geometry, and motion cues according to the semantic requirements of each prompt, preventing dense modalities from overwhelming sparse but critical sensor signals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TSFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks: it improves over the strongest baseline by 8.05 mAP on Talk2Sensors, and transfers to the monocular Mono3DRefer benchmark with 53.05\% Acc@0.5.

AI.title_translation: Talk2Sensors：通过传感器自适应物理线索匹配实现自动驾驶中的3D视觉定位
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个自动驾驶多传感器3D视觉定位数据集Talk2Sensors及统一框架TSFormer，通过动态融合异构传感器的物理线索显著提升了3D定位的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉定位研究主要局限于室内RGB-D/点云或室外单目图像，忽视了自动驾驶中由异构传感器（相机、LiDAR、4D雷达）捕获的互补且独特的物理属性（视觉纹理、3D几何、运动学）。
AI.method: 提出了TSFormer框架，采用粗到细的属性感知融合策略：Language-Routed Property Sampler（语言引导属性采样器）进行粗粒度文本条件特征检索，Sparse-Preserving Modality Arbiter（稀疏保持模态仲裁器）进行细粒度模态仲裁和文本引导精炼。
AI.result: 在Talk2Sensors数据集上比最强基线提升了8.05 mAP，在Mono3DRefer基准上达到了53.05%的Acc@0.5。
AI.conclusion: Talk2Sensors数据集和TSFormer框架有效解决了自动驾驶中多传感器异构物理线索利用不足的问题，在多个基准测试中达到了SOTA性能。
AI.translation: 作为具身智能的关键能力，3D视觉定位（3DVG）主要在室内场景中通过RGB-D或点云输入进行研究，而现有的室外扩展大多仅依赖单目图像。这两种设置都无法满足真实世界室外感知的需求，因为异构传感器捕获了互补且截然不同的物理属性（如视觉纹理、3D几何和物体运动学），这些属性对于灵活且鲁棒的查询自适应定位不可或缺，但目前尚未得到充分开发。为了弥补这一空白，我们推出了Talk2Sensors，这是第一个基于相机、LiDAR和4D雷达构建的多传感器3D视觉定位数据集。它包含8,682条语言指令和20,558个被指代物体，具有与传感器特定物理线索明确对齐的多样化提示。此外，我们提出了TSFormer，这是一个用于自动驾驶中语言引导的3D视觉定位的统一Transformer框架。TSFormer采用了一种从粗到细的属性感知融合策略：Language-Routed Property Sampler首先通过用查询级语言线索调节传感器采样权重来执行粗粒度的文本条件特征检索，随后的Sparse-Preserving Modality Arbiter模块则进行细粒度的模态仲裁和文本引导精炼，以确定精确的被指代空间位置。这种设计使得能够根据每个提示的语义要求动态路由外观、几何和运动线索，防止密集模态淹没稀疏但关键的传感器信号。大量实验表明，TSFormer在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能：在Talk2Sensors上比最强基线提升了8.05 mAP，并以53.05%的Acc@0.5迁移到单目Mono3DRefer基准测试中。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Talk2Sensors——首个用于自动驾驶的多传感器3D视觉定位数据集，并提出了一个名为TSFormer的统一Transformer框架，通过动态路由外观、几何和运动线索来实现基于查询的精确3D定位。
AI.keywords: 3D Visual Grounding, Autonomous Driving, Multi-Sensor Fusion, Transformer, Physical Cue Matching
AI.comments: 该论文首次针对自动驾驶场景构建了多传感器3D视觉定位数据集（Talk2Sensors），并提出了TSFormer框架，通过粗到细的属性感知融合策略动态匹配传感器物理线索，显著提升了自动驾驶中语言引导的3D定位性能。

title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
summary: Hard prompt compression reduces long-context inference cost by independently scoring tokens, sentences, or chunks and retaining the highest-scoring units under a budget. We identify a structural failure in this procedure: independent selection can split dependent evidence pairs, retaining one member while deleting the other. When retained text contains an answer but deleted text defines the entity needed to interpret it, we call the result referential dangling. At a compression ratio of 0.30, Beaver, which ranks coherent chunks using Qwen3-0.6B embeddings, leaves the answer path incomplete in 34-54% of bridge examples across three multi-hop question answering datasets. On a shared HotpotQA bridge set, all six hard compressors we test exhibit dangling at rates up to 60%, and every document in LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA contains at least one dangling reference. On dangling examples evaluated with Qwen3-8B, reinserting the missing supporting paragraph while removing nonsupporting paragraphs to maintain the token budget improves accuracy by 29-34 percentage points (p < 0.0001), recovering at least 88% of the gap to contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Stronger answer models do not absorb the loss: on MuSiQue, GPT-5.5 is 8.8 points less accurate on compressed contexts than on contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Finally, we train a compact classifier to rank omitted sentences by whether they are needed to interpret retained text and reinsert the top-ranked candidates without support annotations at inference. On HotpotQA with Qwen3-8B, this automatic restoration improves accuracy by 4.7 points while changing the compression ratio only from 0.30 to 0.31. Hard compressors should optimize both relevance and referential completeness.

AI.title_translation: 相关但不完整：硬提示压缩中作为范式级失败模式的指代悬空
AI.tldr: 硬提示压缩会破坏文本间的依赖关系导致“指代悬空”，从而严重降低大模型的问答准确率，而自动恢复缺失内容可有效解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的硬提示压缩方法通过独立评分和选择Token、句子或分块来降低长上下文推理成本，作者旨在指出这种独立选择过程会导致依赖证据对被拆分，进而引发结构性失败（指代悬空）。
AI.method: 评估了六种现有的硬提示压缩器在多个数据集上的表现，量化了指代悬空的发生率，测试了重新插入缺失支持段落的效果，并训练了一个紧凑的分类器来自动恢复被省略但必需的句子。
AI.result: 在0.30的压缩率下，测试的六种硬压缩器在HotpotQA上的指代悬空率高达60%，LongBench-v2中的每个文档都包含至少一个悬空引用。重新插入缺失段落可使准确率大幅提升29-34个百分点，而训练的自动恢复分类器也能在微幅调整压缩率的情况下显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 硬提示压缩在独立评估和保留文本时，极易导致指代悬空，从而严重降低多跳问答等任务的准确率。引入指代完整性约束或进行自动恢复是解决这一范式的有效途径。
AI.translation: 硬提示压缩通过独立对Token、句子或分块进行打分，并在预算下保留得分最高的单元，从而降低长上下文的推理成本。我们在这类过程中发现了一个结构性缺陷：独立的选取得分可能会拆分相互依赖的证据对，保留其中一个成员而删除另一个。当保留的文本包含答案，但被删除的文本定义了对其进行解释所需的实体时，我们将这种结果称为指代悬空。在0.30的压缩率下，使用Qwen3-0.6B嵌入对连贯分块进行排序的Beaver，在三个多跳问答数据集的桥接示例中，有34-54%的答案路径不完整。在一个共享的HotpotQA桥接集上，我们测试的所有六个硬压缩器都表现出了高达60%的悬空率，并且LongBench-v2单文档QA中的每一个文档都包含至少一个悬空的引用。在使用Qwen3-8B评估的悬空示例中，重新插入缺失的支持段落同时移除不Supporting的段落以保持Token预算，可以将准确率提高29-34个百分点（p < 0.0001），恢复了与保留两个支持段落的上下文之间至少88%的差距。更强的答案模型无法弥补这一损失：在MuSiQue上，GPT-5.5在压缩上下文上的准确率比保留两个支持段落的上下文低8.8个百分点。最后，我们训练了一个紧凑的分类器，根据省略的句子是否需要解释保留的文本对其进行排序，并在推理时无需支持标注即重新插入排名字段的候选内容。在配备Qwen3-8B的HotpotQA上，这种自动恢复将准确率提高了4.7个百分点，同时将压缩率仅从0.30变更为0.31。硬提示压缩应该同时优化相关性和指代完整性。
AI.summary: 本文识别并研究了硬提示压缩中的“指代悬空”范式级失败模式，即独立选择文本块导致依赖关系被破坏。研究表明该现象在多个数据集中普遍存在且严重影响推理准确率，而通过自动恢复缺失的必需上下文可以有效弥补这一性能损失。
AI.keywords: 提示压缩, 长文本推理, 指代悬空, 多跳问答, 语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了硬提示压缩中一个被忽视但极其根本的结构性缺陷——指代悬空（Referential Dangling），并提出了通过优化指代完整性来提升压缩性能的有效方案。具有很强的针对性和实用价值。

title: The Personalization Mirage: How LLMs Fabricate User Profiles, and Why Self-Monitoring Misleads
summary: Personalized LLMs with persistent memory are increasingly deployed, yet the faithfulness of their user models remains unexamined. We study over-inference (OI): the phenomenon where LLMs fabricate user attributes beyond what evidence supports. We introduce MirageBench, comprising 150 personas balanced across stereotypical, counter-stereotypical, and neutral profiles, 6 personalization tasks spanning an ``imagination gradient'', a four-way faithfulness taxonomy operationalized by an independent judge (validated against a blind human annotator on 400 claims: Cohen's kappa = 0.863 four-class, kappa = 0.900 binary), and a leaderboard of 12 models across 7 families on 143616 judged claims. We find that over-inference is pervasive: every one of the 12 models over-infers 35%--49% of its claims (cross-model mean 41.6%; claim-weighted 41.8%), with no model in this evaluation escaping it. Most strikingly, we surface a Self-Monitoring Inversion: at the model-selection level, models' self-assessed OI is negatively rank-correlated with their judge-measured OI (rho = -0.60, p = 0.044; exploratory, wide bootstrap CI [-0.90, +0.06], n = 12). The models that report the least over-inference tend to be flagged as fabricating the most, so self-reported confidence is a misleading signal for comparing models, even though within a single model self-audit still ranks that model's own claims moderately well (AUROC 0.58--0.83). We further show that OI is task-dependent (27%--59%) and that, in a multi-turn pilot, inferred attributes accumulate approximately linearly with little revision. MirageBench positions external verification, rather than model self-report, as a more reliable foundation for trustworthy personalization.

AI.title_translation: 个性化幻象：大模型如何捏造用户画像，以及为什么自我监控会产生误导
AI.tldr: 个性化大语言模型会普遍捏造用户画像属性（过度推断率达35%--49%），且模型自我监控不可靠（自我感觉良好的模型往往捏造更多），因此需要依靠外部验证来保证个性化服务的真实性。
AI.motivation: 当前带有持久记忆的个性化大语言模型部署日益增加，但其用户模型的忠实度（是否会凭空捏造用户属性）尚未得到检验。
AI.method: 引入了MirageBench（包含150个角色、6个个性化任务、四分法忠实度分类标准及独立裁判机制），对7个系列的12个模型在143,616个被评估的声明上进行了全面测试与分析。
AI.result: 所有12个测试模型都存在普遍的过度推断现象（占其声明的35%到49%）；发现了“自我监控倒置”现象（模型自我评估的过度-推断水平与其真实测得的过度-推断水平呈负相关）；此外，过度推断具有任务依赖性，且在多轮对话中会线性累积。
AI.conclusion: 外部验证而非模型自我报告，才是确保个性化大语言模型真实性和可靠性的更可靠基础。
AI.translation: 具有持久记忆的个性化大语言模型正越来越多地被部署，然而其用户模型的忠实度仍未得到检验。我们研究了过度推断（OI）现象：即大语言模型在证据支持之外捏造用户属性的现象。我们引入了MirageBench，包含150个平衡了刻板印象、反刻板印象和中性特征的角色、跨越“想象梯度”的6个个性化任务、由独立裁判操作化的四分法忠实度分类标准（在400个声明上与盲法人工标注者进行验证：四分类 Cohen's kappa = 0.863，二分类 kappa = 0.900），以及一个涵盖来自7个系列的12个模型、针对143,616个被评估声明的排行榜。我们发现，过度推断是普遍存在的：所有12个模型中有每一个模型的过度推断比例都在35%至49%之间（跨模型均值41.6%；加权均值41.8%），评估中的没有一个模型能够幸免。最引人注目的是，我们揭示了一种“自我监控倒置”（Self-Monitoring Inversion）：在模型选择层面上，模型自我评估的过度推断与其经裁判测量的过度推断呈负相关（rho = -0.60, p = 0.044；探索性，宽引导置信区间 [-0.90, +0.06], n = 12）。报告过度推断最少的模型往往被判定为捏造最多的模型，因此自我报告的置信度在比较不同模型时是一个具有误导性的信号，尽管在单个模型内部，自我审计仍然能够中等程度地对其自身的声明进行排序（AUROC 0.58--0.83）。我们进一步表明，过度推断具有任务依赖性（27%--59%），并且在多轮对话试点中，推断出的属性大致呈线性累积且几乎没有修正。MirageBench将外部验证而非模型自我报告定位为更可靠的、实现可信个性化的基础。
AI.summary: 该研究通过引入MirageBench评估框架，发现所有测试的个性化大语言模型都存在严重的过度推断（捏造用户属性）现象，并且模型的自我监控存在倒置，即自我感觉良好的模型反而捏造更多，凸显了外部验证对可信个性化AI的必要性。
AI.keywords: 个性化大语言模型, 过度推断, 用户画像, 自我监控倒置, MirageBench
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了当前具有持续记忆的个性化大语言模型普遍存在“过度推断”（Fabrication）现象，并发现模型自我监控存在倒置（即自我感觉良好的模型往往捏造更多）。这对于评估和开发安全、可信的个性化AI系统具有重要的警示和指导意义。

title: Circular Economy Synergies and Trade-offs in Data Centres
summary:
This report analyses data centre (DC) sustainability and circularity, revealing existing synergies and trade-offs:
  The PUE is too coarse, mixing cooling and power provisioning. It wrongly attributes server fan consumption and transformation losses to IT energy. It does not measure compute but infrastructure efficiency, which is already outstanding. Compute energy, however, is exploding. Better energy metrics for DCs would thus cover i) compute efficiency, ii) transformation efficiency, and iii) cooling overhead.
  Trade-offs exist between cooling energy and water as well as on-site and upstream water: Consuming water on-site lowers the cooling energy, which also lowers the water consumed upstream in power generation. For 'wet' electricity, there is little competition: It is worth spending more on-site energy to save both electricity and related upstream water. For 'dry' electricity, there is a trade-off.
  Waste heat recovery brings energy circularity but has limited uses and is not the same energy quality, a fact not reflected by current metrics. A better metric would consider the avoided energy through heat recovery instead of the amount recovered.
  Material circularity can be achieved by interpreting the 9R framework in the context of DCs. Circularity-enhancing measures can be categorised into product design, process design and business models, choice of materials, and operating conditions. Together, they have effects across all circularity levels.
  The relation between DCs and the power grid is complex. Modern DCs present new challenges for the grid. Mitigation includes battery storage and onsite generation. These measures have, in turn, further consequences, both beneficial and detrimental. They can offer grid flexibility as well as innovations in the field of energy. But they also bring noise, pollution, and GHGs, and compete with the energy sector for resources.

AI.title_translation: 数据中心的循环经济协同效应与权衡
AI.tldr: 本报告揭示了数据中心在能效、水耗、余热、材料和电网互动方面的可持续性挑战与权衡，并指出了改进度量衡和循环策略的必要性。
AI.motivation: 分析数据中心在追求可持续发展和循环经济过程中存在的协同效应与权衡（Trade-offs），指出传统指标的不足并探讨改进方向。
AI.method: 通过分析数据中心的可持续性与循环性，评估现有指标（如PUE），探讨冷却与水耗、余热回收、材料循环（9R框架）以及数据中心与电网的关系。
AI.result: 指出了PUE指标的缺陷并提出了改进方向；揭示了现场冷却能耗与水耗、上游水耗之间的权衡关系；分析了余热回收、材料循环（9R框架）以及数据中心对电网的复杂影响。
AI.conclusion: 数据中心的可持续发展需要超越粗糙的PUE指标，全面权衡能源、水、余热、材料及电网互动的复杂影响，采用更精细的评估和循环经济策略。
AI.translation:
本报告分析了数据中心（DC）的可持续性和循环性，揭示了现有的协同效应与权衡：
PUE过于粗糙，将冷却和电力供应混为一谈。它错误地将服务器风扇功耗和转换损耗归因于IT能耗。它衡量的不是计算效率，而是基础设施效率，而后者已经非常出色。然而，计算能耗却在爆炸式增长。因此，更好的DC能源指标应涵盖：i）计算效率，ii）转换效率，iii）冷却开销。
冷却能耗与水耗之间，以及现场用水与上游用水之间存在权衡：现场消耗水会降低冷却能耗，从而也减少了发电过程中上游消耗的水。对于“湿”电力，竞争不大：值得花更多的现场能量来节省电力和相关的上游水。对于“干”电力，则存在权衡。
余热回收带来了能源循环性，但用途有限且能量质量不同，当前指标并未反映这一事实。更好的指标应考虑通过热回收避免的能量，而不是回收的数量。
材料循环性可以通过在DC背景下解释9R框架来实现在。提高循环性的措施可分为产品设计、过程设计与商业模式、材料选择和运行条件。它们共同对所有循环级别产生影响。
数据中心与电网的关系复杂。现代DC给电网带来了新挑战。缓解措施包括电池存储和现场发电。这些措施反过来又会带来进一步的后果，既有益也有害。它们可以提供电网灵活性以及能源领域的创新。但它们也会带来噪音、污染和温室气体，并与能源部门争夺资源。
AI.summary: 本报告分析了数据中心在可持续性和循环经济方面的协同效应与权衡，涵盖能效指标缺陷、水冷权衡、余热回收质量、材料循环性以及数据中心与电网的复杂关系。
AI.keywords: 数据中心, 循环经济, 能效指标, 水能权衡, 电网互动
AI.comments: 该报告全面剖析了数据中心在可持续性和循环经济方面面临的复杂权衡与协同效应，指出了现有指标（如PUE）的局限性，并对能源、水资源、余热利用、材料循环及电网互动提出了深刻见解。

title: When Memory Lies: An Empirical Study of Spatial Memory Staleness in VLM Agents
summary: Memory-augmented VLM agents act on persistent spatial knowledge, yet that knowledge silently goes stale as the environment changes. We ask what happens when an agent must reconcile a confident memory claim with a contradicting observation, and whether current models can catch the conflict before it becomes a safety-relevant mistake. Using a dynamic FrozenLake testbed, we pair a staleness-detection task with a downstream navigation task across three closed-source models and three open-weight VLMs under both text and image inputs (1,800 detection runs, and 12,000 text-mode navigation episodes over four LLM navigators at a shared 50-seed scale). Three findings emerge. First, text solvability does not imply visual grounding: models that flag stale entries reliably from text nonetheless span vision F1 from 0.887 down to 0.067 on the identical grids, and the weakest keeps making fluent, confident decisions that ignore the image. Second, consuming stale memory without an audit is a safety liability: in our primary GPT-4o setting, an agent that trusts raw memory dies more than twice as often as the same agent given no memory at all. Third, auditing helps but does not close the gap: a transparent read-time filter removes much of the safety cost in text mode, yet even oracle stale labels bring no further significant gain on the current grid size, and when visual auditing is unreliable, filtering yields no consistent benefit. Together these results frame spatial-memory staleness as a safety failure mode and isolate reliable visual grounding and action selection under memory--observation conflict as the central open challenges for memory-augmented agents.

AI.title_translation: 当记忆说谎：VLM代理中空间记忆过时状况的实证研究
AI.tldr: 当视觉语言模型代理依赖过时的空间记忆时会导致严重的安全性失败，盲目信任记忆甚至比没有记忆更危险，凸显了可靠视觉基础和冲突解决的必要性。
AI.motivation: 记忆增强的VLM代理依赖持久的空间知识，但环境变化会导致知识静默过时；研究旨在探讨当代理必须协调自信的记忆主张与矛盾的观察时会发生什么，以及当前模型是否能在其变成安全相关错误之前发现冲突。
AI.method: 使用动态FrozenLake测试平台，跨3个闭源模型和3个开源VLM，结合文本和图像输入，进行了1800次检测运行和12000次文本模式导航回合，评估了 staleness-detection（过时检测）任务和下游导航任务。
AI.result: 1) 文本可解性并不意味着视觉基础扎实，弱模型会忽略图像做出自信决策；2) 未经审计的陈旧记忆是一个安全隐患，盲目信任记忆的代理其死亡率是没有记忆代理的两倍以上；3) 审计有帮助但无法完全弥补差距，当视觉审计不可靠时，过滤无法带来持续收益。
AI.conclusion: 空间记忆过时是VLM代理的一个重大安全失效模式，其核心挑战在于实现可靠的视觉基础以及在记忆与观察冲突时的动作选择。
AI.translation: 记忆增强的视觉语言模型（VLM）代理依赖于持久的空间知识，然而随着环境的变化，这些知识会悄然过时。我们探讨了当代理必须协调自信的记忆断言与相矛盾的观察时会发生的情况，以及当前模型是否能够在错误演变成安全相关的失误之前捕捉到冲突。使用动态的FrozenLake测试平台，我们在三种闭源模型和三种开源VLM下，结合文本和图像输入，将过时检测任务与下游导航任务配对（在共享的50随机种子规模下，进行了1,800次检测运行和12,000次文本模式导航回合，涉及四个LLM导航器）。得出了三个发现。首先，文本可解性并不意味着视觉基础：能够从文本中可靠标记过时条目的模型，在相同网格上的视觉F1分数从0.887降至0.067，最弱的模型不断做出流畅、自信但忽略图像的决策。其次，在没有审计的情况下消耗过时的记忆是一个安全隐患：在我们主要的GPT-4o设置中，盲目相信原始记忆的代理其死亡率超过了完全没有记忆的代理的两倍。第三，审计有所帮助但未能弥补差距：透明的读取时间过滤器消除了文本模式中的大部分安全成本，然而即使是预言机（oracle）提供的过时标签在当前网格大小下也没有带来进一步的显着增益，并且当视觉审计不可靠时，过滤也不会产生持续的好处。总之，这些结果将空间记忆过时框定为一个安全失效模式，并将记忆-观察冲突下的可靠视觉基础和动作选择隔离为记忆增强代理的核心开放挑战。
AI.summary: 该论文通过动态FrozenLake测试平台，实证研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）代理中空间记忆过时的现象及其安全影响。研究发现，文本能力不等于视觉基础，盲目信任陈旧记忆会显著增加安全风险，而审计机制虽有帮助但受限于视觉不可靠性。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 空间记忆, 记忆过时, 视觉基础, 安全性
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的动态FrozenLake实验平台，揭示了视觉语言模型（VLM）在空间记忆过时时的严重安全隐患，强调了视觉基础与冲突解决能力的缺失，对未来具身智能和记忆增强Agent的安全研究具有重要意义。

title: PhysMind: From Video to Executable Worlds for Training-Free Physical Reasoning
summary: Reliable physical reasoning from video requires understanding how objects move, interact, and respond to interventions. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) often struggle to interpret these dynamics and reason reliably about future and counterfactual outcomes. We introduce PhysMind, a training-free agentic framework that constructs one reusable, question-agnostic executable world per video. PhysMind recovers a temporally consistent dynamic scene through object segmentation, mesh reconstruction, and 6D pose tracking, then fits analytic continuous-time dynamics and latent physical parameters without unrolling a time-stepped simulator. Given a question, it inspects, continues, or edits the world and answers from the resulting trajectories and interactions. Relative to direct chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with the same VLM, PhysMind improves accuracy by 38.23 points on CLEVRER and 8.08 points on Physion++. On counterfactual questions, it exceeds the strongest evaluated VLM baseline, GPT-5.5, by 19.25 points.

AI.title_translation: PhysMind：从视频到用于免训练物理推理的可执行世界
AI.tldr: 提出PhysMind框架，通过将视频转化为可执行世界并进行物理参数拟合，大幅提升了视觉语言模型的未来预测与反事实物理推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在理解物体运动、交互以及对未来和反事实结果进行可靠推理方面往往存在困难。
AI.method: 提出PhysMind框架，通过对象分割、网格重建和6D姿态跟踪恢复时间一致的动态场景，并拟合解析连续时间动力学和潜在物理参数，而无需展开时间步进模拟器。针对具体问题，通过检查、延续或编辑该世界并根据结果轨迹和交互进行回答。
AI.result: 在CLEVRER数据集上准确率提升38.23个百分点，在Physion++上提升8.08个百分点；在反事实问题上，比最强的评估VLM基线（GPT-5.5）高出19.25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: PhysMind通过将视频转化为可执行的世界并在其中进行分析与推理，有效克服了现有视觉语言模型在动态物理推理上的不足，显著提升了预测和反事实推理的准确性。
AI.translation: 从视频中进行可靠的物理推理需要理解物体如何运动、交互以及对干预做出响应。现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）往往难以解释这些动力学，并对未来和反事实结果进行可靠推理。我们介绍了PhysMind，这是一个无需训练的智能体框架，它为每个视频构建一个可重用的、与问题无关的可执行世界。PhysMind通过对象分割、网格重建和6D姿态跟踪恢复时间一致的动态场景，然后拟合解析的连续时间动力学和潜在的物理参数，而无需展开时间步进模拟器。给定一个问题，它检查、延续或编辑这个世界，并根据由此产生的轨迹和交互进行回答。相对于使用相同VLM的直接思维链（CoT）推理，PhysMind在CLEVRER上的准确率提高了38.23个百分点，在Physion++上提高了8.08个百分点。在反事实问题上，它比评估的最强VLM基线GPT-5.5高出19.25个百分点。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了PhysMind，一个无需训练的智能体框架，它将视频构建为可重用的、与问题无关的可执行世界，用于实现可靠的物理推理。通过场景重建和连续时间动力学拟合，PhysMind能够高效回答关于未来的预测和反事实问题，并在多个基准测试中大幅超越现有的VLM方法。
AI.keywords: 物理推理, 视觉语言模型, 动态场景重建, 可执行世界, 智能体框架
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的智能体框架PhysMind，通过将视频转化为可执行的物理世界进行物理推理，避免了传统时间步进模拟器的复杂性，并在多个物理推理基准测试中展现出显著的性能提升。

title: Causal Evidence Extraction and Triangulation in Crisis Reports using Large Language Models: A ReliefWeb-based Study
summary: Humanitarian reports are long, noisy, and multi-topic, making it difficult to consolidate decision-relevant causal evidence. We present a ReliefWeb study (2000-2024) and a two-stage Large Language Model (LLM) pipeline that extracts structured intervention-outcome records with direction and strength attributes. Query-conditioned extraction restricts output to a specified intervention class, reducing retrieval-induced over-extraction, while snippet grounding links each relation to supporting text for auditability and classification. In an expert-annotated dataset of 100 reports, the best closed-source LLM achieved a weighted F1 score of 90.73% with strong cost-efficiency, while Llama-3.1-8B with supervised fine-tuning reached 94.15% weighted F1 score. We further propose context-preserving triangulation that aggregates strength-weighted evidence within disaster$\times$source cells, applies Laplace smoothing and equally weights cells to quantify cross-context convergence via a Level-of-Evidence score. Applied to cash assistance, food-related outcomes show strong positive convergence (LoE=0.865) and stable long-horizon trajectories.

AI.title_translation: 利用大语言模型在危机报告中提取和三角验证因果证据：基于ReliefWeb的研究
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的两阶段流水线及三角验证方法，用于从危机报告中高效提取和量化因果证据，为灾害应对决策提供了可靠支持。
AI.motivation: 人道主义报告通常冗长、充满噪声且包含多个主题，这使得整合决策相关的因果证据变得十分困难。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段大语言模型流水线（包括查询条件提取和代码段落地支撑），并使用监督微调的Llama-3.1-8B及闭源LLM；同时提出上下文保持的三角验证方法，通过计算证据水平得分来量化跨上下文的收敛性。
AI.result: 最佳闭源大语言模型在专家标注的100篇报告数据集上取得了90.73%的加权F1分数，而经过监督微调的Llama-3.1-8B达到了94.15%的加权F1分数。将该方法应用于现金援助时，发现食品相关结果表现出强烈的正向收敛（LoE=0.865）和稳定的长期轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了利用大语言模型从危机报告中提取和三角验证因果证据的可行性与高效性，为基于证据的人道主义决策提供了强大的技术支撑。
AI.translation: 人道主义报告冗长、充满噪声且包含多个主题，这使得整合决策相关的因果证据变得十分困难。我们展示了一项基于ReliefWeb（2000-2024年）的研究以及一个两阶段大语言模型（LLM）流水线，该流水线可提取带有方向和强度属性的结构化干预-结果记录。查询条件提取将输出限制在指定的干预类别中，减少了检索引起的过度提取，而代码段落地则将每个关系链接到支持文本，以实现可审计性和分类。在一个包含100篇报告的专家标注数据集中，最佳的闭源LLM取得了90.73%的加权F1分数，且具有很高的成本效益，而经过监督微调的Llama-3.1-8B达到了94.15%的加权F1分数。我们进一步提出了上下文保持的三角验证方法，该方法在灾害×来源单元内聚合强度加权的证据，应用拉普拉斯平滑并平等地加权单元，通过证据水平得分来量化跨上下文的收敛性。将其应用于现金援助，与食品相关的结果显示出强烈的正向收敛（LoE=0.865）和稳定的长期轨迹。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的两阶段流水线和上下文保持的三角验证方法，用于从2000年至2024年的ReliefWeb危机报告中提取、归纳和量化因果证据，显著提升了人道主义干预效果评估的准确性与可审计性。
AI.keywords: 因果证据提取, 大语言模型, 人道主义危机报告, 三角验证, ReliefWeb
AI.comments: 本研究创新性地将大语言模型与因果证据提取及三角验证相结合，针对人道主义危机报告中的长文本与多主题痛点，提出了两阶段LLM流水线和上下文保持的三角验证方法，兼具高准确率与可解释性。

title: ACA-GS: Adaptive-Capacity Anchored Gaussian Splatting for Compact Dynamic Radiance Fields
comments: 9 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Recent advances in 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) enable high-fidelity, real-time spatiotemporal rendering, but expose a fundamental trade-off between motion expressiveness and storage efficiency. While anchor-based designs achieve compactness through anchor-level parameter sharing, their rigid uniform parametrization enforces fixed Neural Gaussian counts and feature budgets per anchor. Consequently, insufficient fidelity is addressed by excessive anchor density, rather than lightweight, targeted increases in Neural Gaussian count or feature capacity, resulting in memory waste. To overcome this rigidity, we introduce an adaptive-capacity anchor-based framework that dynamically allocates the representational capacity based on local spatiotemporal demands. Adaptive Anchor Cardinality varies the number of Neural Gaussians per anchor, concentrating primitives in regions of high geometric or motion complexity while suppressing redundancy. In parallel, Adaptive Anchor Feature Masking modulates anchor-level feature channels, assigning rich features to complex regions and lightweight representations to simpler ones. Experiments on MPEG, Panoptic Sports, and N3DV datasets demonstrate substantial storage reduction without degrading visual quality. Notably, on challenging MPEG sequences with complex motion, our method achieves up to 1.5x higher compression than state-of-the-art anchor-based methods while preserving comparable quality.
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026

AI.title_translation: ACA-GS：用于紧凑动态辐射场的自适应容量锚点高斯泼溅
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ACA-GS的动态辐射场压缩方法，通过按需自适应分配神经高斯数量和特征通道，在保持渲染质量的同时实现了比现有锚点方法高1.5倍的压缩率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于锚点的4D高斯泼溅方法虽然能通过参数共享实现紧凑性，但其刚性的均匀参数化强制每个锚点具有固定的神经高斯数量和特征预算，导致在处理复杂区域时通过增加整体锚点密度来弥补不足，从而造成内存浪费。
AI.method: 引入自适应容量锚点框架，具体包括：1）自适应锚点基数（Adaptive Anchor Cardinality），根据局部时空需求动态调整每个锚点的神经高斯数量；2）自适应锚点特征掩码（Adaptive Anchor Feature Masking），根据复杂度动态调节锚点级特征通道。
AI.result: 在MPEG、Panoptic Sports和N3DV数据集上的实验表明，该方法在不降低视觉质量的前提下大幅减少了存储空间，在复杂的MPEG序列上比现有的最新锚点方法实现了高达1.5倍的压缩率。
AI.conclusion: ACA-GS通过自适应调整锚点容量和特征，成功解决了现有4D高斯泼溅方法中由于参数刚性分配导致的内存浪费问题，实现了高压缩率与高质量的平衡。
AI.translation: 最近4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）的进展实现了高保真、实时的时空渲染，但也暴露了运动表现力与存储效率之间的根本权衡。虽然基于锚点的设计通过锚点级别的参数共享实现了紧凑性，但其刚性的均匀参数化对每个锚点强制规定了固定的神经高斯数量和特征预算。因此，保真度不足的问题往往通过过多的锚点密度来解决，而不是针对性地、轻量级地增加神经高斯数量或特征容量，从而导致内存浪费。为了克服这种刚性，我们引入了一种基于锚点的自适应容量框架，根据局部时空需求动态分配表征能力。自适应锚点基数改变每个锚点的神经高斯数量，在几何或运动复杂度高的区域集中图元，同时抑制冗余。同时，自适应锚点特征掩码调节锚点级别的特征通道，为复杂区域分配丰富的特征，为简单区域分配轻量级表示。在MPEG、Panoptic Sports和N3DV数据集上的实验证明了在不降低视觉质量的情况下大幅减少存储。值得注意的是，在具有复杂运动的挑战性MPEG序列上，我们的方法在保持可比质量的同时，实现了比先进的基于锚点的方法高达1.5倍的压缩率。
AI.summary: 论文提出了ACA-GS（自适应容量锚点高斯泼溅）框架，用于紧凑的动态辐射场。通过自适应调整每个锚点的神经高斯数量和特征通道，该方法在局部时空复杂度高的地方集中资源，在简单区域减少冗余，从而在显著提升压缩率的同时保持了渲染质量。
AI.keywords: 4D Gaussian Splatting, Dynamic Radiance Fields, Compression, Adaptive Capacity, Anchor-based
AI.comments: 该论文针对4D高斯泼溅中运动表达能力与存储效率之间的权衡问题，提出了自适应容量锚点框架。创新点在于通过动态分配神经高斯数量和特征通道，有效减少了冗余，在大幅降低存储的同时保持了高渲染质量。

title: A Separator-based Algorithm for the Graph Edit Distance Problem
summary:
The Graph Edit Distance (GED) is a widely used graph similarity measure asking for the minimum cost of a sequence of edits transforming one (labeled) graph into another. The considered edit operations are deletion, insertion, and relabeling of nodes and edges. Special cases include the Graph Isomorphism problem, as well as many other graph problems that ask for the existence or minimum cost of a certain substructure, like the Traveling Salesman or Maximum Clique problem.
  We present a novel exponential time algorithm to compute the exact GED and a corresponding edit sequence in $O^*(4 + \varepsilon)^n$ time and polynomial space, provided one of the two graphs admits strictly sublinear balanced separators. In particular, the claimed runtime holds if one of the graphs is $K_h$-minor free (e.g., planar), or has bounded treewidth, which is the case for many real-world applications (e.g., all instances in GEDLIB). This substantially improves the best known worst-case running time bounds of $O^*(n!)$ for these graph classes.

AI.title_translation: 基于分离器的图编辑距离问题算法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对特定图类（如平面图、有界树宽图）的高效精确图编辑距离算法，将最坏情况时间复杂度从 $O^*(n!)$ 降至 $O^*(4 + \varepsilon)^n$。
AI.motivation: 传统的图编辑距离（GED）问题在最坏情况下的精确算法运行时间高达 $O^*(n!)$，效率极低，因此需要针对具有特殊结构（如现实世界中常见的平面图或有界树宽图）的图设计更高效的精确算法。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于分离器的新型指数时间算法，利用图的次线性平衡分离器性质来计算精确的图编辑距离和对应的编辑序列。
AI.result: 在其中一个图允许严格次线性平衡分离器（如 $K_h$-minor自由图或有界树宽图）的前提下，该算法能在 $O^*(4 + \varepsilon)^n$ 时间和多项式空间内计算出精确的图编辑距离及编辑序列，大幅改进了现有最坏情况下的运行时间界限。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一种基于分离器的指数时间精确算法，用于解决图编辑距离问题，在特定图类（如平面图、无Minor图）上实现了显著的运行时间优化。
AI.translation:
图编辑距离（GED）是一种广泛使用的图相似性度量，它要求将一个（带标签的）图转换为另一个图所需的最小编辑操作序列的成本。考虑的编辑操作包括节点和边的删除、插入和重新贴标签。特殊情况包括图同构问题，以及许多其他要求存在某种子结构或其最小成本的图问题，例如旅行商问题或最大团问题。
我们提出了一种新颖的指数时间算法，用于在 $O^*(4 + \varepsilon)^n$ 时间和多项式空间内计算精确的GED及相应的编辑序列，前提是两个图之一允许严格次线性平衡分离器。特别地，如果其中一个图是 $K_h$-minor 自由图（例如平面图）或具有有界的树宽（这对于许多现实世界的应用都是成立的，例如GEDLIB中的所有实例），则所声称的运行时间成立。这实质性地改进了这些图类中已知的最佳最坏情况运行时间界限 $O^*(n!)$。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对图编辑距离（GED）的新型指数时间精确算法。当输入图之一具有次线性平衡分离器（如无Minor图或有界树宽图）时，该算法能在 $O^*(4 + \varepsilon)^n$ 时间和多项式空间内运行，显著优于以往 $O^*(n!)$ 的最坏情况时间复杂度。
AI.keywords: Graph Edit Distance, Separator-based Algorithm, Exponential Time, Minor-free Graphs, Treewidth
AI.comments: 该论文在图编辑距离（GED）精确求解方面取得了突破性进展，利用图的分离器性质（如次线性平衡分离器、无Minor图或有界树宽图），将传统的最坏情况运行时间从 $O^*(n!)$ 大幅降低到 $O^*(4 + \varepsilon)^n$。这对于实际应用（如GEDLIB中的实例）具有重要意义。

title: Fast Thick-Thin Decomposition for Sparse Spanners on Hyperbolic Surfaces
summary:
We consider spanners for point sets lying in the hyperbolic plane or on a closed hyperbolic surface with the restriction that spanner edges are not allowed to cross. This is a natural generalization of non-crossing Euclidean spanners. Thus, the resulting spanner graphs are embedded in the hyperbolic plane or on the hyperbolic surface. As our main contribution, we show that there are sparse $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanners for these problems when we are allowed to use Steiner points:
  - on the hyperbolic plane we get a non-crossing Steiner $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanner with $\mathcal{O}(n / \varepsilon^2)$ edges,
  - on hyperbolic surfaces of genus $g$ we get a Steiner $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanner with $\mathcal{O}(n / \varepsilon^{3/2} + g/\varepsilon^2)$ non-crossing edges, or with $\mathcal{O}(n / \sqrt{\varepsilon} + g/\varepsilon)$ edges that are allowed to cross.
  In particular, our spanners on surfaces have sparsity with linear dependence on $g$, rather than the easier-to-attain exponential dependence, and the terms $n/\varepsilon^{3/2}$ and $n/\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ match the current best Euclidean results for plane and crossing Steiner spanners, respectively.
  As a corollary of our non-crossing spanner and techniques from the existing literature on light spanners and minor-free TSP, we get an EPTAS for TSP on hyperbolic surfaces.
  Our surface constructions rely on the thick-thin decomposition, a standard tool for studying hyperbolic surfaces. For convex hyperbolic polygons, we introduce an analogous neck decomposition. We give algorithms that compute the thick-thin decomposition of a genus-$g$ surface in $\mathcal{O}(g^4\log g)$ time and the neck decomposition of an $n$-vertex polygon in $\mathcal{O}(n)$ time.

AI.title_translation: 双曲面上稀疏Spanner的快速厚薄分解
AI.tldr: 本文实现了双曲面上稀疏 Steiner spanner 的快速厚薄分解，并首次达到了对亏格的线性稀疏度依赖。
AI.motivation: 为了研究双曲平面或闭双曲面上受限于边不相交条件下的点集spanner问题，并突破现有文献中对于曲面亏格呈现指数依赖的局限。
AI.method: 利用双曲面的厚薄分解（thick-thin decomposition）以及针对凸双曲多边形的颈部分解（neck decomposition）技术，设计了相应的快速算法。
AI.result: 在双曲平面上得到了具有 O(n/ε²) 条边的非相交Steiner (1+ε)-spanner；在亏格为 g 的双曲面上得到了非相交边或允许相交边的最优稀疏度 spanner，并且与亏格 g 呈线性相关；同时给出了计算厚薄分解的 O(g^4 log g) 时间算法和颈部分解的 O(n) 时间算法。
AI.conclusion: 作者成功在双曲面及双曲平面上构造了具有理论最优稀疏度的Steiner spanner，并给出了曲面TSP的EPTAS算法。
AI.translation:
我们研究了位于双曲平面或闭双曲面上的点集的 spanner，其限制条件是 spanner 的边不允许相交。这是对非相交欧几里得 spanner 的自然推广。因此，生成的 spanner 图被嵌入在双曲平面或双曲面上。作为我们的主要贡献，我们证明了在使用 Steiner 点的情况下，这些问题存在稀疏的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanner：
  - 在双曲平面上，我们得到了一个具有 $\mathcal{O}(n / \varepsilon^2)$ 条边的非相交 Steiner $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanner；
  - 在亏格为 $g$ 的双曲面上，我们得到了一个具有 $\mathcal{O}(n / \varepsilon^{3/2} + g/\varepsilon^2)$ 条非相交边的 Steiner $(1+\varepsilon)$-spanner，或者具有 $\mathcal{O}(n / \sqrt{\varepsilon} + g/\varepsilon)$ 条允许相交的边的 Steiner spanner。
  特别是，我们在曲面上的 spanner 具有对 $g$ 的线性依赖稀疏度，而不是较容易达到的指数依赖，并且项 $n/\varepsilon^{3/2}$ 和 $n/\sqrt{\varepsilon}$ 分别匹配了当前最佳的平面和相交 Steiner spanner 的欧几里得结果。
  作为我们的非相交 spanner 以及现有关于轻量 spanner 和无子图 TSP 文献中技术的推论，我们得到了双曲面上 TSP 的 EPTAS。
  我们的曲面构造依赖于厚薄分解（研究双曲面的标准工具）。对于凸双曲多边形，我们引入了类似的颈部分解。我们给出了在 $\mathcal{O}(g^4\log g)$ 时间内计算亏格为 $g$ 的表面的厚薄分解的算法，以及在 $\mathcal{O}(n)$ 时间内计算 $n$ 顶点多边形的颈部分解的算法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了双曲平面和闭双曲面上的稀疏 spanner 问题，提出了一种利用厚薄分解和颈部分解快速构建 Steiner (1+ε)-spanner 的方法，实现了与曲面亏格呈线性相关的稀疏度，并推导出了双曲面上 TSP 的 EPTAS 算法。
AI.keywords: 双曲面, Spanner, 厚薄分解, Steiner点, 运行时间优化
AI.comments: 该论文在双曲面上实现了高效的稀疏Steiner (1+ε)-spanner构建，通过巧妙的厚薄分解和颈部分解，首次在曲面上实现了对亏格 g 的线性依赖稀疏度，并导出了双曲面上TSP的EPTAS，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Breaking the Curse ofMultilinguality inMany-to-Many Speech-to-Text Translation via a Resource-AwareMixture of Speech Encoders
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant success in speech-to-text translation (S2TT). However, when processing multilingual speech inputs, a single speech encoder shared across all languages suffers from the curse of multilinguality: languages at different resource levels compete for limited representation capacity, leading to strong high-resource performance but substantial degradation on low-resource speech. To address this problem and improve multilingual consistency, we propose MSRT, a novel framework built around a resource-aware Mixture of Speech Encoders (MoSE). MoSE uses an explicit language router to assign each utterance to an appropriate expert encoder. A frozen expert preserves high-resource language capabilities, while a trainable expert adapts to and specializes in medium- and low-resource languages. We further introduce a five-stage curriculum learning strategy that substantially reduces data dependence, requiring only 10 hours of paired S2TT data per language for effective alignment. We conduct extensive experiments on 45 languages, systematically evaluating all $45 \times 44$ translation directions. Our 4B-parameter model achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming substantially larger baselines. Empirical analyses show that MoSE improves high-, medium-, and low-resource languages simultaneously, with the largest gains on low-resource speech, thereby breaking the curse of multilinguality without compromising high-resource performance. To support future multilingual S2TT research, we release our code and models.

AI.title_translation: 通过资源感知语音编码器混合打破多语言到多语言语音文本翻译中的多语言诅咒
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MSRT框架，通过资源感知混合语音编码器（MoSE）和高效的课程学习策略，成功解决了语音翻译中的“多语言诅咒”难题，在45种语言上实现了最先进的翻译性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在语音到文本翻译中取得了成功，但单一共用语音编码器在处理多语言输入时会遭受“多语言诅咒”，导致高低资源语言竞争有限的表示容量，从而严重降低低资源语音的翻译性能。
AI.method: 提出MSRT框架，包含资源感知混合语音编码器（MoSE）以及显式语言路由器，结合冻结的高资源专家和可训练的中低资源专家，并引入五阶段课程学习策略。
AI.result: 在45种语言（45×44个翻译方向）的广泛实验中，4B参数的模型取得了最先进的性能，超越了更大的基线模型，且同时提升了高、中、低资源语言的性能，特别是在低资源语音上增幅最大。
AI.conclusion: MSRT框架通过资源感知的混合语音编码器和五阶段课程学习策略，成功打破了多语言语音翻译中的“多语言诅咒”，在45种语言上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在语音到文本翻译（S2TT）中取得了显著成功。然而，在处理多语言语音输入时，所有语言共享的单一语音编码器会遭受多语言诅咒：不同资源水平的语言会争夺有限的表示容量，导致高资源语言性能强劲，而低资源语音性能大幅下降。为了解决这一问题并提高多语言一致性，我们提出了MSRT，这是一个围绕资源感知混合语音编码器（MoSE）构建的新型框架。MoSE使用显式语言路由器将每个话语分配给合适的专家编码器。冻结的专家保留了高资源语言的能力，而可训练的专家则适应并专门处理中低资源语言。我们进一步引入了一个五阶段课程学习策略，大大减少了对数据的依赖，每种语言只需10小时的配对S2TT数据即可进行有效对齐。我们在45种语言上进行了广泛的实验，系统地评估了所有45×44个翻译方向。我们的4B参数模型取得了最先进的性能，优于体量大得多的基线模型。实证分析表明，MoSE同时改善了高、中、低资源语言，其中低资源语音的增幅最大，从而在不损害高资源性能的情况下打破了多语言诅咒。为了支持未来的多语言S2TT研究，我们开源了代码和模型。
AI.summary: 本文针对多语言语音翻译中的资源竞争问题，提出了MSRT框架。该框架利用资源感知混合语音编码器（MoSE）和五阶段课程学习策略，有效解决了多语言诅咒，在45种语言的翻译任务上实现了SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 语音到文本翻译, 多语言诅咒, 混合语音编码器, 课程学习, 多模态大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对语音到文本翻译中多语言模型面临的“多语言诅咒”问题，创新性地提出了资源感知混合语音编码器（MoSE）和五阶段课程学习策略，在保持高资源语言性能的同时显著提升了中低资源语言的翻译质量，具有很高的实用价值和学术意义。

title: MetaVideoAgent: Automated Video-Agent Evolution for Long-Form Video Understanding
summary:
Long-form video understanding requires locating sparse, question-relevant evidence in long, multimodal videos. Real-world video distributions differ in modality-specific information density, content structure, and evidence patterns, causing fixed video-agent designs to incur redundant processing or fail when mismatched. Extending automated agent evolution from text to video is challenging because full long-video execution makes candidate validation expensive, failures propagate across coupled evidence-processing stages, and complex preprocessing, perception tools, and localization strategies make code-level updates difficult to implement reliably.
  We introduce MetaVideoAgent, a framework that automatically evolves a video agent for a target distribution. It profiles information density and evidence requirements from sparsely sampled frames and associated queries to guide initial design, then compresses localized failures into independently executable minimal validation tasks. It constructs evidence-grounded Gold Paths, audits Student trajectories, aggregates recurring failures across samples, and attributes them to responsible modules. A modular agent representation constrains each update to the primary responsible module and its necessary dependencies.
  We further introduce VA-EvoBench, covering eight video distributions with separate evolution and held-out splits. With four evolution iterations per distribution, MetaVideoAgent improves every initial agent and raises macro-average accuracy from 38.44% to 51.47%, at an average evolution cost of 3.54M tokens per distribution. The evolved agents outperform the strongest prior fixed-design video agent by 6.39 percentage points while using the fewest tokens and video frames per question among the compared video agents. We will release all code and data to support reproducible research.

AI.title_translation: MetaVideoAgent：面向长视频理解的自动化视频智能体演化
AI.tldr: MetaVideoAgent 是一个自动演化视频智能体的框架，能根据特定视频分布动态优化智能体结构，显著提升长视频理解的准确率并降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的视频分布具有多样性，固定设计的视频智能体容易导致冗余处理或匹配失效；而将自动化智能体演化扩展到视频领域面临验证成本高、错误传播以及代码级更新困难等挑战，为此需要一个自动化的演化框架。
AI.method: 提出 MetaVideoAgent 框架，通过稀疏采样帧和查询引导初始设计，将本地化失败压缩为独立任务，构建证据支撑的黄金路径，审计学生轨迹，并在模块化智能体表示下进行针对性更新与演化。
AI.result: 在 VA-EvoBench 的八个视频分布上，MetaVideoAgent 将宏平均准确率从 38.44% 提升至 51.47%，超越了最强的固定设计视频智能体 6.39 个百分点，且每个问题的平均 token 和视频帧消耗最少。
AI.conclusion: MetaVideoAgent 成功实现了针对长视频理解任务的自动化视频智能体演化，在提升性能的同时大幅减少了计算资源的消耗。
AI.translation:
长视频理解需要在漫长的多模态视频中定位稀疏且与问题相关的证据。现实世界的视频分布在模态特定的信息密度、内容结构和证据模式上各不相同，这导致固定的视频智能体设计会导致冗余处理或在不匹配时失效。将自动化智能体演化从文本扩展到视频具有挑战性，因为完整的长视频执行使得候选验证成本高昂，失败会在耦合的证据处理阶段传播，且复杂的预处理、感知工具和定位策略使得代码级更新难以可靠地实现。
我们介绍了 MetaVideoAgent，这是一个自动为目标分布演化视频智能体的框架。它通过稀疏采样的帧和关联的查询来配置文件信息密度和证据需求以指导初始设计，然后将局部失败压缩为可独立执行的最小验证任务。它构建了以证据为基础的黄金路径（Gold Paths），审计学生轨迹，聚合样本中反复出现的失败，并将它们归因于负责任的模块。模块化智能体表示将每个更新限制在主要的负责任模块及其必要的依赖项上。
我们进一步推出了 VA-EvoBench，涵盖八个视频分布，并具有独立的演化集和留出集。在每个分布进行四次演化迭代的情况下，MetaVideoAgent 改进了每一个初始智能体，将宏平均准确率从 38.44% 提高到 51.47%，每个分布的平均演化成本为 3.54M 个 token。演化后的智能体比最强的先前固定设计视频智能体高出 6.39 个百分点，同时在对比的视频智能体中使用了最少的 token 和每个问题的视频帧。我们将发布所有代码和数据以支持可重复研究。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 MetaVideoAgent，一个能够自动为目标视频分布演化视频智能体的框架。通过分析稀疏采样的视频帧和查询来引导初始设计，结合模块化智能体表示与独立的错误验证和归因机制，有效解决了长视频理解中固定智能体设计失效与验证成本高昂的问题。同时，作者推出了 VA-EvoBench 基准测试集，实验表明演化后的智能体在准确率和效率上均表现优异。
AI.keywords: 长视频理解, 自动化智能体演化, 模块化设计, 证据定位, 智能体优化
AI.comments: 该论文将自动化智能体演化技术从文本领域成功拓展至长视频理解领域，通过高效的模块化设计和错误归因机制，显著降低了长视频处理的计算开销并提升了准确率，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。

title: EASy: Towards Efficient LLM-Based Agentic System
summary: Agentic systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks by coordinating specialized LLM-based agents. However, most existing systems primarily optimize task success while giving limited consideration to execution efficiency under practical constraints such as executor capability and computational cost. Existing router-based methods have limited ability to reason over rich, evolving task contexts, multi-step dependencies, and intermediate execution feedback, and often generalize poorly to unseen executors. We propose EASy, a trainable agentic framework that jointly optimizes task performance and computational efficiency through reinforcement learning. EASy equips an LLM-based orchestrator with explicit knowledge of the capability and cost profiles of heterogeneous executors, enabling context-sensitive coordination beyond performance-only routing. It further introduces a milestone-plan-act workflow that decomposes complex tasks into manageable milestones, constructs dependency-aware execution graphs, assigns suitable executors, and parallelizes independent steps while adapting subsequent decisions to intermediate outcomes. To train the orchestrator, we develop a tree-structured rollout procedure that explores alternative milestone decompositions and execution plans, together with multi-component rewards that capture task correctness, execution efficiency, and trajectory completeness. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning, embodied decision-making, and deep research benchmarks show that EASy consistently achieves stronger performance-efficiency trade-offs than strong agentic baselines.

AI.title_translation: EASy：迈向高效的基于大语言模型的智能体系统
AI.tldr: EASy 是一个通过强化学习联合优化任务性能与计算效率的 LLM 智能体系统，能根据执行器能力和成本进行智能编排与任务分解。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的智能体系统大多只优化任务成功率，而忽视了在实际约束（如执行器能力和计算成本）下的执行效率；现有的路由方法难以处理丰富的上下文、多步依赖和中间反馈，且对未见过的执行器泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出 EASy 框架，使用强化学习联合优化任务性能与计算效率；赋予编排器异构执行器的能力和成本画像认知；引入里程碑-计划-行动（milestone-plan-act）工作流进行任务分解、依赖感知图构建、执行器分配及并行化；开发树状 rollout 过程和多组件奖励函数来训练编排器。
AI.result: 在数学推理、具身决策和深度研究基准测试上的广泛实验表明，EASy 相比强智能体基线，能够持续获得更强的性能-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: EASy 通过联合优化任务性能与计算效率，并引入能力成本感知和里程碑-计划-行动工作流，有效解决了现有LLM智能体系统效率低下和缺乏泛化能力的问题，在多个基准测试中取得了优异的性能-效率权衡。
AI.translation: 智能体系统已成为通过协调专门的基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体来解决复杂任务的有前景的范式。然而，大多数现有系统主要优化任务成功率，而对在执行器能力和计算成本等实际约束下的执行效率考虑有限。现有的基于路由的方法对丰富且不断演化的任务上下文、多步依赖以及中间执行反馈的推理能力有限，并且对未见过的执行器的泛化能力往往较差。我们提出了 EASy，一个通过强化学习联合优化任务性能和计算效率的可训练智能体框架。EASy 为基于 LLM 的编排器配备了异构执行器的能力和成本配置文件的显式知识，实现了超越单纯性能路由的上下文敏感协调。它进一步引入了里程碑-计划-行动工作流，将复杂任务分解为可管理的里程碑，构建依赖感知执行图，分配合适的执行器，并在根据中间结果调整后续决策的同时将独立步骤并行化。为了训练编排器，我们开发了一种树状 rollout 程序，用于探索替代的里程碑分解和执行计划，以及捕捉任务正确性、执行效率和轨迹完整性的多组件奖励。在数学推理、具身决策和深度研究基准上的大量实验表明，EASy 比强大的智能体基线持续实现了更强的性能-效率权衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 EASy，一个通过强化学习联合优化任务性能与计算效率的可训练智能体框架。EASy 通过让 LLM 编排器感知异构执行器的能力与成本、采用里程碑-计划-行动工作流以及树状 rollout 训练方法，在数学推理、具身决策和深度研究等基准上实现了优异的性能-效率权衡。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型智能体, 强化学习, 计算效率, 任务编排, 执行器异构性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为EASy的高效LLM智能体系统，通过强化学习同时优化任务性能和计算效率。其核心创新在于结合了对异构执行器能力/成本的感知、里程碑-计划-行动工作流，以及基于树状 rollout 的训练方法，在多个基准测试中展现出色的性能-效率权衡。

title: The First EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis 2026: Cross-Domain Egocentric Video Question Answering
summary: EgoCross is a cross-domain egocentric video question answering benchmark designed to evaluate whether multimodal large language models can generalize beyond common daily-life scenarios. The first EgoCross Challenge was hosted at the Third EgoVis Workshop at CVPR 2026 and evaluated models on first-person videos from four target domains: surgery, industrial assembly, extreme sports, and animal perspectives. Each test example consists of an egocentric video clip, a question, and four candidate answers, from which the model must select the correct option. This technical report introduces the challenge task, benchmark resources, and two official Codabench tracks. The Source-Limited Track restricts participants to the official baseline model and a small support set, whereas the Open-Source Track permits broader choices of models and training data under rules that prohibit the manual construction of target-domain training data. In total, the challenge received more than 1,500 submissions from over 130 participants, with 19 teams participating in the Open-Source Track and 38 teams in the Source-Limited Track. We further present the official leaderboard results and summarize the winning solutions from both tracks. We hope that this report will serve as a useful technical reference for advancing cross-domain egocentric video understanding. All resources, including the challenge data, baseline implementation, and code released by the winning teams, are made publicly available.

AI.title_translation: EgoVis 2026首届EgoCross挑战赛：跨领域自我视角视频问答
AI.tldr: EgoVis 2026首届EgoCross挑战赛推出了跨领域第一人称视角视频问答基准，评估模型在手术、工业、极限运动和动物视角下的泛化能力，吸引了大量队伍参与并开源了相关资源。
AI.motivation: 为了评估多模态大语言模型是否能够泛化到常见的日常活动场景之外，测试其在跨领域自我视角视频问答（EgoCross）任务中的表现。
AI.method: 评估模型在手术、工业装配、极限运动和动物视角四个目标领域的第一人称视角视频上的问答表现，设置了限制源数据（Source-Limited）和开源（Open-Source）两个Codabench竞赛赛道。
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引了来自130多名参与者的1500多次提交，其中开源赛道有19支队伍参与，限制源数据赛道有38支队伍参与，官方报告了排行榜结果并总结了获胜方案。
AI.conclusion: EgoCross 2026 挑战赛及其技术报告成功建立了一个严格评估多模态大语言模型跨领域泛化能力的基准，推动了第一人称视角视频理解技术的发展，所有相关资源和获胜方案均已开源。
AI.translation: EgoCross是一个跨领域的自我视角视频问答基准，旨在评估多模态大语言模型是否能够泛化到常见日常场景之外。首届EgoCross挑战赛在CVPR 2026的第三届EgoVis研讨会上举办，评估了模型在四个目标领域的第一人称视角视频上的表现：手术、工业装配、极限运动和动物视角。每个测试样本由一个自我视角视频片段、一个问题和四个候选答案组成，模型必须从中选择正确的选项。本技术报告介绍了挑战赛任务、基准资源以及两个官方Codabench赛道。“限制源数据赛道”（Source-Limited Track）限制参与者使用官方基准模型和一个小型支持集，而“开源赛道”（Open-Source Track）允许更广泛地选择模型和训练数据，但规则禁止手动构建目标领域训练数据。该挑战赛总共吸引了来自130多名参与者的1500多次提交，其中有19支队伍参加了开源赛道，38支队伍参加了限制源数据赛道。我们进一步展示了官方排行榜结果，并总结了两个赛道的获胜解决方案。我们希望本报告能为推进跨领域自我视角视频理解提供有用的技术参考。所有资源，包括挑战赛数据、基准实现以及获胜团队发布的代码，均已公开。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了EgoVis 2026研讨会上的首届EgoCross挑战赛，这是一个旨在评估多模态大语言模型在日常场景之外跨领域泛化能力的自我视角视频问答基准，包含两个赛道、超1500次提交及官方排行榜结果。
AI.keywords: EgoCross Challenge, Egocentric Video, Video Question Answering, Cross-Domain Generalization, Multimodal Large Language Models
AI.comments: 该挑战赛首次专注于跨领域的自我视角视频问答（EgoCross），将测试范围从日常场景扩展到手术、工业装配、极限运动和动物视角等更具挑战性的领域，对推动多模态大语言模型的泛化能力具有重要意义。

title: Joint UAV Flight and Opportunistic Routing under Reinforcement Learning for Delay-Tolerant Networks
summary:
The growing deployment of delay-tolerant networks (DTNs) has made store-carry-forward (SCF) communication indispensable under sparse connectivity.
  However, intermittent contacts, finite buffers, and limited message time-to-live (TTL) often give rise to sparse delivery and congestion, leading to substantial end-to-end performance degradation.
  To address this challenge, this study explores the joint optimization of decentralized opportunistic routing and controllable unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight, aiming to enlarge future contacts through discrete UAV headings while enabling per-node replication under contact-limited observations.
  Building upon this architecture, we study cooperative factored routing--UAV control under centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) and propose JUROR (Joint UAV flight and Opportunistic Routing, based on the proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework.
  In our design, we first cast the problem as a factored partially observable Markov decision process with sequential motion--routing coupling and a per-step team reward; subsequently, decentralized actors act on local observations while a training-time critic uses global statistics, and an optional multi-horizon hotspot predictor provides auxiliary supervision.
  Simulation results over four traffic modes demonstrate effective gains over PRoPHET and MaxProp, while retaining contact-limited decentralized execution.

AI.title_translation: 基于强化学习的延迟容忍网络联合无人机飞行与机会路由
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于强化学习（PPO）的联合无人机飞行与机会路由方法（JUROR），有效解决延迟容忍网络中的稀疏连接与拥塞问题。
AI.motivation: 延迟容忍网络（DTN）中存在间歇性接触、有限缓冲区和有限消息生存时间（TTL），常导致数据投递稀疏和网络拥塞，严重降低端到端性能，因此需要通过联合优化无人机飞行和机会路由来扩大未来接触机会并缓解拥塞。
AI.method: 将问题建模为具有序列运动-路由耦合和单步团队奖励的因式分解部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，提出基于PPO框架的JUROR方法，采用中心化训练与分布式执行（CTDE）架构，结合多视距热点预测器进行辅助监督。
AI.result: 在四种流量模式下的仿真结果表明，与PRoPHET和MaxProp相比，该方法能有效提升性能，同时保持了基于有限接触的分布式执行。
AI.conclusion: 基于PPO框架提出的JUROR方法能够有效联合优化无人机飞行与机会路由，显著提升延迟容忍网络在稀疏连接下的性能。
AI.translation: 延迟容忍网络（DTN）的日益部署使得存储-携带-转发（SCF）通信在稀疏连接下变得不可或缺。然而，间歇性接触、有限缓冲区和有限的消息生存时间（TTL）常常导致投递稀疏和拥塞，从而导致显著的端到端性能下降。为了应对这一挑战，本研究探讨了分散式机会路由与可控无人机（UAV）飞行的联合优化，旨在通过离散的UAV航向扩大未来的接触机会，同时在接触受限的观测下实现每个节点的复制。在此架构的基础上，我们研究了在集中训练与分布式执行（CTDE）下的协同因式分解路由-UAV控制，并提出了基于近端策略优化（PPO）框架的JUROR（Joint UAV flight and Opportunistic Routing）。在我们的设计中，我们首先将该问题建模为具有顺序运动-路由耦合和每步团队奖励的因式分解部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程；随后，分布式动作执行器基于局部观测行动，而训练时的评判器使用全局统计信息，且可选的多视距热点预测器提供辅助监督。四种流量模式下的仿真结果表明，与PRoPHET和MaxProp相比，该方法具有有效的性能增益，同时保持了接触受限的分布式执行。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了延迟容忍网络（DTN）中无人机飞行与机会路由的联合优化问题，提出了基于PPO框架和CTDE架构的JUROR方法，通过对部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程的建模与求解，有效解决了稀疏连接下的数据投递和拥塞问题。
AI.keywords: 延迟容忍网络, 无人机, 机会路由, 强化学习, 联合优化
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地结合了无人机飞行控制与延迟容忍网络（DTN）中的机会路由，利用强化学习（CTDE框架）解决了稀疏连接和拥塞问题，在方法创新性和实用性上表现突出。

title: When Absence Is Evidence: Evaluating Completeness-Sensitive Negative Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often asked whether something is absent from a record, list, or retrieved context. Yet non-observation licenses a negative answer only when evidence completely covers the query scope; otherwise, the answer should remain unknown. We call this completeness-sensitive negative reasoning.
