title: Exploring Cross-Reality Transitions between Projections and Head-Mounted Displays for Immersive Digital Art
summary: Immersive exhibitions increasingly combine large-scale projections with mixed reality (MR) head-mounted displays (HMDs), but how users perceive transitions across these heterogeneous visualization environments remains underexplored. We investigate cross-reality (CR) object- and scene-level transitions in a hybrid immersive art installation spanning projection, augmented reality (AR), and virtual reality (VR). In a within-subjects study (N=24), we compared a calibrated condition with a bundled inconsistency condition introducing noticeable differences in spatial alignment, visual appearance, and cross-device latency. This contrast was used not to establish perceptual thresholds or hardware targets, but as a diagnostic probe to make transition disruptions more perceptible and discussable. The inconsistency condition reduced presence and increased workload. Interviews showed that spatial misalignment disrupted action-outcome predictability, appearance mismatch reduced aesthetic coherence, and latency weakened perceived responsiveness. Effects also varied by asset type: rigid static assets exposed inconsistencies more clearly, animated skeletal assets shifted attention toward motion, and particle effects often masked small discrepancies. These findings clarify how users perceive projection-MR transitions and support asset-aware design strategies for coherent hybrid immersive art. We also release HUICRSync, an open-source Unreal Engine plugin for prototyping projection-MR CR experiences.

title: AsymSpec: Efficient Cloud-Edge Speculative Decoding over Asymmetric Networks
summary: Cloud-edge speculative decoding places a lightweight draft model at an edge gateway and a higher-quality target model in the cloud, but inserts communication into every speculative block. Under a constrained uplink, candidate messages may queue while the verifier is idle. Stop-and-wait scheduling leaves edge compute underutilized; optimistic same-request runahead can waste work when a rejection or an unexpected bonus token invalidates dependent drafts. We present AsymSpec, which addresses uplink-gated verification and invalid dependent work with two corresponding mechanisms. Its asymmetric verification protocol keeps the common-path acceptance upload compact and moves richer, rejection-only correction information to the downlink. A total-variation (TV) certificate for the residual distribution determines whether a small target top-K response suffices; if not, the protocol progressively escalates through proposal-based exact recovery before falling back to the full distribution. Its confirmed-prefix pipeline exposes only independent, valid requests to the edge scheduler and lets the cloud re-batch arrived blocks, hiding verification waits when another confirmed-prefix request is ready without using same-request runahead. Across three draft-target pairs, two workloads, and three asymmetric network profiles, our end-to-end evaluation shows that AsymSpec delivers 2.82-28.03$\times$ the output-token throughput of the strongest baseline.

title: SciCode-Verified: How Benchmark Defects Underestimated the Scientific-Coding Ability of Language Models
summary: SciCode is the standard measure of the scientific-coding ability of language models: research-level problems that demand both frontier scientific theory and its implementation as working numerical code. It is a component of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and a standing evaluation in government and national-laboratory suites. Yet its scores have recently plateaued: the strongest 2026 models cluster tightly around 60\% subproblem accuracy, and a successor model ties its predecessor. We trace this stagnation to defects in the benchmark itself. A per-problem, domain-expert audit of all 65 test problems uncovers 263 defects; 192 of them, spread across 91\% of the main problems, cause correct, instruction-following solutions to be wrongly rejected---through non-reproducible gold answers, over-tight tolerances, or self-contradictory specifications. Critically, 78\% of these score-suppressing defects require specialized physics or mathematics knowledge to detect, not mere clerical proofreading. We corrected every confirmable defect to produce SciCode-Verified. The corrections add only the specifications a well-posed problem requires, repair grading, and tighten the tests that were too lenient; every change is recorded with its justification and independently re-checked by a second domain expert. We re-evaluate twelve frontier model snapshots on the corrected benchmark and find a substantial recovery: subproblem accuracy rises from 45--60\% to 84--98\%, and main-problem accuracy from 9--27\% to 69--92\%. State-of-the-art models are far more proficient in scientific coding than SciCode has suggested---the bottleneck was not model capability, but the quality of the evaluation instrument. We release SciCode-Verified with its complete audit trail as the corrected public standard.

title: Protoreasoning in Tiny Transformers
summary: We show that tiny transformers can profitably employ a simple form of Chain of Thought, which we call protoreasoning, allowing us to study step-by-step reasoning on ~1M-parameter models and opening up opportunities for much more detailed experimentation and analysis than is feasible for larger models. Current Large Language Models exhibit impressive step-by-step reasoning, but we have yet to understand its generality, i.e., when and how LLMs learn genuinely general algorithms rather than "bags of heuristics." Such questions are hard to settle on compute-intensive frontier models trained on opaque data. To work at model scales far below the threshold for natural-language competence, we define reasoning-friendly tasks on Dyck languages (sentences of correctly nested brackets). We find that protoreasoning traces substantially close the out-of-distribution generalization gap, and ablations confirm that the trace's content, not merely its extra tokens, drives the gain.

title: Data generated internal solutions for the plasma wave equation: error bounds and numerical experiments in two dimensions
summary: We consider the computation of internal solutions for a time domain plasma wave equation with an unknown potential $q$ from boundary response data. The internal solutions are computed by transforming known background snapshots using the Cholesky decomposition of the data-driven Gramian, or mass matrix. It was recently shown that in one dimension these data generated internal solutions converge in $L^2$ at order $\sqrtτ$ for well chosen initial waves. Here we study the internal solution reconstruction in two dimensions, where a multiple input/multiple output (MIMO) setup and a block Gramian are needed, with the number of boundary sources increasing as the time sampling is refined. We show that the general error bound carries over to this setting: the distance between the data generated solutions and the best causal approximation from background snapshots is controlled by the best approximation mass matrix mismatch. Numerical refinement studies on a square domain measure the convergence of the data generated solutions alongside the best causal approximation from the background snapshots, with the relative errors appearing to go to zero at rate $\sqrtτ$, and the absolute errors going to zero in $L^1$. We also show that the solution reconstructions remain accurate for high contrast composite media. Finally, since the mass matrix assembled from noisy response data can fail to be positive definite, regularization is needed; comparing a diagonal shift with an eigenvalue floor, we find the floor more robust, with reconstructions that remain more accurate than the unperturbed background field with noise that is up to ten percent of the root mean square data amplitude.

title: RAC: Reference-Aware Activation Compression for Communication-Efficient Split LLM Inference
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly process long, privacy-sensitive contexts, while cloud-only deployment exposes user data beyond the trusted endpoint and fully local deployment often requires costly hardware. Split inference offers a middle ground by executing the model head, tail, and tools locally and the middle layers in the cloud, but its local-cloud-local path transfers boundary hidden states at every invocation and creates a critical communication bottleneck. We present \system, a reference-aware codec that retrieves exact-token historical spans for prefill uplinks, reuses the reconstructed uplink state for same-round prefill downlinks, and generates boundary-specific decode references with lightweight causal predictors. RAC applies grouped affine alignment and calibrated residual quantization with optional prefill outliers, while sender-side wire-format reconstruction synchronizes subsequent references and offline calibration accounts for quality and packed representation costs. Across three models and nine evaluated model-link pairs, Raw-to-RAC mean time to first token (TTFT) and time per output token (TPOT) ratios are 1.24-2.72$\times$ and 1.01-2.79$\times$, while the 12 non-perplexity task-score changes range from $-0.40$ to $+2.50$ points.

title: A Tight Bound on Online Vertex Cover under Edge Arrivals
summary: We prove a tight impossibility result for online vertex cover under edge arrivals. No randomized integral or fractional algorithm achieves a competitive ratio strictly below $2$ against an oblivious adversary, even on bipartite graphs. Since the standard algorithm that takes both endpoints of every uncovered edge is $2$-competitive, this settles the optimal ratio. Our proof is a direct reduction from the recent breakthrough blueprint framework of Assadi, Jiang, and Xiang.

title: Promptable Animal Pose Tracking Across Species
comments: Accepted for presentation at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on CV4Ecology
summary: Animal pose estimation and tracking is important for wildlife monitoring and conservation research, and with limited expert time for labelling automated approaches are imperative. While human pose estimation and tracking has seen rapid progress thanks to large annotated datasets, animal pose remain challenging, due to large morphological and behavioural differences between species and limited annotated data. Existing approaches either optimise generic keypoint localisation from annotated datasets (such as APTv2) with poor generalisation, or track custom keypoints using visual tracking, at the cost of performance. In this paper, we demonstrate that vision foundation models trained on large datasets can be used effectively to track animal pose with limited labelled data. We propose two models, one unsupervised and the other supervised, to track user-selected keypoints in videos. The supervised approach delivers superior tracking accuracy by employing a keypoint prompt encoder to explicitly inject structural priors from a reference frame into feature matching. In parallel, the unsupervised route provides strong cross-species robustness by leveraging diverse foundation-model features for training-free correspondence matching. Extensive evaluation on challenging animal video benchmarks APTv2 and TigDog demonstrates that our framework achieves strong performance while maintaining an effective balance between accuracy and generalisation, offering a practical solution for real-world animal behaviour analysis and conservation applications.

title: DreamWAM: Beyond RGB Future Prediction for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) learn action-relevant representations by predicting how the observed world will evolve. Most existing WAMs define this future in RGB space, where task-relevant state transitions are entangled with nuisance variations in texture, illumination, background, and viewpoint. We argue that WAMs should explicitly predict action-relevant future state rather than relying on RGB prediction alone. We introduce DreamWAM, which reformulates future prediction as structured world modeling beyond RGB, representing future states through complementary views of appearance, motion, geometry, and semantics. During training, DreamWAM combines joint latent denoising of RGB and motion with lightweight gated residual branches for geometry and semantics. Shared attention between VideoDiT and ActionDiT allows the action branch to learn from these future-state predictions, while all beyond-RGB supervision branches are disabled at inference and deployment remains RGB-only. Across both no-rollout and joint video-action inference, DreamWAM consistently improves the matched RGB-only baselines on LIBERO, from 97.30\% to 98.40\% and from 98.00\% to 98.90\%, respectively. The gains become larger under unseen LIBERO-Plus perturbations, from 51.36\% to 63.44\% and from 69.16\% to 75.47\%. The same robustness extends to real-world manipulation, where DreamWAM attains an average success rate of 74.4\% across unseen changes in lighting, background, and object layout, compared with 55.6\% for Fast-WAM-Joint. These results show that robust world-action learning depends not only on predicting the future, but on representing it in a form that matters for action. The code and models are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/DreamWAM.

title: ORACLE: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning-Based Analog Circuit Design Optimizer with Large Language Models-Guided Exploration
summary: Analog circuit design automation using reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for reducing manual effort. However, many existing RL-based methods focus on single-objective optimization. Even methods designed for multi-objective (MO) problems often reduce multiple design specifications to a single scalar reward. This simplification limits the ability to capture the true Pareto trade-off among competing objectives and often leads to suboptimal designs. Moreover, requiring the model to be retrained from scratch whenever the desired MO specifications change remains a key limitation. To address these challenges, we present ORACLE, an open-source RL-based framework for MO analog circuit design optimization that replaces scalar reward optimization with vector-valued learning and preference-aware conditioning. ORACLE represents a true MO analog circuit design optimizer that uses a preference vector to specify the relative weights of multiple objectives, enabling a single trained model to generate designs across diverse trade-off settings without retraining. We further propose two preference-guidance strategies, namely normalized-weight guidance and cosine-aligned guidance, to improve convergence. In addition, we incorporate a large language model (LLM)-guided action selection mechanism to filter actions that are likely to lead to suboptimal designs or increased runtime. Our results show that, on multiple circuit topologies with 2,000 test cases, ORACLE reduces runtime by 20.4x - 104.4x compared to state-of-the-art approaches. It also meets 99.9% of the 2,000 target specifications, and achieves 5.1x - 318.6x better figure of merit in the resulting output specs.

title: Towards Physics of Multimodal Pretraining: Knowledge Flow, Modality Synergy, Early Unification, and Recipes
summary: Vision offers a critical axis for advancing foundation models, driving a shift towards natively unified multimodal pretraining. Despite this momentum, the design space and the fundamental mechanisms of how modalities interact during unified training remain underexplored. We provide empirical clarity through a systematic exploration of multimodal pretraining. Our controlled experiments on both synthetic and large-scale real-world datasets yield four key insights into the physics of multimodal pretraining: (i) Knowledge Flow: We disentangle how language, visual understanding, and visual generation transfer knowledge across modalities, revealing distinct patterns of influence and asymmetry; (ii) Synergy vs. Competition: We show that data "complexity" largely determines whether modalities are synergistic, identify architectural choices that promote synergy: such as shared attention and normalization with modality-specific feed-forward layers, and find that these behaviors generalize across different visual tokenizer designs; (iii) Early Unification: Unifying modalities from the very early stages and training them jointly is shown to be more effective than late alignment or sequential training. This process uncovers a vision laziness phenomenon, where delayed integration leads models to rely on language priors; (iv) Recipes: We derive efficient pretraining recipes that achieve strong generative performance using only 5% of the compute budget. These core findings are subsequently validated at scale by training multiple 13.5B MoE models on 2T tokens. We hope this study provides a principled foundation for understanding and scaling multimodal pretraining.

title: DelusionEval: Measuring Delusion-Linked Behaviors in AI Chatbots
summary: Mental health professionals have raised concerns about risks of psychological harm from interaction with large language models (LLMs), including "delusional spirals" in which concerning human and LLM behaviors reinforce each other over time. With growing public use of LLM-powered chatbots, there is an urgent need to build evaluations grounded in real-world episodes of psychological harm experienced by users. We developed DelusionEval, an evaluation protocol that tests a model's tendencies to exhibit behaviors linked to promoting user delusions. We prompt each model with 589 unique conversation histories from 18 participants, comprising 12,591 messages from users who experienced delusions and psychological harm. We find that the tendency of an evaluated LLM to exhibit delusion-linked behavior does not reliably correlate with model size, release date, or the presence of test-time reasoning. However, extending the context of prior messages substantially increases rates of delusion-linked behaviors, providing evidence for the importance of context in LLM safety evaluation. For example, the rate of failing to discourage self-harm when the user expresses suicidal ideation increases from 30.0% to 41.1% when an additional 350 messages are prepended to the conversation history. All model families (e.g., GPT, Claude) exhibit substantial rates of delusion-linked behaviors. Within families, later, larger, or higher-reasoning models are not uniformly better across all behavior categories. Our results raise concerns regarding the potential psychological impact of LLMs and the need for more rigorous studies of real-world human-AI interaction.

title: Stochastic Emulation using Generalized Stratified Sampling for Performance-Based Risk Optimization of Structures
summary: Metamodels are instrumental in reducing the computational burden associated with nested reliability analyses and optimization loops in Performance-Based Risk Optimization (PBRO) of structures under stochastic loads. In this context, stochastic emulators are particularly useful because they approximate response distributions while accounting for the intrinsic stochasticity of the simulator. Among these methods, Stochastic Polynomial Chaos Expansion (SPCE) is especially attractive because it does not require replications of nonlinear analyses at fixed input conditions. However, SPCE may present limitations in accurately representing extreme responses in the tails of structural response distributions. To address this limitation, this study proposes a framework that combines Generalized Stratified Sampling (GSS) with SPCE. The GSS scheme partitions the input space into strata according to the intensity of the hazard, improving the representation of extreme responses, while independent SPCE emulators are trained within each stratum. The conditional exceedance probabilities estimated in each stratum are then recombined using the total probability theorem to evaluate the probabilistic constraints. The proposed GSS-SPCE framework is applied to the optimal design of buckling-restrained brace cross-sectional areas in a two-story steel building. The objective is to minimize the initial construction cost while satisfying prescribed probabilistic performance constraints. Results show that the proposed framework accurately estimates structural response distributions, including their tail regions, while substantially reducing the number of nonlinear model evaluations required for PBRO.

AI.title_translation: 基于广义分层抽样的随机仿真在结构基于性能风险优化中的应用
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合广义分层抽样（GSS）和随机多项式混沌展开（SPCE）的新框架，在大幅减少非线性计算量的同时精确估计了结构极端响应的尾部概率。
AI.motivation: 在随机荷载作用下结构的基于性能风险优化（PBRO）中，现有的随机多项式混沌展开（SPCE）代理模型在表示结构响应分布尾部的极端响应时存在精度不足的局限性。
AI.method: 提出GSS-SPCE框架：利用广义分层抽样（GSS）根据地震等危险性强度将输入空间划分为不同分层，在每个分层内独立训练SPCE代理模型；然后利用全概率定理重组各分层的条件超越概率，从而评估概率性能约束。
AI.result: 将该框架应用于两层钢结构屈曲约束支撑截面面积的最佳设计中，结果表明该方法不仅能准确预测包括尾部区域在内的结构响应分布，还能显著减少非线性分析的评估次数。
AI.conclusion: GSS-SPCE框架成功解决了传统SPCE在结构响应尾部分布估计上的不足，为结构基于性能风险优化提供了一种高精度且高效的算力替代方案。
AI.translation: 代理模型在减轻随机荷载下结构基于性能风险优化（PBRO）及嵌套可靠度分析中的计算负担方面发挥着重要作用。在此背景下，随机仿真器特别有用，因为它们可以在考虑仿真器内在随机性的同时近似响应分布。在这些方法中，随机多项式混沌展开（SPCE）尤为受关注，因为它不需要在固定输入条件下重复进行非线性分析。然而，SPCE在准确表示结构响应分布尾部的极端响应方面可能存在局限性。为了解决这一局限，本研究提出了一个将广义分层抽样（GSS）与SPCE相结合的框架。GSS方案根据危险性强度将输入空间划分为不同层级，以改善极端响应的表示，同时在每个层级内训练独立的SPCE仿真器。随后利用全概率定理重组在各层级估计的条件超越概率，以评估概率约束。所提出的GSS-SPCE框架被应用于两层钢结构中屈曲约束支撑截面面积的优化设计。目标是在满足预设概率性能约束的同时最小化初始建设成本。结果表明，所提框架能够准确估计包括尾部区域在内的结构响应分布，同时大幅减少PBRO所需的非线性模型评估次数。
AI.summary: 针对结构基于性能风险优化（PBRO）中极端响应评估计算量大且尾部拟合不准的问题，本研究提出了结合广义分层抽样与随机多项式混沌展开的GSS-SPCE框架。该方法通过将输入空间按危险性强度分层并独立建模，显著提高了尾部概率估计精度，同时大幅降低了非线性模型计算成本。

title: The Beginning of ChatGPT Ads
comments: To be published in AAAI/ACM AIES 2026
summary: This paper presents the first empirical study of advertising content being rolled out in the user-facing online interfaces of large language models (LLMs). We systematically examine possible demographic differences in ad content shown to U.S. users of ChatGPT using a sock puppet audit methodology. We create and deploy 91 sock puppets in a 3x3 factorial design, using geolocation cues (account IP proxies and location-signaling prompts) to signal three racial/ethnic groups (Black, Hispanic, and White) and three income terciles (low, medium, and high). We conduct data collection starting in February 2026, collecting over 3,000 advertisements from 186 unique advertisers in response to 335 prompts on a range of realistic user queries. We find that accounts begin receiving ads 14 days after account creation, and that lower-income accounts, regardless of race, are more likely to receive ads. In this first phase of ChatGPT ads, the ads themselves skewed heavily towards consumer goods, directed users to a specific advertiser rather than a particular product, and were clearly separated from the LLM's response text, observations we anticipate will change as ads continue being integrated into LLM chat interfaces. We release a public, searchable archive of all collected advertisements. Finally, we discuss the implications of our findings, and conclude with methodological and theoretical recommendations for future empirical studies of LLM advertisements.

AI.title_translation: ChatGPT 广告的开端
AI.tldr: 本文通过对 ChatGPT 进行傀儡审计，首次实证研究了 LLM 界面中的广告投放机制，发现低收入账户更易收到广告，且当前广告多偏向消费品并与回答文本分离。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）开始在其用户界面中商业化引入广告，缺乏对广告投放机制以及是否存在基于社会人口统计特征（如种族、收入）的差异化靶向问题的实证研究。
AI.method: 采用了“套娃傀儡”（sock puppet）审计方法，设计了 3×3 因子实验（涵盖黑人、西班牙裔、白人 3 个种族/族裔，以及低、中、高 3 个收入水平），部署了 91 个通过 IP 代理和提示词标记地理位置的傀儡账号。自 2026 年 2 月起，针对 335 个真实用户查询提示词，收集了来自 186 个广告商的 3000 多条广告数据。
AI.result:
1. 账号在创建 14 天后开始收到广告；
2. 无论种族背景如何，低收入账号接收广告的概率均高于高收入账号；
3. 初始阶段的广告严重偏向消费品，主要引导用户指向广告商而非具体产品，且广告与 LLM 生成的回答文本保持明确分隔。
AI.conclusion: 研究公开发布了包含所有收集广告的可搜索归档数据库，讨论了 LLM 广告投放对社会和监管的潜在影响，并为未来的 LLM 广告实证研究提出了理论框架与方法论建议。
AI.translation: 本文展示了对大型语言模型（LLM）面向用户的在线界面中推出的广告内容进行的首次实证研究。我们采用傀儡审计（sock puppet audit）方法，系统地调查了向美国 ChatGPT 用户展示的广告内容是否存在潜在的人口统计学差异。我们构建并部署了 91 个傀儡账号，采用 3x3 因子设计，利用地理位置线索（账户 IP 代理和位置提示词）来表示三个种族/族裔群体（黑人、西班牙裔和白人）以及三个收入三分位数（低、中、高）。我们从 2026 年 2 月开始收集数据，针对一系列现实用户查询的 335 个提示词，收集了来自 186 个不同广告商的 3000 多条广告。研究发现，账号在创建 14 天后开始接收广告，且无论种族如何，低收入账号接收广告的可能性更高。在 ChatGPT 广告的这一初始阶段，广告本身严重偏向消费品，引导用户前往特定广告商而非特定产品，并且与 LLM 的响应文本有着明确的分隔，我们预判这些现象将随着广告继续融入 LLM 聊天界面而发生变化。最后，我们公开发布了所有收集到的广告的可搜索归档库，讨论了研究发现的启示，并为未来 LLM 广告的实证研究提出了方法论和理论建议。
AI.summary: 本研究对 ChatGPT 界面中的广告投放进行了首次实证审计。研究团队通过部署 91 个涵盖不同种族和收入阶层的傀儡账号，收集并分析了 3000 多条广告。研究发现低收入群体账号更容易收到广告，且当前广告多偏向消费品并与正文分离。该研究为理解 LLM 商业化及其社会影响提供了重要的数据支持。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, ChatGPT广告, 傀儡审计, 广告靶向差异, 算法公平性
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：本文是首篇针对大语言模型（LLM）用户界面广告投放进行系统实证审计的研究，填补了生成式 AI 商业化广告机制实证分析的空白。
2. **重要性**：揭示了广告投放中的社会经济学差异（如低收入人群更容易收到广告），对探讨算法公平性、数字广告伦理以及平台监管具有重大意义。
3. **局限性**：研究结论受限于特定的采样时间节点，随着 LLM 厂商进一步将广告直接植入或融入生成式文本中，当前的界面隔离特征和投放规律可能会发生快速演变。

title: Towards Decentralized Searcher Competition in MEV Markets
summary:
Centralization in maximal extractable value (MEV) markets is a significant concern for blockchain systems, as persistent concentration of economic power can weaken competition, reduce openness, and undermine the decentralization goals of permissionless protocols. While much of the existing analysis has focused on builders, validators, and block-building markets, this paper studies centralization from the perspective of searcher competition. We develop a heterogeneous model in which searchers differ in opportunity coverage and execution efficiency, and we analyze how auction design affects fairness, decentralization, and security among searchers competing for the same MEV opportunity.
  To evaluate searcher competition, we introduce two metrics: a Shapley-weighted Jain fairness index, which measures whether rewards are proportional to searchers' marginal contributions, and an expected-reward Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI), which measures concentration in long-run searcher rewards. Using these metrics, we first analyze the standard first-price, winner-take-all auction as a benchmark. Our analysis shows that, under searcher heterogeneity, first-price competition can reward rank dominance rather than marginal contribution, leading to concentrated rewards and weaker contribution-adjusted fairness.
  Motivated by these limitations, we propose an entry-filtered Shapley-capped auction mechanism that distributes searcher rewards more fairly and broadly among admitted high-quality submissions. Designing such a mechanism in a permissionless blockchain environment is challenging: searchers may create Sybil identities by submitting copied or degraded versions of the same execution strategy, and validators may collude with searchers to increase joint payoff. We address these concerns through Bayesian security constraints for copied-code Sybil deviations and validator-searcher coalition deviations.

AI.title_translation: 迈向MEV市场中去中心化的搜索者竞争
AI.tldr: 本文研究了MEV市场中搜索者的竞争与中心化问题，指出了传统拍卖的缺陷，并提出了一种促进公平性和去中心化的新型拍卖机制。
AI.motivation: 区块链MEV市场中普遍存在中心化担忧，现有分析多集中于构建者和验证者，而本文旨在研究搜索者层面的竞争与集中化问题，并探究拍卖设计如何影响搜索者之间的公平性、去中心化和安全性。
AI.method: 开发了一个异质搜索者模型，引入Shapley加权Jain公平指数和期望奖励HHI指数两个新指标，评估标准拍卖的性能，并提出了一种新的入场过滤Shapley封顶拍卖机制（带有贝叶斯安全约束）。
AI.result: 分析表明，传统的首次价格拍卖会奖励排名占优者而非边际贡献，导致奖励集中和公平性减弱；而提出的新拍卖机制能更公平、广泛地分配奖励，并在贝叶斯框架下抵御女巫攻击和合谋。
AI.conclusion: 标准的首次价格赢者通吃拍卖在搜索者异质性下会导致奖励过度集中和公平性下降。本文提出的入场过滤Shapley封顶拍卖机制能够有效缓解这一问题，同时抵抗女巫攻击和验证者-搜索者合谋。
AI.translation:
最大可提取价值（MEV）市场中的中心化是区块链系统的一个重大隐患，因为经济权力的持续集中会削弱竞争、降低开放性，并破坏无许可协议的去中心化目标。虽然现有的许多分析主要集中在构建者、验证者和区块构建市场上，但本文从搜索者竞争的角度研究了中心化问题。我们开发了一个异质性模型，其中搜索者在机会覆盖率和执行效率上各不相同，并分析了拍卖设计如何影响争夺同一MEV机会的搜索者之间的公平性、去中心化和安全性。
为了评估搜索者竞争，我们引入了两个指标：一是Shapley加权的Jain公平指数，用于衡量奖励是否与搜索者的边际贡献成正比；二是期望奖励赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数（HHI），用于衡量长期搜索者奖励的集中度。利用这些指标，我们首先分析了作为基准的标准第一价格赢者通吃拍卖。我们的分析表明，在搜索者异质性下，第一价格竞争奖励的是排名优势而非边际贡献，从而导致奖励集中以及较弱的贡献调整公平性。
受这些局限性的启发，我们提出了一种入场过滤的Shapley封顶拍卖机制，该机制能更公平、更广泛地将搜索者奖励分配给被准入的高质量提交。在无permissionless区块链环境中设计这样的机制具有挑战性：搜索者可能会通过提交同一执行策略的复制或降级版本来创建女巫身份，并且验证者可能会与搜索者勾结以增加联合收益。我们通过针对复制代码女巫偏差和验证者-搜索者联盟偏差的贝叶斯安全约束来解决这些问题。
AI.summary: 本文研究了区块链MEV市场中搜索者的竞争与中心化问题。通过构建异质搜索者模型并引入公平性与集中度评估指标，作者发现标准首次价格拍卖存在缺陷，并据此提出了一种能有效防止女巫攻击和合谋的新型拍卖机制。
AI.keywords: MEV, 搜索者竞争, 拍卖设计, 去中心化, 区块链经济学
AI.comments: 本文切入点新颖，从MEV市场中较少被关注的“搜索者（Searcher）”竞争角度出发，分析了去中心化与集中化问题，并创新性地提出了结合Shapley值和HHI指数的评估指标以及一种新型拍卖机制，对区块链经济学研究具有重要意义。

title: OneDayAgent: Towards a Long-Horizon Harness for Autonomous Agents
summary: LLM agents are increasingly applied to open-ended everyday requests that span work, study, and life. These tasks are long-horizon, cross-environment, and multimodal, forcing the agent to preserve goals and constraints across many steps while navigating heterogeneous tools and attachments. While prior work has addressed individual failure modes such as goals drift, states loss, and context overflow, whether a single harness can manage them jointly and remain effective across backends has received less study. We present OneDayAgent, a long-horizon harness for autonomous agents. OneDayAgent turns an open-ended request into a managed execution process that decomposes tasks into bounded subtasks, maintains execution memory under context pressure, and verifies and repairs the final deliverable. We evaluate OneDayAgent on AgentIF-OneDay across 104 tasks. With the GLM-5.2 backend, OneDayAgent sets a new state of the art with an overall score of 0.821. The same harness runs across five backend LLMs from three model families, indicating the harness generalizes across backends without tuning, even as different models induce distinct execution styles under the same workflow.

AI.title_translation: OneDayAgent：迈向自主代理的长周期框架
AI.tldr: OneDayAgent是一个创新的长周期代理框架，通过任务分解、内存管理和成果修复解决了复杂开放式任务中的多个痛点，并在多个大模型后端上实现了SOTA的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）代理常被应用于跨工作、学习和生活等领域的开放式长周期、跨环境及多模态请求。尽管以往的研究解决了诸如目标漂移、状态丢失和上下文溢出等单一失效模式，但缺乏一个能够同时管理这些问题并在不同后端模型上保持高效的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出了OneDayAgent框架，将开放式请求转化为受管理的执行过程，包括将任务分解为有界子任务、在上下文压力下维护执行内存、验证并修复最终成果。
AI.result: 在AgentIF-OneDay的104个任务上进行评估，使用GLM-5.2后端时，OneDayAgent取得了0.821的综合评分，创下了新的技术先进水平（SOTA）；并且该框架无需调优即可在来自三个模型家族的五个后端LLM上运行。
AI.conclusion: OneDayAgent能够有效地管理和执行复杂的长周期开放式任务，在保持高性能的同时具备极强的跨模型泛用性，为未来自主代理系统的构建提供了坚实的基础框架。
AI.translation: LLM代理越来越多地被应用于跨越工作、学习和生活的开放式日常请求中。这些任务具有长周期、跨环境和多模态的特点，迫使代理在跨越多步执行时保持目标和约束，同时遍历异构的工具和附件。虽然先前的研究已经解决了诸如目标漂移、状态丢失和上下文溢出等单独的失效模式，但单个框架能否联合管理这些问题并在不同后端之间保持有效性，受到的研究还较少。我们提出了OneDayAgent，一个用于自主代理的长周期框架。OneDayAgent将开放式请求转化为受管理的执行过程，将任务分解为有界子任务，在上下文压力下维护执行内存，并验证和修复最终的交付成果。我们在AgentIF-OneDay的104个任务上评估了OneDayAgent。在使用GLM-5.2后端时，OneDayAgent以0.821的总分创下了新的先进水平（SOTA）。该框架还可以在来自三个模型家族的五个后端LLM上运行，这表明该框架在无需调优的情况下能够泛化到不同的后端，尽管不同的模型在相同的工件下会产生不同的执行风格。
AI.summary: OneDayAgent是一个用于自主代理的长周期框架，能够将开放式请求转化为受管理的执行过程，通过任务分解、内存维护和交付验证来解决长周期任务中的各种失效模式。它在多项任务上取得了SOTA效果，并展现了优秀的跨模型泛用性。
AI.keywords: LLM 代理, 长周期任务, 任务分解, 跨环境, 多模态
AI.comments: 本文提出了OneDayAgent，这是一个专门针对长周期、跨环境、多模态的开放式任务的AI代理框架（harness）。其创新之处在于通过任务分解、上下文压力下的内存维护以及最终成果的验证与修复，统一解决目标漂移、状态丢失和上下文溢出等问题，并在多个不同的大模型后端上表现出良好的泛用性。

title: Link prediction on multi-relational graphs from an influence propagation perspective
comments: Accepted for publication in Pattern Recognition
summary: Predicting the existence and type of links (edges) between nodes in a multi-relational graph is key for applications from social interaction prediction to knowledge relationship identification. Enhancing local features with relevant global information is crucial for accurate link prediction, yet it remains challenging. We address this by modeling the relationship between node pairs as node influence. That is, whether the node influence can be propagated and what type of influence is propagated indicates where and what type the edge is, which will be the most relevant local and global information to predict the edges. To this end, we extend the Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) epidemic model to capture the influence propagation of nodes on a large scale through sub-graph structures. Subsequently, these sub-graphs are compressed using virtual edges, thereby substantially reducing the computation associated with utilizing the global graph structure. Finally, we propose the Influential Graph Neural Predictor, referred to as IGNP, a link prediction framework guided by influence propagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method, which outperforms strong baselines by a large margin on the widely used and real-world datasets.
comment: Accepted for publication in Pattern Recognition

AI.title_translation: 多关系图上的链接预测：从影响传播的角度
AI.tldr: 通过将节点关系建模为影响传播，并使用SIR流行病模型和虚拟边压缩子图，提出了一种名为IGNP的链接预测框架，并在实验中证明了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 在多关系图中准确预测链接（边）的类型和存在性至关重要，但仅靠局部特征不足以实现，需要整合全局信息，这仍然是一个挑战。
AI.method: 将节点对之间的关系建模为节点影响，并使用扩展的SIR流行病模型来捕获大规模节点影响传播。通过虚拟边压缩子图以减少计算量。提出了一种名为IGNP的链接预测框架。
AI.result: IGNP在广泛使用且真实世界的数据集上，相比于强大的基线方法，表现出了显著的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于影响传播的IGNP链接预测框架在多关系图链接预测任务上取得了优越的性能。
AI.translation: 预测多关系图中节点之间链接（边）的存在性和类型，对于从社交互动预测到知识关系识别等应用至关重要。用相关的全局信息增强局部特征对于准确的链接预测至关重要，但这仍然具有挑战性。我们通过将节点对之间的关系建模为节点影响来解决这个问题。也就是说，节点影响是否可以传播以及传播的是哪种类型的影响，表明了边在哪里以及是什么类型，这将是预测边的最相关局部和全局信息。为此，我们扩展了易感-感染-恢复（SIR）流行病模型，以捕获大规模节点通过子图结构的影响传播。随后，使用虚拟边压缩这些子图，从而大大减少了利用全局图结构的计算。最后，我们提出了有影响力的图神经网络预测器（IGNP），这是一个以影响传播为指导的链接预测框架。大量实验证明了该方法的优越性，它在广泛使用的真实世界数据集上的表现优于强大的基线。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为IGNP（Influential Graph Neural Predictor）的链接预测框架，该框架从影响传播的角度来解决多关系图中的链接预测问题。研究将节点间的关系视为节点影响的传播过程，并利用扩展的SIR流行病模型来模拟这种传播。通过引入虚拟边来压缩子图，有效降低了计算复杂度。实验结果表明，IGNP在多个真实世界数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 链接预测,多关系图,影响传播,图神经网络,SIR模型
AI.comments: 该研究将影响传播理论应用于链接预测问题，提供了一种新颖的视角。通过结合SIR模型和图神经网络，并利用虚拟边优化计算效率，该方法在多关系图链接预测任务上取得了显著的成果。然而，对于SIR模型参数的选择和虚拟边对模型性能的具体影响，可能需要进一步的消融研究。

title: Short-term load forecasting under EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments: Results from a 41-day live challenge on the aggregated German transmission-grid load
summary: Short-term load forecasting (STLF) play a vital role in the electric power industry. It serves infrastructure that European and German law designate as critical. Determinism, reproducibility, and auditability are engineering requirements rather than optional extras. STLF is no longer purely an accuracy problem. It is also a software-engineering and compliance problem. This paper describes results from a 41-day live challenge that evaluated a complete STLF pipeline for the aggregated German transmission-grid load. The pipeline is based on the open-source Python library spotforecast2-safe, which implements the EU-AI Act Requirements in Safety-Critical Environments by design. The pipeline predicts the 24 hourly load values of a target day from European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity (ENTSO-E) data. It includes anomaly detection and gap-aware data preparation, calendar and weather covariates, a recursive multi-step forecasting algorithm, and hyperparameter tuning. Forecast accuracy is measured against the official ENTSO-E day-ahead forecast. The EU-AI act compliant spotforecast2-safe pipeline beats the ENTSO-E baseline. In-context models show competitive performance. Transparent, low-cost, and auditable local models (referred to as macl2l in this paper) are competitive with more than 100-million-parameter large, energy-intensive pre-trained foundation models such as chronos-2. The challenge infrastructure, the complete submission history of all teams, and the frozen final leaderboard are publicly available.

AI.title_translation: 安全关键环境下符合欧盟人工智能法案要求的短期负荷预测：德国输电网聚合负荷41天实时挑战赛结果
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种符合欧盟AI法案的开源短期负荷预测管道，在德国输电网41天实时挑战中超越官方基线，并证明了轻量级可审计模型可媲美大模型。
AI.motivation: 在电力工业等被欧洲和德国法律指定为关键基础设施的环境中，短期负荷预测已不仅是准确性问题，更是需要满足确定性、可复现性和可审计性的软件工程与合规问题（如欧盟人工智能法案的要求）。
AI.method: 使用基于开源Python库spotforecast2-safe的完整短期负荷预测管道，包含异常检测与间隙感知的数据准备、日历和天气协变量、递归多步预测算法以及超参数调优，并在德国输电网聚合负荷上进行了41天的实时挑战赛评估。
AI.result: 符合欧盟AI法案要求的spotforecast2-safe管道击败了官方的ENTSO-E基线预测；同时，透明、低成本且可审计的本地模型（macl2l）表现出与拥有超过1亿参数的耗能巨大预训练基础模型（如chronos-2）相竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于spotforecast2-safe管道的短期负荷预测方法不仅满足欧盟人工智能法案在安全关键环境下的严格合规要求，还能在实际德国输电网聚合负荷预测中超越官方基线，且低成本本地模型具备与超大规模预训练模型相媲美的竞争力。
AI.translation: 短期负荷预测（STLF）在电力工业中发挥着至关重要的作用。它服务于欧洲和德国法律指定为关键的基础设施。确定性、可复现性和可审计性是工程要求，而不仅仅是可选项。STLF不再纯粹是一个准确性问题，它也是一个软件工程和合规性问题。本文描述了一项针对德国输电网聚合负荷的41天的实时挑战赛的结果，该挑战评估了一个完整的STLF管道。该管道基于开源Python库spotforecast2-safe，该库在设计上实现了安全关键环境中欧盟人工智能法案的要求。该管道根据欧洲输电系统运营商网（ENTSO-E）的数据预测目标日期的24个小时负荷值。它包括异常检测和间隙感知的数据准备、日历和天气协变量、递归多步预测算法以及超参数调优。预测准确性与官方的ENTSO-E日前预测进行了对比。符合欧盟AI法案的spotforecast2-safe管道击败了ENTSO-E基线。上下文模型表现出有竞争力的性能。透明、低成本且可审计的本地模型（在本文中称为macl2l）能够与拥有超过1亿参数、耗能巨大的预训练基础模型（如chronos-2）相媲美。挑战赛的基础设施、所有团队的完整提交历史以及冻结的最终排行榜均已公开。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一项针对德国输电网聚合负荷的41天实时预测挑战赛结果，评估了一个采用开源库spotforecast2-safe的短期负荷预测管道。该管道在设计上满足了欧盟人工智能法案在安全关键环境下的要求，不仅在准确率上超越了官方基线，还证明了轻量级、可审计的本地模型能够媲美大规模预训练基础模型。
AI.keywords: 短期负荷预测, 欧盟人工智能法案, 关键基础设施, 开源管道, 输电网负荷
AI.comments: 该论文将欧盟人工智能法案（EU-AI Act）的要求引入到电力系统短期负荷预测中，展示了兼顾合规性、确定性和准确性的开源框架（spotforecast2-safe），在实际测试中表现优异，并证明了轻量级可审计模型在关键基础设施中具有不逊色于超大预训练模型的竞争力。

title: Optimal Constrained sc-LTL Planning in MDPs via Switching Policies
comments: 12 pages, 6 figures. Author's accepted version; accepted for publication in the IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
summary: We study the synthesis of optimal policies for planning problems on Markov decision processes with both objectives and safety constraints specified in co-safe linear temporal logic (sc-LTL). Our problems are inherently non-Markovian due to the complexity of the sc-LTL specification and may require policy randomization to balance the objective and constraint. We propose a novel approach that reduces the constrained sc-LTL planning problem to a constrained reachability problem on an extended model. We then show that a class of switching policies constructed from stationary policies for the individual sc-LTL specifications is sufficient for optimality for the constrained reachability problem. Our finding enables a tractable linear program to compute the optimal policy. A grid world case study demonstrates that our switching policies can achieve the optimal trade-off between the objective and the safety constraint and validates both optimality and tractability.

title: Exact simulation of diffusions and improved algorithms for log-concave sampling
summary: We study exact simulation of diffusions via rejection sampling on path space using unbiased estimators of the density ratio obtained from Girsanov's theorem. When applied to the underdamped Langevin diffusion, it yields an algorithm for sampling from a strongly log-concave and log-smooth distribution with condition number $κ$, in dimension $d$, to accuracy $\varepsilon$ in Rényi divergence, in $\widetilde O(κ^{2/3} d^{1/3}\,\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$ queries. Under a third derivative bound, the dimension dependence improves to $d^{1/5}$. This improves substantially over the prior state-of-the-art complexity of $\widetilde O(κd^{1/2}\,\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$ for the Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm, and over the $d^{1/4}$ dimension dependence of Metropolized Hamiltonian Monte Carlo under the same third derivative bound. We also present applications to the mirror Langevin diffusion, and for obtaining Fisher information bounds in the non-log-concave case.

AI.title_translation: 扩散过程的精确模拟与对数凹采样改进算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于路径空间拒绝采样和Girsanov定理的扩散过程精确模拟方法，大幅改善了高维对数凹采样的算法复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统的Metropolis调整朗之万算法（MALA）和Metropolized Hamiltonian Monte Carlo（MHMC）在对数凹采样中的维度和条件数依赖仍有改进空间，因此需要开发更高效的精确扩散模拟和采样算法。
AI.method: 利用基于Girsanov定理获得的密度比无偏估计量，通过路径空间上的拒绝采样来研究扩散过程的精确模拟；将其应用于欠阻尼朗之万扩散，并推导出相应的查询复杂度。
AI.result: 对于具有条件数$\kappa$和维度$d$的强对数凹平滑分布，在Rényi散度下达到精度$\varepsilon$所需的查询复杂度为$\widetilde O(\kappa^{2/3} d^{1/3}\,\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$；在三阶导数界下，维度依赖性进一步改善至$d^{1/5}$，大幅优于现有先进算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于Girsanov定理的路径空间拒绝采样，本文成功实现了对扩散过程的精确模拟，并为对数凹采样及相关问题提供了复杂度显著优于传统MALA和MHMC的新算法。
AI.translation: 我们通过利用由吉尔萨诺夫定理（Girsanov's theorem）得到的密度比的无偏估计量，在路径空间上采用拒绝采样，研究了扩散过程的精确模拟。当将其应用于欠阻尼朗之万扩散（underdamped Langevin diffusion）时，该方法在Rényi散度下，以精度 $\varepsilon$ 从维度为 $d$、条件数为 $\kappa$ 的强对数凹且对数光滑的分布中进行采样，产生了一个查询复杂度为 $\widetilde O(\kappa^{2/3} d^{1/3}\,\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$ 的算法。在三阶导数界的约束下，维度依赖性可进一步提升至 $d^{1/5}$。这在很大程度上优于此前 Metropolis 调整朗之万算法（MALA）的最先进复杂度 $\widetilde O(\kappa d^{1/2}\,\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon))$，同时也优于在相同三阶导数界下 Metropolized Hamiltonian Monte Carlo 算法的 $d^{1/4}$ 维度依赖。我们还展示了该方法在镜像朗之万扩散（mirror Langevin diffusion）以及在获取非对数凹情况下的费舍尔信息界（Fisher information bounds）方面的应用。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用Girsanov定理无偏估计量在路径空间进行拒绝采样的扩散过程精确模拟方法。将其应用于欠阻尼朗之万扩散，在对数凹采样问题中实现了对现有MALA和MHMC算法在维度和条件数依赖上的显著超越，并进一步拓展到了镜像朗之万扩散及非对数凹情况下的Fisher信息界应用。
AI.keywords: 扩散过程精确模拟, 对数凹采样, Girsanov定理, 路径空间拒绝采样, 复杂度分析
AI.comments: 本文在对数凹采样领域取得了理论上的重大突破，通过结合路径空间拒绝采样与Girsanov定理，大幅降低了采样算法的维度和条件数依赖，对高维统计推断和抽样算法设计具有重要价值。

title: Canonical Joint Energy-Based Model on CIFAR-10: failure modes and practical indistinguishability of Predictor-Corrector and SGLD samplers
comments: 17 pages, 4 figures. Under review at Discover Computing
summary: Joint Energy-Based Models (JEM) unify classification and generation within a single network and support out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. Canonical JEM training relies on stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD); a theoretically motivated alternative, the Predictor-Corrector (PC) sampler, has not previously undergone a systematic replication test on the canonical model. We reproduce canonical JEM on WideResNet-28-10 without normalisation layers on two independent runs and test whether PC retains its theoretical advantage without an annealed noise schedule, across three protocols: PC replacing SGLD throughout the roughly 130 training epochs; cold-start generation (FID); and refinement-style multi-OOD detection (AUROC). The reconstruction reaches 92.88% test accuracy and buffer-FID 44.46 (canonical: 92.9% and 38.40). We document two failure modes: catastrophic late-training divergence via the canonical outlier-buffer mechanism (both SGLD runs and, with the same signature, both PC runs), and run-dependent SVHN OOD-discrimination dynamics. No method-level advantage of PC over SGLD is observed on any protocol: at inference the absolute AUROC difference stays below 0.007 across all ten checkpoint-OOD pairs and the FID difference below 0.5; on the training protocol a hierarchical seed-by-image bootstrap gives a 95% confidence interval on the macro-averaged AUROC difference that contains zero, while a seed-level equivalence test with two runs per method cannot establish formal equivalence. The data are consistent both with equivalence and with a small directional effect. This practical indistinguishability is theoretically expected: under fixed noise the PC predictor step degenerates by construction, so its guarantees do not transfer to canonical JEM.
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Under review at Discover Computing

AI.title_translation: CIFAR-10上的规范联合能量基模型：预测-校正与SGLD采样器的失效模式与实际不可区分性
AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在规范联合能量基模型（JEM）中，预测-校正（PC）采样器在没有退火噪声调度时退化，其性能与传统SGLD采样器在实践中无法区分。
AI.motivation: 联合能量基模型（JEM）依赖随机梯度朗之万动力学（SGLD）进行规范训练，而理论上有优势的预测-校正（PC）采样器此前尚未在规范模型上进行过系统的复现测试。
AI.method: 在无归一化层的WideResNet-28-10上独立运行两次规范JEM训练，通过全训练周期替换SGLD、冷启动生成（FID）和多OOD检测（AUROC）三种协议，系统测试了预测-校正（PC）采样器的表现。
AI.result: 实验复现达到了92.88%的测试准确率和44.46的buffer-FID；发现了两种失效模式（灾难性后期训练发散和与运行相关的SVHN OOD判别动态）；在各项协议中，PC与SGLD在实际表现上无法区分（AUROC差异小于0.007，FID差异小于0.5）。
AI.conclusion: 在没有退火噪声调度的情况下，PC采样器在规范JEM上退化并表现出与SGLD实际不可区分的效果，理论上的优势未能体现。
AI.translation: 联合能量基模型（JEM）将分类和生成统一在一个网络中，并支持分布外（OOD）检测。规范的JEM训练依赖于随机梯度朗之万动力学（SGLD）；作为一种理论上有动机的替代方案，预测-校正（PC）采样器此前尚未在规范模型上进行过系统的复制测试。我们在没有归一化层的WideResNet-28-10上独立运行两次，复制了规范JEM，并测试了PC在没有退火噪声调度的情况下是否保留其理论优势，测试采用了三种协议：在约130个训练周期中用PC代替SGLD；冷启动生成（FID）；以及精炼风格的多OOD检测（AUROC）。重建达到了92.88%的测试准确率和44.46的buffer-FID（规范为92.9%和38.40）。我们记录了两种失效模式：通过规范异常值缓冲区机制导致的灾难性后期训练发散（两个SGLD运行以及具有相同特征的两个PC运行），以及与运行相关的SVHN OOD判别动态。在任何协议上都没有观察到PC优于SGLD的方法级优势：在推理时，所有十个检查点-OOD对的绝对AUROC差异保持在0.007以下，FID差异保持在0.5以下；在训练协议上，分层的种子-图像自举给出了宏平均AUROC差异包含零的95%置信区间，而每个方法有两次运行的种子级等价性测试无法确立形式上的等价性。这些数据与等价性和小的方向性效应都是一致的。这种实际上的不可区分性在理论上是可以预料的：在固定噪声下，PC预测器步骤通过构造退化，因此其保证不适用于规范JEM。
AI.summary: 该论文系统测试了预测-校正（PC）采样器在规范联合能量基模型（JEM）上的性能，并将其与SGLD采样器进行了对比。研究发现，在没有退火噪声调度的情况下，PC采样器并未展现出理论上的优势，两者的实际表现无法区分，且均遇到了灾难性后期训练发散等失效模式。
AI.keywords: Joint Energy-Based Models, SGLD, Predictor-Corrector sampler, OOD detection, CIFAR-10
AI.comments: 本文针对能量基联合模型（JEM）中预测-校正（PC）采样器与SGLD采样器在规范模型上的表现进行了系统性复现与对比，揭示了它们在实际应用中的不可区分性及潜在失效模式，对理解和改进JEM模型具有重要价值。

title: ArtAnno: Annotating Implicit Semantics in Artworks through LLM Agent-Driven Bidirectional Human-AI Augmentation
summary: High-quality annotation of artworks is essential for computational art research, yet extracting implicit semantics remains challenging due to the reliance on culturally grounded meanings and deep contextual knowledge behind the images. Current AI-assisted annotation tools often lack assistance or rely on one-way workflows where experts have to perform extra manual calibrations to improve AI models, resulting in limited efficiency. To address this, we propose Bidirectional Human-AI Augmentation(BiHAA), a closed-loop framework in which skills and domain knowledge base evolve through real-time interaction and bidirectional HAI augmentation. Informed by a formative study with 20 artwork annotators from different backgrounds, we implement this framework in ArtAnno, an artwork annotation system driven by a multi-agent architecture. The system includes a Proactive Agentic Support Module, where AI augments humans through semantic mining and label suggestion, and an Interaction-Driven Evolution Module, where human expertise continuously enhances the AI through distilling annotation trajectories into reusable experience. Evaluation through a user study and two case studies demonstrates that our framework and system improve annotation efficiency, enable knowledge accumulation, and reduce the effort of information seeking and verification for annotators with limited domain expertise. We conclude by discussing broader implications and future directions.

AI.title_translation: ArtAnno：通过大模型代理驱动的双向人机增强标注艺术品中的隐式语义
AI.tldr: 本文开发了ArtAnno系统，利用大模型多智能体架构实现双向人机增强，有效提升了艺术品隐式语义标注的效率和知识积累。
AI.motivation: 由于艺术品隐式语义依赖于深厚的文化背景和上下文知识，高质量的艺术品标注极具挑战性，而现有的AI辅助标注工具通常缺乏有效帮助或仅依赖单向工作流，导致标注效率受限。
AI.method: 提出双向人机增强（BiHAA）闭环框架，并基于多智能体架构实现ArtAnno系统，包含主动代理支持模块（语义挖掘与标签建议）和交互驱动演化模块（人类专业知识蒸馏与经验复用）。
AI.result: 用户研究和两个案例研究表明，该框架和系统提高了标注效率，实现了知识积累，并减少了领域知识有限的标注人员在信息搜寻和验证方面的精力付出。
AI.conclusion: ArtAnno通过双向人机增强框架有效提升了艺术品隐式语义标注的效率，促进了领域知识的积累，并降低了非专业标注人员的信息搜寻与验证成本。
AI.translation: 高质量的艺术品标注对于计算艺术研究至关重要，然而由于依赖图像背后的文化根基含义和深厚的上下文知识，提取隐式语义依然充满挑战。当前的AI辅助标注工具往往缺乏有效协助，或依赖专家必须进行额外手动校准来改进AI模型的单向工作流，导致效率受限。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了双向人机增强（BiHAA）闭环框架，在该框架中，技能和领域知识库通过实时交互和双向人机增强得以演进。在对来自不同背景的20位艺术品标注人员进行形成性研究的基础上，我们在ArtAnno中实现了该框架，这是一个由多智能体架构驱动的艺术品标注系统。该系统包含一个主动代理支持模块（通过语义挖掘和标签建议来增强人类），以及一个交互驱动演化模块（通过将标注轨迹蒸馏为可复用经验，使人类专业知识持续增强AI）。通过用户研究和两个案例研究的评估表明，我们的框架和系统提高了标注效率，实现了知识积累，并减少了领域知识有限的标注人员的信息搜寻与验证成本。最后，我们讨论了更广泛的影响和未来方向。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了ArtAnno，一个由大语言模型代理驱动的、基于双向人机增强（BiHAA）框架的艺术品隐式语义标注系统。通过主动智能支持和交互驱动的系统演化，ArtAnno实现了人机协同的闭环，显著提升了标注效率并促进了领域知识的积累。
AI.keywords: 艺术品标注, 隐式语义, 大语言模型代理, 双向人机增强, 多智能体架构
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多智能体架构与双向人机增强（BiHAA）闭环框架引入艺术品隐式语义标注中，有效解决了传统AI辅助工具单向工作流效率低、缺乏深度知识交互的问题，对计算艺术研究和专业知识沉淀具有重要价值。

title: Language Models Generalize to Human-like Word Order Preferences
summary: A central question in language acquisition is whether linguistic biases can emerge from general learning mechanisms operating over underdetermined input. Artificial Language Learning (ALL) studies have shown that human learners reliably generalize beyond the evidence provided, including by preferring scope-homomorphic noun phrase modifier orders. In this work, we investigate whether language models exhibit the same bias under similar conditions. We create a controlled learning environment in which models are trained on a corpus where all noun phrases containing multiple modifiers have been removed, eliminating direct evidence about modifier ordering, and are then evaluated on multiple modifier sentences. Across three model sizes, we find that they consistently prefer scope-homomorphic orders despite never observing them during training. These preferences vary in strength by modifier type. To investigate the source of these preferences, we examine noun-modifier association strength using pointwise mutual information (PMI). While PMI reflects known modifier-ordering patterns, it does not explain the models' ordering preferences. These findings demonstrate that LMs can recover human-like linguistic generalizations from impoverished input and provide a controlled framework for investigating the mechanisms underlying such biases.

AI.title_translation: 语言模型泛化至人类般的语序偏好
AI.tldr: 语言模型在没有直接训练证据的情况下，能像人类一样泛化出特定的修饰语语序偏好。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在面对输入证据不足的情况下，是否能像人类学习者一样展现出对类人语序偏好（如辖域同态的修饰语顺序）的泛化能力。
AI.method: 创建一个受控的学习环境，在训练语料中移除所有包含多个修饰语的名词短语以消除直接证据，然后评估模型在多修饰语句子上的表现，并使用点互信息（PMI）检验名词与修饰语的关联强度以探究偏好来源。
AI.result: 跨三个不同规模的模型测试表明，尽管在训练中从未观察过，模型始终倾向于选择辖域同态的顺序，且这种偏好的强度因修饰语类型而异，而PMI无法解释模型的这种语序偏好。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型能够在贫乏的输入下恢复出类人的语言归纳偏好，这并非完全由点互信息（PMI）驱动，为研究AI语言偏置的底层机制提供了有效框架。
AI.translation: 语言习得中的一个核心问题是，语言偏差是否可以由在欠定输入上运行的一般学习机制产生。人工语言学习（ALL）研究表明，人类学习者能够可靠地泛化超出所提供证据的范围，包括偏爱辖域同态的名词短语修饰语顺序。在这项工作中，我们研究了语言模型在相似条件下是否表现出相同的偏置。我们创建了一个受控学习环境，其中模型在一个语料库上进行训练，该语料库删除了所有包含多个修饰语的名词短语，从而消除了关于修饰语顺序的直接证据，然后对多修饰语句子进行评估。在三种模型规模下，我们发现它们始终偏爱辖域同态的顺序，尽管在训练期间从未观察到它们。这些偏好的强度因修饰语类型而异。为了调查这些偏好的来源，我们使用逐点互信息（PMI）检查了名词与修饰语的关联强度。虽然PMI反映了已知的修饰语排序模式，但它并不能解释模型的语序偏好。这些发现表明，语言模型可以从贫乏的输入中恢复出类似人类的语言泛化能力，并为研究此类偏置背后的机制提供了一个受控的框架。
AI.summary: 该研究通过构建受控学习环境发现，语言模型在训练数据缺乏多修饰语直接证据的情况下，能够泛化并表现出类似人类的辖域同态修饰语语序偏好，且这种偏好无法简单归结为词汇间的点互信息（PMI）。
AI.keywords: 语言模型, 语序偏好, 人工语言学习, 归纳偏置, 点互信息
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了语言模型在缺乏直接证据的条件下是否能够表现出人类特有的语言学偏好（如辖域同态的名词短语修饰语顺序），创新性地将人工语言学习的实验范式引入大语言模型研究中，为理解语言模型的内部机制和人类语言习得提供了新视角。

title: On Computational Hardness of Mistake-Bounded Language Generation: A Random-Oracle Query Separation
summary: Generation in the limit guarantees eventual generation for every countable collection of infinite languages in the model of Kleinberg and Mullainathan [KM24], while closure dimension characterizes stronger information-theoretic guarantees [RLT25]. Neither restricts per-output computation. The cumulative-mistake objective in mistake-bounded generation makes finite failure prefixes quantitative [KPR26], and a per-output query budget exposes their computational source. Polynomial-time algorithms are known for parities, conjunctions, and monotone functions with polynomially many maxterms [JKO26]. We ask whether information-theoretic ease can coexist with bounded-access computational hardness. Relative to a random oracle $H$, we answer yes by constructing a countable collection $C^\star$ of infinite languages with closure dimension zero. Almost surely on the same $H$, an unbounded generator makes zero mistakes on every target and every complete distinct enumeration. Yet, writing $λ$ for the target-seed length, every fixed uniform generator $G$ with polynomially many oracle queries in $λ$ and the output index $i$ has a constant $c_G>0$ such that, for every sufficiently large $λ$, some target incurs more than $2^{c_Gλ}$ expected mistakes within its first $2(\lceil 2^{c_Gλ}\rceil+1)$ canonical outputs. Infinite accidental agreement enables exhaustive search; sparse queries hide fresh target values. Thus, in the random-oracle model, zero-mistake information-theoretic generation coexists with a generator-dependent exponential lower bound on worst-case expected mistakes under polynomial-query access.

AI.title_translation: 论错误有界语言生成的计算困难性：一个随机预言机查询分离
AI.tldr: 该论文证明了在随机预言机模型下，信息论上零错误的语言生成可以与多项式查询计算下的指数级错误下限共存。
AI.motivation: 探索在语言生成中，信息论意义上的“容易”（如闭包维数为零、信息论保证）是否可以与有界计算访问下的“计算困难性”共存。
AI.method: 通过构造一个闭包维数为零的可数无限语言集合 $C^\star$，并在随机预言机 $H$ 的相对意义下进行证明。几乎必然地，一个无界生成器可以在所有目标和完全不同的枚举上做到零错误；然而，任何多项式查询的统一生成器在面对某些目标时都会产生指数级的期望错误。
AI.result: 证明了在随机预言机模型中，存在闭包维数为零的语言集，虽然无界生成器可实现零错误，但任何多项式查询的统一生成器在最坏情况下都会遭遇指数级的期望错误。
AI.conclusion: 在随机预言机模型下，零错误的语言生成信息论易解性可以与生成器相关的多项式查询下最坏情况期望错误的指数下限共存。
AI.translation: Kleinberg和Mullainathan [KM24]模型中的极限生成保证了对无限语言的每个可数集合的最终生成，而闭包维数则表征了更强的信息论保证[RLT25]。两者都没有限制每个输出的计算。错误有界生成中的累积错误目标使得有限失败前缀具有定量性[KPR26]，而每个输出的查询预算暴露出它们的计算来源。对于奇偶校验、合取以及具有多项最大项的单调函数，已知有多项式时间算法[JKO26]。我们探讨信息论的易解性是否可以与有界访问的计算困难性共存。相对于随机预言机 $H$，我们通过构造一个闭包维数为零的无限语言的可数集合 $C^\star$ 给出了肯定的回答。在相同的 $H$ 上几乎必然地，一个无界生成器对每个目标和每个完全不同的枚举都不犯任何错误。然而，记 $\lambda$ 为目标种子长度，在 $\lambda$ 和输出索引 $i$ 中具有多项式级别预言机查询的每个固定统一生成器 $G$，都具有一个常数 $c_G>0$，使得对于每个足够大的 $\lambda$，某些目标在其前 $2(\lceil 2^{c_G\lambda}\rceil+1)$ 个规范输出中会产生超过 $2^{c_G\lambda}$ 的期望错误。无限的意外吻合使得穷举搜索成为可能；稀疏的查询隐藏了新鲜的目标值。因此，在随机预言机模型中，零错误的信息论生成与多项式查询访问下最坏情况期望错误的生成器依赖的指数下限共存。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了错误有界语言生成的计算困难性，通过随机预言机查询分离，证明了信息论上的零错误语言生成可以与多项式查询约束下的计算困难性（指数级期望错误下限）共存。
AI.keywords: 计算困难性, 错误有界语言生成, 闭包维数, 随机预言机分离, 信息论易解性
AI.comments: 该论文在理论计算机科学和语言生成领域具有重要意义，通过随机预言机模型成功分离了信息论意义上的“可学习性/易生成性”与有界计算资源下的“计算困难性”，展示了信息论简单性与多项式查询计算困难性的共存。

title: From Score Matrices to Football-Aware Match-State Simulation: An Auditable LLM Harness for Exact-Score Reranking
comments: 9 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Interim chronological benchmark on the first 150 matches of the 2025-26 English Premier League
summary: Football score forecasting combines a strong statistical core with a difficult contextual edge. Dynamic Poisson-family models estimate team strength, expected goals, and coherent score probabilities, but do not directly understand roles, tactical matchups, motivation, or how a first goal changes behaviour. Large language models (LLMs) can reason about such concepts, yet are not calibrated probability engines. We combine both components through an auditable information harness. This paper documents four iterations: V1, a dynamic score-driven Dixon-Coles baseline; V2, which maps LLM contextual ratings back into expected-goal parameters; V3, which replaces scalar correction with goal-by-goal simulations over a frozen score-candidate set; and V4, which adds shared first-breakthrough and post-goal cascade judgments, time-aware stopping, and deterministic tail candidates. The harness defines input semantics, supplies pre-match evidence, and constrains the LLM to an inspectable reasoning route. On a chronological replay of the first 150 matches of the 2025-26 English Premier League, V1 achieved 10.0% Top-1 and 26.7% Top-3 exact-score accuracy. V3 reached 12.0% and 30.0%, while V4 reached 14.7% and 30.7%. V4 increased candidate coverage from 77.3% to 84.7%, although no added tail candidate became a Top-3 exact hit. V1's native 1X2 distribution achieved 53.3% argmax accuracy, 0.9878 log loss, 0.5870 Brier score, and 0.2095 ranked probability score. These results are exploratory: the development slice is not an untouched benchmark, and temporal input isolation cannot exclude outcome memory in a closed LLM. The contribution is an auditable hybrid architecture, a clear design evolution, and negative findings showing where football-aware simulation does and does not improve score selection.
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Interim chronological benchmark on the first 150 matches of the 2025-26 English Premier League

AI.title_translation: 从得分矩阵到足球感知的比赛状态模拟：用于精确比分重排的可审计LLM控制框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合统计模型与大语言模型的可审计混合框架，通过比赛状态模拟显著提升了足球精确比分的预测准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统的动态泊松族统计模型能估计球队实力和预期进球，但缺乏对战术、动机及比赛状态变化的理解；而大语言模型具备强大的推理能力，却不是校准良好的概率引擎。因此，需要将两者的优势结合起来，解决足球比分预测中兼具统计核心与复杂上下文的难题。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含四个迭代版本（V1至V4）的可审计信息控制框架。V1为动态Dixon-Coles基线模型；V2将LLM的上下文评分映射回预期进球参数；V3在固定的比分候选集上进行逐球模拟；V4则加入了共享的首次进球突破与进球后连锁反应判断、时间感知停止机制以及确定性尾部候选。
AI.result: 在对2025-26赛季英超前150场比赛的回测中，V1的Top-1和Top-3准确率分别为10.0%和26.7%；V3分别达到12.0%和30.0%；V4则提升至14.7%和30.7%。V4将候选集覆盖率从77.3%提高到84.7%，但新增的尾部候选未能进入前三命中。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过构建一个可审计的混合架构（V1-V4迭代），展示了将统计模型与大语言模型结合进行足球比赛比分模拟的可行性。结果表明，比赛状态模拟能显著提升精确比分的预测准确率，但同时也伴随着局限性和探索性质。
AI.translation: 足球比分预测将强大的统计核心与困难的上下文优势结合在一起。动态泊松族模型可以估计球队实力、预期进球和一致的比分概率，但不能直接理解角色、战术对决、动机或第一个进球如何改变行为。大语言模型（LLM）可以推理这些概念，但并不是校准良好的概率引擎。我们通过一个可审计的信息控制框架将这两个组件结合起来。本文记录了四个迭代版本：V1是一个动态得分驱动的Dixon-Coles基线模型；V2将LLM上下文评分映射回预期进球参数；V3在固定的比分候选集上用逐球模拟代替标量校正；V4增加了共享的首次突破和进球后连锁反应判断、时间感知停止以及确定的尾部候选。该框架定义了输入语义，提供赛前证据，并将LLM约束在可检查的推理路径上。在对2025-26赛季英格兰足球超级联赛前150场比赛的时序重放中，V1实现了10.0%的Top-1和26.7%的Top-3精确比分准确率。V3达到了12.0%和30.0%，而V4达到了14.7%和30.7%。V4将候选覆盖率从77.3%提高到了84.7%，尽管没有增加的尾部候选成为Top-3精确命中。V1的本地1X2分布实现了53.3%的argmax准确率、0.9878的对数损失、0.5870的布里尔分数和0.2095的排序概率分数。这些结果是探索性的：开发切片不是一个未被触及的基准，并且在封闭的LLM中时间输入隔离不能排除结果记忆。该贡献是一个可审计的混合架构、清晰的设计演进以及展示足球感知模拟在何处改进和未改进比分选择的负面发现。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种将统计学比分矩阵与大语言模型结合的可审计混合框架，用于足球比赛的精确比分重排。通过四个版本的迭代演进，该方法利用LLM对比赛状态和战术背景的推理来改进传统的泊松族模型（如Dixon-Coles），在英超比赛的历史回测中显著提升了精确比分的预测准确率。
AI.keywords: 足球比分预测, 大语言模型, Dixon-Coles模型, 比赛状态模拟, 可审计混合架构
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地结合了统计模型（如Dixon-Coles）与大型语言模型的优势，提出了一种可审计的信息控制框架，用于足球比分预测。通过四个版本的迭代，证明了基于比赛状态的模拟能有效提升比分预测的准确率，同时也指出了LLM在处理这类任务时的局限性。

title: Dimensions of Power: A Systematic Guide to Power Indices for Explainable AI
summary: Power indices, originating in cooperative game theory, quantify each player's influence on the outcome of a given game. Originally designed to distribute profits or costs among players and to analyse the fairness of voting systems, power indices have recently gained prominence as methods for attributing outputs of AI-based systems to inputs, thus facilitating explainability. However, selecting the appropriate power index for a given explanation task is an understudied problem. To address this, we organise power indices along three attribution dimensions: single-player, set-based, and cardinality-based. For each dimension, we review the corresponding power indices, generalise existing ones where applicable, and analyse which formal principles they satisfy. We provide proofs for properties that are missing in the literature and show that moving to the cardinality-based setting removes player-identity information while preserving some index-level distinctions. Using concrete examples, we illustrate how the choice of dimension and index affects the resulting attributions in practice, and offer guidance for practitioners seeking to select a suitable power index for a given application context.

AI.title_translation: 权力的维度：可解释人工智能权力指数系统指南
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套系统指南，通过将权力指数划分为三个维度，帮助从业者在可解释人工智能中选择合适的权力指数进行输入归因。
AI.motivation: 尽管权力指数最近在人工智能输出对输入的归因（即可解释性）中日益凸显，但针对特定解释任务如何选择合适的权力指数仍然是一个研究不足的问题。
AI.method: 沿着单玩家、基于集合和基于基数三个归因维度组织权力指数，对现有指数进行回顾与推广，分析其满足的形式化原则，并对文献中缺失的性质提供证明。
AI.result: 论文证明了相关性质，展示了转向基于基数的设置会消除玩家身份信息但保留某些指数级差异，并通过具体示例说明了维度和指数选择对实际归因的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过提出一个系统的指导框架，本文澄清了不同权力指数在可解释人工智能中的适用性，帮助从业者在具体的应用场景中做出明智的选择。
AI.translation: 权力指数源于合作博弈论，用于量化每个玩家对给定游戏结果的影响。最初设计用于在玩家之间分配利润或成本以及分析投票系统的公平性，权力指数最近作为将基于AI系统的输出归因于输入的方法而受到重视，从而促进了可解释性。然而，为给定的解释任务选择合适的权力指数是一个研究不足的问题。为了解决这个问题，我们沿着三个归因维度组织权力指数：单玩家、基于集合和基于基数。对于每个维度，我们回顾了相应的权力指数，在适用的情况下推广了现有的指数，并分析了它们满足的形式原理。我们为文献中缺失的属性提供了证明，并表明转向基于基数的设置会消除玩家身份信息，同时保留一些指数级别的差异。通过具体的例子，我们说明了维度和指数的选择如何在实践中影响产生的归因，并为寻求在给定应用上下文中选择合适权力指数的从业者提供了指导。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究了源自合作博弈论的权力指数在可解释人工智能（XAI）中的应用。通过将权力指数划分为单玩家、基于集合和基于基数三个维度，作者回顾并推广了现有指数，分析了其形式化原则，并为从业者在实际应用中选择合适的权力指数提供了实用指导。
AI.keywords: 权力指数, 可解释人工智能, 合作博弈论, 归因方法, 投票系统
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地将合作博弈论中的权力指数引入可解释性人工智能（XAI）领域，通过三个维度进行分类与泛化，填补了针对特定解释任务选择合适权力指数的研究空白，具有重要的理论与实践指导意义。

title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
summary:
Sparse matrix kernels are fundamental to scientific computing, graph analytics, and machine learning. Their GPU performance depends strongly on the input sparsity pattern and execution strategy. For the same SpMM on the same matrix, cuSPARSE exhibits a 350x performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL. Our study of multiple data formats, specialized systems, and sparse compilers shows that no single implementation consistently dominates across sparsity patterns and operators. This motivates a system that can adapt its representation, execution strategy, and hardware mapping to each workload and target GPU.
  We present SparseDitto, an LLM-based system that constructs a GPU kernel for each matrix, operator, and target GPU. SparseDitto supports SpMV, SpMM, and SpGEMM within a unified design framework. A lightweight additive model ranks established strategies using structural features of the input matrix. An architecture-aware planner then proposes several candidate designs. Coding and verification agents implement and refine them using measurements from the target GPU. Across three sparse operators and a diverse set of matrices, SparseDitto achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 2.68x over cuSPARSE on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, with a maximum of 146.61x. On an NVIDIA H200 GPU, it achieves 2.79x, with a maximum of 78.5x. Its generated SpMM kernels also accelerate full-batch GCN training by up to 3.39x.

title: When Do PEFT Adaptations Leak Structure? Measuring Black-Box Structural Bounds in Public-Base Model Services
summary: Services increasingly deploy public foundation models with private parameter-efficient adaptations, creating a differential information leakage risk when auditors or adversaries can execute the public base model locally and observe victim outputs. We present VectorHijack-SR, a measurement methodology that converts paired victim/base residuals into calibrated structural bounds over PEFT family, layer locality, and coarse rank, while separating metadata visibility from open-world validity and operational exploitability. Our estimator aggregates query-level magnitude, ranking, entropy, margin, length, template, locality, and spectral statistics into service-level representations. A service-disjoint classifier quantifies structural evidence, and a cross-fitted hierarchical rejector evaluates whether a victim lies outside the calibrated LoRA manifold. Across classification backbones, family leakage exceeds uniform chance on BERT/MNLI (8/12), RoBERTa/MNLI (21/24), and DeBERTa-v3 on MNLI (12/18) and AG News (15/18). Rank inference is task dependent: BERT/MNLI and DeBERTa/AG News reach 8/9, whereas DeBERTa/MNLI achieves 4/9 and is statistically compatible with chance after correction. On a ten-seed BERT open-set grid, the rejector achieves pooled AUROC 0.804 (95% CI [0.660, 0.927]) and known accuracy 0.956, but remains limited on structurally close DoRA and LoRA+head variants. Exact-version linkage on five held-out LoRA-r64 services reaches AUC 0.940. Experiments reveal a visibility-exploitability gap: two-stage recovery provides no fair-budget query savings, posterior-selected PEFT underperforms distill-then-convert PEFT (0.356 vs. 0.517), and free-running generation remains near chance. These results show that known-base, rich-output PEFT services can leak actionable structural and version information, while closed-set confidence alone does not establish universal adapter recovery.

AI.title_translation: PEFT适配器何时会泄露结构？测量公共基座模型服务中的黑盒结构边界
AI.tldr: 本文提出VectorHijack-SR方法，证明了公共基座模型服务中的私有PEFT适配器存在结构和版本信息泄露风险。
AI.motivation: 随着服务越来越多地部署带有私有参数高效微调（PEFT）的公共基础模型，当审计师或攻击者能够在本地执行公共基础模型并观察受害者输出时，会产生差分信息泄露风险。本研究旨在测量和评估这种黑盒结构边界。
AI.method: 提出VectorHijack-SR测量方法，将配对的受害者/基础残差转换为关于PEFT族、层局部性和粗秩的校准结构边界；聚合查询级统计量形成服务级表示，利用服务不相交分类器量化结构证据，并通过交叉拟合的分层拒绝器评估受害者是否位于校准的LoRA流形之外。
AI.result: 在多个分类骨干网络上，家族泄露超过了随机均匀概率（如BERT/MNLI 8/12，RoBERTa/MNLI 21/24等）；秩推断具有任务依赖性；在BERT开放集网格上拒绝器实现了较高的AUROC（0.804）和已知准确率（0.956）；精确版本链接达到了0.940的AUC；实验揭示了可见性与可利用性之间的鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 已知基座且输出丰富的PEFT服务会泄露可操作的结构和版本信息，但封闭集的置信度并不能保证通用适配器的完全恢复。
AI.translation: 服务越来越多地部署带有私有参数高效微调（PEFT）的公共基础模型，当审计师或攻击者能够在本地执行公共基础模型并观察受害者输出时，这会产生差分信息泄露风险。我们提出了VectorHijack-SR，这是一种测量方法，它将配对的受害者/基础残差转换为关于PEFT族、层局部性和粗秩的校准结构边界，同时将元数据可见性与开放世界有效性和操作可利用性区分开来。我们的估计器将查询级的大小、排名、熵、边距、长度、模板、局部性和谱统计量聚合为服务级表示。服务不相交分类器量化了结构证据，交叉拟合的分层拒绝器评估受害者是否位于校准的LoRA流形之外。在不同的分类骨干网络中，家族泄露超过了均匀随机几率（BERT/MNLI为8/12，RoBERTa/MNLI为21/24，DeBERTa-v3在MNLI上为12/18，在AG News上为15/18）。秩推断具有任务依赖性：BERT/MNLI和DeBERTa/AG News达到8/9，而DeBERTa/MNLI达到4/9，校正后在统计上与几率相符。在一个十种子BERT开放集网格上，拒绝器实现了0.804的聚合AUROC（95% CI [0.660, 0.927]）和0.956的已知准确率，但在结构上相近的DoRA和LoRA+head变体上仍然受限。在五个保留的LoRA-r64服务上的精确版本链接达到了0.940的AUC。实验揭示了可见性与可利用性之间的鸿沟：两阶段恢复不提供公平预算的查询节省，后验选择的PEFT表现不如蒸馏后转换的PEFT（0.356对0.517），且自由运行生成保持在接近几率的水平。这些结果表明，已知基座、丰富输出的PEFT服务可以泄露可操作的结构和版本信息，而仅靠闭集置信度并不能建立通用的适配器恢复。
AI.summary: 本文研究了公共基础模型服务中私有PEFT适配器的结构信息泄露风险，提出了VectorHijack-SR测量方法来量化PEFT家族、层局部性和粗秩的结构边界，并通过实验证明了已知基座的PEFT服务存在结构和版本信息的泄露。
AI.keywords: 参数高效微调 (PEFT), 信息泄露, 黑盒测量, 结构边界, 模型安全
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了VectorHijack-SR测量方法，通过黑盒观测探究了公共基础模型服务中私有参数高效微调（PEFT）适配器的结构信息泄露风险。该研究在密码学和隐私保护交叉领域具有重要意义，明确指出了已知基座、丰富输出的PEFT服务存在结构和版本信息的泄露风险，并揭示了可见性与可利用性之间的鸿沟。

title: Private Direct Preference Optimization for LLM Alignment
comments: accepted for publication at CCS 2026, extended version
summary:
Direct preference optimization (DPO) is now a standard method for aligning large language models (LLMs) using human preference data. Each DPO example contains a prompt and a pair of candidate model responses. While prompts and responses are often public or model-generated, the relative preference between responses reflects subjective judgments and can reveal sensitive attributes of annotators or end users. Off-the-shelf privacy-preserving approaches are not well matched to this structure, leading to unnecessary noise injection and biased updates in training.
  In this paper, we formalize preference privacy, a label-DP-style privacy notion for DPO that protects only the relative preference between candidate responses, assuming an adversary who already knows the prompt and responses. We then design PrivDPO, a DPO variant that enforces preference privacy while remaining compatible with large-scale LLM training. Our main observation is that, for neighboring examples differing only in their preference signal, the gradient difference lies on a one-dimensional preference axis determined solely by the text; all preference information flows through this axis. PrivDPO adds calibrated randomness only along this axis via an unbiased randomized rescaling of the DPO objective, avoiding per-example gradient operations. Our experiments on three alignment benchmarks and three LLM families show that PrivDPO consistently achieves strong privacy-utility trade-offs compared with privacy-preserving baselines.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型对齐的私有直接偏好优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了PrivDPO，一种专为大模型DPO对齐设计的隐私保护方法，通过在特定的偏好轴上添加校准噪声，在保护标注者隐私的同时实现了优秀的模型性能。
AI.motivation: 人类偏好数据往往包含敏感属性，而现有的通用隐私保护方法不适合DPO的结构，会导致不必要的噪声注入和有偏的更新。因此需要专门针对偏好对齐设计的隐私保护方法。
AI.method: 提出PrivDPO算法，利用一维偏好轴的概念，通过对DPO目标函数进行无偏随机重缩放，仅在该轴上添加校准的随机性，从而避免了繁琐的逐样本梯度操作。
AI.result: 在三个对齐基准和三个大模型系列上的实验表明，与现有的隐私保护基线相比，PrivDPO始终能实现更强的隐私-效能权衡。
AI.conclusion: PrivDPO为大模型偏好对齐提供了一种高效且具备强隐私-效能权衡的差分隐私解决方案。
AI.translation:
直接偏好优化（DPO）现在是利用人类偏好数据对齐大语言模型（LLM）的标准方法。每个DPO示例包含一个提示词和一对候选模型响应。虽然提示词和响应通常是公开的或模型生成的，但响应之间的相对偏好反映了主观判断，可能会泄露标注者或最终用户的敏感属性。现有的开箱即用隐私保护方法与这种结构并不匹配，会导致训练中注入不必要的噪声并产生有偏更新。
在本文中，我们形式化了偏好隐私（preference privacy），这是一种针对DPO的标签差分隐私风格的隐私概念，它仅保护候选响应之间的相对偏好，假设攻击者已经知道提示词和响应。然后，我们设计了PrivDPO，这是一种DPO变体，它在保持与大规模LLM训练兼容的同时强制执行偏好隐私。我们的主要观察是，对于仅在偏好信号上有所不同的相邻示例，梯度差位于完全由文本决定的一维偏好轴上；所有偏好信息都流经该轴。PrivDPO通过对DPO目标函数进行无偏随机重缩放，仅沿该轴添加校准的随机性，从而避免了逐示例的梯度操作。我们在三个对齐基准和三个LLM系列上的实验表明，与隐私保护基线相比，PrivDPO始终能实现强大的隐私-效能权衡。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大语言模型对齐中的隐私保护问题，提出了针对DPO的偏好隐私概念和PrivDPO算法。该方法通过在一维偏好轴上添加校准噪声，避免了复杂的逐样本梯度计算，在多个基准测试中展现出优异的隐私-效能权衡。
AI.keywords: 大模型对齐, 直接偏好优化, 差分隐私, 偏好隐私
AI.comments: 该论文针对大模型对齐中的DPO方法提出了隐私保护方案，创新性地定义了偏好隐私（Preference Privacy），并通过一维偏好轴的重缩放实现了高效的差分隐私训练，兼顾了隐私与模型效能。

title: BridgeVLA++: A Data-Efficient, Generalizable, and Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Framework for 3D Manipulation
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE TPAMI for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Leveraging pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to construct vision-language-action (VLA) models has emerged as a promising paradigm for 3D robot manipulation. However, existing 3D VLA methods remain data-hungry, exhibit limited generalization under distribution shifts, and lack explicit memory of past observations. These limitations hinder their application to data-scarce, open-world, and memory-dependent manipulation scenarios. Our previous work, BridgeVLA, improves data efficiency and generalization by preserving the input--output alignment of a pre-trained VLM during 3D action learning: raw point clouds are projected into multi-view images, and intermediate heatmaps are predicted before generating robot actions. In this work, we develop BridgeVLA++ by equipping BridgeVLA with a unified spatio-temporal memory architecture that models persistent spatial context and temporal interaction history. The resulting memory-augmented framework can reason over observation histories while preserving BridgeVLA's data efficiency and generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves strong performance on spatial manipulation tasks while exhibiting robust generalization. BridgeVLA++ further achieves state-of-the-art performance on two challenging memory-dependent manipulation benchmarks without sacrificing the data efficiency and generalization of the original BridgeVLA. In addition, BridgeVLA++ performs effectively in bimanual manipulation settings and is validated on an additional real-world robotic platform, demonstrating its scalability across tasks, environments, and robotic platforms. These results establish BridgeVLA++ as a unified 3D vision-language-action framework that simultaneously supports data-efficient learning, robust generalization, and effective memory-aware robot manipulation. Project website: https://bridgevla-plus.github.io/.

AI.title_translation: BridgeVLA++：一个面向3D操作的数据高效、可泛化且具备记忆增强的视觉-语言-动作框架
AI.tldr: BridgeVLA++是一个集成了时空记忆架构的3D视觉-语言-动作框架，显著提升了机器人在数据稀缺、开放世界和依赖记忆场景下的操作能力与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D VLA方法存在数据需求量大、在分布偏移下泛化能力有限、且缺乏对过去观测的显式记忆等问题，无法满足数据稀缺、开放世界和依赖记忆的操作场景需求。
AI.method: 在BridgeVLA的基础上，配备了统一的时空记忆架构，用于建模持久的空间上下文和时间交互历史。
AI.result: 在空间操作任务上表现强劲且泛化鲁棒；在两个具挑战性的依赖记忆的操作基准上取得了SOTA性能；在双臂操作和真实世界机器人平台上得到有效验证。
AI.conclusion: BridgeVLA++是一个统一的3D VLA框架，能够同时实现数据高效学习、鲁棒泛化和有效的记忆感知机器人操作。
AI.translation: 利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）来构建视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，已成为3D机器人操作的一个有前景范式。然而，现有的3D VLA方法仍然非常消耗数据，在分布偏移下表现出有限的泛化能力，且缺乏对过去观测的显式记忆。这些局限性阻碍了它们在数据稀缺、开放世界和依赖记忆的操作场景中的应用。我们先前的研究BridgeVLA通过在3D动作学习期间保留预训练VLM的输入-输出对齐，提高了数据效率和泛化能力：将原始点云投影到多视角图像中，并在生成机器人动作之前预测中间热力图。在这项工作中，我们开发了BridgeVLA++，通过为BridgeVLA配备一个统一的时空记忆架构来对持久的空间上下文和时间交互历史进行建模。由此产生的记忆增强框架能够在推理观测历史的同时，保持BridgeVLA的数据效率和泛化能力。大量实验表明，我们的框架在空间操作任务上取得了优异的性能，同时展现出强大的泛化能力。BridgeVLA++在两个具挑战性的依赖记忆的操作基准上进一步实现了最先进的性能，且没有牺牲原始BridgeVLA的数据效率和泛化能力。此外，BridgeVLA++在双臂操作设置中表现有效，并在另一个真实世界的机器人平台上得到了验证，证明了其在不同任务、环境和机器人平台之间的可扩展性。这些结果确立了BridgeVLA++作为一个统一的3D视觉-语言-动作框架，能够同时支持数据高效学习、鲁棒泛化和有效的记忆感知机器人操作。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BridgeVLA++，这是一个针对3D操作的数据高效、可泛化且具备记忆增强的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过引入时空记忆架构解决了以往VLA模型缺乏历史记忆的问题，并在多种复杂任务和真实平台上展现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: 3D操作, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 时空记忆, 数据高效, 机器人学
AI.comments: BridgeVLA++在保持前作数据高效和泛化能力的基础上，引入了时空记忆架构，有效解决了具身智能中长期存在的记忆依赖问题，并在双臂操作和真实世界平台上验证了其强大的可扩展性。

title: Gradient Immunity: Null-Space Resistance to Malicious Fine-Tuning
summary: Released aligned large language models remain vulnerable to malicious downstream finetuning. Existing defenses are largely designed for the fine-tuning-as-a-service (FTaaS) paradigm or rely on downstream users to follow additional safety procedures, and therefore do not directly address the setting we study: a provider controlled partially protected open-weight (PPOW) release setting in which most weights remain trainable while a small safety-critical component is preserved at release. We propose a Unidirectional Safety Gate (USG), instantiated as a Null Space Cubic Layer together with an Inverse Adapter inserted after the final Transformer layer. During downstream fine-tuning, the cubic layer suppresses or blocks gradients from harmful samples whose hidden states fall in a calibrated protected region, while the Inverse Adapter restores the base model's forward behavior. In practice, we calibrate a threshold using defender-held harmful data, allowing protection to generalize to nearby in-distribution harmful samples. Across six evaluated model-dataset settings, USG keeps post-finetuning attack success rate close to the pre-release level under a fixed release threshold, while maintaining high safe-pass rates on easier settings and exhibiting a clearer safety-utility trade-off on unsafe samples from BeaverTails. These results suggest that release-time representation-space blocking can raise the cost of malicious downstream adaptation without requiring downstream cooperation. The code is available at https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/Gradient-Immunity.

AI.title_translation: 梯度免疫：对恶意微调的零空间抵抗
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为USG的新防御方法，利用零空间技术在模型发布时阻止恶意微调对大语言模型安全性的破坏，无需下游用户配合。
AI.motivation: 目前发布的对齐大语言模型容易受到恶意的下游微调攻击，现有防御大多依赖微调即服务（FTaaS）范式或下游用户的配合，无法直接解决提供商控制的部分受保护开源权重（PPOW）发布场景。
AI.method: 提出了单向安全门（USG），包含一个零空间三次层和一个插入在最终Transformer层之后的逆适配器，通过抑制有害样本的梯度并恢复基础模型的前向行为来实现防御。
AI.result: 在六个评估模型-数据集设置中，USG在固定发布阈值下使微调后的攻击成功率保持在接近预发布水平，同时保持了较高的安全通过率。
AI.conclusion: 基于零空间和单向安全门的防御机制（USG）能够有效抵抗恶意的下游微调，在保持模型实用性的同时大幅降低攻击成功率。
AI.translation: 发布对齐的大语言模型仍然容易受到恶意的下游微调攻击。现有的防御措施主要针对微调即服务（FTaaS）范式，或者依赖下游用户遵循额外的安全程序，因此并未直接解决我们研究的场景：即提供商控制的部分受保护开源权重（PPOW）发布场景，其中大部分权重可训练，但在发布时保留了一个小的安全关键组件。我们提出了单向安全门（USG），它实例化为零空间三次层以及插入在最终Transformer层之后的逆适配器。在下游微调过程中，三次层抑制或阻断了其隐藏状态落入校准保护区域的有害样本的梯度，而逆适配器恢复了基础模型的前向行为。在实践中，我们使用防御者持有的有害数据校准阈值，使保护能够泛化到附近的同分布有害样本。在六个评估的模型-数据集设置中，USG在固定的发布阈值下，将微调后的攻击成功率保持在接近预发布水平，同时在较简单的设置中保持了高的安全通过率，并在BeaverTails的不安全样本上展现出更清晰的安全-效用权衡。这些结果表明，发布时的表征空间阻断可以在不需要下游配合的情况下，提高恶意下游适配的成本。代码可在https://github.com/OpenCausaLab/Gradient-Immunity获取。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了开源大语言模型在面对恶意下游微调时的安全性问题，并提出了一种名为单向安全门（USG）的发布时防御机制，通过零空间抵抗恶意梯度更新，在无需下游配合的情况下显著提高了恶意攻击的成本。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 恶意微调, 零空间, 安全防御, 开源模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“梯度免疫”视角，通过在发布时利用零空间（Null-Space）技术来抵抗恶意微调，无需下游用户的配合，对开源大语言模型的安全防御具有重要意义。

title: Exact Model-Free Policy Iteration for Co-safe LTL Planning
comments: 7 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication in IEEE Control Systems Letters. To be presented at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary: This work studies model-free reinforcement learning for co-safe linear temporal logic (sc-LTL) objectives in finite Markov decision processes, which can be reduced to maximal reachability objectives via the standard product construction. For this problem, direct sample-based bootstrap methods (e.g., TD or Q-learning) may fail to converge to optimal policies due to the noncontractive nature and nonuniqueness of solutions to the Bellman equation. We develop a new two-step model-free reinforcement learning method that first uses a discounted surrogate to identify a clamp set that resolves this nonuniqueness, and then applies undiscounted policy evaluation and greedy policy improvement with guarantees of finding an optimal solution. We prove almost-sure convergence of the policy evaluation step and finite termination of the policy iteration algorithm at an optimal policy. These theoretical results are validated through numerical experiments on a stochastic grid world.
