title: BnBERT-iPET: Sparse Few-Shot Language Modeling for Bengali via Lottery Ticket Pruning
summary: Deep neural networks have shown impressive success in NLP tasks owing to their complex structure and huge number of edges. Achieving state-of-the-art performance in natural language processing with a large pre-trained model such as BERT is expensive and time-consuming, carries a large carbon footprint, and is difficult to realize on machines with minimal computational capability. This creates a barrier to training complex models for resource-constrained languages such as Bengali. However, in a complex neural model, not all edges are equally impactful, and the contributions of some of them can be neglected. Pruning promises to reduce the memory footprint of regular networks, shorten the training time of ever-growing networks, and increase inference efficiency without sacrificing comparable performance. In this work, we introduce BnBERT-iPET, a sparse few-shot language modeling approach for Bengali, and experimentally show that a lightweight few-shot-learned language model retaining only 10% of the edges of an initial model such as BERT can perform neck and neck with much larger models on challenging tasks for a resource-constrained language such as Bengali. By learning from few shots through iterative pattern exploiting training and achieving 90% sparsity with the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis pruning technique, our pruned BnBERT-iPET model proves to be a tough competitor to state-of-the-art language models such as Bangla Electra, Indic-BERT, and XLM-RoBERTa on downstream tasks over standard benchmark datasets of the Bengali language.

AI.title_translation: BnBERT-iPET：基于彩票假设剪枝的孟加拉语稀疏少样本语言建模
AI.tldr: 通过彩票假设剪枝技术，BnBERT-iPET 实现了仅保留10%参数的孟加拉语轻量化少样本语言模型，且性能可与最先进的大模型媲美。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练模型计算成本高昂且碳足迹大，在计算资源受限的语言（如孟加拉语）中难以实现，而模型剪枝可以在不牺牲性能的前提下减小内存占用并提高效率。
AI.method: 结合了迭代模式利用训练（iPET）的少样本语言建模方法，并利用彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）剪枝技术实现 90% 的稀疏性。
AI.result: 提出的轻量级 BnBERT-iPET 模型仅保留了初始模型 10% 的边（90% 稀疏度），在孟加拉语的标准基准数据集的下游任务中，其性能与 Bangla Electra、Indic-BERT 和 XLM-RoBERTa 等先进语言模型不相上下。
AI.conclusion: BnBERT-iPET 证明了通过结合迭代模式利用训练和彩票假设剪枝，可以在资源受限的孟加拉语NLP任务中，构建出轻量化且具有高度竞争力的少样本语言模型。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络由于其复杂的结构和大量的边缘，在自然语言处理（NLP）任务中取得了令人瞩目的成功。利用 BERT 等大型预训练模型实现最先进的性能是昂贵且耗时的，具有巨大的碳足迹，并且难以在计算能力极低的机器上实现。这为训练资源匮乏语言（如孟加拉语）的复杂模型制造了障碍。然而，在复杂的神经模型中，并非所有边缘的影响力都相同，其中一些边缘的贡献可以被忽略。剪枝有望在不牺牲可比性能的情况下，减少常规网络的内存占用，缩短不断增长的训练时间，并提高推理效率。在这项工作中，我们推出了 BnBERT-iPET，这是一种针对孟加拉语的稀疏少样本语言建模方法，并通过实验表明，一个轻量级的少样本学习语言模型（仅保留诸如 BERT 等初始模型 10% 的边缘）能够在资源匮乏语言（如孟加拉语）的挑战性任务中，与更大的模型不相上下。通过少样本学习（通过迭代模式利用训练）并利用彩票假设剪枝技术实现 90% 的稀疏性，我们剪枝后的 BnBERT-iPET 模型被证明是孟加拉语标准基准数据集下游任务上诸如 Bangla Electra、Indic-BERT 和 XLM-RoBERTa 等先进语言模型的强劲竞争对手。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了 BnBERT-iPET，这是一种针对孟加拉语的稀疏少样本语言建模方法。通过结合迭代模式利用训练和彩票假设剪枝，该方法在仅保留10%模型参数的情况下，在孟加拉语下游任务中取得了与最先进大模型相当的性能。
AI.keywords: 孟加拉语, 少样本学习, 语言建模, 彩票假设, 模型剪枝
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将彩票 hypothesis 剪枝技术应用于孟加拉语的少样本预训练语言模型中，在大幅减小模型体积（保留10%参数）的同时保持了具有竞争力的性能，对资源匮乏语言的NLP研究具有重要价值。

title: CoPlan: A Trustworthy Co-Intelligence Interface for Care Planning through Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs
comments: Accepted at the 2026 International Conference on Next Generation AI Systems (NGEN-AI 2026)
summary: AI-supported care planning can help clinicians, patients, caregivers, and care teams coordinate complex decisions across clinical, functional, psychosocial, and environmental needs. However, many AI systems present recommendations as fixed outputs, limiting stakeholders' ability to inspect, challenge, and revise plans when they conflict with clinical judgment, patient values, or real-world feasibility. We present CoPlan - a Co-Intelligent and Contestable Interface for Human-AI Care Planning. CoPlan uses a multi-agent workflow in which specialized AI agents generate candidate interventions and supporting or challenging arguments, while human care planners can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before final plan generation. Through this design, CoPlan combines co-intelligence, in which humans and AI agents contribute complementary expertise, with contestability, where recommendations remain open to inspection, revision, and justification. We demonstrate CoPlan in an aging-in-place care planning scenario. The system supports adaptive care team recruitment, role-based argument review, final care plan generation, and practical follow-up through scheduling agents. This work contributes a contestable care planning interface and a design framing for trustworthy human-AI care planning that preserves human agency and clinical accountability.
comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Conference on Next Generation AI Systems (NGEN-AI 2026)

AI.title_translation: CoPlan：一个基于角色可异议论辩图的护理规划可信人机协同接口
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为CoPlan的人机协同护理规划接口，通过可异议的多智能体论辩图，让医疗团队能够检查、挑战和修改AI的护理建议，从而确保人类的决策主导权和临床问责制。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI辅助护理规划系统通常将建议作为固定输出呈现，限制了利益相关者在面对临床判断、患者价值观或现实可行性冲突时检查、挑战和修改计划的能力，因此需要开发一种可信赖的、支持人机协同与可异议性的护理规划界面。
AI.method: 采用基于多智能体的工作流，由专用AI智能体生成候选干预措施以及支持或反驳的论据，并提供基于角色的可异议论辩图，让人类护理规划者对论据进行接受、拒绝、修改或添加，最后生成最终护理计划并进行实际跟进。
AI.result: 在居家养老（aging-in-place）护理规划场景中成功演示了CoPlan系统，支持自适应护理团队招募、基于角色的论据审查、最终护理计划生成以及通过调度智能体进行实际跟进。
AI.conclusion: CoPlan作为一个可信赖的人机协同护理规划接口，通过多智能体工作流与可异议的论辩图机制，在保留人类主体性和临床问责制的同时，提升了护理规划的质量与效率。
AI.translation: AI支持的护理规划可以帮助临床医生、患者、照顾者和护理团队协调跨临床、功能、心理社会和环境需求的复杂决策。然而，许多AI系统将建议作为固定输出呈现，限制了利益相关者在建议与临床判断、患者价值观或现实可行性发生冲突时检查、挑战和修改计划的能力。我们提出了CoPlan——一个用于人机护理规划的协同智能与可异议接口。CoPlan使用多智能体工作流，其中专门的AI智能体生成候选干预措施以及支持或挑战的论据，而人类护理规划者可以在生成最终计划之前接受、拒绝、修改或添加论据。通过这种设计，CoPlan将协同智能（人类和AI智能体贡献互补专长）与可异议性（推荐建议仍然开放以供检查、修改和论证）结合起来。我们在居家养老护理规划场景中演示了CoPlan。该系统支持自适应护理团队招募、基于角色的论据审查、最终护理计划生成以及通过调度智能体进行实际跟进。这项工作贡献了一个可异议的护理规划接口以及用于可信赖的人机护理规划的设计框架，从而保留了人类的主体性和临床问责制。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CoPlan，这是一个用于护理规划的可信赖人机协同与可异议接口。它利用多智能体工作流生成候选干预措施和论据，允许人类规划者检查、修改和挑战AI建议，从而在居家养老场景中保留了人类的代理权和临床问责制。
AI.keywords: 护理规划, 人机协同, 可异议性, 多智能体系统, 可信赖AI
AI.comments: 该论文提出的CoPlan接口很好地结合了人工智能的协同效率与人类的临床决策权，通过基于角色的可异议论辩图（Contestable Argument Graphs），有效解决了医疗AI系统中常见的不透明和“一言堂”问题，对构建可信赖的医疗人机协作系统具有重要意义。

title: Agent Against Agent: An Agentic System for Automatic Prompt Injection Red Teaming
comments: Our code is available at https://github.com/wang-yanting/PIMiner
summary: Prompt injection poses significant security risks to LLM agents. Efficient and effective red-teaming is therefore critical, both for evaluating these risks and for collecting training data to improve defenses. Existing state-of-the-art prompt injection red-teaming methods primarily rely on reinforcement learning (RL), producing attacker models that often generalize poorly to new target LLMs. In this work, we develop PIMiner, an agentic system for prompt injection red-teaming. During training, PIMiner is trained on a sequence of (dataset, target model) pairs and builds a strategy library from scratch. At test time, the learned strategy library can be directly transferred to a previously unseen target LLM without additional training. PIMiner requires only a small number of queries to a target agent (e.g., 10) per test sample. Experimental results demonstrate that PIMiner achieves strong performance. On IPIArena, it attains a 76.2% ASR against Gemini-2.5-Pro, 61.9% ASR against GPT-5.1, and 42.9% ASR against Claude-Sonnet-4.5. On AgentDojo, it achieves an 86.7% ASR against Gemini-2.5-Pro, 53.3% ASR against GPT-5.1, and 40.0% ASR against Claude-Sonnet-4.5.
comment: Our code is available at https://github.com/wang-yanting/PIMiner

AI.title_translation: 智能体对智能体：用于自动提示词注入红蓝对抗的智能体系统
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PIMiner的智能体系统，通过构建可迁移的策略库来实现高效的自动提示词注入红蓝对抗，无需对新模型进行额外训练即可实现高攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于强化学习的最先进提示词注入红蓝对抗方法主要依赖于训练攻击者模型，这些模型通常对新的目标大语言模型泛化能力较差，因此需要开发一种高效且具备良好泛化能力的红蓝对抗系统。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为PIMiner的智能体系统。在训练阶段，PIMiner在一系列（数据集，目标模型）对上进行训练，从零开始构建一个策略库；在测试阶段，学到的策略库可以直接转移到未见过的目标大语言模型，且每个测试样本仅需少量的查询次数。
AI.result: 在IPIArena上，PIMiner对Gemini-2.5-Pro达到了76.2%的攻击成功率（ASR），对GPT-5.1达到了61.9%的ASR，对Claude-Sonnet-4.5达到了42.9%的ASR；在AgentDojo上，对Gemini-2.5-Pro达到了86.7%的ASR，对GPT-5.1达到了53.3%的ASR，对Claude-Sonnet-4.5达到了40.0%的ASR。
AI.conclusion: PIMiner作为一种新颖的智能体系统，能够高效、通用地对大语言模型智能体执行提示词注入红蓝对抗，为评估和提升模型安全性提供了强大的工具。
AI.translation: 提示词注入给大语言模型智能体带来了重大的安全风险。因此，高效且有效的红蓝对抗对于评估这些风险以及收集改进防御的训练数据至关重要。现有的最先进提示词注入红蓝对抗方法主要依赖于强化学习（RL），生成的攻击者模型通常对新的目标大语言模型泛化能力较差。在这项工作中，我们开发了PIMiner，一个用于提示词注入红蓝对抗的智能体系统。在训练期间，PIMiner在一系列（数据集，目标模型）对上进行训练，并从零开始构建一个策略库。在测试时，学习到的策略库可以直接迁移到先前未见过的目标大语言模型，而无需进行额外的训练。每个测试样本，PIMiner仅需对目标智能体进行少量的查询（例如10次）。实验结果表明，PIMiner取得了优异的性能。在IPIArena上，它对Gemini-2.5-Pro达到了76.2%的攻击成功率（ASR），对GPT-5.1达到了61.9%的ASR，对Claude-Sonnet-4.5达到了42.9%的ASR。在AgentDojo上，它对Gemini-2.5-Pro达到了86.7%的ASR，对GPT-5.1达到了53.3%的ASR，对Claude-Sonnet-4.5达到了40.0%的ASR。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了PIMiner，这是一个用于自动提示词注入红蓝对抗的智能体系统。通过在训练过程中构建策略库，PIMiner能够在不需要额外训练的情况下直接泛化到未见过的目标大语言模型，并且在多次实验中展现出极高的攻击成功率和查询效率。
AI.keywords: Prompt Injection, Red Teaming, LLM Agents, Agentic System
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为PIMiner的智能体系统，用于自动提示词注入红蓝对抗。其创新之处在于通过构建策略库实现了跨模型的直接泛化，而无需在测试时进行额外的训练，这极大地提高了红蓝对抗的效率和实用性。

title: Reward Structure Shapes the Interaction Between Episodic Exploration and Neural Memory in Reinforcement Learning
summary: In partially observable reinforcement learning, agents face a dual bottleneck: they must explore to encounter rewarding states and retain that experience in memory to optimize their policies. Exploration bonuses and memory architectures are traditionally evaluated in isolation, leaving their interaction unmeasured, and standard notions of sparse reward conflate temporal signal density with what the reward actually supervises. We present a controlled study crossing episodic exploration bonuses with diverse neural memory architectures across three environments that vary how the content of memory is acquired. An identical bonus signal yields three distinct interaction patterns: it amplifies architectural capacity differences where memory content must be actively discovered and retained unsupervised; equalizes architectures to a shared ceiling where the content, once sought out, is a single reward-supervised cue; and is null where the observation stream is purely scheduled. Controlled reward manipulations verify that these patterns track reward structure rather than density: a dense reward neutralizes a bonus only if it directly supervises the required latent memory, and a small avoidable penalty on exploratory actions (leaving the optimum unchanged) induces policy convergence to suboptimal stationary states, which either bonus resolves. We then formalize reward sparsity with observation-anchored reward machines, separating structural sparsity (an automaton reproduces the return without the task-required history) from potential sparsity (the one-step reward misprices local exploratory actions); the resulting vocabulary organizes the three regimes by the retention burden each task exposes. Together, these results show exploration and memory are complements, not substitutes: a bonus induces exposure, and only memory converts exposure into return.

AI.title_translation: 奖励结构塑造强化学习中情景探索与神经记忆的交互
AI.tldr: 强化学习中的探索奖励与神经记忆架构是互补的，其交互作用完全由任务的奖励结构而非密度塑造。
AI.motivation: 传统的探索奖励和记忆架构通常被孤立评估，它们之间的交互作用尚未被测量，且标准的稀疏奖励概念混淆了时间信号密度与奖励监督的内容，因此需要研究奖励结构如何塑造探索与记忆的交互。
AI.method: 通过控制实验，交叉组合情景探索奖励与多种神经记忆架构，在三个具有不同记忆内容获取方式的环境中进行评估，并引入基于观察锚定的奖励机器（observation-anchored reward machines）来形式化奖励稀疏性。
AI.result: 相同的奖励信号产生了三种不同的交互模式：放大架构容量差异、使架构趋于相同上限、以及无效果。结果表明这些模式取决于奖励结构而非密度，且探索奖励能够解决由可避免的小惩罚导致的策略收敛到次优平稳状态的问题。
AI.conclusion: 探索与记忆是互补的而非替代的：探索奖励诱发状态暴露，而只有记忆才能将暴露转化为回报。奖励结构决定了这种交互的形式。
AI.translation: 在部分可观测的强化学习中，智能体面临双重瓶颈：它们必须进行探索以遇到有奖励的状态，并将这些经验保留在记忆中以优化策略。探索奖励和记忆架构传统上是孤立评估的，这使得它们的交互作用未被测量，并且标准的稀疏奖励概念将时间信号密度与奖励实际监督的内容混淆了。我们提出了一项受控研究，跨越了三个环境（这些环境改变了记忆内容的获取方式），将情景探索奖励与多样化的神经记忆架构结合起来。相同的奖励信号产生了三种不同的交互模式：当记忆内容必须被主动发现并以无监督方式保留时，它放大了架构容量的差异；当记忆内容一旦被寻找出来，就是单一奖励监督的线索时，它使各个架构达到共享的上限；而在观察流纯粹是预定的情况下，它则无效。受控的奖励操纵证实了这些模式追踪的是奖励结构而不是密度：密集的奖励只有在直接监督所需潜伏记忆时才会使奖励无效，并且对探索动作的小额可避免惩罚（保持最优解不变）会导致策略收敛到次优平稳状态，而任何一种奖励都能解决这个问题。然后，我们用观察锚定的奖励机器形式化了奖励稀疏性，将结构稀疏性（自动机在没有任务所需历史的情况下复现回报）与潜在稀疏性（一步奖励对局部探索动作定价错误）分离开来；由此产生的词汇表按每个任务暴露的保留负担组织了这三种机制。总之，这些结果表明探索和记忆是互补的，而不是替代品：奖励引起暴露，只有记忆才能将暴露转化为回报。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了强化学习中情景探索与神经记忆架构的交互作用，发现奖励结构而非奖励密度塑造了这种交互。通过控制实验和引入观察锚定的奖励机器，作者表明探索和记忆是互补关系，探索奖励诱发暴露，记忆将暴露转化为回报。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 情景探索, 神经记忆, 奖励结构, 部分可观测性
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了强化学习中情景探索（episodic exploration）与神经记忆架构（neural memory architectures）之间的交互作用，揭示了奖励结构如何塑造这种交互，对理解强化学习中的探索与记忆机制具有重要理论价值。

title: Robust and Efficient Motion Reasoning for Privacy-Aware Classroom Incident Recognition
summary: Can computer vision help make classrooms safer? In this pilot study, we investigate privacy-aware and computationally efficient classroom incident recognition from CCTV-style observations. This setting remains underexplored, with limited benchmarks and few methods designed for the privacy, efficiency, and generalization demands of real-world deployment. We introduce a novel hybrid benchmark combining generative CCTV-style videos with real-world classroom pose data, and propose a lightweight, but robust motion-reasoning framework motivated by the observation that many incidents differ more in motion direction, speed, acceleration, and intensity than in pose alone. To that end, our method first constructs hierarchical kinematic representations of human actions. Our method then distills hierarchical, multi-order kinematic reasoning from a large teacher into a much smaller single-order student, enabling efficient per-person inference while preserving expressive motion understanding. Experiments show that our model outperforms substantially larger baselines at less than one-tenth of their computational cost, while also demonstrating stronger out-of-domain motion reasoning and zero-shot synthetic-to-real generalization. We will publicly release the benchmark, codebase, and supporting tools to facilitate further research in privacy-aware classroom safety.

AI.title_translation: 面向隐私保护的课堂事件识别之鲁棒且高效的运动推理
AI.tldr: 提出了一种高效、隐私保护且具备强大泛化能力的课堂事件识别框架，利用运动推理与知识蒸馏，在极低计算成本下超越了大型基准模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算机视觉方法在满足真实世界部署所需的隐私保护、计算效率和泛化能力方面存在不足，且针对此类设置的研究和基准较少，因此需要开发一种兼顾高效与鲁棒性的课堂事件识别方法。
AI.method: 构建了结合生成式CCTV视频与真实姿态数据的混合基准；提出了分层运动推理框架，首先构建人类动作的分层运动学表示，然后通过知识蒸馏将大教师模型的复杂多阶运动推理能力压缩至小单阶学生模型中。
AI.result: 实验表明，该模型在计算成本不到基准模型十分之一的情况下，性能超越了明显更大的基准模型，同时表现出更强的跨域运动推理能力和零样本（zero-shot）合成到真实的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一个高效、隐私保护且泛化能力强的课堂事件识别框架，为真实场景下的智能监控部署提供了有力的技术支撑。
AI.translation: 计算机视觉能帮助让课堂更安全吗？在这项试点研究中，我们从类似CCTV（闭路电视）的观测视角，研究了注重隐私且计算高效的课堂事件识别。这一设置在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，缺乏基准，且很少有方法能满足现实部署中对隐私、效率和泛化能力的要求。我们引入了一个新颖的混合基准，将生成的CCTV风格视频与真实世界的课堂姿态数据相结合，并提出了一种轻量且鲁棒的运动推理框架，其动机在于观察到许多事件在运动方向、速度、加速度和强度上的差异往往大于仅在姿态上的差异。为此，我们的方法首先构建了人类动作的分层运动学表示。然后，我们的方法将来自大型教师模型的分层、多阶运动推理蒸馏到一个更小的单阶学生模型中，从而在保持富于表现力的运动理解的同时，实现高效的逐人推理。实验表明，我们的模型在计算成本不到基准模型十分之一的情况下，性能优于明显更大的基准模型，同时也展示了更强的跨域运动推理能力和零样本合成到真实的泛化能力。我们将公开基准、代码库和支持工具，以促进隐私保护课堂安全领域的进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种针对隐私保护和计算高效的课堂事件识别框架。通过引入结合生成视频与真实姿态数据的混合基准，以及利用分层多阶运动推理和知识蒸馏技术，该轻量级模型在大幅降低计算成本的同时，实现了优异的识别性能与泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 课堂事件识别, 隐私保护, 运动推理, 轻量化模型, 知识蒸馏
AI.comments: 该论文针对课堂安全监控中的隐私和效率痛点，创新性地结合了生成式监控视频与真实姿态数据，并提出了基于多阶运动推理的轻量化框架，通过知识蒸馏在大幅减少计算成本的同时提升了模型的泛化能力。

title: Characterizing Visual Accessibility Issues in AI Developer Tools: An Empirical Study
summary: AI-assisted developer tools increasingly mediate programming through chat panels, terminal agents, generated diffs, and streaming status output. These interaction surfaces may create visual accessibility barriers for blind, low-vision, and color-vision-deficient developers, yet little is known about how such barriers are reported in public tool ecosystems. We analyze issues and forum discussions from five AI developer tool ecosystems: GitHub Copilot in VS Code, Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and OpenCode. From 2,652 keyword-retrieved candidates, a three-model ensemble identified 600 unanimously positive visual accessibility reports. A stratified manual sanity check supported this conservative selection. Topic modeling and qualitative analysis identified three recurring categories: screen-reader and assistive-technology barriers; visual presentation, contrast, and differentiation problems; and readability, scaling, and control limitations in AI-specific interfaces. The relative prominence of these concerns varied across ecosystems and reflected differences in editor, terminal, chat, diff, and agent interaction surfaces. An exploratory metadata analysis further identified differences in reporter activity and, across the GitHub-based ecosystems, maintainer participation and closure processes. These findings show that the accessibility record of AI developer tools is shaped by both their interaction design and the reporting and maintenance practices of their surrounding ecosystems.

title: Cardinal Grid Slime Trail is PSPACE-Complete
summary: Slime Trail is a two-player combinatorial game in which the players alternately move a shared token to an adjacent vertex, permanently removing each vertex the token leaves, while attempting to reach a goal node. Ferland and Burke (2017) proved that Slime Trail is PSPACE-complete on arbitrary planar graphs and asked whether the same holds for the grid version actually used in play. We resolve this open problem by proving that Cardinal Grid Slime Trail, that is, Slime Trail on a square grid with four-directional movement, is PSPACE-complete. We adapt their QBF reduction to the grid setting, designing grid-compatible gadgets that respect the degree-4 bound and the parity constraints of the integer lattice. We further show the construction extends, under a 45-degree rotation, to the eight-directional variant.

title: DASyR-LLM: Domain-Aware Symbolic Regression with LLMs for Kinetic Model Discovery
summary: Kinetic model discovery is a central challenge in chemical engineering, as accurate rate expressions are essential for understanding and controlling chemical and biological processes. Symbolic regression (SR) has emerged as a powerful data-driven approach for identifying interpretable kinetic models, but usually operates without domain knowledge, often exploring physicochemically implausible models. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for injecting domain expertise into this search. Here, we introduce an LLM-guided SR framework, embedding an LLM module within an iterative SR algorithm for automated kinetic model discovery. The LLM performs two roles at each iteration: (1) a qualitative physicochemical critique of the best SR candidates, and (2) the proposal of new candidate rate expressions guided by the SR-generated models and embedded chemical knowledge. Our framework is evaluated on four in silico case studies of increasing complexity, spanning heterogeneous catalysis and bioprocess systems. Results show the LLM-guided framework reduces iterations to identify the ground-truth model by $41.7-79.3\%$ versus a state-of-the-art SR framework, with the LLM directly proposing the correct model structure in over half of the guided runs. In practical settings, where each iteration typically requires a new wet-lab experiment, this translates into a substantial reduction in experimental effort. Predictive performance on an independent validation set is equivalent between both approaches, with $R^2>0.98$ in all case studies. Ablation studies indicate that both the SR component and the LLM scale contribute to this performance, with a reduced-size LLM largely retaining discovery efficiency. These findings demonstrate that LLMs can effectively inject domain knowledge into scientific model discovery, paving the way toward fully automated, domain-aware kinetic modelling pipelines.

title: IRIS: A Visual Cortex-Inspired Framework for Analyzing Orientation Selectivity in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision transformers (ViTs) have become the de facto standard for image encoding across many perception tasks. Despite their empirical success, it remains mechanistically unclear how they encode low-level features, given their lack of inductive biases: ViTs process information globally rather than relying on local structure. Biological visual systems, in contrast, build low-level features, such as orientation selectivity in the primary visual cortex, by combining information from small, localized regions of the visual field. These features are general-purpose representations, shared and required across multiple specialized neural pathways, unlike higher-level, task-specific semantic features. This raises the question if such biologically-grounded features arise in ViTs. In this work, we systematically study how orientation selectivity emerges in ViTs by introducing a suite of neuroscience-inspired metrics: representational similarity score (RSS), orientation recruitment score (ORS), and orientation tuning bandwidth to quantify how orientation is encoded in representational geometry and as a function of model depth. Through extensive analysis, we find that: (1) the training paradigm is the strongest determinant of orientation selectivity, with models sharing an objective, peaking at comparable relative depths regardless of scale (2) many units are orientation-selective early in training, with early-to-middle layers recruiting more such units over time, while deeper layers lose selectivity and broaden their tuning toward semantic encoding and (3) our metrics offer a mechanistic heuristic for how many layers to unfreeze for best downstream generalization. Our framework presents a way to track biologically-grounded features during ViT training, probes how desired properties are encoded in transformer representations, and builds a systematic understanding of how ViTs generalize across tasks.

title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
summary: Long context reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is usually constrained by the fact that a single inference trajectory has to simultaneously explore the context, store intermediate state, verify evidence, and produce the final answer. This becomes particularly difficult in tasks that require extraction, counting, ordering, or multi-hop reasoning, where an early mistake can propagate until the final response. In this work, we propose Chained Recursive Language Models (Chained RLM), an inference-time architecture, in which the same underlying model is called repeatedly as a sequence of fresh reasoning roots. Each root receives the original problem and context, but does not inherit the full conversational history. Instead, it receives a compact plain-text summary, a plain-text blackboard, and some durable task-specific artifacts written by predecessor roots. The motivation is to manage the context by chopping into partial tasks rather than one large inference response; in each staged computation, intermediate artifacts can be inspected, corrected, and extended by a later fresh inference by the same model. We describe the system model, handoff mechanism, artifact workspace, and evaluation protocol for this system. We study when fresh-context artifact continuation gives a measurable gain in accuracy over direct LLM answering even with recursive tool-calling.

title: Spoken Function Calling: A New Perspective on Spoken Language Understanding for Large Audio Language Models
summary: Spoken Language Understanding (SLU) is the core component of task-oriented dialogue systems and a pivotal link in achieving seamless human-agent interaction. While traditional SLU can effectively extract user semantics for closed-set tasks after in-domain supervised fine-tuning, it faces significant challenges in leveraging in-context learning for open-domain tasks due to its ambiguous rule definitions. This work proposes Spoken Function Calling (SFC), a novel semantic understanding perspective that optimizes semantic understanding with structured rule definitions, to evolve beyond traditional closed-set SLU. Specifically, we curate and extend a suite of spoken functions based on traditional SLU datasets, construct a multi-agent system to synthesize the SFC-Bench dataset, evaluate the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Audio Language Models (LALMs), and enhance the SFC capabilities of LALMs through post-training. Experiments demonstrate that SFC outperforms traditional SLU, substantially enhancing the semantic extraction accuracy for LLMs and LALMs.

title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
summary: Achieving local differential privacy in distributed optimization while maintaining low communication cost remains challenging. Existing vector quantization methods, such as vqSGD, use high-dimensional geometric constructions but incur unfavorable dimension-dependent variance. In this work, we propose Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant (SSTQ), a framework that combines overcomplete equal-norm tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware one-dimensional quantization. SSTQ includes two variants: a Flat Randomized Response version and a Metric-Aware Laplace version, the latter being better suited to higher codebook bit-width regimes. We show that SSTQ achieves optimal mean squared error scaling while using only $\lceil \log_2 N \rceil + b$ bits per client, where $N = Θ(d)$ is the frame size. We also derive a surrogate privacy-aware codebook objective that reduces the codebook-dependent MSE scaling from $O(4^b)$ to $O(2^b)$. Finally, we empirically evaluate SSTQ against established baselines on federated learning tasks using CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST, demonstrating favorable utility and communication efficiency.

title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has become a standard post-training approach for improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing methods draw privileged information from diverse input sources to guide self-distillation. Yet these designs overlook Modality Imbalance, a challenge inherent to MLLM reasoning. When textual information dominates generation, the model cannot fully integrate its multimodal input. Consequently, carefully designed privileged information remains underused, limiting the effectiveness of OPSD. To examine this limitation, we construct a Positive Teacher with the Zoom-In Image and a Negative Teacher with the Mask Image, which exhibit different degrees of Modality Imbalance. Changes in their reasoning correctness and token logits reveal that Modality Balance can itself serve as privileged information. Motivated by this finding, we introduce OPD-V, a visual OPSD paradigm that instantiates such information through the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher. Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins define a Modality-Balance Trust Region that selects the on-policy tokens used for self-distillation. Experiments across 6 benchmarks, 4 MLLM backbones, and 5 post-training methods show that OPD-V consistently improves reasoning performance while reducing training cost.

title: Predicting Brain Morphometry with MT-GNN: Mesh Evolution in Continuous Time with Graph-Based Metric Tensor Embeddings
summary: Predicting how a subcortical structure's shape will evolve from a few prior scans could support prognosis and clinical-trial enrichment. Existing longitudinal mesh predictors either extrapolate shape trajectories via high-dimensional embeddings or regress vertex deformations directly. We instead predict the surface's intrinsic geometry in continuous time: a single per-structure graph network predicts the future per-vertex first fundamental form (metric tensor) for an arbitrary causal multiple-visit history and an arbitrary prediction horizon, conditioned on a Fourier encoding of the lead time. The predicted metric is decoded into a surface by a differentiable As-Rigid-As-Possible solver, and the model is trained end-to-end on the rigid-aligned vertex error. Training through the reconstruction keeps the decoded prediction a valid surface and consistently improves it. On 14 subcortical structures from the ADNI dataset, the proposed mesh evolution model (MT-GNN) predicts best among the evaluated methods at every horizon ($-2.29\%$ mean vertex error vs. the temporal mean, $p{=}6.1{\times}10^{-5}$, beating it on 14/14 structures), ahead of geodesic shape regression (DCM, $-0.19\%$) and a mesh transformer (TransforMesh, $-0.45\%$; $p{=}1.2{\times}10^{-4}$), with the lead widening as the horizon grows.

title: DeepConnect: A Visual Analytics System for Bridging Interdisciplinary Research Collaborations
comments: 11 pages, 7 figures, and 1 table. Accepted at IEEE VIS 2026; to appear in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics
summary: Interdisciplinary research collaboration is crucial for scientific innovation, but it remains difficult to initiate in practice. Existing collaborator discovery approaches are often constrained by disciplinary boundaries and static researcher profiles that do not reflect the specific context of a new collaboration goal. As a result, researchers struggle to translate open-ended collaboration goals into domain-specific tasks, evaluate candidate researchers' fit and complementarity, and establish common ground before initial contact. To address these challenges, we present DeepConnect, an LLM-augmented visual analytics system for interdisciplinary collaborator discovery. DeepConnect translates collaboration ideas into domain-specific tasks, retrieves relevant papers to ground cross-domain exploration, and provides coordinated visualizations for exploring and comparing candidate researchers. It further reveals terminology gaps and overlaps across domains and supports publication-grounded conversation rehearsal to help users prepare for outreach. We evaluate DeepConnect through two case studies, a user study, and a component-level evaluation, showing its value for complementary team formation, idea refinement, and pre-contact preparation. The DeepConnect website is available at https://deepconnect.sg.

title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
comments: 22 pages main text + appendices, 5 figures. Code, seeds, and raw run records: https://github.com/idevender/loss-basis-adam
summary: Gradient descent on a factored model $W = UV^\top$ is implicitly biased toward low-rank solutions, while Adam, starting from the same small initialization, is not. We trace the difference to the gauge symmetry of the loss, its invariance under $(U, V) \mapsto (UQ, VQ)$. Gradient flow's low-rank mechanism is available to an optimizer only if that optimizer is gauge-equivariant, a condition necessary for the transfer but not sufficient for low-rank recovery. Gradient descent, momentum, "shared-scalar" Adam, Muon, and Shampoo satisfy it. Adam, RMSProp, and the other coordinate-wise methods do not. A structure theorem characterizes the memoryless equivariant rules as exactly the Gram-determined left preconditioners, and a transfer theorem carries gradient flow's pathwise properties to common-scalar flows. We then sort nine update rules on underdetermined matrix sensing by recovery error against the planted ground truth. A one-parameter family from coordinate-wise to shared-scalar preconditioning restores the bias monotonically, isolating anisotropy as the cause. A "spectral schedule" reconciles two opposing reports about Muon: equal-rate updates recover exactly low-rank targets but lose their edge as the spectral tail grows. In transformers, Adam separates two gauge-equivalent initializations at the first step, where the equivariant optimizers stay at float precision, and ends with the per-head invariants $W_Q^\top W_K$ 56% apart in relative Frobenius distance, a gap no per-head rotation can close. On two hyperspectral datasets at matched training loss, gradient descent cuts held-out error by 43-44% at the lowest sampling density, and at lower effective rank. Basis choice is therefore not a tuning detail but a decision about which interpolant the optimizer selects.

title: SmartMage: Dynamic Modality Orchestration for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Understanding 3D scenes is fundamental to embodied intelligence, requiring joint reasoning over heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including visual and geometric cues. However, the relevance of these modalities often varies across queries. Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) typically rely on fixed modality combinations, overlooking query-dependent modality needs. Such a rigid design can introduce semantic noise from irrelevant modalities while underutilizing more informative ones, leading to wasted computation and diluted reasoning. To address these challenges, this paper proposes SmartMage, a unified MLLM that dynamically orchestrates heterogeneous modalities for semantic-aware 3D scene understanding. Specifically, SmartMage incorporates: (1) a Semantic-guided Modality Adaptive RouTng (SMART) module that selects task-relevant modalities using semantic priors, text-modality alignment, and modality quality; and (2) a Modality-Aware Gating Expert (MAGE) module that leverages modality priors to guide expert activation, fostering adaptive specialization in multimodal reasoning. Empirically, SmartMage achieves state-of-the-art performance across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks, and attains competitive results on RGB-only video understanding benchmarks. In our diagnostic benchmark ScanFacet, tasks are divided into fine-grained semantic categories, enabling analysis of modality combinations preferred by each semantic type. The observed modality-semantic patterns provide further evidence of SmartMage's effectiveness. Project page: https://yuecheong.github.io/SmartMage/.

title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Long-horizon reasoning in recent LLMs demands that the model switch between distinct skills inside a reasoning chain, such as first doing a math derivation, then using the result to plan a schedule. We call such problems cross-skill long-horizon tasks: multi-step tasks whose steps require different reasoning skills and depend on earlier outputs. Existing benchmarks often evaluate individual skills, lacking a principled way to measure how well a model switches between skills. We address this gap from both the evaluation and training sides. We introduce Skill Entropy, a measure of the difficulty of switching from one skill to another. We then propose Skill^2-Bench, a benchmark of cross-skill long-horizon tasks built over 558 skills across 9 verifiable and open-ended domains. Each task is assigned a task-level skill-entropy score and grouped into three difficulty levels. Evaluating 8 frontier and 4 open-source models on Skill^2-Bench reveals a skill-switching gap: accuracy decreases on higher-entropy tasks. We then turn skill entropy from a benchmark scale into a training signal. We propose Skill-Entropy RL, an RL framework where the model predicts not only the answer at each step but also the skill used to produce it. The reward combines step-level correctness with a skill-entropy reward that measures the alignment between the model-predicted skill sequence and the gold skill sequence. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-1.7B, Skill-Entropy RL improves the Skill^2-Bench score from 34.4% to 68.4% and from 14.6% to 40.1%, respectively, outperforming competitive baselines. The same pipeline can be applied to off-the-shelf training data such as OpenR1-Math, indicating that skill entropy is a reusable training signal. Code available at: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/Skill-Entropy-RL

AI.title_translation: 迈向技能原生的大语言模型：用于基准测试和训练长程推理的技能熵
AI.tldr: 本文提出“技能熵”以度量LLM长程推理中的技能切换难度，并基于此构建了Skill^2-Bench基准和Skill-Entropy RL强化学习框架，显著提升了模型的跨技能长程推理能力。
AI.motivation: 近期大语言模型的长程推理需要模型在推理链中频繁切换不同的技能（例如先数学推导再日程规划）。然而，现有的基准测试多专注于评估单一技能，缺乏对模型技能切换能力进行原则性评估与训练的方法。
AI.method:
1. 提出“技能熵”（Skill Entropy），用于量化从一种技能切换到另一种技能的难度。
2. 构建Skill^2-Bench基准测试，涵盖跨9个领域的558种技能，并根据任务级技能熵划分难度等级。
3. 提出Skill-Entropy RL强化学习框架，要求模型在每一步同时预测答案和所用技能，利用结合了步骤正确性与技能序列对齐度的技能熵奖励指导训练。
AI.result:
1. 在Skill^2-Bench上评估12个模型，发现模型在高技能熵（高频繁切换）任务上的准确率显著下降，证实存在“技能切换差距”。
2. 应用Skill-Entropy RL后，Qwen3-4B-Instruct和Qwen3-1.7B在Skill^2-Bench上的得分分别从34.4%提升至68.4%以及从14.6%提升至40.1%，显著优于强基线。
3. 该方法在OpenR1-Math等开源训练数据上也表现出良好的可复用性和效果。
AI.conclusion: 技能熵不仅能有效衡量与评估大语言模型在复杂长程任务中的跨技能切换能力，还能作为一种通用且可复用的强化学习信号，显著增强模型的长程推理与技能调度能力。

title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
summary: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager to facilitate the recursive retrieval of code references, enabling the curation of dependency-rich code contexts of millions of tokens in length. We then train OctoLong-Instruct, a suite of capable long-context open LMs, derived from base models ranging in size from 600M to 14B parameters, via context-extension mid-training on a ~50B-token mixture containing ~6.2B tokens of OctoLong code contexts, followed by ~10B tokens of instruction tuning. Our training ablations and experimental evaluations against 18 state-of-the-art open-weight long-context LMs show that supplanting just 12% of traditional context-extension corpora with OctoLong data yields substantial gains in long-range retrieval, long-term state tracking, repository-level code understanding, and downstream agentic tasks, while also enhancing API usage in short-context coding scenarios.

AI.title_translation: OctoLong：基于跨仓库代码上下文的中训增强长上下文建模
AI.tldr: 通过代码工具链递归提取跨仓库依赖构建超长代码上下文（OctoLong），仅替代12%的传统长文本训练数据即可大幅提升模型在长程检索、仓库级代码理解及智能体任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 针对上下文学习、自我改进及长流程智能体工作流对长上下文能力的需求，传统长文本语料（如书籍、论文、单代码库）资源有限且往往缺乏复杂的长距离依赖关系，难以有效训练模型处理长范围关联。
AI.method: 提出了 OctoLong 上下文工程流水线，结合 AST 解析器、语言服务器后端（LSP）和包管理器，递归检索代码引用以构建长达数百万 token 且依赖丰富的代码上下文。随后基于 600M 至 14B 参数的模型，在包含约 62 亿 OctoLong 代码 token 的 500 亿 token 混合数据上进行上下文扩展中训（Mid-Training），并接续 100 亿 token 的指令微调，打造 OctoLong-Instruct 模型族。
AI.result: 对比 18 个主流开源长上下文模型及消融实验结果表明，仅将传统长上下文扩展语料中的 12% 替换为 OctoLong 数据，即可在长程检索、长期状态跟踪、代码库级理解和下游智能体任务中取得显著提升，同时还能增强短上下文场景下的 API 使用能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨仓库代码依赖检索构建超长上下文数据并进行中训，能够显著增强语言模型在长文本理解、复杂依赖跟踪以及智能体任务上的综合能力。
AI.translation: 随着上下文学习、自我改进和长流程智能体工作流需求的增长，语言模型（LM）的上下文长度显著增加。然而，现有的长上下文语料主要由书籍、学术文章和代码仓库占据，这些资源数量有限且通常缺乏长距离依赖。在这项工作中，我们推出了 OctoLong，这是一个上下文工程流水线，它结合了 AST 解析器、语言服务器后端和包管理器，以促成代码引用的递归检索，从而能够策划长度达数百万 token 且具备丰富依赖关系的代码上下文。随后，我们通过在包含约 62 亿 token 的 OctoLong 代码上下文的约 500 亿 token 混合数据上进行上下文扩展中训，并接续约 100 亿 token 的指令微调，基于 600M 到 14B 参数的基础模型训练了高能长上下文开源模型套件 OctoLong-Instruct。我们的训练消融和针对 18 个最先进的开源长上下文 LM 的实验评估表明，仅用 OctoLong 数据替代 12% 的传统上下文扩展语料，即可在长程检索、长期状态跟踪、仓库级代码理解和下游智能体任务中获得大幅提升，同时也增强了短上下文代码场景中的 API 使用能力。
AI.summary: 针对现有长上下文语料缺乏复杂长距离依赖的问题，本文提出了 OctoLong 框架，利用代码工具链递归检索并生成数百万 token 级别的跨仓库依赖上下文。基于此数据对多规模模型进行上下文扩展中训及指令微调，打造了 OctoLong-Instruct 系列模型，在长文本检索、代码理解和智能体任务中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: Long-Context Modeling, Code Intelligence, Mid-Training, Context Engineering, Agentic Workflows
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用语法解析器、LSP及包管理器递归提取跨仓库的复杂依赖，解决了传统长文本缺乏交织关联的难题。仅通过替代12%的中训数据即实现了多维度的性能飞跃（甚至包括短上下文API调用），性价比与实用性极高。潜在局限性在于流水线对不同编程语言的工具链完整度有一定的依赖。

title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
summary: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives, constraints, and verification criteria, and admits memories, skills, procedures, verifiers, routing decisions, and rejected routes only after role-owned review and, when available, task-native verification. Model weights remain fixed; self-evolution occurs through persistent runtime state and control policy, with autonomous execution between operator-owned escalation points. Across seven GPT-5.5 benchmark arenas, Argus achieves about 78% on SWE-Bench Pro versus 59% for Direct Copilot while using 1.41 times the aggregate tokens. After verification-gated self-evolution, mature SWE-Bench waves use 21% fewer solve-input tokens and 15% less active workflow time per task than startup waves, while recording 34 verifier recoveries and 22 strict review-loop rescues. Argus also reaches 76.8% on AARRI-Bench and a 28.0-point gap on mathematical data synthesis, with competitive GPU-kernel and language-model-training results. Beyond benchmarks, an optimized RWKV6 kernel was merged upstream; a multi-day mathematics campaign retained falsified routes and proof-backed frontier updates; and six paper pipelines completed 254 missions with 16 stage rollbacks. These results show that a fixed-weight, self-evolving harness can revise, recover, and accumulate verified approaches while producing structured trajectories for future supervised and reinforcement learning.

AI.title_translation: Argus：面向长程推理的通用智能体运行时
AI.tldr: Argus 是一个无需修改模型权重的自演化智能体运行时，通过多角色分工与持久化状态管理，显著提升了长程复杂任务的推理与故障恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 长程推理需要一种智能体运行时，能够平衡“坚持”与“转向”：当证据支持当前方法时保持专注，而当测量结果显示失败、隐藏约束或目标设定不当时又能及时调整路线。
AI.method: Argus 提出了一个持久化、自演化的智能体运行时，包含 Manager、Planner、Engineer 和 Reviewer 四个角色，共同在持久项目状态上执行有界任务。它将用户稳定意图与具体操作目标/约束解耦，并通过角色审查和原生验证机制决定记忆、技能、规程和路径的存留。模型权重保持固定，仅通过持久运行时状态与控制策略实现自演化。
AI.result: 在 SWE-Bench Pro 上达到了约 78% 的准确率（对比 Direct Copilot 的 59%）；演化成熟阶段比初始阶段减少了 21% 的输入 token 和 15% 的工作流时间，录得 34 次验证器恢复与 22 次审查救回。此外在 AARRI-Bench 达到 76.8%，数学数据合成取得 28 分优势，成功将优化后的 RWKV6 内核贡献至上游，并在实际论文流水线中完成了 254 个任务。
AI.conclusion: 无需更新模型权重的自演化框架能够有效地修订、恢复并积累经过验证的方法，同时为未来的监督学习和强化学习生成高质量的结构化轨迹数据。
AI.translation: 长程推理需要一种智能体运行时，它不仅能在证据支持当前方法时保持专注，还能够在测量结果显示失败、隐藏约束或目标设定不当时及时转向。我们提出了 Argus，一个持久且自演化的运行时系统，其中 Manager、Planner、Engineer 和 Reviewer 角色在持久的项目状态上执行有界任务。Argus 将稳定的用户意图与具体的操作目标、约束和验证标准相分离，并且仅在经过角色拥有的审查以及（可用时）任务原生验证之后，才接纳记忆、技能、规程、验证器、路由决策和被拒绝的路线。模型权重保持不变；自演化通过持久运行时状态和控制策略发生，并在操作员拥有的升级点之间实现自主执行。在七个 GPT-5.5 基准竞技场中，Argus 在 SWE-Bench Pro 上达到了约 78% 的准确率，而 Direct Copilot 为 59%（消耗 1.41 倍的总 token 数）。经过验证门控的自演化后，成熟的 SWE-Bench 轮次相比启动轮次每任务减少了 21% 的解决输入 token 以及 15% 的活动工作流时间，同时记录了 34 次验证器恢复和 22 次严格审查循环救回。Argus 在 AARRI-Bench 上也达到了 76.8%，并在数学数据合成上取得了 28.0 分的差距，在 GPU 内核与语言模型训练方面也取得了富有竞争力的结果。在基准测试之外，一个优化后的 RWKV6 内核被合并到了上游；一项持续多天的数学项目保留了证伪路径和基于证明的前沿更新；六个论文流水线完成了 254 个任务，并进行了 16 次阶段回滚。这些结果表明，一个固定权重的自演化框架可以修订、恢复并积累经过验证的方法，同时为未来的监督学习和强化学习生成结构化轨迹。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Argus，一个面向长程推理的通用自演化智能体运行时系统。在不更新底层大模型权重的框架下，Argus 通过 Manager、Planner、Engineer 和 Reviewer 四角色协作，结合持久化项目状态与严格的验证门控机制，实现了自动容错、路线修正与知识积累。实验表明，Argus 在 SWE-Bench Pro 等多个复杂基准上显著超越现有基线，且随着运行演化表现出更高的效率与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 长程推理, 智能体运行时, 自演化系统, 验证门控, 复杂任务解决
AI.comments:
创新性：Argus 的核心创新在于不改变大模型权重的前提下，仅依靠控制策略与持久运行时状态实现智能体的“自演化”与自动回滚修复，设计了明确的多角色分工（Manager, Planner, Engineer, Reviewer）和严格的验证门控机制。
重要性：该工作为长程复杂推理任务（如软件工程、数学推导、科学写作等）提供了一套高可靠、可复用的智能体系统范式，同时生成的优质结构化轨迹可直接用于未来的 LLM 监督与强化学习。
局限性：系统在执行复杂多角色审查时相比 Direct Copilot 消耗了更多 token（约1.41倍），且系统运行机制相对复杂，可能带来一定的时延成本。

title: Objects as Audio-Visual Modal Sound Fields
summary: While modern 3D reconstruction excels at modeling object geometry and appearance, it largely ignores the rich acoustic cues revealed through physical interaction. Object impact sounds convey material, stiffness, and structural properties that complement vision, yet existing impact sound modeling approaches either rely on expensive physics-based simulation or require large datasets to generalize in a purely data-driven manner. We introduce Audio-Visual Modal Sound Field (AV-MSF), a novel object-level acoustic representation reconstructed from multi-view images and only a few impact sound recordings. AV-MSF builds on 3D Gaussian Splatting integrated with dense 3D visual feature to provide a strong geometry-aware prior, and represents the impact sound field using compact, physically meaningful modal parameters, enabling robust few-shot reconstruction. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that AV-MSF achieves state-of-the-art impact sound rendering, outperforming both physics-based and data-driven baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate downstream applications enabled by our representation, including contact localization and object sound editing.

AI.title_translation: 物体的视听模态声场表示
AI.tldr: AV-MSF通过结合3D高斯泼溅视觉先验与物理模态参数，实现了基于少量录音的高精度物体碰撞声场重建与编辑。
AI.motivation: 传统的3D重建忽略了物理交互中的声学线索，而现有的碰撞声音建模方法要么依赖高昂的基于物理的模拟，要么依赖海量数据驱动，难以在少样本情况下高效重建物体的声学特性。
AI.method: 提出视听模态声场（AV-MSF），将集成了密集3D视觉特征的3D Gaussian Splatting作为强几何感知先验，并利用紧凑且具物理意义的模态参数表示碰撞声场，仅通过多视角图像和少量碰撞声音录音即可进行鲁棒的少样本声场重建。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，AV-MSF实现了最先进（SOTA）的碰撞声音渲染效果，超越了基于物理和纯数据驱动的基线方法，并支持接触定位与声音编辑等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: AV-MSF成功构建了一种高质量的物体级视听声学表示，不仅在少样本声音渲染上显著优于现有基线，还展示了在接触定位和声音编辑等下游任务中的应用潜力。
AI.translation: 尽管现代3D重建擅长建模物体的几何形状和外观，但它很大程度上忽略了通过物理交互揭示的丰富声学线索。物体碰撞发出的声音传达了与视觉相互补的材质、刚度和结构属性，然而现有的碰撞声建模方法要么依赖昂贵的基于物理的模拟，要么需要海量数据集以纯数据驱动的方式进行泛化。我们提出了视听模态声场（AV-MSF），这是一种从多视角图像和仅少量碰撞声录音中重建的全新物体级声学表示。AV-MSF基于集成了密集3D视觉特征的3D Gaussian Splatting，以提供强有力的几何感知先验，并使用紧凑且具有物理意义的模态参数来表示碰撞声场，从而实现鲁棒的少样本重建。在两个真实数据集上的实验表明，AV-MSF实现了最先进的碰撞声渲染效果，超越了基于物理和数据驱动的基线。此外，我们还展示了由我们的表示所支持的下游应用，包括接触定位和物体声音编辑。
AI.summary: 本文提出了视听模态声场（AV-MSF），一种结合多视角图像与少量碰撞声录音来重建物体声学特性的新方法。该方法利用3D Gaussian Splatting和密集视觉特征构建几何先验，并结合物理模态参数实现紧凑的声场表示。实验证明该方法在碰撞音渲染及声音编辑等任务中达到了SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: Audio-Visual Modal Sound Field, 3D Gaussian Splatting, Impact Sound Rendering, Few-Shot Reconstruction
AI.comments: 本研究创新性地将3D Gaussian Splatting的视觉几何先验与物理模态声学建模相结合，成功解决了少样本条件下物体碰撞声场重建的难题。其使用的模态参数兼具紧凑性与物理意义，不仅大幅提升了碰撞声渲染的质量，还为接触定位和物体声音编辑等视听融合应用提供了强有力的表示基础。

title: Reasoning Core: Designing Broad Procedural Data for Completion-Supervised Reasoning Training
summary: Procedural generators produce useful verifiable reasoning problems at scale, but have received less attention as data for completion-supervised fine-tuning. We introduce Reasoning Core, a collection of 50 generators spanning mathematics, logic, planning, state tracking, formal languages, structured data, games, causality, and code, with semantic scorers, difficulty controls, and task evaluators. Under a matched completion-supervised protocol, we compare Reasoning Core with Procedural Warmup, Reasoning Gym, and SynLogic across four base-model settings and multiple training durations. In the primary 3B comparison, Reasoning Core achieves the highest mean scores on DROP, LogiQA, and ARC-Challenge, exceeding both the baseline without procedural data and all three alternative procedural collections. Task-level analyses show that semantic validity alone does not ensure training utility, highlighting compact targets and calibrated difficulty as important design factors. We ran audits combining model-assisted review, human adjudication, and regression testing. Applied throughout Reasoning Core development and to the other collections, they reveal subtle mismatches among generation, rendering, targets, and scoring, a reminder that procedural generation alone does not guarantee correctness. The library, generated datasets, and audit material are publicly available.

AI.title_translation: Reasoning Core：面向补全监督推理训练的广泛程序化数据设计
AI.tldr: 本文推出了包含50个生成器的程序化数据集 Reasoning Core，显著提升了补全监督下模型的推理能力，并强调了数据难度校准与严格审计的重要性。
AI.motivation: 程序化生成器能大规模提供可验证的推理问题，但作为补全监督微调（SFT）数据的研究较少；同时，单纯的语义有效性并不足以保证数据的训练效果，程序化生成过程中也容易存在渲染、目标与打分不匹配等隐蔽错误。
AI.method: 构建了包含50个生成器的程序化数据集 Reasoning Core，涵盖数学、逻辑、规划等9大领域，并配有语义打分器、难度控制和任务评估器；结合模型辅助审查、人工裁决和回归测试进行数据审计；在统一的补全监督训练协议下，与多种现有程序化数据集及无程序化数据基线进行了对比实验。
AI.result: 在3B模型的主要对比中，Reasoning Core 在 DROP、LogiQA 和 ARC-Challenge 上的平均得分最高，超越了无程序数据基线以及 Procedural Warmup、Reasoning Gym、SynLogic 三个对比集合；审计分析揭示了生成、渲染、目标和打分之间微妙的不匹配问题。
AI.conclusion: 程序化生成自身无法保证数据的绝对正确性，紧凑的目标与校准后的难度是提升训练实用性的关键设计因素。Reasoning Core 库、生成的数据集和审计材料均已开源。
AI.translation: 程序化生成器可以大规模产生有用的可验证推理问题，但作为补全监督微调的数据源，它们获得的关注较少。我们推出了 Reasoning Core，这是一个包含 50 个生成器的集合，涵盖数学、逻辑、规划、状态跟踪、形式语言、结构化数据、游戏、因果关系和代码，并配备了语义打分器、难度控制和任务评估器。在匹配的补全监督协议下，我们在四种基座模型设置和多个训练时长上，将 Reasoning Core 与 Procedural Warmup、Reasoning Gym 和 SynLogic 进行了比较。在主要的 3B 模型比较中，Reasoning Core 在 DROP、LogiQA 和 ARC-Challenge 上取得了最高平均得分，超越了没有程序化数据的基线模型以及所有三种备选程序化集合。任务层面的分析表明，单纯的语义有效性并不能确保训练实用性，突出了紧凑目标和校准难度是重要的设计因素。我们开展了结合模型辅助审查、人工裁决和回归测试的审计。这些审计应用于 Reasoning Core 的开发过程及其他集合中，揭示了生成、渲染、目标和打分之间微妙的不匹配，提醒人们程序化生成本身并不能保证正确性。该代码库、生成的数据集和审计材料均已公开。
AI.summary: 本文推出了 Reasoning Core，一个包含50个跨领域生成器的程序化数据集，旨在推进补全监督下的模型推理训练。研究通过多模型、多时长的实验验证了其优异性能，并强调了难度校准、紧凑目标以及结合模型和人工审计对确保程序化数据质量的重要性。
AI.keywords: Procedural generation, Reasoning training, Completion-supervised fine-tuning, Data audit
AI.comments: 该研究针对大模型推理微调中高质量可验证数据不足的问题，提出了覆盖面广且具备严格审计机制的程序化数据生成库 Reasoning Core。其重要创新点在于不仅构建了多样化的数据集，还揭示了“仅凭语义有效性无法保证训练实用性”这一现象，强调了紧凑目标、校准难度以及数据审计在程序化数据设计中的关键作用。

title: CoCo-IR: Contextual Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Current instruction-based image retrieval systems are powerful but limited to single-turn interactions, failing to capture the iterative nature of complex, real-world visual searches. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Contextual Composed Image Retrieval (CoCo-IR), a novel task that enables users to progressively refine search results through interactions. We address this new task by proposing a new model based on a Large Multimodal Model (LMM) that functions as a context-aware reasoner for CoCo-IR. Our model interprets the entire interaction history to generate Transformable Image Embeddings (TIE) that evolve across turns. To fuel the model training without expensive human annotations, we develop a fully autonomous, scalable data engine that leverages LMMs to generate high-quality contextual retrieval data, and uses model-guided verification to mine challenging hard negatives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes new state-of-the-art performance: We achieve 39.4 mAP@5 on the challenging single-turn benchmark CIRCO; furthermore, on our new CoCo-IR benchmark, our model maintains robust performance with 44.1 R@1 on 4-turn dialogues, dramatically outperforming existing methods (28.2 4-turn R@1) that fail to handle multi-turn context. Project page: https://CoCo-IR.github.io.

AI.title_translation: CoCo-IR：上下文复合图像检索
AI.tldr: 本文引入了上下文复合图像检索（CoCo-IR）任务，旨在克服现有图像检索系统单轮交互的局限性。研究人员提出了一个基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的新模型，该模型能够作为上下文感知推理器，通过解释整个交互历史来生成可变形图像嵌入（TIE），从而实现搜索结果的逐步优化。为解决训练数据问题，开发了一个自主、可扩展的数据引擎，利用LMM生成高质量数据并挖掘难负样本。实验表明，该方法在单轮和多轮基准测试中均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前基于指令的图像检索系统功能强大，但仅限于单轮交互，未能捕捉复杂、真实世界视觉搜索的迭代性质。
AI.method: 提出一个基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的新模型，作为CoCo-IR的上下文感知推理器。该模型解释整个交互历史以生成跨回合演变的“可变形图像嵌入”（TIE）。为训练模型，开发了一个完全自主、可扩展的数据引擎，利用LMM生成高质量上下文检索数据，并使用模型引导验证来挖掘具有挑战性的难负样本。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的单轮基准CIRCO上实现了39.4 mAP@5的性能；此外，在新CoCo-IR基准上，模型在4轮对话中保持44.1 R@1的稳健性能，显著优于无法处理多轮上下文的现有方法（28.2 4轮R@1）。
AI.conclusion: 本文引入了CoCo-IR任务和基于LMM的新模型，通过上下文感知推理和可变形图像嵌入，有效处理多轮交互式图像检索，并在相关基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 当前基于指令的图像检索系统功能强大，但仅限于单轮交互，未能捕捉复杂真实世界视觉搜索的迭代性质。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了上下文复合图像检索（CoCo-IR），这是一项新颖的任务，允许用户通过交互逐步完善搜索结果。我们通过提出一个基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的新模型来解决这项新任务，该模型充当CoCo-IR的上下文感知推理器。我们的模型解释整个交互历史以生成跨回合演变的可变形图像嵌入（TIE）。为了在没有昂贵的人工标注的情况下为模型训练提供数据，我们开发了一个完全自主、可扩展的数据引擎，该引擎利用LMM生成高质量的上下文检索数据，并使用模型引导验证来挖掘具有挑战性的难负样本。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法建立了新的最先进性能：我们在具有挑战性的单轮基准CIRCO上实现了39.4 mAP@5；此外，在我们新的CoCo-IR基准上，我们的模型在4轮对话中保持44.1 R@1的稳健性能，大大优于无法处理多轮上下文的现有方法（28.2 4轮R@1）。项目页面：https://CoCo-IR.github.io。
AI.summary: 本文针对当前图像检索系统单轮交互的局限性，提出了上下文复合图像检索（CoCo-IR）新任务。研究人员开发了一个基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的上下文感知推理器，通过解释完整的交互历史来生成可变形图像嵌入（TIE），以实现迭代式搜索结果优化。为解决数据标注问题，设计了一个自主数据引擎，利用LMM生成训练数据并挖掘难负样本。实验证明，该方法在单轮和多轮图像检索任务中均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 上下文复合图像检索, 大型多模态模型, 迭代搜索, 可变形图像嵌入, 数据引擎
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入CoCo-IR任务和基于LMM的解决方案，在图像检索领域迈出了重要一步，使其更接近真实世界的复杂交互需求。其创新点在于利用LMM作为上下文感知推理器来处理多轮交互，并设计了无需人工标注的自主数据生成引擎，这解决了多轮交互数据稀缺的挑战，具有很高的实用价值和可扩展性。

title: A Deep Causal Inference Approach to Measuring the Effects of Forming Group Loans in Online Non-profit Microfinance Platform
summary: Kiva is an online non-profit crowdsouring microfinance platform that raises funds for the poor in the third world. The borrowers on Kiva are small business owners and individuals in urgent need of money. To raise funds as fast as possible, they have the option to form groups and post loan requests in the name of their groups. While it is generally believed that group loans pose less risk for investors than individual loans do, we study whether this is the case in a philanthropic online marketplace. In particular, we measure the effect of group loans on funding time while controlling for the loan sizes and other factors. Because loan descriptions (in the form of texts) play an important role in lenders' decision process on Kiva, we make use of this information through deep learning in natural language processing. In this aspect, this is the first paper that uses one of the most advanced deep learning techniques to deal with unstructured data in a way that can take advantage of its superior prediction power to answer causal questions. We find that on average, forming group loans speeds up the funding time by about 3.3 days.

AI.title_translation: 在线非营利微型金融平台中组建团体贷款效应测量：一种深度因果推断方法
AI.tldr: 本文结合深度NLP与因果推断方法，证实了在线微金平台上的团体贷款能够平均缩短约3.3天的筹资时间。
AI.motivation: 探究在慈善在线微金平台（如Kiva）中，借款人组建团体贷款是否能够比个人贷款更快地筹集资金，同时解决贷款文本描述等非结构化混杂变量难以在因果推断中被有效控制的问题。
AI.method: 结合深度学习自然语言处理（NLP）技术来处理非结构化的贷款文本描述，并在控制贷款规模及其他混杂因素的前提下，采用深度因果推断框架评估团体贷款对筹资时间的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现，平均而言，组建团体贷款能够使筹资时间缩短（加快）约3.3天。
AI.conclusion: 在线非营利微金平台上组建团体贷款对提升筹资效率具有积极效应，能够有效缩短借款人的筹资等待时间。
AI.translation: Kiva是一个在线非营利众筹微型金融平台，为第三世界的贫困人口筹集资金。Kiva上的借款人是小企业主和急需资金的个人。为了尽可能快地筹集资金，他们可以选择组建团体并以团体名义发布贷款需求。虽然人们普遍认为团体贷款对投资者而言风险低于个人贷款，但我们研究了在慈善在线市场中情况是否确实如此。特别是，我们在控制贷款规模和其他因素的同时，测量了团体贷款对筹资时间的影响。由于贷款描述（以文本形式呈现）在Kiva出资人的决策过程中起着重要作用，我们通过自然语言处理中的深度学习技术利用了这一信息。在这方面，这是第一篇利用最先进的深度学习技术处理非结构化数据，并利用其出色的预测能力来回答因果问题的论文。我们发现，平均而言，组建团体贷款能将筹资时间加快约3.3天。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在在线非营利微型金融平台Kiva上，组建团体贷款对筹资时间的影响。为了准确评估因果效应，研究利用深度学习NLP技术提取贷款文本描述中的非结构化信息并加以控制。实证结果显示，组建团体贷款平均可将筹资时间加快约3.3天。
AI.keywords: 深度因果推断, 团体贷款, 微型金融, 自然语言处理, Kiva
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将高级深度学习（NLP）与因果推断相结合，利用深度模型提取非结构化文本中的信息以控制混杂因素，为评估在线微金平台上的因果效应提供了新颖且实用的方法。

title: Leveraging Machine Learning to Gain Insights on Quantum Thermodynamic Entropy
summary: We present a thermodynamic analysis of a quantum engine that uses a single quantum particle as its working fluid, inspired by Szilard's classical single-particle engine. Our design is modeled after the classically-chaotic Szilard Map and involves a thermodynamic cycle of measurement, thermal-energy extraction, and memory reset. Our focus is on investigating the thermodynamic costs associated with observing and controlling the particle and comparing these costs in the quantum and classical limits. Through our study, we aim to shed light on the thermodynamic trade-offs that arise from Lindauer's Principle for information-processing-induced thermodynamic dissipation in both the quantum and classical regimes. Using machine learning methods, we demonstrate that energy analysis can be performed and the quantum engine can be simulated according to the Szilard engine based Second Law of Thermodynamics in its working condition. However, we note that the quantum engine operates using significantly different mechanisms than its classical counterpart, where the cost of inserting partitions plays a critical role in the quantum implementation.

AI.title_translation: 利用机器学习获取量子热力学熵的深刻见解
AI.tldr: 本文结合机器学习与量子思拉德引擎模型，揭示了量子与经典热力学发动机在信息处理成本及运行机制（尤其是隔板插入成本）上的本质差异。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究观察和控制单个量子粒子时的热力学成本，对比量子与经典极限下的差异，并深入理解由兰道尔原理引发的信息处理热力学耗散与权衡。
AI.method: 基于经典混沌思拉德映射建立量子发动机模型，设计包含测量、热能提取和记忆重置的热力学循环，并运用机器学习方法对发动机进行能量分析与运行模拟。
AI.result: 证明了利用机器学习可以成功模拟量子发动机并按热力学第二定律进行能量分析；发现量子发动机与经典发动机的作用机制存在显著差异，其中插入隔板的成本在量子机制下尤为关键。
AI.conclusion: 量子发动机的运行机制与其经典对应物存在本质区别，其中量子实现中插入隔板的热力学成本扮演了至关重要的角色。
AI.translation: 我们对一种以单个量子粒子作为工作物质的量子发动机进行了热力学分析，该发动机的设计受思拉德（Szilard）经典单粒子发动机的启发。我们的模型基于经典混沌思拉德映射，包含测量、热能提取和记忆重置的热力学循环。我们的研究重点是探究观察和控制粒子所产生的热力学成本，并在量子和经典极限下对比这些成本。通过研究，我们旨在阐明在量子和经典机制下，由信息处理引发的热力学耗散（遵循兰道尔原理）所带来的权衡关系。利用机器学习方法，我们证明了可以在工作条件下根据基于思拉德发动机的热力学第二定律进行能量分析并模拟量子发动机。然而，我们注意到量子发动机运行的机制与其经典对应物显著不同，其中插入隔板的成本在量子实现中发挥着关键作用。
AI.summary: 本文基于思拉德单粒子引擎模型设计了一种量子发动机，包含测量、抽热与记忆重置循环。研究通过机器学习对其进行了热力学模拟与能量分析，对比了经典与量子极限下观察控制粒子的耗散成本，揭示了量子环境下插入隔板成本对发动机运行机制的关键影响。
AI.keywords: 量子热力学, 思拉德发动机, 机器学习, 兰道尔原理, 量子熵
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将机器学习应用于量子热力学领域，用于模拟量子思拉德引擎并分析其能量过程。文章突出了量子与经典系统在热力学成本（特别是插入隔板的代价）上的本质差异，对理解量子信息处理中的兰道尔原理和热力学极限具有重要意义。

title: AutoProteinEngine: A Large Language Model Driven Agent Framework for Multimodal AutoML in Protein Engineering
summary: Protein engineering is important for biomedical applications, but conventional approaches are often inefficient and resource-intensive. While deep learning (DL) models have shown promise, their training or implementation into protein engineering remains challenging for biologists without specialized computational expertise. To address this gap, we propose AutoProteinEngine (AutoPE), an agent framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) for multimodal automated machine learning (AutoML) for protein engineering. AutoPE innovatively allows biologists without DL backgrounds to interact with DL models using natural language, lowering the entry barrier for protein engineering tasks. Our AutoPE uniquely integrates LLMs with AutoML to handle model selection for both protein sequence and graph modalities, automatic hyperparameter optimization, and automated data retrieval from protein databases. We evaluated AutoPE through two real-world protein engineering tasks, demonstrating substantial performance improvements compared to traditional zero-shot and manual fine-tuning approaches. By bridging the gap between DL and biologists' domain expertise, AutoPE empowers researchers to leverage DL without extensive programming knowledge. Our code is available at https://github.com/tsynbio/AutoPE.

AI.title_translation: AutoProteinEngine：用于蛋白质工程中多模态自动机器学习的大语言模型驱动智能体框架
AI.tldr: AutoPE是一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，让无编程背景的生物学家能够通过自然语言轻松开展多模态蛋白质工程的自动机器学习与模型微调。
AI.motivation: 传统蛋白质工程方法效率低且消耗资源，深度学习模型虽具潜力但门槛高，缺乏专业计算背景的生物学家难以训练或应用这些模型。
AI.method: 提出了AutoProteinEngine (AutoPE) 智能体框架，将大语言模型（LLM）与自动机器学习（AutoML）相结合。支持生物学家通过自然语言交互，自动完成蛋白质序列与图结构模态的模型选择、自动超参数优化以及蛋白质数据库的数据检索。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界的蛋白质工程任务中，AutoPE的表现显著优于传统的零样本（zero-shot）方法和手动微调方法。
AI.conclusion: AutoPE弥合了深度学习与生物学领域知识之间的鸿沟，使科研人员无需具备丰富的编程知识即可高效利用深度学习进行蛋白质工程研究。
AI.translation: 蛋白质工程对生物医学应用至关重要，但传统方法通常效率低下且资源消耗大。尽管深度学习（DL）模型展现出了巨大的应用前景，但对于缺乏专业计算知识的生物学家而言，将其训练或应用于蛋白质工程仍面临巨大挑战。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了AutoProteinEngine（AutoPE），这是一个利用大语言模型（LLM）进行蛋白质工程多模态自动机器学习（AutoML）的智能体框架。AutoPE创新性地允许没有深度学习背景的生物学家使用自然语言与深度学习模型进行交互，降低了蛋白质工程任务的入门门槛。AutoPE将LLM与AutoML独特地结合在一起，能够处理蛋白质序列和图两种模态的模型选择、自动超参数优化以及蛋白质数据库的自动化数据检索。我们在两个真实世界的蛋白质工程任务中对AutoPE进行了评估，结果表明与传统的零样本和手动微调方法相比，性能得到了大幅提升。通过缩小深度学习与生物学家领域知识之间的差距，AutoPE赋能研究人员在无需具备丰富编程知识的情况下利用深度学习。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/tsynbio/AutoPE 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AutoProteinEngine (AutoPE)，这是一个由大语言模型驱动的智能体框架，专门用于蛋白质工程中的多模态自动机器学习（AutoML）。AutoPE允许无深度学习背景的生物学家使用自然语言进行交互，自动化完成数据检索、序列与图模态的模型选择及超参数优化，显著降低了深度学习的应用门槛并提升了预测性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 蛋白质工程, 自动机器学习, 智能体框架, 多模态深度学习
AI.comments:
创新性：将大语言模型（LLM）与自动机器学习（AutoML）深度结合并应用于蛋白质工程领域，实现了自然语言交互与多模态（序列和图结构）自动化建模。
重要性：切中生物学家缺乏编程背景但需要使用AI工具的行业痛点，大幅降低了深度学习在生命科学领域的应用门槛。
局限性：摘要中未提及系统的计算开销、LLM决策的幻觉风险对AutoML模型选择的影响，以及对极端复杂蛋白质任务的适应性。

title: TourSynbio-Search: A Large Language Model Driven Agent Framework for Unified Search Method for Protein Engineering
summary: The exponential growth in protein-related databases and scientific literature, combined with increasing demands for efficient biological information retrieval, has created an urgent need for unified and accessible search methods in protein engineering research. We present TourSynbio-Search, a novel bioinformatics search agent framework powered by the TourSynbio-7B protein multimodal large language model (LLM), designed to address the growing challenges of information retrieval across rapidly expanding protein databases and corresponding online research literature. The agent's dual-module architecture consists of PaperSearch and ProteinSearch components, enabling comprehensive exploration of both scientific literature and protein data across multiple biological databases. At its core, TourSynbio-Search employs an intelligent agent system that interprets natural language queries, optimizes search parameters, and executes search operations across major platforms including UniProt, PDB, ArXiv, and BioRxiv. The agent's ability to process intuitive natural language queries reduces technical barriers, allowing researchers to efficiently access and analyze complex biological data without requiring extensive bioinformatics expertise. Through detailed case studies in literature retrieval and protein structure visualization, we demonstrate TourSynbio-Search's effectiveness in streamlining biological information retrieval and enhancing research productivity. This framework represents an advancement in bridging the accessibility gap between complex biological databases and researchers, potentially accelerating progress in protein engineering applications. Our codes are available at: https://github.com/tsynbio/Toursynbio-Search

AI.title_translation: TourSynbio-Search：用于蛋白质工程统一检索的大语言模型驱动智能体框架
AI.tldr: TourSynbio-Search 是一个由蛋白质多模态大模型驱动的智能体框架，支持使用自然语言统一检索与分析跨平台的蛋白质数据与学术文献。
AI.motivation: 随着蛋白质数据库和科研文献的指数级增长，研究人员在跨多个独立数据库检索复杂生物信息时面临巨大的技术门槛和效率瓶颈，迫切需要一种统一且简便的检索方法。
AI.method: 基于 TourSynbio-7B 蛋白质多模态大语言模型构建 TourSynbio-Search 智能体框架。该框架采用由 PaperSearch 和 ProteinSearch 组成的双模块架构，能够理解自然语言查询并自动优化搜索参数，跨 UniProt、PDB、ArXiv 和 BioRxiv 等主流平台执行文献与蛋白质数据的检索及结构可视化。
AI.result: 文献检索和蛋白质结构可视化的案例研究表明，TourSynbio-Search 能够精准高效地理解自然语言指令并完成跨平台检索与数据分析，显著简化了信息获取流程并提升了科研效率。
AI.conclusion: TourSynbio-Search有效地弥合了研究人员与复杂生物数据库之间的技术鸿沟，显著降低了数据获取门槛，为加速蛋白质工程领域的研究与应用提供了有力工具。
AI.translation: 蛋白质相关数据库和科学文献的指数级增长，结合对高效生物信息检索日益增长的需求，使得蛋白质工程研究中迫切需要统一且易用的检索方法。我们提出了 TourSynbio-Search，这是一个由 TourSynbio-7B 蛋白质多模态大语言模型（LLM）驱动的创新生物信息学检索智能体框架，旨在解决快速扩展的蛋白质数据库及相应在线研究文献中日益增长的信息检索挑战。该智能体的双模块架构由 PaperSearch 和 ProteinSearch 组件组成，能够实现对多个生物数据库中的科学文献和蛋白质数据的全面探索。TourSynbio-Search 的核心是一个智能体系统，该系统可以解释自然语言查询、优化搜索参数，并在包括 UniProt、PDB、ArXiv 和 BioRxiv 在内的主要平台上执行搜索操作。智能体处理直观自然语言查询的能力降低了技术门槛，使研究人员无需具备深入的生物信息学专业知识即可高效访问和分析复杂的生物数据。通过在文献检索和蛋白质结构可视化方面的详细案例研究，我们展示了 TourSynbio-Search 在简化生物信息检索和提高研究生产力方面的有效性。该框架代表了弥合复杂生物数据库与研究人员之间可达性差距的一项进步，有望加速蛋白质工程应用的发展。我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/tsynbio/Toursynbio-Search。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 TourSynbio-Search，这是一个由 TourSynbio-7B 蛋白质多模态大模型驱动的智能体框架。该框架包含 PaperSearch 和 ProteinSearch 两个模块，支持通过自然语言统一检索和分析 UniProt、PDB、ArXiv 及 BioRxiv 中的文献与蛋白质结构数据，显著降低了生物信息学的技术使用门槛。
AI.keywords: 蛋白质工程, 大语言模型智能体, 生物信息检索, 多模态大模型, 统一搜索
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：将多模态大语言模型智能体引入蛋白质工程领域，实现了跨科学文献与生物分子数据库（如PDB、UniProt等）的统一自然语言检索。
2. **重要性**：极大降低了非生物信息学背景的研究人员使用复杂生物数据库的门槛，有助于提高科研生产力并加速蛋白质设计与工程的进程。
3. **局限性**：摘要中主要通过案例研究展示效果，缺乏在大规模评估集上与其他现有检索工具或智能体系统的定量对比数据。

title: Monsoon Mayhem to Market Waves: Forecasting Fisheries Resilience in Sri Lanka
summary: Sri Lanka's fisheries sector is important for jobs and food supply. Between 2019 and 2025, it faced several major problems at the same time, and how these events together affected fish production and prices is still not well understood. This study develops a framework to connect weather changes, major disruption events, fish production, and prices, with the goal of helping policymakers, traders, and supply chain managers make better decisions. Seasonal patterns are studied using STL decomposition. Spearman lag correlation is used to find delayed effects of climate on production. Interrupted Time Series (ITS) regression measures the impact of major events. SARIMAX models predict monthly production and prices. Hotspot detection identifies unusual patterns. The results show that marine and inland fisheries behave differently in terms of seasons and climate effects. Major disruptions caused different levels of impact, and in some cases, one sector helped compensate for another. These findings can support better planning, for example, improving infrastructure in high-risk areas, strengthening cold storage systems, and using early warning alerts for unusual events. Price forecasting tools should be used as decision-support tools, not as direct market signals.

AI.title_translation: 季风混乱到市场波动：预测斯里兰卡渔业的韧性
AI.tldr: 本研究通过整合气候数据、中断时间序列分析与SARIMAX预测模型，揭示了斯里兰卡海洋与内陆渔业对重大干扰事件和天气变化的响应差异与互补性，为渔业风险管理与基础设施建设提供了决策支持。
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡渔业对当地就业和粮食安全至关重要，但在2019至2025年间连续遭受多重重大危机，目前尚不清楚这些事件如何共同影响水产品产量和价格。因此需要建立一个框架来分析气候变化、干扰事件与渔业产销的关系，以辅助决策。
AI.method: 结合多种数据分析方法：采用STL分解分析季节性模式；使用Spearman滞后相关分析评估气候对产量的延迟影响；运用中断时间序列（ITS）回归量化重大干扰事件的影响；建立SARIMAX模型预测月度产量与价格；利用热点检测识别异常模式。
AI.result: 海洋渔业与内陆渔业在季节性规律和气候响应上存在显著差异；重大干扰事件造成了不同程度的影响，且在特定情况下内陆与海洋渔业部门之间存在相互补偿的作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现有助于优化政策规划（如改善高风险区域基础设施、强化冷库系统及建立异常预警），并建议将价格预测工具定位为辅助决策工具而非绝对的市场信号。
AI.translation: 斯里兰卡的渔业部门对就业和食物供应至关重要。在2019年至2025年期间，该部门同时面临着几个重大问题，而这些事件如何共同影响水产品产量和价格目前仍未得到充分理解。本研究开发了一个将天气变化、重大干扰事件、水产品产量和价格相联系的框架，旨在帮助政策制定者、交易商和供应链管理者做出更好的决策。季节性模式使用STL分解进行研究。Spearman滞后相关用于发现气候对产量的延迟效应。中断时间序列（ITS）回归用于衡量重大事件的影响。SARIMAX模型用于预测月度产量和价格。热点检测用于识别异常模式。结果表明，海洋渔业和内陆渔业在季节性和气候效应方面表现不同。重大干扰造成了不同程度的影响，在某些情况下，一个部门帮助弥补了另一个部门的损失。这些发现可以支持更好的规划，例如改善高风险地区的基础设施、加强冷库系统，以及对异常事件使用早期预警提示。价格预测工具应被用作决策支持工具，而不是直接的市场信号。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在评估斯里兰卡渔业在多重危机与气候变暖下的韧性。通过整合STL分解、ITS回归及SARIMAX模型等手段，分析了天气变迁与突发事件对海洋和内陆渔业产量与价格的影响，揭示了不同渔业部门间的互补性，并提出了加强冷链和预警系统的政策建议。
AI.keywords: 斯里兰卡渔业, 渔业韧性, SARIMAX模型, 中断时间序列, 价格预测
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：该研究将时间序列分解（STL）、中断时间序列分析（ITS）与季节性预测模型（SARIMAX）相结合，构建了一个多维度评估框架，能够综合分析极端天气与突发干扰事件对渔业产销的复合影响。
2. 实用价值：研究指出了海洋渔业与内陆渔业之间的互补效应，为应对风险提供了具体的政策与基础设施改善建议（如冷链系统建设与早期预警）。
3. 局限性：摘要未透露模型的具体预测精度指标（如RMSE或MAPE），且关于不同部门间“相互补偿”的具体机制和量化比例未作详细阐述。

title: A Multi-Cohort Validation of Censoring-Aware Conformal Lower Predictive Bounds for Pathology Survival Models
comments: 22 pages, 3 figures, 2 main tables, and supplementary material. Preprint
summary: Whole-slide survival models commonly provide risk rankings without calibrated statements about individual event times. We evaluate fixed-cutoff drcosarc, a post-hoc conformal wrapper for discrete-time multiple-instance learning survival heads using frozen UNI2-h representations, in an internal 18-configuration sweep across five TCGA cohorts and an external five-configuration evaluation across three CPTAC cohorts. We distinguish configuration--fold--split summaries of the inverse-probability-of-censoring-weighted (IPCW) estimate and median lower predictive bound (LPB) from a hierarchy-aware patient-ensemble estimand of the mean drcosarc--naive LPB difference. At $α=0.1$, the drcosarc IPCW estimate was nearest 0.90 in KIRC, LUAD, and STAD. Patient-ensemble drcosarc--naive intervals excluded zero in KIRC, KIRP, STAD, UCEC, and CPTAC-CCRCC, but included zero in internal LUAD, CPTAC-LUAD, CPTAC-UCEC, and the internal LUSC extension. In a 20-replicate low-censoring semi-synthetic setting with known event times, drcosarc empirical coverage was 0.9129 [0.9053, 0.9207]. An exploratory analysis supported a head-error-by-censoring interaction within that data-generating process. In a two-cohort ABMIL sensitivity analysis, increasing the hazard grid to $K=16$ raised localized marginal IPCW estimates above the prespecified 0.87 threshold and yielded positive paired LPB differences, although worst-group estimates remained below 0.87. Overall, performance was cohort dependent, and its interpretation changed with the patient-level unit, estimand, and censoring assumptions.
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 2 main tables, and supplementary material. Preprint

AI.title_translation: 病理生存模型中感知删失的共形下预测界的多队列验证
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了并验证了一种感知删失的共形预测方法（drcosarc），用于为计算病理学生存模型提供个体生存下界，实验表明其效果显著但受队列及删失假设影响。
AI.motivation: 现有的全切片图像病理生存模型通常仅能输出相对风险排名，缺乏对个体事件发生时间进行校准的预测能力和不确定性估计。
AI.method: 评估了一种名为 fixed-cutoff drcosarc 的事后共形包装器（post-hoc conformal wrapper），该方法基于冻结的 UNI2-h 特征表示，作用于离散时间多实例学习生存预测头。研究在5个 TCGA 队列（内部）和3个 CPTAC 队列（外部）中进行了评估，并结合了半合成低删失设定与 ABMIL 敏感性分析。
AI.result: 在 α=0.1 时，drcosarc 的 IPCW 估计值在 KIRC、LUAD 和 STAD 中最接近目标 coverage (0.90)；在低删失半合成设定下，经验覆盖率为 0.9129；在增加风险网格粒度至 K=16 的敏感性分析中，局部边缘 IPCW 估计值提升至预设的 0.87 阈值以上。然而，部分队列的配对 LPB 差值区间包含零，且最差组估计值仍低于 0.87。
AI.conclusion: drcosarc 的整体表现具有较强的队列依赖性，且其结果解释极大地依赖于患者层面的评估单位、被估计量（estimand）以及删失假设。
AI.translation: 全切片生存模型通常仅提供风险排名，而缺乏关于个体事件发生时间的校准陈述。我们在5个 TCGA 队列（内部18种配置搜索）和3个 CPTAC 队列（外部5种配置评估）中，评估了基于冻结 UNI2-h 特征表示的离散时间多实例学习生存预测头的事后共形包装器 fixed-cutoff drcosarc。我们区分了反概率删失加权（IPCW）估计和中位数下预测界（LPB）的“配置-折叠-划分”汇总，与均值 drcosarc-朴素 LPB 差值的层次感知患者集成被估计量。在 α=0.1 时，drcosarc IPCW 估计值在 KIRC、LUAD 和 STAD 中最接近 0.90。患者集成的 drcosarc-朴素区间在 KIRC、KIRP、STAD、UCEC 和 CPTAC-CCRCC 中排除了零，但在内部 LUAD、CPTAC-LUAD、CPTAC-UCEC 及内部 LUSC 扩展中包含零。在已知事件时间的 20 次重复低删失半合成设定中，drcosarc 的经验覆盖率为 0.9129 [0.9053, 0.9207]。探索性分析支持在该数据生成过程中存在预测头误差与删失的交互作用。在双队列 ABMIL 敏感性分析中，将风险网格增加到 K=16 使局部边缘 IPCW 估计值提高到预设的 0.87 阈值以上，并产生了正的配对 LPB 差值，尽管最差组的估计值仍低于 0.87。总体而言，模型性能具有队列依赖性，其解释随患者级单位、被估计量和删失假设而变化。
AI.summary: 本研究在多个病理队列中验证了一种能感知删失的共形下预测界方法（drcosarc），用于评估计算病理学生存模型的不确定性。实验表明该方法能有效提供校准的个体生存时间下界，但其经验覆盖率和预测性能呈现出明显的队列依赖性和删失假设敏感性。
AI.keywords: 共形预测, 生存分析, 计算机病理学, 删失数据, 多队列验证
AI.comments: 该研究针对全切片病理生存预测中缺乏可靠个体预测区间的痛点，引入了感知删失的共形下预测界（drcosarc），并在多个内部及外部队列中进行了系统性验证。创新性在于结合多实例学习和共形预测，提出了高信度的不确定性量化方法；局限性在于其表现高度依赖于具体的队列特性、删失假设及风险网格配置，部分队列中性能未达既定阈值。

title: The Cost of Binarizing Survival Outcomes in Clinical Prognostic Modeling
comments: Accepted to Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC) Conference 2026
summary: Survival analysis is an established framework for analyzing time-to-event data, yet many clinical machine learning studies still binarize the outcome before model training. This practice excludes censored patients, collapses temporal information into a single threshold, and can affect which features are selected as prognostically relevant. We examine the cost of this binarization in the context of Bayesian network (BN) feature selection, using two recent publications as case studies: one that applies BN-based feature selection to a head-and-neck cancer cohort and a second surgical cohort study that, while not BN-based, likewise binarizes its survival endpoint. We replace the binary scoring function with the Cox partial log-likelihood for feature-to-outcome edges, a modification we call the Survival-Aware Bayesian network, and recover prognostic features that binarization misses. Our ablation experiment confirms that the improvement is driven by the time-to-event scoring formulation rather than by retaining more patients. The results generalize across five endpoint-cohort combinations in head-and-neck cancer and extend to three further cancer types (breast, colorectal, and kidney). We propose that clinical studies with survival outcomes should use time-to-event methods by default, as binarization discards the prognostic signal retained by survival analysis.
comment: Accepted to Machine Learning for Healthcare (MLHC) Conference 2026

AI.title_translation: 临床预后建模中生存结局二值化的代价
AI.tldr: 在临床预后建模中将生存结局二值化会丢失关键信息并影响特征选择；本研究提出了一种生存感知的贝叶斯网络方法，并证明时间事件方法优于二值化，应默认使用。
AI.motivation: 生存分析是分析时间事件数据的既定框架，但许多临床机器学习研究在模型训练前仍将结局二值化。这种做法会排除审查患者、将时间信息压缩为单一阈值，并影响预后相关特征的选择。本研究旨在检验这种二值化实践的代价。
AI.method: 本研究在贝叶斯网络（BN）特征选择的背景下，检验了二值化的代价。使用两份近期出版物作为案例研究：一份将基于BN的特征选择应用于头颈癌队列，另一份外科队列研究也对生存终点进行了二值化。研究用Cox偏对数似然替换了特征到结局边缘的二值评分函数，将此修改称为“生存感知贝叶斯网络”。通过消融实验确认改进是由时间事件评分公式驱动的。
AI.result: 研究成功恢复了二值化错过的预后特征。消融实验证实，改进是由时间事件评分公式而非保留更多患者所驱动。结果在头颈癌的五种终点-队列组合中具有普遍性，并扩展到其他三种癌症类型（乳腺癌、结直肠癌和肾癌）。
AI.conclusion: 建议具有生存结局的临床研究默认使用时间事件方法，因为二值化会丢弃生存分析保留的预后信号。
AI.translation: 生存分析是分析时间事件数据的既定框架，然而许多临床机器学习研究在模型训练前仍然将结局二值化。这种做法会排除审查患者，将时间信息压缩为单一阈值，并可能影响哪些特征被选为具有预后相关性。我们以贝叶斯网络（BN）特征选择为背景，检验了这种二值化的代价，并使用两份近期出版物作为案例研究：一份将基于BN的特征选择应用于头颈癌队列，第二份外科队列研究虽然并非基于BN，但同样对其生存终点进行了二值化。我们将二值评分函数替换为Cox偏对数似然，用于特征到结局的边缘，我们将这种修改称为生存感知贝叶斯网络，并恢复了二值化错过的预后特征。我们的消融实验证实，这种改进是由时间事件评分公式而非保留更多患者所驱动的。结果在头颈癌的五种终点-队列组合中具有普遍性，并扩展到其他三种癌症类型（乳腺癌、结直肠癌和肾癌）。我们建议，具有生存结局的临床研究应默认使用时间事件方法，因为二值化会丢弃生存分析保留的预后信号。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了在临床预后建模中将生存结局二值化的负面影响。许多机器学习研究错误地将时间事件数据二值化，导致信息丢失和特征选择偏差。作者提出了一种“生存感知贝叶斯网络”，通过将二值评分函数替换为Cox偏对数似然来处理时间事件数据。实验结果表明，该方法能恢复二值化遗漏的预后特征，并且这种改进源于时间事件评分公式。研究建议临床研究应默认采用时间事件方法，以避免丢失重要的预后信号。
AI.keywords: 生存分析, 二值化, 预后建模, 贝叶斯网络, 特征选择
AI.comments: 这项研究通过量化二值化生存结局的“代价”，强调了在临床预后建模中正确处理时间事件数据的重要性。其创新之处在于提出了“生存感知贝叶斯网络”方法，并将Cox偏对数似然引入特征选择过程，有效地解决了传统二值化带来的信息损失问题。研究结果具有较强的普遍性，对于指导临床机器学习实践具有重要意义。

title: Statistical learning theory and Occam's razor: Regularization
summary: The principle of Occam's razor, which instructs us to prefer simplicity in inductive inference, has attracted much scrutiny both in the philosophy of science and in machine learning. In either field, however, a justification for the principle has been elusive. In this paper, building on an earlier "core argument," I spell out a justification from statistical learning theory for the procedure of regularization: for trading off fit for simplicity. The means-ends argument is that in order to profit from theoretical reliability and "what-you-see-is-what-you-get" guarantees, one must implement a certain preference for simplicity over fit. This is a genuine methodological justification, which neither collapses to a purely pragmatic principle that we prefer simplicity for its own sake, nor to an ontological assumption that the truth is simple.

AI.title_translation: 统计学习理论与奥卡姆剃刀：正则化
AI.tldr: 本文从统计学习理论出发，为机器学习中正则化（权衡拟合度与简单性）的合理性提供了一种无需依赖“真理是简单的”本体论假设的方法论论证。
AI.motivation: 在科学哲学和机器学习中，奥卡姆剃刀原则（归纳推理中偏好简单性）的合理性解释长期以来一直难以确立，需要为其提供坚实的方法论依据。
AI.method: 基于先前的“核心论点”，利用统计学习理论提出一种“手段-目的”（means-ends）论证，以此来解释在模型拟合度与简单性之间进行权衡的正则化过程。
AI.result: 论证了为了获得理论可靠性和“所见即所得”（泛化性能）的保证，必须在算法中引入对模型简单性优于拟合度的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 该论证提供了一种真正的程序方法论辩护，既避免了降级为“为了简单而简单”的纯粹实用主义，也无需依赖“真理本身是简单的”这一本体论假设。
AI.translation: 奥卡姆剃刀原则指导我们在归纳推理中偏好简单性，这一原则在科学哲学和机器学习领域都受到了广泛关注。然而，在这两个领域中，对该原则的合理性解释一直难以寻觅。本文在先前“核心论点”的基础上，从统计学习理论的角度对正则化（即在拟合度与简单性之间进行权衡）的过程给出了合理性解释。这种“手段-目的”论证表明，为了受益于理论可靠性和“所见即所得”的保证，人们必须实施某种对简单性高于拟合度的偏好。这是一种真正的方法论合理化，它既没有退化为单纯为了简单而偏好简单的纯粹实用主义原则，也没有退化为假设真理本身是简单的那种本体论假设。
AI.summary: 本文通过统计学习理论，为机器学习中的正则化技术（即在模型拟合度与简单性之间做权衡）提供了方法论上的合理性辩护。作者提出了一种“手段-目的”论证，说明为了获得理论上的可靠性和泛化保证，必须偏好简单模型，从而在无需假设“真理是简单的”前提下证明了奥卡姆剃刀原则的合理性。
AI.keywords: 统计学习理论, 奥卡姆剃刀, 正则化, 方法论辩护, 归纳推理
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于跨学科地结合了科学哲学与统计学习理论，为机器学习中极具基础性的“正则化”技术提供了严密的方法论辩护。其重要性在于摆脱了“真理必然简单”这一难以证实的本体论假设，转而通过统计学习理论中的泛化保证（如理论可靠性）来解释为何必须偏好简单性。局限性在于本文偏向理论与哲学逻辑探讨，摘要中未展示具体的数学公式或实证分析。

title: Unifying quantum measurement constructions via a relative-entropy minimum change principle
summary: The minimum change principle provides an information-theoretic characterization of the Bayes reversal channel in classical probability theory and has recently been proposed as a framework for extending Bayes' rule to quantum information theory. Using quantum relative entropy, we investigate a minimum change principle for the setting of quantum statistical inference. Specifically, we consider a forward process based on a classical-to-quantum preparation channel and a reverse process based on a quantum-to-classical measurement channel. We establish a closed-form characterization of measurements that are optimal for this principle, and this optimal measurement can be found via a dual formulation involving a single unconstrained Hermitian variable. This perspective allows us to recover some notable measurements within the same framework, including pretty good measurements and Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements, and we use it to discover a novel family that we call softmin thermal measurements. We further show that softmin thermal measurements arise as optimal solutions to entropy-regularized semidefinite optimization problems, demonstrating that they play a role for measurements analogous to that of thermal states in statistical mechanics. Finally, we prove an additivity property for the relative-entropy minimum change principle and investigate the performance of Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements for quantum hypothesis testing.

AI.title_translation: 通过相对熵最小变化原理统一量子测量构建
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于量子相对熵最小变化原理的统一框架，成功重现了多种已知量子测量，并发现了全新的Softmin热测量族。
AI.motivation: 最小变化原理在经典概率论中刻画了贝叶斯反转信道，但将其推广至量子信息论和量子统计推断领域仍需系统的理论框架，因而需要探究基于量子相对熵的最小变化原理以统一量子测量的构建。
AI.method: 作者考虑了一个由经典到量子准备信道组成的正向过程与由量子到经典测量信道组成的反向过程；利用量子相对熵建立最小变化原理，并通过包含单个无约束Hermitian变量的对偶表述形式求解闭形式的最优测量方案。
AI.result:
1. 建立了最优测量的闭形式刻画，并给出对偶优化形式；
2. 在统一框架下重现了Pretty Good Measurement与费米-狄拉克热测量；
3. 发现并定义了全新的Softmin热测量族，证明其为熵正则化半正定优化的最优解；
4. 证明了相对熵最小变化原理的可加性；
5. 分析了费米-狄拉克热测量在量子假设检验中的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于量子相对熵的最小变化原理为量子测量构建提供了一个统一且强有力的框架，不仅深化了对现有量子测量方法的理解，也为量子统计推断与假设检验开辟了新的研究方向。
AI.translation: 最小变化原理为经典概率论中的贝叶斯反转信道提供了一个信息论刻画，最近被提出作为将贝叶斯规则推广到量子信息论的框架。利用量子相对熵，我们研究了量子统计推断设定下的最小变化原理。具体而言，我们考虑了一个基于经典到量子准备信道的正向过程和一个基于量子到经典测量信道的反向过程。我们建立了对此原理最优的测量的闭形式刻画，并且该最优测量可以通过涉及单个无约束Hermitian变量的对偶表述来寻找。这种视角使我们能够在同一个框架内恢复一些显著的测量，包括Pretty Good Measurement和费米-狄拉克热测量，并且我们用它发现了一个称为Softmin热测量的全新族。我们进一步证明，Softmin热测量是熵正则化半正定优化问题的最优解，表明它们在测量中所扮演的角色类似于热态在统计力学中的作用。最后，我们证明了相对熵最小变化原理的可加性，并探讨了费米-狄拉克热测量在量子假设检验中的性能。
AI.summary: 本文基于量子相对熵探讨了量子统计推断中的最小变化原理。通过设定正向准备信道与反向测量信道，论文给出了最优测量的闭形式刻画与对偶求解方法。该框架不仅统一了已有的Pretty Good Measurement和费米-狄拉克热测量，还发现了全新的Softmin热测量族，并证明了其可加性及在量子假设检验中的应用价值。
AI.keywords: 量子测量, 相对熵最小变化原理, 贝叶斯反转, 费米-狄拉克热测量, Softmin热测量
AI.comments: 本研究创新性地将经典概率论中的最小变化原理通过量子相对熵推广至量子统计推断，建立了一个统一量子测量构建的通用理论框架。该框架不仅能够涵盖Pretty Good Measurement和费米-狄拉克热测量等已知重要方法，还成功推导出了全新的Softmin热测量族，并证明了其对偶性与可加性，具有极高的理论价值和极强的数学美感。

title: Guiding Compiler Optimizations for Neutral Atom Quantum Computers Through Visualizations
summary: The scale of Neutral Atom (NA) quantum computers requires automated compilation tools. Designing the required heuristic methods demands a deep understanding of complex hardware trade-offs, for which visualizations can provide crucial insights. This work introduces NAViz, the first publicly available app to visualize quantum computations on NA devices in real-time. A case study demonstrates how NAViz was instrumental in identifying and resolving inefficiencies in an existing compilation strategy, leading to a new, more performant one. The tool is available as part of the Munich Quantum Toolkit (MQT) at https://github.com/munich-quantum-toolkit/naviz.

title: An Artificial-Compressibility Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Unsteady Incompressible Navier--Stokes Equations
summary: We study a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for the unsteady, two-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations in which the stiff divergence-free constraint is replaced by an artificial-compressibility (AC) relaxation governed by a single scalar parameter $\eps$. The relaxation reintroduces a pressure time derivative, converting a differential-algebraic constraint into an ordinary residual that a PINN can minimise directly. On the Taylor--Green vortex, which admits a closed-form unsteady solution, we quantify the effect of $\eps$: the residual divergence scales as $\eps\,|\partial_t p|$, so larger $\eps$ raises both the divergence and the velocity error, and both decrease monotonically and saturate as $\eps$ is reduced. On the $Re=100$ cylinder wake the plain forward AC-PINN collapses to the steady symmetric branch and does not reproduce von Kármán shedding; assimilating a few hundred sparse velocity sensors from a boundary-layer-resolved finite-element reference (whose Strouhal number, $0.176$, we bring close to the $0.164$--$0.172$ literature band by resolving the separating shear layer, though it remains just above it) recovers the unsteady vortex street to $7\%$ over the wake and its shedding frequency to within $3\%$ of that same reference --- a bound set by the reference's own fidelity rather than an independent validation against the true flow.
