title: TopoChunker: Topology-Aware Agentic Document Chunking Framework
summary: Current document chunking methods for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) typically linearize text. This forced linearization strips away intrinsic topological hierarchies, creating ``semantic fragmentation'' that degrades downstream retrieval quality. In this paper, we propose TopoChunker, an agentic framework that maps heterogeneous documents onto a Structured Intermediate Representation (SIR) to explicitly preserve cross-segment dependencies. To balance structural fidelity with computational cost, TopoChunker employs a dual-agent architecture. An Inspector Agent dynamically routes documents through cost-optimized extraction paths, while a Refiner Agent performs capacity auditing and topological context disambiguation to reconstruct hierarchical lineage. Evaluated on unstructured narratives (GutenQA) and complex reports (GovReport), TopoChunker demonstrates state-of-the-art performance. It outperforms the strongest LLM-based baseline by 8.0% in absolute generation accuracy and achieves an 83.26% Recall@3, while simultaneously reducing token overhead by 23.5%, offering a scalable approach for structure-aware RAG.

AI.title_translation: TopoChunker：感知拓扑的智能体文档切分框架
AI.tldr: TopoChunker 是一个通过双智能体架构保留文档拓扑层级的文档切分框架，能够显著提升 RAG 的检索生成质量并降低 token 开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）文档切分方法通常将文本线性化，去除了固有的拓扑层级结构，从而导致“语义碎片化”并降低了下游的检索质量。
AI.method: 提出 TopoChunker 智能体框架，将异构文档映射到结构化中间表示（SIR）以保留跨段落依赖关系；采用双智能体架构，包括负责动态路由的 Inspector Agent 和负责容量审计及拓扑上下文消歧的 Refiner Agent。
AI.result: 在 GutenQA 和 GovReport 数据集上的评估表明，TopoChunker 比最强的基于 LLM 的基线模型的绝对生成准确率高出 8.0%，Recall@3 达到 83.26%，同时将 token 开销减少了 23.5%。
AI.conclusion: TopoChunker 能够有效保留文档的拓扑层级结构，在非结构化叙事和复杂报告上均展现出 SOTA 性能，降低了 token 开销，为结构感知型 RAG 提供了一个可扩展的方案。
AI.translation: 当前的检索增强生成（RAG）文档切分方法通常将文本线性化。这种强行的线性化剥夺了固有的拓扑层级，产生了降低下游检索质量的“语义碎片化”。在本文中，我们提出了 TopoChunker，这是一个将异构文档映射到结构化中间表示（SIR）以显式保留跨段落依赖关系的智能体框架。为了平衡结构保真度与计算成本，TopoChunker 采用了双智能体架构。检查员智能体（Inspector Agent）动态地将文档路由通过成本优化的提取路径，而精炼智能体（Refiner Agent）执行容量审计和拓扑上下文消歧以重建层级血缘。在非结构化叙事（GutenQA）和复杂报告（GovReport）上的评估表明，TopoChunker 展示了最先进的性能。它比最强的基于 LLM 的基线在绝对生成准确率上高出 8.0%，实现了 83.26% 的 Recall@3，同时将 token 开销降低了 23.5%，为结构感知的 RAG 提供了一种可扩展的方法。
AI.summary: TopoChunker 是一个拓扑感知的智能体文档切分框架，通过将文档映射到结构化中间表示并利用双智能体架构（Inspector 和 Refiner 智能体），在保留文档层级结构和上下文的同时，显著提升了 RAG 的检索和生成性能并降低了计算成本。
AI.keywords: 文档切分, 检索增强生成, 拓扑感知, 多智能体架构, 语义碎片化
AI.comments: TopoChunker 通过引入拓扑感知和双智能体架构，有效地解决了传统 RAG 中文本线性化导致的语义碎片化问题，在提升检索和生成准确率的同时降低了计算开销。

title: SEAR: Simple and Efficient Adaptation of Visual Geometric Transformers for Unpaired RGB+Thermal 3D Reconstruction
summary: Foundational feed-forward visual geometry models enable accurate and efficient camera pose estimation and scene reconstruction by learning strong scene priors from massive RGB datasets. However, their effectiveness drops when applied to mixed sensing modalities, such as RGB-thermal (RGB-T) images. We observe that while a visual geometry grounded transformer pretrained on RGB data generalizes well to thermal-only reconstruction, it struggles to align RGB and thermal modalities when processed jointly. To address this, we propose SEAR, a simple yet efficient fine-tuning strategy that adapts a pretrained geometry transformer to multimodal RGB-T inputs. Despite being trained on a relatively small RGB-T dataset, our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods for 3D reconstruction and camera pose estimation, achieving significant improvements over all metrics and delivering higher detail and consistency between modalities with negligible overhead in inference time compared to the original pretrained model. Notably, SEAR enables reliable multimodal pose estimation and reconstruction even under challenging conditions, such as low lighting and dense smoke. We validate our architecture through extensive ablation studies and demonstrate how the model aligns both modalities. Additionally, we introduce a new dataset featuring RGB and thermal sequences captured at different times, viewpoints, and illumination conditions, providing a robust benchmark for future work in multimodal 3D scene reconstruction. Code and models are publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/ZENODO.21077295.

AI.title_translation: SEAR：用于非配对RGB+热成像3D重建的视觉几何Transformer简单高效自适应方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SEAR策略，通过高效微调视觉几何Transformer，解决了RGB+热成像多模态3D重建中的模态对齐难题，大幅提升了重建精度与位姿估计性能，且推理开销极小。
AI.motivation: 虽然基于RGB数据预训练的基础视觉几何模型在单模态热成像重建中表现良好，但在联合处理RGB和热成像（RGB-T）图像时无法很好地对齐这两种模态，因此需要一种方法来适应混合传感模态。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为SEAR的简单且高效的微调策略，将预训练的视觉几何Transformer适配到多模态RGB-T输入上，并通过消融实验进行了验证。同时引入了一个包含不同时间、视点和光照条件下的RGB和热成像序列的新数据集。
AI.result: 尽管是在相对较小的RGB-T数据集上训练，该方法在3D重建和相机位姿估计方面显著优于现有最先进的方法，在所有指标上都有显著提升，模态间具有更高的细节和一致性，且推理开销可忽略不计，在低光照和浓烟等恶劣条件下也能实现可靠的位姿估计和重建。
AI.conclusion: SEAR是一种简单而高效的视觉几何Transformer微调策略，能够有效解决RGB+热成像多模态3D重建和相机位姿估计问题，在极具挑战的环境下表现出色，且几乎不增加推理开销。
AI.translation: 基础的前馈视觉几何模型通过从大规模RGB数据集中学习强大的场景先验，能够实现准确高效的相机位姿估计和场景重建。然而，当应用于混合传感模态（如RGB-热成像（RGB-T）图像）时，它们的有效性会下降。我们观察到，虽然在RGB数据上预训练的视觉几何基础Transformer能够很好地泛化到纯热成像重建，但在联合处理时却难以对齐RGB和热成像模态。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SEAR，这是一种简单而高效的微调策略，可将预训练的几何Transformer适配到多模态RGB-T输入。尽管是在相对较小的RGB-T数据集上训练，我们的方法在3D重建和相机位姿估计方面仍显著优于当前最先进的方法，在所有指标上都取得了显著提升，在模态之间提供了更高的细节和一致性，并且与原始预训练模型相比，推理时间的开销可以忽略不计。值得注意的是，SEAR甚至在低光照和浓烟等具有挑战性的条件下也能实现可靠的多模态位姿估计和重建。我们通过广泛的消融实验验证了我们的架构，并展示了该模型如何对齐这两种模态。此外，我们引入了一个新数据集，其中包含在不同时间、视点和光照条件下捕获的RGB和热成像序列，为未来多模态3D场景重建的研究提供了强大的基准。代码和模型已在https://doi.org/10.5281/ZENODO.21077295公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SEAR，一种简单且高效的微调策略，用于将预训练的视觉几何Transformer适配到无配对的RGB+热成像（RGB-T3D）重建任务中。通过在小型RGB-T数据集上进行微调，该方法解决了RGB与热成像模态对齐的难题，在位姿估计和3D重建指标上大幅超越现有方法，同时几乎不增加推理时间，并在低光 and 浓烟等恶劣环境下展现出色的鲁棒性。此外，本文还贡献了一个全新的RGB-T基准数据集。
AI.keywords: 多模态3D重建, RGB-热成像, 视觉几何Transformer, 相机位姿估计, 微调策略
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种简单高效的微调策略SEAR，用于解决视觉几何Transformer在处理RGB+红外（RGB-T）多模态3D重建时的模态对齐难题。创新点在于通过极小的开销实现了显著的性能提升，并在低光照和烟雾等极具挑战性的条件下表现优异，同时开源了代码和一个新的RGB-T数据集，对多模态3D重建领域具有重要的推动作用。

title: RiboSphere: Learning Unified and Efficient Representations of RNA Structures
summary: Accurate RNA structure modeling remains difficult because RNA backbones are highly flexible, non-canonical interactions are prevalent, and experimentally determined 3D structures are comparatively scarce. We introduce RiboSphere, a framework that learns discrete geometric representations of RNA by combining vector quantization with flow matching. Our design is motivated by the modular organization of RNA architecture: complex folds are composed from recurring structural motifs. RiboSphere uses a geometric transformer encoder trained using mean-centered coordinates and random rotation augmentation to produce geometry-aware features, which are discretized with finite scalar quantization (FSQ) into a finite vocabulary of latent codes. Conditioned on these discrete codes, a flow-matching decoder reconstructs atomic coordinates, enabling high-fidelity structure generation. We find that the learned code indices are enriched for specific RNA motifs, suggesting that the model captures motif-level compositional structure rather than acting as a purely compressive bottleneck. Across benchmarks, RiboSphere achieves strong performance in structure reconstruction (RMSD 1.25,Å, TM-score 0.84), and its pretrained discrete representations transfer effectively to inverse folding and RNA--ligand binding prediction, with robust generalization in data-scarce regimes. Code is available at https://github.com/Zhangz312/RiboSphere.

AI.title_translation: RiboSphere：学习统一且高效的 RNA 结构表示
AI.tldr: RiboSphere 是一个结合向量量化与流匹配的 RNA 结构表示框架，能有效捕捉 RNA 基序并实现出色的结构重建与下游任务迁移。
AI.motivation: 准确的 RNA 结构建模由于骨架高度灵活、非规范相互作用普遍以及实验测定的 3D 结构相对稀缺而变得很困难。受 RNA 结构具有由重复结构基序组成的模块化组织形式的启发，作者旨在开发一种能够学习统一且高效的 RNA 结构几何表示的框架。
AI.method: RiboSphere 结合了向量量化和流匹配（flow matching）。它使用配备均值中心化坐标和随机旋转数据增强的几何 Transformer 编码器来生成几何感知特征，并通过有限标量量化（FSQ）将其离散化为潜在编码的有限词表；接着利用条件流匹配解码器根据这些离散编码重建原子坐标。
AI.result: RiboSphere 在结构重建方面取得了优异的性能（RMSD 1.25 Å，TM-score 0.84），并且其预训练的离散表示能够有效地迁移到反向折叠（inverse folding）和 RNA-配体结合预测任务中，在数据稀缺的情况下展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RiboSphere 成功利用向量量化和流匹配学习到了统一且高效的 RNA 结构离散表示，能够有效捕捉结构基序并在多项下游任务中表现出色。
AI.translation: 准确的 RNA 结构建模仍然很困难，因为 RNA 骨架高度灵活、非规范相互作用普遍存在，且通过实验测定的 3D 结构相对稀缺。我们引入了 RiboSphere，这是一个通过将向量量化与流匹配相结合来学习 RNA 离散几何表示的框架。我们的设计受到 RNA 架构模块化组织的启发：复杂的折叠由反复出现的结构基序组成。RiboSphere 使用在均值中心化坐标和随机旋转数据增强下训练的几何 Transformer 编码器来生成几何感知的特征，这些特征通过有限标量量化（FSQ）离散化为潜在编码的有限词表。以这些离散编码为条件，流匹配解码器重建原子坐标，从而实现高保真的结构生成。我们发现，学到的编码索引富集了特定的 RNA 基序，这表明该模型捕获了基序级的组合结构，而不是充当纯粹的压缩瓶颈。在各项基准测试中，RiboSphere 在结构重建方面取得了优异的性能（RMSD 1.25 Å，TM-score 0.84），并且其预训练的离散表示能有效地迁移到反向折叠和 RNA-配体结合预测中，在数据稀缺的情况下具有强大的泛化能力。代码可在 https://github.com/Zhangz312/RiboSphere 获取。
AI.summary: RiboSphere 是一个通过结合向量量化和流匹配来学习 RNA 统一且高效离散几何表示的框架。它能够捕捉 RNA 的基序级特征，在结构重建、反向折叠和配体结合预测等任务中表现出色。
AI.keywords: RNA structure modeling, vector quantization, flow matching, geometric representation, RNA motifs
AI.comments: RiboSphere 通过结合向量量化和流匹配（Flow Matching），实现了 RNA 结构的高效离散几何表示。它能够捕捉到 RNA 的基序（motif）级组合结构，不仅在结构重建上表现优异，还能很好地迁移到反向折叠和配体结合预测等下游任务中，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Is Monitoring Enough? Strategic Agent Selection For Stealthy Attack in Multi-Agent Discussions
summary: Multi-agent discussions have been widely adopted, motivating growing efforts to develop attacks that expose their vulnerabilities. In this work, we study a practical yet largely unexplored attack scenario, the discussion-monitored scenario, where anomaly detectors continuously monitor inter-agent communications and block detected adversarial messages. Although existing attacks are effective without discussion monitoring, we show that they exhibit detectable patterns and largely fail under such monitoring constraints. But does this imply that monitoring alone is sufficient to secure multi-agent discussions? To answer this question, we develop a novel attack method explicitly tailored to the discussion-monitored scenario. Extensive experiments demonstrate that effective attacks remain possible even under continuous monitoring, indicating that monitoring alone does not eliminate adversarial risks.

AI.title_translation: 监控就足够了吗？多智能体讨论中针对隐蔽攻击的战略智能体选择
AI.tldr: 本文研究了多智能体讨论在监控环境下的安全性，证明了仅靠通信监控无法阻止隐蔽攻击，并提出了一种新型的战略智能体选择攻击方法。
AI.motivation: 研究在持续监控和拦截对抗性消息的“讨论监控场景”下，现有的多智能体讨论攻击是否会失效，以及仅靠监控是否足以保证多智能体讨论的安全性。
AI.method: 开发了一种专门针对讨论监控场景的新型攻击方法（战略智能体选择）。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，即使在持续监控下，有效的攻击仍然可能发生，这证明了仅靠监控并不能消除对抗风险。
AI.conclusion: 单纯的通信监控不足以完全防范多智能体讨论中的隐蔽攻击，有效的攻击在持续监控下依然可行，需要更先进的防御机制。
AI.translation: 多智能体讨论已被广泛采用，这激发了人们开发暴露其脆弱性的攻击的不断努力。在这项工作中，我们研究了一个实用但很大程度上未被探索的攻击场景——讨论监控场景，在该场景中，异常检测器持续监控智能体之间的通信并阻止检测到的对抗性消息。尽管现有的攻击在没有讨论监控的情况下是有效的，但我们表明它们表现出可检测的模式，并且在很大程度上在这样的监控限制下失效。但这是否意味着仅靠监控就足以确保多智能体讨论的安全呢？为了回答这个问题，我们开发了一种专门针对讨论监控场景的新型攻击方法。大量的实验表明，即使在持续监控下，有效的攻击仍然是可能的，这表明仅靠监控并不能消除对抗风险。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了多智能体讨论在持续监控条件下的安全性，发现尽管现有攻击在监控下会暴露并失败，但通过开发一种专门的战略智能体选择攻击方法，仍然可以在监控下成功实施隐蔽攻击，表明单纯依靠监控无法完全消除安全风险。
AI.keywords: 多智能体讨论, 异常检测, 战略智能体选择, 隐蔽攻击, 安全脆弱性
AI.comments: 该论文指出了当前多智能体讨论中异常检测机制的局限性，通过提出针对性的策略性智能体选择攻击方法，揭示了单纯依赖监控并不足以消除对抗风险，对未来构建更安全的多智能体系统具有重要的警示和启发意义。

title: The Luna Bound Propagator for Formal Analysis of Neural Networks
summary: The parameterized CROWN analysis, a.k.a., alpha-CROWN has emerged as a practically successful abstract interpretation method for neural network verification. However, existing implementations of alpha-CROWN are limited to Python, which complicates integration into existing DNN verifiers and long-term production-level systems. We introduce Luna, a new abstract-interpretation-based bound propagator implemented in C++. Luna supports Interval Bound Propagation, the DeepPoly/CROWN analysis, and the alpha-CROWN analysis over a general computational graph. We describe the architecture of Luna and show that it outperforms the state-of-the-art alpha-CROWN implementation in terms of both bound tightness and computational efficiency on supported benchmarks from VNN-COMP 2025. Luna is publicly available at https://github.com/ai-ar-research/luna.

AI.title_translation: 用于神经网络形式化分析的Luna边界传播器
AI.tldr: Luna是一个高性能的C++神经网络边界传播器，支持alpha-CROWN等形式化验证方法，性能超越现有的Python实现。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数化CROWN分析（alpha-CROWN）实现局限于Python语言，难以集成到现有的深度神经网络验证器和长期的生产级系统中。
AI.method: 使用C++实现了一个新的抽象解释边界传播器Luna，支持区间边界传播（IBP）、DeepPoly/CROWN以及通用计算图上的alpha-CROWN分析，并对其架构进行了精细设计。
AI.result: 在VNN-COMP 2025的支持基准测试中，Luna在边界紧密度和计算效率方面均优于现有的最先进的alpha-CROWN实现。
AI.conclusion: Luna成功实现了C++版本的alpha-CROWN及相关边界传播算法，在计算效率和边界紧密度上均超越了现有的Python实现，为神经网络验证系统提供了优质的生产级基础组件。
AI.translation: 参数化CROWN分析（又称alpha-CROWN）已成为神经网络验证中一种实际成功的抽象解释方法。然而，现有的alpha-CROWN实现仅限于Python，这使它难以集成到现有的DNN验证器和长期的生产级系统中。我们介绍了Luna，这是一个用C++实现的新型基于抽象解释的边界传播器。Luna在通用计算图上支持区间边界传播、DeepPoly/CROWN分析以及alpha-CROWN分析。我们描述了Luna的架构，并表明在VNN-COMP 2025的支持基准测试中，它在边界紧密度和计算效率方面均优于最先进的alpha-CROWN实现。Luna已在 https://github.com/ai-ar-research/luna 上开源。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Luna，一个基于C++实现的神经网络边界传播器。它支持多种抽象解释分析方法（如IBP、CROWN和alpha-CROWN），克服了以往Python实现的局限性，在VNN-COMP 2025的基准测试中展现出优于现有最先进实现的效率和边界紧密度。
AI.keywords: 神经网络验证, 抽象解释, alpha-CROWN, C++实现, 边界传播器
AI.comments: Luna提供了一个高性能、基于C++的神经网络边界传播器，突破了传统Python实现的性能和集成瓶颈，对神经网络形式化验证领域具有重要推动作用。

title: SleepVLM: A Rule-Grounded Vision-Language Model for Auditable Sleep Staging
summary: Sleep staging is essential for sleep assessment and disorder diagnosis. In recent years, automatic sleep staging systems have achieved accuracy approaching that of human experts, but the black-box nature of their predictions hinders clinical adoption. Existing interpretability methods offer partial insight into model behavior, but their outputs still require expert reinterpretation and do not provide a direct basis for auditing individual predictions. To improve trustworthiness, we propose the task of auditable sleep staging. To solve this task, we present SleepVLM, a vision-language model that casts sleep staging as visual reasoning over rendered polysomnography (PSG) waveform images. For each epoch, SleepVLM outputs a stage together with the applicable American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) rules and an auditable rationale. The model is trained using a two-stage framework: Waveform-Perceptual Pre-training followed by Rule-Grounded Supervised Fine-tuning over a mixture of fine-grained and coarse annotations. Experiments on four datasets show that SleepVLM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on average. An automated AASM-feature audit shows broad coverage of stage-defining evidence in the rationales, and independent experts validate their reasoning quality. To facilitate further research, we construct and release MASS-EX, an expert-annotated dataset for rule-grounded sleep staging with AASM rule annotations and expert-written rationales.

AI.title_translation: SleepVLM：一个用于可审计睡眠分期的基于规则的视觉语言模型
AI.tldr: SleepVLM是一个结合美国睡眠医学会（AASM）规则的视觉语言模型，能够在提供高精度睡眠分期的同时，输出可审计的医学推理理由，解决了自动睡眠分期系统的黑盒问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动睡眠分期系统虽然准确率高，但具有黑盒特性，阻碍了其在临床中的应用。现有的可解释性方法只能提供部分洞察，无法直接作为审计个体预测的依据。为了提高模型的可靠性和可信度，作者提出了可审计睡眠分期的新任务及相应的解决方法。
AI.method: 提出SleepVLM模型，将睡眠分期转化为对渲染的多导睡眠图（PSG）波形图像的视觉推理。采用两阶段训练框架：波形感知预训练（Waveform-Perceptual Pre-training）和规则基础监督微调（Rule-Grounded Supervised Fine-tuning），并在微调时使用混合的细粒度和粗粒度注释。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，SleepVLM的平均性能优于当前最先进的方法；自动化AASM特征审计证明其理由涵盖了广泛的阶段定义证据，并且独立专家验证了其推理质量。此外，构建并发布了带有AASM规则注释和专家编写理由的MASS-EX数据集。
AI.conclusion: SleepVLM通过将睡眠分期建模为基于渲染多导睡眠图图像的视觉推理任务，实现了高准确性与临床可审计性的有机统一，在四个数据集上展现出优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 睡眠分期对于睡眠评估和疾病诊断至关重要。近年来，自动睡眠分期系统的准确率已接近人类专家，但其预测结果的黑盒特性阻碍了其在临床上的应用。现有的可解释性方法只能提供对模型行为的部分见解，其输出仍需要专家重新解释，无法为审计单个预测提供直接依据。为了提高可信度，我们提出了可审计睡眠分期的任务。为了解决这一任务，我们提出了SleepVLM，这是一个将睡眠分期描述为对渲染的多导睡眠图（PSG）波形图像进行视觉推理的视觉语言模型。对于每个历元（epoch），SleepVLM输出一个睡眠阶段，连同适用的美国睡眠医学会（AASM）规则以及可审计的理由。该模型使用两阶段框架进行训练：波形感知预训练，随后在细粒度和粗粒度注释的混合数据上进行规则基础监督微调。在四个数据集上的实验表明，SleepVLM的平均性能优于最先进的方法。自动AASM特征审计显示，推理理由对阶段定义证据具有广泛的覆盖范围，且独立专家验证了其推理质量。为了促进进一步研究，我们构建并发布了MASS-EX，这是一个用于规则基础睡眠分期的专家注释数据集，包含AASM规则注释和专家编写的理由。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SleepVLM，一个旨在实现可审计睡眠分期的基于规则的视觉语言模型。通过将睡眠分期视为对多导睡眠图图像的视觉推理任务，并结合两阶段训练框架，SleepVLM能够在预测睡眠阶段的同时输出适用的AASM规则和可审计的推理理由，实验证明其在准确率和可解释性上均表现优异。
AI.keywords: Sleep staging, Vision-Language Model, Auditable reasoning, American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM), Polysomnography (PSG)
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多模态视觉语言模型（VLM）引入睡眠分期任务，不仅预测睡眠阶段，还能结合AASM规则给出可审计的推理理由，有效打破了传统深度学习模型的“黑盒”限制，极大地提高了临床医学对自动睡眠分期系统的信任度。同时发布的MASS-EX数据集也为该领域的后续研究奠定了坚实基础。

title: How Effective Are NPM Malicious Package Detectors? A Large-Scale Empirical Study
summary: The NPM ecosystem faces escalating threats from malicious packages that exploit its open publication model. While numerous detection tools have been proposed, they are evaluated on disparate datasets with inconsistent settings, making cross-tool comparison unreliable and leaving practitioners without clear guidance. We present the first large-scale empirical study of NPM malicious package detection, evaluating 11 tools with 16 variants on a unified benchmark of 6,420 malicious and 7,288 benign packages annotated with 11 behavior categories and 8 evasion techniques. Unlike prior work, we inspect each tool's source code to explain why tools succeed or fail, not merely how often. Our key findings: (1) the precision and recall a tool achieves are structurally determined by how it resolves the ambiguity between code capability and malicious intent, with IntelGuard reaching the best F1 at 95.98% by grounding its judgment in retrieved evidence and GuardDog the best among conventional tools at 93.32%; (2) behavioral coupling amplifies detection signals when behaviors co-occur, raising SAP_DT from 3.2% to 79.3% for the collect-and-exfiltrate chain; (3) 80.3% of malware uses no evasion because the ecosystem lacks mandatory pre-publication scanning; (4) ML degradation is driven by concept convergence rather than concept drift, since malware became simpler and every decision boundary fitted to a corpus ages with it; (5) combination effectiveness equals complementarity minus false-positive introduction, not paradigm diversity. Strategic combinations reach up to 97.21% accuracy and 97.02% F1. We release our benchmark and evaluation framework.

AI.title_translation: NPM恶意包检测器究竟有多有效？一项大规模实证研究
AI.tldr: 通过首次对11款NPM恶意包检测工具进行大规模统一基准评估，本文揭示了其性能差异的根源，并指出了提升检测率的有效组合策略。
AI.motivation: NPM生态系统面临日益严重的恶意包威胁，尽管提出了许多检测工具，但由于数据集和设置不一致导致跨工具比较不可靠，从业缺乏清晰指导，因此需要进行大规模的统一实证研究。
AI.method: 在包含6,420个恶意包和7,288个良性包的统一基准上，评估了11种工具的16个变体（包含11个行为类别和8种逃逸技术），并深入检查每个工具的源代码以分析其成败原因。
AI.result: 研究发现：IntelGuard（F1达95.98%）和GuardDog（F1达93.32%）表现最佳；行为耦合能显著放大检测信号；80.3%的恶意软件未使用逃逸技术；机器学习性能下降主要由概念收敛而非概念漂移驱动；策略性工具组合可将准确率提升至97.21%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过大规模统一基准评估了11款NPM恶意包检测工具，揭示了检测效能的内在决定因素、逃逸技术的现状以及机器学习模型退化的原因，为构建更高效的软件供应链防御体系提供了重要见解和基准框架。
AI.translation: NPM生态系统面临着利用其开放式发布模型的恶意包带来的不断升级的威胁。尽管已经提出了许多检测工具，但它们是在具有不一致设置的不同数据集上进行评估的，这使得跨工具比较不可靠，并使从业者缺乏明确的指导。我们对NPM恶意包检测进行了第一次大规模实证研究，在一个包含6,420个恶意包和7,288个良性包的统一基准上评估了11个工具的16个变体，这些包注释了11个行为类别和8种逃逸技术。与以往的工作不同，我们检查每个工具的源代码来解释工具成功或失败的原因，而不仅仅是频率。我们的主要发现：（1）工具实现的精确率和召回率由其如何解决代码能力与恶意意图之间的模糊性结构性决定，IntelGuard通过将判断建立在检索到的证据上，达到了95.98%的最佳F1，而GuardDog在传统工具中达到了93.32%的最佳F1；（2）行为耦合在行为共同发生时会放大检测信号，将collect-and-exfiltrate链的SAP_DT从3.2%提高到79.3%；（3）80.3%的恶意软件不使用逃逸，因为该生态系统缺乏强制性的发布前扫描；（4）机器学习性能下降是由概念收敛而不是概念漂移驱动的，因为恶意软件变得更简单，并且拟合到语料库的每个决策边界都会随之老化；（5）组合效果等于互补性减去误报引入，而不是范式多样性。战略性组合可实现高达97.21%的准确率和97.02%的F1。我们发布了我们的基准和评估框架。
AI.summary: 本文针对NPM恶意包检测工具开展了首次大规模实证研究。通过构建统一的基准并评估11款工具（16个变体），作者深入分析了工具的成败原因、行为耦合、逃逸技术、机器学习模型退化及工具组合策略，并开源了评估框架与基准。
AI.keywords: NPM生态系统, 恶意包检测, 实证研究, 软件供应链安全, 机器学习检测
AI.comments: 本文首次对NPM恶意包检测工具进行了大规模、系统性的实证研究。通过统一基准和深入的代码级分析，不仅揭示了现有工具的优缺点，还指出了机器学习检测模型退化的根源以及多工具组合的最佳策略，对软件供应链安全具有极高的指导价值。

title: Secret Key Rate Analysis of RIS-Assisted THz MIMO CV-QKD Systems under Access-Constrained Eavesdropping
summary: A reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) system operating at terahertz (THz) frequencies, in which a transmitter, Alice, encodes secret keys using Gaussian-modulated coherent states and communicates them to a legitimate receiver, Bob, is considered in this paper. The composite wireless channel, comprising the direct Alice-Bob link and the RIS-assisted reflected link, is modeled as a passive linear Gaussian quantum channel, enabling a unitary dilation that preserves the canonical commutation relations. The security of the considered system is investigated under collective Gaussian entangling attacks by introducing a practical access-constrained eavesdropping model, in which an eavesdropper, Eve, is assumed to access only the environmental modes associated with physically accessible propagation segments. A unified analytical framework is developed to derive the achievable secret key rate (SKR) across all single-segment, pairwise-segment, and full-segment access scenarios, assuming homodyne detection and reverse reconciliation at Bob. Furthermore, an optimization framework is developed to determine the optimal RIS phase configuration matrix and transmitter/receiver beam-splitter parameters that maximize the SKR performance. The resulting optimization problem is efficiently solved using particle swarm optimization. Numerical results are presented to demonstrate the system's performance with respect to various free parameters. It is showcased that the secrecy performance strongly depends on Eve's accessible propagation segments, with the Alice-RIS channel constituting the most security-critical segment.

AI.title_translation: 受限窃听下RIS辅助的太赫兹MIMO连续变量量子密钥分发系统秘密密钥率分析
AI.tldr: 本文研究了RIS辅助的THz MIMO CV-QKD系统在受限窃听下的秘密密钥率，开发了分析与优化框架，发现Alice-RIS信道是系统安全性的关键。
AI.motivation: 为了解决太赫兹（THz）频段下行链路中的传输损耗和安全性问题，研究智能反射面（RIS）辅助的多输入多输出（MIMO）连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）系统的秘密密钥率（SKR）性能。
AI.method: 将复合无线信道建模为无源线性高斯量子信道，引入实用化的受限窃听模型推导集体高斯纠缠攻击下的秘密密钥率（SKR）分析框架，并采用粒子群优化（PSO）算法求解最大化SKR的RIS相位配置矩阵及收发器分束器参数。
AI.result: 开发了适用于各种单段、双段和全段访问场景的统一SKR分析框架，数值结果表明系统保密性能严重依赖于Eve可访问的传播段，其中Alice-RIS信道是安全性的关键。
AI.conclusion: 窃听者的可访问传播段对系统保密性能有决定性影响，其中Alice-RIS信道是安全性最关键的区段，通过优化RIS相位矩阵和收发器参数能有效提升密钥生成率。
AI.translation: 本文研究了一个在太赫兹（THz）频段运行的重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的多输入多输出（MIMO）连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）系统，其中发送方Alice使用高斯调制相干态编码密钥并传输给合法接收方Bob。由直接Alice-Bob链路和RIS辅助反射链路组成的复合无线信道被建模为被动线性高斯量子信道。通过引入一个实际的受限窃听模型（假设窃听者Eve只能访问物理可访问传播段的环境模式），在集体高斯纠缠攻击下研究了系统的安全性。开发了一个统一的分析框架，推导出了假设Bob采用零差探测和逆协调时，在所有单段、两段和全段访问场景下的可实现秘密密钥率（SKR）。此外，开发了一个优化框架，以确定使SKR性能最大化的最优RIS相位配置矩阵和发射机/接收机分束器参数。所得到的优化问题使用粒子群优化算法进行了有效求解。数值结果展示了系统在各种自由参数下的性能，表明保密性能在很大程度上取决于Eve可访问的传播段，其中Alice-RIS信道构成了对安全性最关键的区段。
AI.summary: 本文研究了RIS辅助的THz MIMO CV-QKD系统，在考虑受限窃听模型和集体高斯攻击的情况下，推导了统一的秘密密钥率分析框架，并利用粒子群优化算法对系统参数进行了优化，揭示了窃听者可访问段对系统安全性的影响。
AI.keywords: Reconfigurable intelligent surface, Terahertz communications, Continuous-variable quantum key distribution, Secret key rate, Particle swarm optimization
AI.comments: 该论文首次将RIS引入THz MIMO CV-QKD系统中，并结合实际的受限窃听模型分析了密钥生成率，创新性地提出了基于粒子群算法的系统参数联合优化框架，对量子通信的物理层安全研究具有重要意义。

title: SimMOF: AI agent for Automated MOF Simulations
summary: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) offer a vast design space, and as such, computational simulations play a critical role in predicting their structural and physicochemical properties. However, MOF simulations remain difficult to access because reliable analysis require expert decisions for workflow construction, parameter selection, tool interoperability, and the preparation of computational ready structures. Here, we introduce SimMOF, a large language model based multi agent framework that automates end-to-end MOF simulation workflows from natural language queries. SimMOF translates user requests into dependency aware plans, generates runnable inputs, orchestrates multiple agents to execute simulations, and summarizes results with analysis aligned to the user query. Through representative case studies, we show that SimMOF enables adaptive and cognitively autonomous workflows that reflect the iterative and decision driven behavior of human researchers and as such provides a scalable foundation for data driven MOF research.

AI.title_translation: SimMOF：用于自动化MOF模拟的AI智能体
AI.tldr: SimMOF是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，可通过自然语言查询自动执行端到端的MOF计算模拟。
AI.motivation: MOF设计空间广阔，计算模拟对其性质预测至关重要，但由于工作流构建、参数选择、工具互操作性及结构准备等需要专家决策，导致模拟门槛高且难以访问。
AI.method: 提出基于大语言模型的多智能体框架SimMOF，将用户请求转化为依赖感知计划，生成可运行的输入，编排多个智能体执行模拟，并结合查询进行结果总结与分析。
AI.result: 通过代表性案例研究，证明了SimMOF能够实现自适应和认知自主的工作流，模拟人类研究人员的迭代和决策驱动行为。
AI.conclusion: SimMOF为MOF及相关材料的数据驱动研究提供了一个可扩展、自适应且认知自主的基础框架。
AI.translation: 金属有机框架（MOFs）提供了广阔的设计空间，因此，计算模拟在预测其结构和理化性质方面发挥着关键作用。然而，MOF模拟仍然难以进行，因为可靠的分析需要专家在工作流构建、参数选择、工具互操作性和计算就绪结构的准备等方面做出决策。在此，我们介绍了SimMOF，这是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，它可以通过自然语言查询自动化端到端的MOF模拟工作流。SimMOF将用户请求转化为依赖感知的计划，生成可运行的输入，编排多个智能体执行模拟，并总结与用户查询相一致的分析结果。通过具有代表性的案例研究，我们表明SimMOF能够实现自适应和认知自主的工作流，反映了人类研究人员迭代和决策驱动的行为，从而为数据驱动的MOF研究提供了可扩展的基础。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SimMOF，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，能够通过自然语言查询自动化端到端的金属有机框架（MOF）模拟工作流，极大地简化了复杂的计算模拟过程。
AI.keywords: 金属有机框架, 多智能体框架, 大语言模型, 自动化模拟, 计算化学
AI.comments: SimMOF利用大语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，有效降低了MOF计算模拟的门槛，实现了从自然语言到端到端模拟工作流的自动化，具有极高的创新性和实用价值。

title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
comments: Pre-print. Under review. 51 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables
summary: There has been growing interest in building agents that can interact with digital platforms to execute meaningful enterprise tasks autonomously. Among the approaches explored are tool-augmented agents built on abstractions such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and web agents that operate through graphical interfaces. Yet, it remains unclear whether such complex agentic systems are necessary given their cost and operational overhead. We argue that a coding agent equipped only with a terminal and a filesystem can solve many enterprise tasks more effectively by interacting directly with platform APIs. We evaluate this hypothesis across diverse real-world systems and show that these low-level terminal agents match or outperform more complex agent architectures at a fraction of the cost. Our findings suggest that simple, flexible programmatic interfaces combined with strong foundation models should be the backbone of enterprise automation.

title: Do LLMs Know What Is Private Internally? Probing and Steering Contextual Privacy Norms in Large Language Model Representations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, yet they frequently violate contextual privacy by disclosing private information in situations where humans would exercise discretion. This raises a fundamental question: do LLMs internally encode contextual privacy norms, and if so, why do violations persist? We present the first systematic study of contextual privacy as a structured latent representation in LLMs, grounded in contextual integrity (CI) theory. Probing multiple models, we find that the three norm-determining CI parameters (information type, recipient, and transmission principle) are encoded as linearly separable and functionally independent directions in activation space. Despite this internal structure, models still leak private information in practice, revealing a clear gap between concept representation and model behavior. To bridge this gap, we introduce CI-parametric steering, which independently intervenes along each CI dimension. This structured control reduces privacy violations more effectively and predictably than monolithic steering. Our results demonstrate that contextual privacy failures arise from misalignment between representation and behavior rather than missing awareness, and that leveraging the compositional structure of CI enables more reliable contextual privacy control, shedding light on potential improvement of contextual privacy understanding in LLMs.

title: MOON3.0: Reasoning-aware Multimodal Representation Learning for E-commerce Product Understanding
comments: Accepted by the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM), 2026. 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: With the rapid growth of e-commerce, exploring general representations rather than task-specific ones has attracted increasing attention. Although recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have driven significant progress in product understanding, they are typically employed as feature extractors that implicitly encode product information into global embeddings, thereby limiting their ability to capture fine-grained attributes. Therefore, we argue that leveraging the reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to explicitly model fine-grained product attributes holds significant potential. Nevertheless, achieving this goal remains non-trivial due to several key challenges: (i) long-context reasoning tends to dilute the model's attention to salient information in the raw input; (ii) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) primarily encourages rigid imitation, limiting the exploration of effective reasoning strategies; and (iii) fine-grained details are progressively attenuated during forward propagation. To address these issues, we propose MOON3.0, the first reasoning-aware MLLM-based model for product representation learning. Our method (1) employs a multi-head modality fusion module to adaptively integrate raw signals; (2) incorporates a joint contrastive and reinforcement learning framework to autonomously explore more effective reasoning strategies; and (3) introduces a fine-grained residual enhancement module to progressively preserve local details throughout the network. Additionally, we release a large-scale multimodal e-commerce benchmark MBE3.0. Experimentally, our model demonstrates state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across various downstream tasks on both our benchmark and public datasets.

title: From Understanding to Erasing: Towards Complete and Stable Video Object Removal
summary: Video object removal aims to erase target objects while reconstructing visually plausible and temporally coherent content. However, target objects often induce shadows, reflections, illumination changes and other effects that extend beyond the provided mask, making conventional mask-conditioned completion prone to visible residuals. We therefore formulate side-effect-aware object removal as an understanding-guided process that integrates object--effect relations, affected-region localization, and context-aware reconstruction. Specifically, we introduce Object-Induced Relation Distillation to transfer token-level object--effect relations from a pretrained vision foundation model to the video diffusion model. We then design Object-aware Framewise Context Cross-Attention to combine target-object semantics with per-frame background context for removal and reconstruction, and propose Attention-guided Region Localization to derive a soft spatial prior over the target object and its affected regions. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves more complete object-and-effect removal and outperforms existing approaches in removal quality, side-effect suppression, and temporal consistency.

title: Koopman-Based Nonlinear Identification and Model Predictive Control of a Turbofan Engine
summary: This paper investigates Koopman operator-based approaches for multivariable control of a two-spool turbofan engine. A physics-based component-level model is developed to generate training data and validate the controllers. A meta-heuristic extended dynamic mode decomposition is adapted, with a cost function designed to accurately capture both spool-speed dynamics and the engine pressure ratio (EPR), enabling the construction of a single Koopman model that can be reused across multiple control strategies. Using the identified time-varying Koopman model, an adaptive Koopman-based model predictive controller (AKMPC) with a disturbance observer is developed and compared with a Koopman-based feedback linearization controller (K-FBLC) and its integrator-augmented version (K-FBLC-I). The Koopman representation further enables nonlinear GTE output limiters, such as rotor-acceleration and turbine-inlet-temperature limits, to be expressed as linear constraints in the AKMPC. The controllers are evaluated for two control configurations of spool speeds and EPR, under both sea-level and varying flight conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed identification approach enables accurate predictions of both spool speeds and EPR, allowing the Koopman model to be reused flexibly across different control formulations. While all strategies achieve comparable performance in sea-level conditions, the AKMPC demonstrates improved performance under varying flight conditions due to its ability to capture nonlinear dynamics, handle constraints, and compensate for model mismatch. Moreover, the EPR control strategy improves the thrust response. The study highlights the applicability of Koopman-based control and the advantages of the AKMPC framework for robust turbofan engine control.

title: When Modalities Remember: Continual Learning for Multimodal Knowledge Graphs
comments: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Real-world multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) are dynamic, with new entities, relations, and multimodal knowledge emerging over time. Existing continual knowledge graph reasoning (CKGR) methods focus on structural triples and cannot fully exploit multimodal signals from new entities. Existing multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (MMKGR) methods, however, usually assume static graphs and suffer catastrophic forgetting as graphs evolve. To address this gap, we present a systematic study of continual multimodal knowledge graph reasoning (CMMKGR). We construct several continual multimodal knowledge graph benchmarks from existing MMKG datasets and propose MRCKG, a new CMMKGR model. Specifically, MRCKG employs a multimodal-structural collaborative curriculum to schedule progressive learning based on the structural connectivity of new triples to the historical graph and their multimodal compatibility. It also introduces a cross-modal knowledge preservation mechanism to mitigate forgetting through entity representation stability, relational semantic consistency, and modality anchoring. In addition, a multimodal contrastive replay scheme with a two-stage optimization strategy reinforces learned knowledge via multimodal importance sampling and representation alignment. Experiments on multiple datasets show that MRCKG preserves previously learned multimodal knowledge while substantially improving the learning of new knowledge.

title: String Representation Based on Substring Equation Systems
summary: Repetitiveness measures quantify how much repetitive structure a string contains and serve as parameters for compressed representations and indexing data structures. Many compression schemes represent strings by recording equalities between identical substrings. We introduce the substring equation system (SES), a general compression scheme that represents a string as the unique solution to substring-equality and character-assignment constraints. We show that every string $w$ has an SES of size $O(χ(w))$, where $χ(w)$ is the size of its smallest suffixient set. This result establishes the reachability of $χ$, which had been an open problem. We also prove that computing the size $s(w)$ of the smallest SES that represents $w$ is NP-hard and $(1 + \varepsilon)$-inapproximable for some fixed constant $\varepsilon > 0$. Finally, we prove that the size $b(w)$ of the smallest bidirectional macro scheme (BMS) representing $w$ satisfies $s(w) \leq b(w) \leq 4s(w)$. Hence, SES and BMS are equivalent up to a constant factor, and this equivalence gives the new bound $b(w) \in O(χ(w))$.

title: AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance
summary: People often optimize for long-term goals in collaboration: A mentor or companion doesn't just answer questions, but also scaffolds learning, tracks progress, and prioritizes the other person's growth over immediate results. In contrast, current AI systems are fundamentally short-sighted collaborators - optimized for providing instant and complete responses, without ever saying no (unless for safety reasons). What are the consequences of this dynamic? Here, through a series of randomized controlled trials on human-AI interactions (N = 1,222), we provide causal evidence for two key consequences of AI assistance: reduced persistence and impairment of unassisted performance. Across a variety of tasks, including mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension, we find that although AI assistance improves performance in the short-term, people perform significantly worse without AI and are more likely to give up. Notably, these effects emerge after only brief interactions with AI (approximately 10 minutes). These findings are particularly concerning because persistence is foundational to skill acquisition and is one of the strongest predictors of long-term learning. We posit that persistence is reduced because AI conditions people to expect immediate answers, thereby denying them the experience of working through challenges on their own. These results suggest the need for AI model development to prioritize scaffolding long-term competence alongside immediate task completion.

title: Document Optimization for Black-Box Retrieval via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Document expansion is a classical technique for improving retrieval quality, and is attractive since it shifts computation offline, avoiding additional query-time processing. However, when applied to modern retrievers, it has been shown to degrade performance, often introducing noise that obfuscates the discriminative signal. We recast document expansion as a document optimization problem: a language model or a vision language model is fine-tuned to transform documents into representations that better align with the expected query distribution under a target retriever, using GRPO with the retriever's ranking improvements as rewards. This approach requires only black-box access to retrieval ranks, and is applicable across single-vector, multi-vector and lexical retrievers. We evaluate our approach on code retrieval and visual document retrieval (VDR) tasks. We find that learned document transformations yield retrieval gains and in many settings enable smaller, more efficient retrievers to outperform larger ones. For example, applying document optimization to OpenAI text-embedding-3-small model improves nDCG5 on code (58.7 to 66.8) and VDR (53.3 to 57.6), even slightly surpassing the 6.5X more expensive OpenAI text-embedding-3-large model (66.3 on code; 57.0 on VDR). When retriever weights are accessible, document optimization is often competitive with fine-tuning, and in some settings their combination performs best, improving Jina-ColBERT-V2 from 55.8 to 63.3 on VDR and from 48.6 to 61.8 on code retrieval.

title: ReCodeAgent: A Multi-agent Workflow for Language-Agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-Scale Repositories
summary: Most repository-level code translation and validation techniques have been evaluated on a single source-target programming language (PL) pair, owing to the complex engineering effort required to adapt new PL pairs. Programming agents can enable PL-agnosticism in repository-level code translation and validation: they can synthesize code across many PLs and autonomously use existing tools specific to each PL's analysis. However, state-of-the-art has yet to offer a fully autonomous agentic approach for repository-level code translation and validation of large-scale programs. This paper proposes ReCodeAgent, an autonomous multi-agent approach for language-agnostic repository-level code translation and validation. Users only need to provide the project in the source PL and specify the target PL for ReCodeAgent to automatically translate and validate the entire repository. ReCodeAgent is the first technique to achieve high translation success rates across many PLs. We compare the effectiveness of ReCodeAgent with four alternative neuro-symbolic and agentic approaches to translate 118 real-world projects, with 1,975 LoC and 43 translation units for each project, on average. The projects cover 6 PLs and 4 PL pairs. Our results demonstrate that ReCodeAgent consistently outperforms prior techniques on translation correctness, improving test pass rate by 60.8% on ground-truth tests, with an average cost of $15.3. We also perform process-centric analysis of ReCodeAgent trajectories to confirm its procedural efficiency. Finally, we investigate how the design choices (a multi-agent vs. single-agent architecture) influence ReCodeAgent performance: on average, the test pass rate drops by 40.4%, and trajectories become 28% longer and persistently inefficient.

title: SHIELD: A Segmented Hierarchical Memory Architecture for Energy-Efficient LLM Inference on Edge NPUs
comments: Accepted to 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS'26)
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) inference on edge Neural Processing Units (NPUs) is fundamentally constrained by limited on-chip memory capacity. Although high-density embedded DRAM (eDRAM) is attractive for storing activation workspaces, its periodic refresh consumes substantial energy. Prior work has primarily focused on reducing off-chip traffic or optimizing refresh for persistent Key-Value (KV) caches, while transient and error-resilient Query and Attention Output (QO) activations are largely overlooked. We propose SHIELD, a lifecycle-aware segmented eDRAM architecture that jointly exploits temporal residency and bit-level sensitivity in bfloat16 (BF16) activations. SHIELD isolates the sign and exponent fields from the mantissa, disables refresh for transient QO mantissas, and applies relaxed refresh to persistent KV mantissas. Across multiple LLMs and inference scenarios, SHIELD reduces eDRAM refresh energy by 35% relative to a standard-refresh baseline while preserving accuracy on WikiText-2, PIQA, and ARC-Easy.

AI.title_translation: SHIELD：面向边缘NPU上高效能大语言模型推理的分段分层内存架构
AI.tldr: SHIELD通过结合生命周期感知与BF16位级敏感度，对eDRAM实施差异化刷新策略，在保持模型精度的同时将刷新能耗降低了35%。
AI.motivation: 边缘NPU上的大语言模型推理受片上内存容量限制，虽然高密度eDRAM适合存储激活数据，但其定期刷新消耗大量能量，且现有研究忽视了瞬态且具容错能力的QO激活值的优化空间。
AI.method: 提出一种生命周期感知的分段eDRAM架构SHIELD。该架构将BF16激活值的符号位和指数位与尾数位隔离，对瞬态QO激活值的尾数禁用刷新，对持久KV缓存的尾数采用宽松刷新策略。
AI.result: 在多种LLM和推理场景中，SHIELD相比标准刷新基线降低了35%的eDRAM刷新能耗，并在WikiText-2、PIQA和ARC-Easy数据集上保持了模型精度。
AI.conclusion: SHIELD架构通过对不同生命周期和位敏感度的激活数据实施差异化刷新控制，有效降低了边缘NPU上大语言模型推理的eDRAM刷新能耗，且未造成精度损失。
AI.translation: 边缘神经网络处理器（NPU）上的大语言模型（LLM）推理从根本上受限于有限的片上内存容量。尽管高密度嵌入式DRAM（eDRAM）在存储激活工作区方面很具吸引力，但其定期刷新会消耗大量的能量。先前的工作主要集中在减少片外流量或优化持久键值（KV）缓存的刷新，而瞬态且具有容错能力的查询和注意力输出（QO）激活值在很大程度上被忽视了。我们提出了SHIELD，一种生命周期感知的分段eDRAM架构，该架构联合利用了bfloat16（BF16）激活值的时间驻留特性和位级敏感性。SHIELD将符号和指数字段与尾数隔离，对瞬态QO尾数禁用刷新，并对持久KV尾数应用宽松刷新。在多种LLM和推理场景下，相比标准刷新基线，SHIELD在保持WikiText-2、PIQA和ARC-Easy准确率的同时，将eDRAM刷新能耗降低了35%。
AI.summary: 针对边缘NPU上LLM推理时eDRAM高刷新能耗的问题，本文提出了SHIELD分段内存架构。利用BF16激活数据的时间驻留特性和位敏感度，SHIELD剥离符号/指数位并针对瞬态QO尾数和持久KV尾数应用差异化刷新策略。实验表明，SHIELD在保持模型精度的同时，将刷新能耗降低了35%。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型推理, 边缘NPU, eDRAM刷新能耗, 分层内存架构, BF16激活值
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于巧妙结合了数据生命周期（瞬态QO与持久KV）与BF16数值格式的位级敏感度差异，对eDRAM刷新进行了精细化分段控制，兼顾了能效与模型精度，具有很高的工程应用价值。局限性在于该方法依赖特定的数值格式（BF16）及eDRAM分段硬件设计，在其他数据精度或内存介质上的拓展性仍待进一步验证。

title: Generative Experiences for Digital Mental Health Interventions: Evidence from a Randomized Study
summary: Digital mental health (DMH) tools have extensively explored personalization of interventions to users' needs and contexts. However, this personalization often targets what support is provided, not how it is experienced. Even well-matched content can fail when the interaction format misaligns with how someone can engage. We introduce generative experience as an approach to DMH support, where the intervention experience is composed at runtime. We instantiate this in GUIDE, a system that generates personalized intervention content and multimodal interaction structure through rubric-guided generation of modular components. In a preregistered study with N=237 participants, GUIDE significantly reduced stress (p=.02) and improved user experience (p=.04) compared to an LLM-based cognitive restructuring control. GUIDE also supported diverse forms of reflection and action through varied interaction flows, while revealing tensions around personalization across the interaction sequence. This work lays the foundation for interventions that dynamically shape how support is experienced and enacted in digital settings.

AI.title_translation: 数字精神卫生干预的生成式体验：来自随机对照研究的证据
AI.tldr: 提出了GUIDE系统，通过在运行时动态生成个性化的干预内容与多模态交互结构，显著降低了用户的心理压力并提升了用户体验。
AI.motivation: 当前的数字精神卫生（DMH）工具虽然探索了针对用户需求的个性化，但多集中于“提供什么内容”（what），而忽略了“如何体验”（how）。如果交互形式与用户的实时参与能力或状态不匹配，即使内容再精准也可能失效。因此，需要一种能够在运行时动态构建交互体验的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了“生成式体验”（generative experience）方法，并在GUIDE系统中进行实现。该系统通过规则指导（rubric-guided）动态生成模块化组件，在运行时构建个性化的干预内容和多模态交互结构。研究团队开展了一项N=237名参与者的预注册随机对照实验，将其与基于LLM的传统认知重构干预进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在包含237名参与者的随机对照研究中，与基于LLM的认知重构对照组相比，GUIDE显著降低了用户的压力程度（p=.02），并显著提升了用户体验（p=.04）。此外，GUIDE通过多样的交互流程支持了多样化的反思与行动，同时也揭示了在整个交互序列中关于个性化的张力与挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了生成式体验在数字精神卫生干预中的有效性，为未来在数字环境中动态塑造心理支持的呈现与执行方式奠定了理论与实践基础。
AI.translation: 数字精神卫生（DMH）工具广泛探索了针对用户需求和语境的干预个性化。然而，这种个性化通常针对的是“提供什么支持”，而非“如何体验这种支持”。即使是高度匹配的内容，如果交互形式与个人的参与方式不匹配，也可能失效。我们提出了“生成式体验”作为数字精神卫生支持的一种新方法，其中干预体验是在运行时构建的。我们在GUIDE系统中实现了这一点，该系统通过细则指导的模块化组件生成，来动态生成个性化的干预内容和多模态交互结构。在一项包含237名参与者的预注册研究中，与基于大语言模型（LLM）的认知重构对照组相比，GUIDE显著减轻了压力（p=.02）并提升了用户体验（p=.04）。GUIDE还通过多样的交互流程支持了不同形式的反思与行动，同时揭示了整个交互序列中关于个性化的微妙张力。这项工作为在数字环境中动态塑造支持的体验与实施奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究针对数字精神卫生工具忽视交互形式个性化的难题，提出了“生成式体验”方法，并构建了GUIDE系统。该系统能在运行时利用LLM动态生成个性化内容与多模态交互结构。237人的随机对照实验表明，GUIDE在减轻压力和提升用户体验方面均显著优于传统LLM干预，展示了生成式交互在心理健康干预中的应用前景。
AI.keywords: 数字精神卫生, 生成式体验, 大语言模型, 个性化干预, 随机对照研究
AI.comments: 创新性：本文将生成式AI的应用范式从单纯的“内容/文本生成”扩展到了“交互结构与体验生成”，提出了“生成式体验”概念，切中了以往心理干预工具形式单一、难以适应个体实时状态的痛点。重要性：通过N=237的高质量预注册随机对照研究，证实了动态生成交互结构在减轻压力和提升体验上的实际疗效，为下一代数字精神卫生工具的设计奠定了基础。局限性：虽然在运行时代生成多模态交互，但生成过程中的可控性、安全边界以及长期干预效果仍需进一步深入探讨。

title: Multi-Modal Learning meets Genetic Programming: Analyzing Alignment in Latent Space Optimization
comments: Accepted at PPSN 2026 (Trento, Italy). To appear in Springer LNCS
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover mathematical expressions from data, a task traditionally tackled using Genetic Programming (GP) through combinatorial search over symbolic structures. Latent Space Optimization (LSO) methods use neural encoders to map symbolic expressions into continuous spaces, transforming the combinatorial search into continuous optimization. SNIP (Meidani et al., 2024), a contrastive pre-training model inspired by CLIP, advances LSO by introducing a multi-modal approach: aligning symbolic and numeric encoders in a shared latent space to learn the phenotype-genotype mapping, enabling optimization in the numeric space to implicitly guide symbolic search. However, this relies on fine-grained cross-modal alignment, whereas literature on similar models like CLIP reveals that such an alignment is typically coarse-grained. In this paper, we investigate whether SNIP delivers on its promise of effective bi-modal optimization for SR. Our experiments show that: (1) cross-modal alignment does not improve during optimization, even as fitness increases, and (2) the alignment learned by SNIP is too coarse to efficiently conduct principled search in the symbolic space. These findings reveal that while multi-modal LSO holds significant potential for SR, effective alignment-guided optimization remains unrealized in practice, highlighting fine-grained alignment as a critical direction for future work.
