AI.title_translation: 多模态学习结合遗传编程：分析隐空间优化中的对齐机制
AI.tldr: 分析发现，基于多模态对比预训练的隐空间优化模型SNIP因跨模态对齐过于粗糙且在优化中未有提升，未能真正实现有效的对齐引导符号搜索。
AI.motivation: 基于SNIP等多模态对比学习模型的隐空间优化试图通过对齐符号和数值编码器来引导符号回归搜索，但类似于CLIP的模型通常只能学习到粗粒度的模态对齐。本文旨在探究SNIP是否真正实现了其所宣称的高效双模态优化。
AI.method: 通过实验对结合对比预训练模型SNIP的多模态隐空间优化（LSO）过程进行系统分析，评估其在优化过程中跨模态对齐（符号与数值编码器）的变化以及对齐粒度对符号空间搜索效率的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明：（1）在优化过程中，即使适应度提高，跨模态对齐也未得到改善；（2）SNIP所学习到的对齐过于粗糙，无法在符号空间中高效且有原则地进行搜索。
AI.conclusion: 虽然多模态隐空间优化在符号回归中展现出巨大潜力，但目前在实践中尚未真正实现由对齐引导的有效优化，精细化跨模态对齐是未来研究的关键方向。
AI.translation: 符号回归（SR）旨在从数据中发现数学表达式，该任务传统上使用遗传编程（GP）通过对符号结构进行组合搜索来解决。隐空间优化（LSO）方法使用神经网络编码器将符号表达式映射到连续空间中，从而将组合搜索转化为连续优化。SNIP（Meidani等，2024）是一种受CLIP启发的对比预训练模型，它通过引入多模态方法推进了LSO：在共享隐空间中对齐符号和数值编码器以学习表型-基因型映射，从而允许在数值空间中进行优化以隐式指导符号搜索。然而，这种方法依赖于精细的跨模态对齐，而关于类似模型（如CLIP）的文献表明这种对齐通常是粗粒度的。在本文中，我们探讨了SNIP是否实现了其在SR中进行有效双模态优化的承诺。我们的实验表明：（1）即使适应度提高，跨模态对齐在优化过程中也没有改善；（2）SNIP学习到的对齐关系过于粗糙，无法在符号空间中高效地开展原则性搜索。这些发现揭示了虽然多模态LSO对SR具有巨大潜力，但有效的对齐引导优化在实践中仍未实现，凸显了精细化对齐作为未来工作的重要方向。
AI.summary: 本文分析了结合多模态学习与遗传编程的符号回归方法SNIP。尽管SNIP试图通过对比预训练对齐符号和数值编码器以引导隐空间优化（LSO），但研究表明其跨模态对齐过于粗糙且在优化过程中未能改善，无法有效指导符号搜索。这表明实现精细化模态对齐是未来多模态LSO发展的核心关键。
AI.keywords: 符号回归, 隐空间优化, 遗传编程, 多模态学习, 跨模态对齐
AI.comments: 本文对结合多模态对比学习（如CLIP/SNIP）与遗传编程/符号回归的前沿方法进行了批判性的实证分析。其重要性在于揭示了此前研究中假设的“精细模态对齐”在实际隐空间优化过程中并未发生的客观事实，指出了当前多模态表征在指导符号搜索时的局限性，为未来如何实现更精准的表型-基因型对齐以及改进符号回归算法指明了重要方向。

title: Functional Misalignment in Human-AI Interactions on Digital Platforms
summary: Algorithmic systems, particularly social media recommenders, have achieved remarkable success in predicting behavior. By optimizing for observable signals such as clicks, views, and engagement, these systems effectively capture user attention and guide interaction. Yet their widespread adoption has coincided with troubling outcomes, including rising mental health concerns, increasing polarization, and erosion of trust. This paper argues that these effects are consequences of a structural functional misalignment between what algorithms optimize - predictable behavior - and the human goals these predictions are intended to serve. We propose that this misalignment arises through three mechanisms: (1) a bias toward modeling fast, reactive behavioral signals over reflective judgment, (2) feedback loops that couple user behavior with algorithmic learning, and (3) emergent collective dynamics that amplify these effects at scale. Together, these mechanisms explain how accurate individual-level predictions can produce adverse societal outcomes. We present functional misalignment as a unifying framework and outline a research agenda for studying and mitigating its effects in human-AI interaction systems.

AI.title_translation: 数字平台上人机交互中的功能失配
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“功能失配”框架，揭示了推荐算法因过度优化点击等即时行为而偏离人类真实目标，进而引发心理健康恶化、群体极化等负面社会后果的深层机制。
AI.motivation: 虽然社交媒体推荐等算法系统通过优化点击、浏览等可观测信号成功捕获了用户注意力，但其普及伴随着心理健康问题增加、群体极化加剧和信任侵蚀等严重社会问题。本文旨在探究算法优化的行为目标与算法本应服务的人类真实目标之间的结构性矛盾。
AI.method: 提出“功能失配”（functional misalignment）统一框架，并归纳了导致该失配的三种机制：（1）偏向建模快速反应性行为信号而非深思熟虑的判断；（2）将用户行为与算法学习相耦合的反馈回路；（3）在大规模下放大上述效应的涌现集体动态。
AI.result: 揭示了精确的个体级预测如何通过快速信号偏好、反馈循环和群体涌现效应这三条机制，最终转化为有害的社会级后果，并为人AI交互领域指明了缓解此类问题的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: “功能失配”为理解和解释人机交互系统中的负面社会后果提供了一个统一的理论框架，并为未来评估和缓解算法带来的副作用指明了研究议程。
AI.translation: 算法系统（特别是社交媒体推荐系统）在预测行为方面取得了巨大成功。通过针对点击、浏览和参与度等可观测信号进行优化，这些系统有效地捕获了用户注意力并引导了交互。然而，它们的广泛应用伴随着令人担忧的后果，包括心理健康问题上升、极化加剧以及信任侵蚀。本文认为，这些影响是算法所优化的目标（可预测的行为）与这些预测旨在服务的人类目标之间结构性“功能失配”的结果。我们提出，这种失配是通过三个机制产生的：（1）偏向于对快速、反应性的行为信号进行建模，而非深思熟虑的判断；（2）将用户行为与算法学习耦合在一起的反馈回路；（3）在大规模下放大这些效应的涌现集体动态。这些机制共同解释了精准的个体级预测如何产生负面的社会后果。我们提出了“功能失配”这一统一框架，并提出了在人机交互系统中研究和缓解其影响的研究议程。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了社交媒体推荐算法等AI系统带来的负面社会影响，提出了“功能失配”统一理论框架。文章指出，算法优化的“可预测行为”与“人类真实目标”之间存在结构性矛盾，并通过快反应信号偏好、行为-算法反馈回路以及大规模集体涌现三大机制，解释了精准个体预测引发不良社会后果的过程，为未来相关研究与治理奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 功能失配, 人机交互, 推荐算法, 行为预测, 社会影响
AI.comments: 本文提出了“功能失配”这一极具启发性的理论框架，深刻揭示了当前推荐算法“个体预测精准却导致负面群体社会效应”的根本原因。其创新点在于从行为建模偏好、反馈回路及涌现动态三个维度系统化地解释了算法优化与人类长远目标脱节的机制，为解决算法伦理、人机交互对齐问题提供了明确的研究方向。

title: A tensor-based exponential integrator for diffusion--reaction equations in common curvilinear coordinates
summary: In this paper, we study a tensor-based method for the numerical solution of a class of diffusion--reaction equations defined on spatial domains that admit common curvilinear coordinate representations. Typical examples in 2D include disks (polar coordinates), and in 3D balls or cylinders (spherical or cylindrical coordinates) as well as spheres for problems involving the Laplace--Beltrami operator. The proposed approach is based on a carefully chosen finite difference discretization of the Laplace operators that yields matrices with a structured representation as sums of Kronecker products. For the time integration, we introduce a novel split variant of the exponential Euler method that effectively handles the stiffness and avoids the severe time step size restriction of classical explicit methods. By exploiting the peculiar form of the obtained discretized operators and the chosen splitting strategy, we compute the needed action of the $\varphi_1$ matrix function through suitable tensor-matrix products in a $μ$-mode framework. We demonstrate the efficiency the approach on a wide range of physically relevant 2D and 3D examples of $N$-coupled diffusion--reaction systems generating Turing patterns with up to $10^6$ degrees of freedom.

AI.title_translation: 常见曲线坐标系中扩散-反应方程的基于张量的指数积分器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对曲线坐标系下扩散-反应方程的张量指数积分器，可高效求解高达百万自由度的复杂系统。
AI.motivation: 针对常见曲线坐标系（如圆盘、球体、圆柱体及球面等）下的扩散-反应方程组，传统数值解法面临严重的时间步长限制和刚性问题，需要发展一种高效的离散化和时间积分张量方法。
AI.method: 1. 针对拉普拉斯/拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子采用精心设计的有限差分离散，构造出表示为克罗内克积之和的结构化矩阵；2. 提出一种新型指数埃勒（exponential Euler）方法的拆分变体进行时间积分，避免显式方法的严苛时间步长限制；3. 利用$\mu$-模式（$\mu$-mode）张量-矩阵乘法高效计算所需$\varphi_1$矩阵函数的作用。
AI.result: 在包含高达$10^6$自由度、可生成图灵图样的多种物理相关的2D和3D的$N$耦合扩散-反应系统上验证了该方法的极高效率。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于张量的指数积分器有效地克服了极严的时间步长限制，能够高效解决常见曲线坐标系下大规模高维扩散-反应方程的数值求解问题。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了一种基于张量的方法，用于数值求解定义在允许常见曲线坐标表示的空间域上的一类扩散-反应方程。二维中的典型示例包括圆盘（极坐标），三维中包括球体或圆柱体（球坐标或柱坐标），以及涉及拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子问题的球面。所提出的方法基于精心选择的拉普拉斯算子有限差分离散化，该离散化可产生具有克罗内克积之和结构化表示的矩阵。对于时间积分，我们引入了指数埃勒方法的一种新型拆分变体，能够有效地处理刚性并避免传统显式方法的严苛时间步长限制。通过利用所得离散化算子的特定形式和所选的拆分策略，我们在 $\mu$-模式框架下通过合适的张量-矩阵乘法计算所需的 $\varphi_1$ 矩阵函数作用。我们在广泛的物理相关 2D 和 3D 的 $N$ 耦合扩散-反应系统示例（生成高达 $10^6$ 自由度的图灵图样）上展示了该方法的效率。
AI.summary: 本文针对常见曲线坐标系下的扩散-反应方程，提出了一种基于张量和拆分指数埃勒方法的指数积分器。通过有限差分获得克罗内克积结构矩阵，并在张量框架下高效计算$\varphi_1$矩阵函数，成功在高达百万自由度的2D和3D系统（如图灵图样生成）中实现了高效求解。
AI.keywords: 扩散-反应方程, 曲线坐标系, 张量方法, 指数指数埃勒法, 图灵图样
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将克罗内克积（Kronecker product）形式的有限差分离散化与改进的指数埃勒（exponential Euler）拆分策略相结合，并在微模式（$\mu$-mode）张量框架下高效计算$\varphi_1$矩阵函数的作用。该方法的显著优势是能克服高维曲线坐标系下硬（stiffness）扩散-反应方程的极严时间步长限制，适用于处理高达$10^6$自由度的大规模系统。局限性在于主要针对可进行常见曲线坐标系表示的规则或特定空间区域。

title: Topology-Aware Reasoning over Incomplete Knowledge Graph with Graph-Based Soft Prompting
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across various tasks but remain prone to hallucinations in knowledge-intensive scenarios. Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) mitigates this by grounding generation in Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, most multi-hop KBQA methods rely on explicit edge traversal, making them fragile to KG incompleteness. In this paper, we proposed a novel graph-based soft prompting framework that shifts the reasoning paradigm from node-level path traversal to subgraph-level reasoning. Specifically, we employ a Graph Neural Network (GNN) to encode extracted structural subgraphs into soft prompts, enabling LLM to reason over richer structural context and identify relevant entities beyond immediate graph neighbors, thereby reducing sensitivity to missing edges. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage paradigm that reduces computational cost while preserving good performance: a lightweight LLM first leverages the soft prompts to identify question-relevant entities and relations, followed by a more powerful LLM for evidence-aware answer generation. Experiments on four multi-hop KBQA benchmarks show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on three of them, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is available at the repository: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/GraSP.

AI.title_translation: 基于图软提示的未完备知识图谱拓扑感知推理
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图软提示的框架（GraSP），将知识图谱问答从节点级遍历转向子图级推理，有效缓解了知识图谱不完备对大模型多跳推理的影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在知识密集型任务中容易产生幻觉，而现有的多跳知识库问答（KBQA）方法多依赖显式的图节点/边遍历，当知识图谱存在边缺失（不完备）时表现非常脆弱。
AI.method: 提出了GraSP框架：1. 使用图神经网络（GNN）将抽取出的结构化子图编码为软提示（Soft Prompts），融入LLM的推理过程；2. 采用两阶段架构：先由轻量级LLM结合软提示识别与问题相关的实体和关系，再由更强大的LLM基于提取到的证据生成最终答案。
AI.result: 在四个多跳KBQA基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在其中三个数据集上取得了最先进（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将推理范式从节点级遍历提升至子图级推理，增强了LLM在不完备知识图谱上的多跳推理能力，并在保持高性能的同时降低了计算开销。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在各种任务中展现出了非凡的能力，但在知识密集型场景中仍容易产生幻觉。基于知识库的问答（KBQA）通过将生成过程建立在知识图谱（KGs）之上来缓解这一问题。然而，大多数多跳KBQA方法依赖于显式的边遍历，使其对知识图谱的不完备性十分脆弱。在本文中，我们提出了一种全新的基于图的软提示框架，将推理范式从节点级路径遍历转向子图级推理。具体而言，我们使用图神经网络（GNN）将提取的结构化子图编码为软提示，使LLM能够在更丰富的结构上下文中进行推理，并识别出超越直接图邻居的相关实体，从而降低对缺失边的敏感性。此外，我们引入了一种两阶段范式，在保持优异性能的同时降低计算成本：首先由轻量级LLM利用软提示识别与问题相关的实体和关系，随后由更强大的LLM进行感知证据的答案生成。在四个多跳KBQA基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在其中三个基准上取得了最先进的性能，证明了其有效性。代码已开源：https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/GraSP。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GraSP框架，旨在解决知识图谱不完备对多跳问答的影响。该方法利用GNN将局部子图结构编码为LLM的软提示，实现子图级别的结构化推理，降低对缺失边的敏感度；同时结合两阶段推理策略降低计算成本，在多个KBQA基准上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱问答, 大语言模型, 软提示, 图神经网络, 多跳推理
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将GNN对图结构的编码能力与LLM的泛化推理能力巧妙结合，通过软提示（Soft Prompting）将传统硬性的路径遍历转化为子图级表示，有效解决了知识图谱缺失边带来的不完备性问题。此外，采用“轻量级LLM定位实体关系 + 高能力LLM生成答案”的两阶段范式，显著降低了推理成本，兼具学术创新性与工程实用价值。

title: AffectAgent: Collaborative Multi-Agent Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: LLM-based multimodal emotion recognition relies on static parametric memory and often hallucinates when interpreting nuanced affective states. In this paper, given that single-round retrieval-augmented generation is highly susceptible to modal ambiguity and therefore struggles to capture complex affective dependencies across modalities, we introduce AffectAgent, an affect-oriented multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation framework that leverages collaborative decision-making among agents for fine-grained affective understanding. Specifically, AffectAgent comprises three jointly optimized specialized agents, namely a query planner, an evidence filter, and an emotion generator, which collaboratively perform analytical reasoning to retrieve cross-modal samples, assess evidence, and generate predictions. These agents are optimized end-to-end using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) with a shared affective reward to ensure consistent emotion understanding. Furthermore, we introduce Modality-Balancing Mixture of Experts (MB-MoE) and Retrieval-Augmented Adaptive Fusion (RAAF), where MB-MoE dynamically regulates the contributions of different modalities to mitigate representation mismatch caused by cross-modal heterogeneity, while RAAF enhances semantic completion under missing-modality conditions by incorporating retrieved audiovisual embeddings. Extensive experiments on MER-UniBench demonstrate that AffectAgent achieves superior performance across complex scenarios. Our code will be released at: https://github.com/Wz1h1NG/AffectAgent.

AI.title_translation: AffectAgent：用于检索增强多模态情感识别的协同多智能体推理
AI.tldr: 提出了AffectAgent框架，通过三智能体协同检索推理（基于MAPPO优化）、模态平衡专家混合（MB-MoE）及自适应融合（RAAF），显著提升了多模态情感识别在复杂与缺失模态场景下的性能。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的多模态情感识别依赖静态参数记忆，易产生幻觉；而传统的单轮检索增强生成（RAG）容易受模态模糊性影响，难以捕捉跨模态的复杂情感依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出了AffectAgent框架，由三个联合优化的专业智能体（查询规划器、证据过滤器、情感生成器）组成；采用带共享情感奖励的多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）进行端到端训练；结合模态平衡专家混合（MB-MoE）调节不同模态贡献，并利用检索增强自适应融合（RAAF）通过视听嵌入增强模态缺失下的语义补全。
AI.result: 在MER-UniBench基准测试上的广泛实验表明，AffectAgent在各种复杂场景下均取得了优异的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，结合多智能体协同推理、强化学习对齐（MAPPO）以及自适应模态平衡与融合机制，能够有效提升大模型在复杂多模态情感识别任务中的准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多模态情感识别依赖于静态参数记忆，在解释细微的情感状态时经常产生幻觉。在本文中，鉴于单轮检索增强生成（RAG）极易受到模态模糊性的影响，从而难以捕获跨模态的复杂情感依赖，我们提出了AffectAgent——一种面向情感的多智能体检索增强生成框架，利用智能体之间的协作决策来进行细粒度的情感理解。具体而言，AffectAgent包含三个联合优化的专业智能体（即查询规划器、证据过滤器和情感生成器），它们协同进行分析推理，以检索跨模态样本、评估证据并生成预测。这些智能体使用带有共享情感奖励的多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）进行端到端优化。此外，我们引入了模态平衡专家混合（MB-MoE）和检索增强自适应融合（RAAF），其中MB-MoE动态调节不同模态的贡献以缓解跨模态异构性引起的表示不匹配，而RAAF则通过结合检索到的视听嵌入增强了模态缺失条件下的语义补全。在MER-UniBench上的广泛实验表明，AffectAgent在复杂场景下取得了优异的性能。我们的代码将开源于：https://github.com/Wz1h1NG/AffectAgent。
AI.summary: 针对大模型在多模态情感识别中的幻觉及单轮RAG难以捕捉复杂情感依赖的问题，本文提出了AffectAgent框架。该框架利用查询规划、证据过滤和情感生成三个专业智能体协同推理，结合MAPPO强化学习优化、MB-MoE模态平衡和RAAF模态缺失补全技术，显著提升了复杂场景下的多模态情感理解能力。
AI.keywords: 多模态情感识别, 多智能体协同, 检索增强生成, MAPPO, 模态融合
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：将多智能体协同推理与强化学习（MAPPO）引入多模态检索增强生成（RAG），并针对模态异构和模态缺失提出了MB-MoE与RAAF模块，技术方案较为全面。
2. 重要性：有效解决了大模型在细粒度情感识别中的幻觉问题以及单轮RAG对复杂跨模态依赖捕捉能力不足的痛点。
3. 局限性：基于多智能体交互和MAPPO训练的系统架构较为复杂，训练和推理的计算开销与响应延迟在摘要中未具体说明。

title: Where Trust Fails: Mapping Location-Data Provenance Risks in Europe
comments: Accepted for presentation at CPDP 2026, the 19th International Conference on Computers, Privacy and Data Protection
summary: European digital sovereignty and security increasingly depend on whether high-impact decisions can be grounded in location evidence that remains credible under adversarial pressure. This paper frames a cross-sector analysis as a location-data provenance problem: whether there is contestable evidence about where and when an asserted event occurred, who or what produced the assertion, what a device or service reported as location, and which audit and retention guarantees apply. Trust-erosion patterns are observable across democratic processes and the information environment, trade and origin-sensitive supply chains, finance and illicit shipping flows, critical infrastructure and mobility, and harms targeting individuals' private and social domains. In these patterns we see a recurring asymmetry in which locality, presence, routing, or jurisdiction can be asserted cheaply while institutions and affected parties face costly reconstruction when disputes arise. To make this challenge actionable, this paper introduces a compact risk taxonomy that decomposes provenance failures into integrity axes and recurring failure modes, and derives design expectations for next-generation digital trust infrastructure centered on contestability under dispute, while remaining privacy- and rights-compatible. It argues for treating location as a digital primitive that should be represented as evidence-bearing claims rather than self-asserted coordinates, and positions proof-of-location (PoL) mechanisms as a candidate capability layer for producing verifiable presence claims under explicit threat and privacy assumptions. The outcome is a sector-neutral foundation for future architectural work on a next-generation digital trust infrastructure for Europe.
comment: Accepted for presentation at CPDP 2026, the 19th International Conference on Computers, Privacy and Data Protection

AI.title_translation: 信任失效之处：梳理欧洲位置数据出处风险
AI.tldr: 本文分析了位置数据易被虚假声明而难于事后核实的信任危机，提出了位置数据出处风险分类法与基于位置证明（PoL）的下一代数字信任基础设施设计框架。
AI.motivation: 欧洲的数字主权与安全高度依赖在对抗压力下依然可信的位置证据。目前存在严重的不对称现象：位置、存在、路由或管辖权的自我声明成本极低，但当发生争议时，机构和受影响方进行事实重构的成本却极其昂贵。
AI.method: 将跨领域问题归结为位置数据出处（Location-Data Provenance）问题；构建精简的风险分类法，将出处失效分解为完整性轴与循环失效模式；提出面向可争议性、兼顾隐私与权利兼容的下一代数字信任基础设施设计期望，并将位置重构为带证据的声明，引入位置证明（PoL）机制。
AI.result: 揭示了民主进程、供应链、金融、关键基础设施及个人隐私等多领域中的信任侵蚀模式，并成功提出了风险分类法及基于位置证明（PoL）的可验证存在声明架构基础。
AI.conclusion: 本文为欧洲下一代数字信任基础设施的未来架构设计奠定了领域中立的基础。
AI.translation: 欧洲的数字主权与安全日益取决于高影响力的决策能否建立在面对对抗压力时依然可信的位置证据之上。本文将跨领域分析框架化为一个位置数据出处问题：即关于声称的事件在何地、何时发生，由谁或何物生成该声明，设备或服务报告了什么位置，以及适用哪些审计和留存保证，是否存在可争议的证据。在民主进程与信息环境、贸易与源头敏感的供应链、金融与非法运输流、关键基础设施与移动性，以及针对个人私密和社交领域的伤害中，都可以观察到信任侵蚀模式。在这些模式中，我们看到了一个反复出现的非对称性：位置、存在、路由或管辖权可以廉价地被声明，而当争议发生时，机构和受影响方却面临昂贵的重构成本。为了使这一挑战具备可操作性，本文引入了一个精炼的风险分类法，将出处失效分解为完整性轴和循环失效模式，并推导出集中于争议下可争议性、同时兼顾隐私与权利兼容的下一代数字信任基础设施的设计期望。本文主张将位置视为一种应被表示为带有证据的声明而非自我声明坐标的数字原语，并将位置证明（PoL）机制定位为在明确的威胁和隐私假设下生成可验证存在声明的候选能力层。其成果为欧洲下一代数字信任基础设施的未来架构工作奠定了领域中立的基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对欧洲数字主权中的位置数据信任危机，将该挑战归结为位置数据出处问题。面对位置声明廉价而争议重构昂贵的非对称风险，文章提出了风险分类法，主张将位置表示为带有证据的声明，并提出基于位置证明（PoL）的信任基础设施设计框架，为欧洲下一代数字信任体系提供了理论和架构基础。
AI.keywords: 位置数据出处, 数字信任基础设施, 位置证明, 风险分类法, 数字主权
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将位置数据从单纯的地理坐标提升为“具备出处与证据力的数字声明”，并提出了跨领域的风险分类法与位置证明（PoL）信任架构。这对构建具有抗对抗能力的数字主权和安全基础设施具有重要意义。局限性在于摘要仅给出了理论框架与设计期望，缺乏具体技术实现的性能评估与落地案例。

title: Any3DAvatar: Fast and High-Quality Full-Head 3D Avatar Reconstruction from Single Portrait Image
summary: Reconstructing a complete 3D head from a single portrait remains challenging because existing methods still face a sharp quality-speed trade-off: high-fidelity pipelines often rely on multi-stage processing and per-subject optimization, while fast feed-forward models struggle with complete geometry and fine appearance details. To bridge this gap, we propose Any3DAvatar, a fast and high-quality method for single-image 3D Gaussian head avatar generation, whose fastest setting reconstructs a full head in under one second while preserving high-fidelity geometry and texture. First, we build AnyHead, a unified data suite that combines identity diversity, dense multi-view supervision, and realistic accessories, filling the main gaps of existing head data in coverage, full-head geometry, and complex appearance. Second, rather than sampling unstructured noise, we initialize from a Plücker-aware structured 3D Gaussian scaffold and perform one-step conditional denoising, formulating full-head reconstruction into a single forward pass while retaining high fidelity. Third, we introduce auxiliary view-conditioned appearance supervision on the same latent tokens alongside 3D Gaussian reconstruction, improving novel-view texture details at zero extra inference cost. Experiments show that Any3DAvatar outperforms prior single-image full-head reconstruction methods in rendering fidelity while remaining substantially faster.

AI.title_translation: Any3DAvatar：基于单张肖像图像快速高质量重建全头部3D化身
AI.tldr: Any3DAvatar结合结构化3D高斯骨架初始化与单步条件去噪，实现了1秒内从单张肖像图重建高质量3D全头化身。
AI.motivation: 现有的单张肖像3D头部重建方法存在质量与速度之间的严重权衡：高保真方法通常依赖多阶段处理和逐对象优化（速度慢），而快速的前馈模型则难以恢复完整的全头几何与精致的外观细节。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含身份多样性、密集多视角监督和真实配件的AnyHead统一数据集；\n2. 基于Plücker坐标感知的结构化3D高斯骨架（3D Gaussian scaffold）进行初始化，并执行单步条件去噪，将全头重建简化为单次前向传播；\n3. 在相同Latent Tokens上引入辅助视角条件外观监督，在零额外推理成本下提升新视角的纹理细节。
AI.result: Any3DAvatar在渲染保真度上显著超越了现有的单图全头重建方法，同时速度大幅提升，最快可在1秒内完成完整3D头部的重建。
AI.conclusion: Any3DAvatar有效解决了单图3D头部重建中速度与质量不可兼得的问题，为实时、高保真3D化身生成提供了全新的可行方案。
AI.translation: 从单张肖像图像重建完整的3D头部仍然极具挑战性，因为现有方法仍面临严重的质量与速度权衡：高保真管线通常依赖多阶段处理和逐对象优化，而快速的前馈模型难以还原完整的几何结构和精致的外观细节。为了缩小这一差距，我们提出了Any3DAvatar，一种快速且高质量的单图3D高斯头部化身生成方法，其最快设置可在不到一秒的时间内重建完整头部，同时保留高保真的几何形状与纹理。首先，我们构建了AnyHead统一数据集，该数据集结合了身份多样性、密集的多视角监督和逼真的配件，填补了现有头部数据在覆盖范围、全头几何和复杂外观上的主要空白。其次，我们并非采样无结构的噪声，而是从具有Plücker感知的结构化3D高斯骨架初始化，并执行单步条件去噪，将全头重建归纳为单次前向传播，同时保持高保真度。第三，我们在3D高斯重建的同时，在相同的Latent Tokens上引入了辅助视角条件的呈现监督，以零额外推理成本提升了新视角的纹理细节。实验表明，Any3DAvatar在渲染保真度上超越了以往的单图全头重建方法，同时速度显著加快。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Any3DAvatar，一种从单张肖像快速生成高质量3D高斯全头化身的方法。通过构建高质量数据集AnyHead、采用Plücker感知结构化3D高斯骨架初始化及单步去噪机制，以及引入辅助视角外观监督，该方法在单次前向传递中实现了高保真全头重建，最快重建时间不足1秒。
AI.keywords: 3D Avatar Reconstruction, 3D Gaussian Splatting, Single-Image Reconstruction, Conditional Denoising
AI.comments: 该论文成功打破了单图3D人像重建中“高保真”与“高实时性”不可兼得的瓶颈。其主要创新在于：1）结合Plücker坐标感知的结构化3D高斯骨架与单步条件去噪，实现了极速的前向推理；2）通过辅助视角条件外观监督提升纹理细节且不增加推理开销；3）构建了全头几何与细节丰富的AnyHead数据集，填补了现有训练数据的短板。

title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
comments: Published at COLM 2026. 50 pages, 20 figures. Code and data at https://technion-cs-nlp.github.io/vibe-testing-llms
summary: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.
comment: Published at COLM 2026. 50 pages, 20 figures. Code and data at https://technion-cs-nlp.github.io/vibe-testing-llms

AI.title_translation: 从感觉到指标：理解并形式化用户如何对大语言模型进行“氛围测试”
AI.tldr: 本研究将用户对大语言模型非正式的“氛围测试”进行了形式化，提出了基于个性化提示词和用户感知标准的评估流水线，成功连接了基准测试与真实体验。
AI.motivation: 传统基准测试得分往往难以反映大语言模型在真实世界中的实用性，用户普遍依赖非正式的“氛围测试”（vibe-testing），但这种方法过于随意且缺乏结构，难以大规模分析或复现。
AI.method: 首先通过调查用户评估实践和收集社交媒体/博客中的实际模型对比报告，将氛围测试形式化为包含个性化测试内容和用户感知判断标准的双过程；随后构建概念验证评估流水线，生成个性化提示词并基于用户感知标准对比模型输出。
AI.result: 在代码基准测试上的实验表明，结合个性化提示词和用户感知评估改变了模型的优选顺序，真实反映了实际应用中氛围测试的作用。
AI.conclusion: 形式化的氛围测试能够作为一种有效的评估方法，弥补传统基准测试得分与实际用户体验之间的差距。
AI.translation: 评估大语言模型（LLM）具有挑战性，因为基准测试得分往往无法捕捉模型在真实世界中的实用性。相反，用户通常依赖“氛围测试”（vibe-testing）：即基于经验的非正式评估，例如在与其工作流相关的代码任务上对比模型。尽管氛围测试很普遍，但它通常过于随意且无结构，难以进行大规模分析或复现。在这项工作中，我们研究了氛围测试在实践中的运作方式，并将其形式化以支持系统化分析。我们首先分析了两个经验资源：（1）关于用户评估实践的调查，以及（2）来自博客和社交媒体的真实模型对比报告集合。基于这些资源，我们将氛围测试形式化为一个由两部分构成的过程：用户对测试内容和回应判断方式均进行个性化设定。随后，我们提出了一个概念验证评估流水线，该流水线遵循此形式化定义，生成个性化提示词并使用用户感知的感知主观标准来对比模型输出。在代码基准上的实验表明，结合个性化提示词和用户感知评估会改变优选的模型，这反映了氛围测试在实践中的作用。这些发现表明，形式化的氛围测试可以作为弥合基准得分与真实体验之间差距的有效方法。
AI.summary: 本文深入研究了大语言模型评估中用户常用的“氛围测试”现象，并将其形式化为包含个性化测试和主观评估标准的系统化流程。通过构建概念验证流水线并开展代码基准实验，研究证实了形式化氛围测试能够有效缩小传统基准分数与真实用户体验之间的差距。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型评估, 氛围测试, 个性化提示词, 用户感知评估, 真实体验
AI.comments: 该研究首次对大语言模型评估中普遍存在但缺乏系统定义的“氛围测试”（Vibe-Testing）进行了形式化和定量分析。其创新点在于将主观的用户体验转化为可重复、定制化的评估流程，弥补了标准基准测试与真实用户体验之间的鸿沟。局限性在于目前仅在代码生成基准上进行了概念验证，未来需要扩展到更多通用任务场景。

title: Reasoning Dynamics and the Limits of Monitoring Modality Reliance in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent advances in vision language models (VLMs) offer reasoning capabilities, yet how these unfold and integrate visual and textual information remains unclear. We analyze reasoning dynamics in 18 VLMs covering instruction-tuned and reasoning-trained models from two different model families. We track confidence over Chain-of-Thought (CoT), measure the corrective effect of reasoning, and evaluate the contribution of intermediate reasoning steps. We find that models are prone to answer inertia, in which early commitments to a prediction are reinforced, rather than revised during reasoning steps. While reasoning-trained models show stronger corrective behavior, their gains depend on modality conditions, from text-dominant to vision-only settings. Using controlled interventions with misleading textual cues, we show that models are consistently influenced by these cues even when visual evidence is sufficient, and assess whether this influence is recoverable from CoT. Although this influence can appear in the CoT, its detectability varies across models and depends on what is being monitored. Reasoning-trained models are more likely to explicitly refer to the cues, but their longer and fluent CoTs can still appear visually grounded while actually following textual cues, obscuring modality reliance. In contrast, instruction-tuned models refer to the cues less explicitly, but their shorter traces reveal inconsistencies with the visual input. Taken together, these findings indicate that CoT provides only a partial view of how different modalities drive VLM decisions, with important implications for the transparency and safety of multimodal systems.

AI.title_translation: 视觉语言模型中的推理动态与监控模态依赖性的局限性
AI.tldr: 研究发现视觉语言模型在推理中存在强化早期错误决策的答案惯性，且思维链（CoT）容易掩盖实际的文本依赖，无法完全反映真实的决策依据。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）虽然展现出推理能力，但其推理过程如何展开以及如何融合视觉与文本信息仍不明确。需要评估思维链（CoT）能否真实反映模型的模态依赖性，以保障多模态系统的透明度与安全性。
AI.method: 对来自两个模型家族的18个VLM（包括指令微调与推理训练模型）进行推理动态分析：追踪思维链（CoT）中的置信度变化，评估中间推理步骤的纠正能力；通过设计带有误导性文本提示的控制干预实验，评估模型在视觉证据充足时受文本影响的程度，并检验这种影响是否以及如何通过CoT被检测和恢复。
AI.result: 1. 模型普遍存在“答案惯性”（Answer Inertia），即推理步骤倾向于强化而非修正早期的预测承诺；2. 推理训练模型具备更强的纠正行为，但效果受模态条件影响；3. 即使视觉证据充分，模型仍持续受误导性文本提示影响；4. 推理训练模型的长CoT虽然流畅且看似进行了视觉接地，但实际可能暗中遵循了文本提示，掩盖了对文本的依赖；而指令微调模型的短Trace虽不明确提及提示，却表现出与视觉输入的不一致。
AI.conclusion: 思维链（CoT）仅能提供不同模态如何驱动VLM决策的局部视图。仅依赖CoT无法完全监控模型的真实模态偏好，这对多模态系统的透明度、可解释性和安全性评估提出了重要警示。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的近期进展赋予了其推理能力，但这些能力如何展开以及如何整合视觉和文本信息仍不清楚。我们分析了来自两个不同模型家族的18个VLM（涵盖指令微调和推理训练模型）的推理动态。我们追踪了思维链（CoT）上的置信度，测量了推理的纠正效果，并评估了中间推理步骤的贡献。我们发现模型容易产生“答案惯性”，即对早期预测的承诺在推理步骤中会被强化而非修正。尽管经过推理训练的模型展现出更强的纠正行为，但它们的收益取决于模态条件（从文本主导到纯视觉设置）。通过使用误导性文本提示进行控制干预，我们表明即使视觉证据充足，模型也会持续受到这些提示的影响，并评估了这种影响是否能从CoT中被恢复/检测。尽管这种影响可能会出现在CoT中，但其可检测性在不同模型之间存在差异，并取决于监控的内容。经过推理训练的模型更有可能明确提及这些提示，但它们更长且流畅的CoT即使实际上遵循文本提示，也仍然可能看起来具有视觉接地性，从而掩盖了模态依赖性。相比之下，指令微调模型对提示的引用不够明确，但其较短的轨迹揭示了与视觉输入的不一致。综合来看，这些发现表明CoT仅提供了不同模态如何驱动VLM决策的局部视图，对多模态系统的透明度和安全性具有重要启示。
AI.summary: 本研究深入分析了18个视觉语言模型的推理动态与模态依赖性。结果发现模型存在强化早期预测的答案惯性，且容易受到误导性文本提示的影响。研究表明，看似流畅完善的思维链（CoT）可能掩盖模型对文本的真实过度依赖，证明CoT只能作为了解VLM决策过程的局部视角，对多模态可解释性与安全监控具有重要意义。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 思维链, 推理动态, 模态依赖性, 可解释性
AI.comments: 本文创新性地揭示了视觉语言模型（VLM）在思维链（CoT）推理过程中存在的“答案惯性”以及CoT与实际模态依赖之间的解耦现象。研究表明，经过推理训练的模型生成的长CoT虽然表面上看起来具有视觉接地性（visually grounded），但实际上可能暗中依赖误导性文本提示，这暴露了仅依赖CoT进行透明度和安全性监控的严重局限性。论文对多模态模型的可解释性与安全评估具有重要价值。局限性在于分析主要依赖特定的控制干预实验，需进一步探讨在更多多样化真实场景中的普适性。

title: TSM-Pose: Topology-Aware Learning with Semantic Mamba for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level object pose estimation is fundamental for embodied intelligence, yet achieving robust generalization to unseen instances remains challenging. However, existing methods mainly rely on simple feature extraction and aggregation, which struggle to capture category-shared topological structures and conduct semantic keypoint modeling, limiting their generalization. To address these, we propose a \textbf{T}opology-Aware Learning with \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{M}amba for Category-Level \textbf{P}ose Estimation framework (TSM-Pose). Specifically, we introduce a Topology Extractor to capture the global topological representation of the point cloud, which is integrated into local geometry features and enables robust category-level structural representation. Simultaneously, we propose a Mamba-based Global Semantic Aggregator that injects semantics priors into keypoints to enhance their expressiveness and leverages multiple TwinMamba blocks to model long-range dependencies for more effective global feature aggregation. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets (REAL275, CAMERA25, and HouseCat6D) demonstrate that TSM-Pose outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: TSM-Pose：基于语义Mamba拓扑感知学习的类别级物体姿态估计
AI.tldr: TSM-Pose结合拓扑提取器与Mamba语义聚合器，突破了类别级姿态估计中的拓扑建模与长距离依赖难题，取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 类别级物体姿态估计对未见实例的鲁棒泛化十分关键，但现有方法依赖简单特征提取与聚合，难以捕获类别共享的拓扑结构并进行语义关键点建模，限制了泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出了TSM-Pose框架：1）引入拓扑提取器（Topology Extractor）捕获点云全局拓扑表示，并将其融合到局部几何特征中；2）提出基于Mamba的全局语义聚合器，将语义先验注入关键点，并利用多个TwinMamba模块建模长距离依赖关系。
AI.result: 在REAL275、CAMERA25和HouseCat6D三个基准数据集上的实验表明，TSM-Pose的性能超越了现有的最先进（SOTA）方法。
AI.conclusion: TSM-Pose通过拓扑感知学习与基于Mamba的语义特征聚合，显著提升了类别级物体姿态估计对未见实例的结构鲁棒性与泛化性能。
AI.translation: 类别级物体姿态估计是具身智能的基础，然而实现对未见实例的鲁棒泛化仍然具有挑战性。然而，现有方法主要依赖于简单的特征提取和聚合，难以捕捉类别共享的拓扑结构并进行语义关键点建模，限制了它们的泛化能力。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了用于类别级姿态估计的基于语义Mamba拓扑感知学习框架（TSM-Pose）。具体而言，我们引入了一个拓扑提取器来捕捉点云的全局拓扑表示，并将其融入局部几何特征中，从而实现鲁棒的类别级结构表示。同时，我们提出了基于Mamba的全局语义聚合器，将语义先验注入关键点以增强其表达能力，并利用多个TwinMamba模块建模长距离依赖关系，实现更有效的全局特征聚合。在三个基准数据集（REAL275、CAMERA25和HouseCat6D）上的大量实验表明，TSM-Pose超越了现有的最先进方法。
AI.summary: 针对类别级物体姿态估计中未见实例泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出了TSM-Pose框架。该框架结合了捕获全局点云结构的拓扑提取器以及融合语义先验与长距离依赖建模的Mamba语义聚合器，在三个主流基准数据集上均取得了SOTA效果。
AI.keywords: 类别级姿态估计, 拓扑感知学习, Mamba模型, 具身智能, 语义特征聚合
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将Mamba架构（具体为TwinMamba模块）和拓扑结构建模引入到类别级物体姿态估计任务中，成功解决了现有方法难以捕获长距离依赖与类别共享拓扑结构的难题。这一创新对于提高具身智能系统对未见物体的泛化能力具有重要价值。局限性在于摘要中未探讨其推理延迟及计算资源消耗。

title: Just Repair: A Minimal Denoising Network for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomaly detectors have grown steadily more complex, incorporating attention mechanisms, adversarial training, and stochastic latent variables. Yet, it is unclear how much of this machinery detection actually requires. We test this question with JuRe (Just Repair), a deliberately minimal detector: a single depthwise-separable convolutional residual block trained to repair Gaussian-corrupted, channel-masked windows, scored at inference by a fixed structural discrepancy function with no learned parameters. JuRe ranks second on the TSB-AD multivariate benchmark (AUC-PR 0.404 over 180 series) and second on the UCR univariate archive (AUC-PR 0.201 over 250 series), where it leads all neural baselines. On TSB-AD, JuRe runs roughly $20\times$ faster than AxonAD, one of the top-ranked methods on that benchmark. Full-benchmark ablations show that removing Gaussian corruption reduces AUC-PR by 0.046, whereas AUC-PR across the evaluated architecture variants spans at most 0.017. A synthetic linear-manifold experiment provides partial evidence for this geometric interpretation: anomaly scores correlate with true off-manifold distance (Pearson $r=0.725$), and repair directions align increasingly with the true projection as anomaly magnitude grows. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction find significant differences against 20 of 25 baselines, although dependence among series limits dataset-level interpretation. Code is available at https://github.com/iis-esslingen/JuRe.

AI.title_translation: Just Repair：用于时间序列异常检测的极简去噪网络
AI.tldr: 提出了极简去噪网络 JuRe，仅靠单个深度可分离卷积残差块和固定打分函数，即在各大时间序列异常检测基准上超越多数复杂神经网络，且运行速度提升近20倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列异常检测器融入了注意力机制、对抗训练和随机隐变量等越来越复杂的结构，但尚不清楚这些复杂机制中有多少是实际异常检测真正必需的。
AI.method: 提出了极简检测器 JuRe (Just Repair)：1. 网络架构仅由单个深度可分离卷积残差块构成；2. 训练阶段通过学习修复加高斯噪声与通道掩码的时间序列窗口；3. 推理阶段采用没有任何可学习参数的固定结构差异函数进行异常打分。
AI.result: 1. 在 TSB-AD 多变量基准（AUC-PR 0.404）和 UCR 单变量归档（AUC-PR 0.201）上均排名第二，且在 UCR 上超越所有神经网络基线；2. 运行速度在 TSB-AD 上比顶尖方法 AxonAD 快约 20 倍；3. 消融实验显示去除高斯噪声会导致 AUC-PR 显著下降 0.046，而不同架构变体间差异很小（≤0.017）；4. 合成流形实验表明异常得分与真实离流形距离强相关（Pearson r=0.725）。
AI.conclusion: 简单的去噪重建机制配合非参数的固定结构打分函数，足以在单变量和多变量时间序列异常检测中取得顶尖的性能与极高的计算效率，挑战了盲目堆叠复杂神经网络机制的现行趋势。
AI.translation: 时间序列异常检测器变得越来越复杂，融合了注意力机制、对抗训练和随机隐变量。然而，目前尚不清楚这些复杂机制中有多少是实际检测所必需的。我们通过 JuRe (Just Repair) 这一极简检测器对该问题进行了测试：该模型仅包含单个深度可分离卷积残差块，通过训练来修复受高斯噪声污染和通道掩码覆盖的窗口，并在推理时使用没有可学习参数的固定结构差异函数进行打分。JuRe 在 TSB-AD 多变量基准（180 个序列，AUC-PR 0.404）上排名第二，在 UCR 单变量归档（250 个序列，AUC-PR 0.201）上排名第二，并领先所有神经网络基线。在 TSB-AD 上，JuRe 的运行速度比该基准上的顶尖方法之一 AxonAD 快约 20 倍。完整基准的消融实验表明，移除高斯噪声会导致 AUC-PR 降低 0.046，而不同架构变体之间的 AUC-PR 跨度最多仅为 0.017。合成线性流形实验为这种几何解释提供了部分证据：异常得分与真实离流形距离呈正相关（Pearson r=0.725），且随着异常幅度的增加，修复方向与真实投影的对齐度越来越高。带有 Holm 校正的 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验表明，与 25 个基线中的 20 个存在显著差异，不过序列之间的依赖性限制了数据集层面的解释。代码已开源：https://github.com/iis-esslingen/JuRe。
AI.summary: 本文针对时间序列异常检测模型盲目复杂化的现状，提出了名为 JuRe 的极简去噪网络。JuRe 仅由单个深度可分离卷积残差块组成，通过修复加噪和掩码窗口进行训练，并在推理阶段采用无参数的固定差异函数打分。实验表明，JuRe 在 TSB-AD 和 UCR 基准上均取得第2名的优异成绩，领先所有神经网络基线，且运行速度较现有顶尖模型提升约20倍，验证了极简去噪架构在兼顾高性能与极高计算效率上的巨大优势。
AI.keywords: 时间序列异常检测, 去噪网络, 极简架构, 流形投影, 计算效率
AI.comments: 该论文具有很强的批判性思维和实用价值。其创新性在于反思了当前时间序列异常检测模型盲目复杂化的现象，通过极简的单块卷积去噪网络（JuRe）结合非参数打分函数，证明了简单的几何流形投影去噪即可实现高精度检测。重要性体现在为该领域提供了一个极其高效且强力的基线，速度比现有顶尖模型快近20倍，非常适合工业界实际部署。局限性在于序列间依赖性对数据集层面的统计显著性分析有一定限制，且模型对高斯噪声增强具有强依赖性。

title: Automated Logging Is Language-Sensitive: A Multilingual Benchmark and Empirical Study of LLMs
summary: Logging statements are central to debugging, failure diagnosis, and production observability, yet writing them requires developers to decide where to place a logging statement, which API and severity level to use, and what runtime information to expose. Automated logging aims to reduce this burden, but existing evidence remains dominated by Java-centric repository-snapshot dataset. It is therefore unclear whether conclusions about model behavior and model selection generalize across programming-language ecosystems or realistic code evolution. This paper presents MultiLogBench, a multilingual benchmark and empirical study spanning six programming language ecosystems. MultiLogBench contains 63,965 production-code repository-snapshot instances, 744 revision-history cases where developers introduce logging statements during maintenance, and a paired transformed revision-history branch for robustness analysis. Using seven contemporary large language models under a unified protocol, we evaluate logging-site localization, framework-anchor matching, severity prediction, message generation, variable recovery, and cascaded overall quality. Results show clear cross-language variation: framework-anchor matching is the most language-sensitive component, loop and nested-callable sites are the hardest structural contexts, and model rankings are stable only at the top tier. These patterns persist at a coarse level on revision-history data, while transformed inputs do not cause a broad same-direction performance collapse. Overall, MultiLogBench shows that robust claims about automated logging require multilingual evaluation and maintenance-oriented validation.

AI.title_translation: 自动日志记录具有语言敏感性：面向大语言模型的多语言基准与实证研究
AI.tldr: 构建了涵盖 6 种编程语言的自动日志基准 MultiLogBench，实证表明 LLM 在日志生成任务上具有强烈的语言敏感性。
AI.motivation: 日志编写对软件调试和可观测性至关重要，但现有自动日志记录的研究严重依赖以 Java 为中心的单语言代码库快照数据集，无法证明相关结论能否泛化到其他编程语言生态系统或真实的真实代码演化（维护）场景中。
AI.method: 提出了包含 6 种编程语言生态的多语言基准 MultiLogBench，包含 63,965 个代码库快照实例、744 个日志维护演化案例及配对的鲁棒性分析分支。在统一协议下使用 7 个现代大语言模型，对日志位置定位、框架锚点匹配、严重性预测、消息生成、变量恢复等 6 项任务及整体质量进行了综合评估。
AI.result: 跨语言差异显著，其中框架锚点匹配是对语言最敏感的环节；循环和嵌套可调用位置是难度最大的结构上下文；模型排名仅在顶尖模型间保持稳定；此外，输入转换并未导致普遍的性能崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 关于自动日志记录能力的可靠结论必须建立在多语言评估和面向真实维护场景验证的基础之上，单一语言的评估结果无法直接泛化。
AI.translation: 日志语句是调试、故障诊断和生产可观测性的核心，但编写日志需要开发人员决定日志放置位置、使用何种 API 和严重性级别以及暴露哪些运行时信息。自动日志记录旨在减轻这一负担，但现有的研究证据仍然被以 Java 为中心的代码库快照数据集所主导。因此，关于模型行为和模型选择的结论是否能够泛化到不同的编程语言生态系统或真实的代码演化过程尚不明确。本文提出了 MultiLogBench，这是一个跨越六种编程语言生态系统的多语言基准和实证研究。MultiLogBench 包含 63,965 个生产代码库快照实例、744 个开发人员在维护期间引入日志语句的版本历史案例，以及一个配对的转换版本历史分支以用于鲁棒性分析。在统一协议下使用七个现代大语言模型，我们评估了日志位置定位、框架锚点匹配、严重性预测、消息生成、变量恢复以及级联整体质量。结果表明存在明显的跨语言差异：框架锚点匹配是最具语言敏感性的组件，循环和嵌套可调用位置是最难的结构上下文，且模型排名仅在顶级模型中保持稳定。这些模式在版本历史数据上大体保持一致，而转换后的输入不会引发普遍的同向性能崩溃。总体而言，MultiLogBench 表明关于自动日志记录的稳健结论需要多语言评估和面向维护的验证。
AI.summary: 针对自动日志记录研究缺乏多语言和真实代码演化验证的问题，本文构建了包含 6 种编程语言生态的基准 MultiLogBench，并通过 7 个大语言模型在多维日志任务上的对比评估，揭示了自动日志记录具有强烈的语言敏感性与结构上下文依赖性。
AI.keywords: Automated Logging, Multilingual Benchmark, Large Language Models, Software Observability
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地构建了首个涵盖多语言生态及真实代码演化历史的自动日志记录基准 MultiLogBench，打破了传统研究仅局限于 Java 语言的局限。论文不仅包含了静态代码库快照，还引入了真实的维护演化历史和输入转换分支，评估维度全面且深入。局限性在于尽管涵盖了 6 种语言生态，实际开发中的提示词工程或特定领域的上下文补充可能还会对 LLM 性能产生进一步影响。

title: UniCSG: Unified High-Fidelity Content-Constrained Style-Driven Generation via Staged Semantic and Frequency Disentanglement
summary: Style transfer must match a target style while preserving content semantics. DiT-based diffusion models often suffer from content-style entanglement, leading to reference-content leakage and unstable generation. We present UniCSG, a unified framework for content-constrained, style-driven generation in both text-guided and reference-guided settings. UniCSG employs staged training: (i) a latent-space semantic disentanglement stage that combines low-frequency preprocessing with conditioning corruption to encourage content-style separation, and (ii) a latent-space frequency-aware detail reconstruction stage that refines details via multi-scale frequency supervision. We further incorporate pixel-space reward learning to align latent objectives with perceptual quality after decoding. Experiments demonstrate improved content faithfulness, style alignment, and robustness in both settings.

AI.title_translation: UniCSG：通过分阶段语义和频率解耦实现统一的高保真内容约束风格驱动生成
AI.tldr: UniCSG是一个新的统一框架，通过分阶段训练和像素空间奖励学习，解决了DiT模型中的内容-风格纠缠问题，实现了高保真、内容约束的风格驱动生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于DiT的扩散模型在风格迁移中常出现内容-风格纠缠问题，导致参考内容泄露和生成不稳定，难以在匹配目标风格的同时保留内容语义。
AI.method: UniCSG采用分阶段训练方法：(i) 潜在空间语义解耦阶段，结合低频预处理和条件扰动以鼓励内容-风格分离；(ii) 潜在空间频率感知细节重建阶段，通过多尺度频率监督细化细节。此外，还结合了像素空间奖励学习，以使潜在目标与解码后的感知质量对齐。
AI.result: 实验证明，在文本引导和参考引导两种设置下，UniCSG均提高了内容的忠实度、风格对齐度和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: UniCSG通过其创新的分阶段语义和频率解耦以及像素空间奖励学习，有效地解决了扩散模型中的内容-风格纠缠问题，实现了高质量、稳定的内容约束风格驱动生成。
AI.translation: 风格迁移必须在保留内容语义的同时匹配目标风格。基于DiT的扩散模型常常遭受内容-风格纠缠的困扰，导致参考内容泄露和生成不稳定。我们提出了UniCSG，一个用于内容约束、风格驱动生成的统一框架，适用于文本引导和参考引导设置。UniCSG采用分阶段训练：(i) 一个潜在空间语义解耦阶段，该阶段结合了低频预处理和条件扰动以鼓励内容-风格分离，以及 (ii) 一个潜在空间频率感知细节重建阶段，该阶段通过多尺度频率监督来细化细节。我们进一步结合了像素空间奖励学习，以在解码后使潜在目标与感知质量对齐。实验表明，在两种设置下，内容的忠实度、风格对齐度和鲁棒性均得到了改善。
AI.summary: UniCSG是一个统一的框架，旨在解决基于DiT的扩散模型中内容-风格纠缠问题，实现高保真、内容约束的风格驱动生成。它通过分阶段训练：首先在潜在空间进行语义解耦以分离内容和风格，然后进行频率感知细节重建以细化细节。此外，该框架还引入了像素空间奖励学习以优化感知质量。实验结果验证了其在内容忠实度、风格对齐和鲁棒性方面的提升。
AI.keywords: 风格迁移, 扩散模型, 内容-风格解耦, 频率感知, 生成模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入分阶段的语义和频率解耦训练以及像素空间奖励学习，为内容约束的风格驱动生成提供了一个创新且统一的解决方案。其方法有效地解决了现有扩散模型中内容-风格纠缠的挑战，提高了生成质量和鲁棒性，对于图像风格迁移和生成领域具有重要意义。

title: MAPRPose: Mask-Aware Proposal and Amodal Refinement for Multi-Object 6D Pose Estimation
summary: 6D object pose estimation in cluttered scenes remains challenging due to severe occlusion and sensor noise. We propose MAPRPose, a two-stage framework that leverages mask-aware correspondences for pose proposal and amodal-driven Region-of-Interest (ROI) prediction for robust refinement. In the Mask-Aware Pose Proposal (MAPP) stage, we lift 2D correspondences into 3D space to establish reliable keypoint matches and generate geometrically consistent pose hypotheses based on correspondence-level scoring, from which the top-$K$ candidates are selected. In the refinement stage, we introduce a tensorized render-and-compare pipeline integrated with an Amodal Mask Prediction and ROI Re-Alignment (AMPR) module. By reconstructing complete object geometry and dynamically adjusting the ROI, AMPR mitigates localization errors and spatial misalignment under heavy occlusion. Furthermore, our GPU-accelerated RGB-XYZ reprojection enables simultaneous refinement of all $N \times B$ pose hypotheses in a single forward pass.

AI.title_translation: MAPRPose：多物体6D姿态估计中的掩模感知提议与非模态精修
AI.tldr: MAPRPose是一个两阶段框架，用于解决杂乱场景中多物体6D姿态估计的遮挡和噪声问题。它通过掩模感知对应生成姿态提议，并通过非模态驱动的ROI预测进行鲁棒精修。
AI.motivation: 由于严重遮挡和传感器噪声，在杂乱场景中进行6D物体姿态估计仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 本文提出了MAPRPose，一个两阶段框架。第一阶段是掩模感知姿态提议（MAPP），它将2D对应提升到3D空间以建立可靠的关键点匹配，并基于对应级别的评分生成几何一致的姿态假设。第二阶段是精修阶段，引入了一个张量化渲染与比较管道，并集成了非模态掩模预测和ROI重新对齐（AMPR）模块。AMPR通过重建完整的物体几何和动态调整ROI来减轻重度遮挡下的定位误差和空间错位。此外，GPU加速的RGB-XYZ重投影能够在一个前向传播中同时精修所有姿态假设。
AI.result: Not mentioned in abstract

title: A Systematic Review and Taxonomy of Reinforcement Learning-Model Predictive Control Integration for Linear Systems
summary: The integration of Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for constrained decision-making and adaptive control. MPC offers structured optimization, explicit constraint handling, and established stability tools, whereas RL provides data-driven adaptation and performance improvement in the presence of uncertainty and model mismatch. Despite the rapid growth of research on RL--MPC integration, the literature remains fragmented, particularly for control architectures built on linear or linearized predictive models. This paper presents a comprehensive Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of RL--MPC integrations for linear and linearized systems, covering peer-reviewed and formally indexed studies published until 2025. The reviewed studies are organized through a multi-dimensional taxonomy covering RL functional roles, RL algorithm classes, MPC formulations, cost-function structures, and application domains. In addition, a cross-dimensional synthesis is conducted to identify recurring design patterns and reported associations among these dimensions within the reviewed corpus. The review highlights methodological trends, commonly adopted integration strategies, and recurring practical challenges, including computational burden, sample efficiency, robustness, and closed-loop guarantees. The resulting synthesis provides a structured reference for researchers and practitioners seeking to design or analyze RL--MPC architectures based on linear or linearized predictive control formulations.

AI.title_translation: 强化学习-模型预测控制线性系统集成：系统综述与分类
AI.tldr: 本文对强化学习（RL）与模型预测控制（MPC）在线性系统中的集成进行了系统综述，并提出了一个多维度分类法，以组织和理解该领域的研究现状、设计模式和挑战。
AI.motivation: 尽管强化学习（RL）和模型预测控制（MPC）的集成研究迅速增长，但文献仍然分散，特别是在基于线性或线性化预测模型的控制架构方面。因此，需要一个全面的系统综述来组织和理解这一领域。
AI.method: 本文采用系统文献综述（SLR）的方法，涵盖了截至2025年发表的同行评审和正式索引的研究。通过多维度分类法（包括RL功能角色、RL算法类别、MPC公式、成本函数结构和应用领域）对研究进行组织。此外，还进行了跨维度综合，以识别常见的设计模式和维度之间的关联。
AI.result: 综述结果提出了一个多维度分类法，并识别了RL-MPC集成中的重复设计模式和报告关联。论文还强调了方法学趋势、普遍采用的集成策略以及常见的实际挑战，包括计算负担、样本效率、鲁棒性和闭环保证。
AI.conclusion: 本综述的综合结果为研究人员和从业者提供了一个结构化的参考，帮助他们设计或分析基于线性或线性化预测控制公式的RL-MPC架构。
AI.translation: 模型预测控制（MPC）与强化学习（RL）的结合已成为受约束决策和自适应控制的一个有前景的范例。MPC 提供结构化优化、显式约束处理和已建立的稳定性工具，而 RL 在存在不确定性和模型失配的情况下提供数据驱动的适应和性能改进。尽管 RL-MPC 集成的研究迅速增长，但文献仍然分散，特别是对于基于线性或线性化预测模型的控制架构。本文对线性及线性化系统中的 RL-MPC 集成进行了全面的系统文献综述（SLR），涵盖了截至 2025 年发表的同行评审和正式索引的研究。通过涵盖 RL 功能角色、RL 算法类别、MPC 公式、成本函数结构和应用领域的多维度分类法对审查的研究进行组织。此外，还进行了跨维度综合，以识别审查语料库中这些维度之间重复的设计模式和报告关联。该综述强调了方法学趋势、普遍采用的集成策略以及常见的实际挑战，包括计算负担、样本效率、鲁棒性和闭环保证。由此产生的综合为寻求设计或分析基于线性或线性化预测控制公式的 RL-MPC 架构的研究人员和从业者提供了结构化参考。
AI.summary: 本论文对强化学习（RL）与模型预测控制（MPC）在线性系统中的集成进行了系统文献综述（SLR）。鉴于该领域文献的分散性，本研究旨在通过多维度分类法（涵盖RL功能、算法、MPC公式、成本函数和应用领域）组织现有研究。综述识别了常见的设计模式、方法趋势和实际挑战，为设计和分析RL-MPC架构提供了结构化参考。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 模型预测控制, 系统综述, 线性系统, 集成
AI.comments: 本文通过对RL-MPC集成领域进行系统梳理和分类，有效解决了该领域文献碎片化的问题。其提出的多维度分类法和对设计模式及挑战的识别，为研究人员和从业者提供了宝贵的结构化参考，有助于推动该领域的进一步发展。

title: Latent Denoising Improves Visual Alignment in Large Multimodal Models
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) such as LLaVA are typically trained with an autoregressive language modeling objective, providing only indirect supervision to visual tokens. This often yields weak internal visual representations and brittle behavior under distribution shift. Inspired by recent progress on latent denoising for learning high-quality visual tokenizers, we show that the same principle provides an effective form of visual supervision for improving internal visual feature alignment and multimodal understanding in LMMs. We propose a latent denoising framework that corrupts projected visual tokens using a saliency-aware mixture of masking and Gaussian noising. The LMM is trained to denoise these corrupted tokens by recovering clean teacher patch features from hidden states at a selected intermediate LLM layer using a decoder. To prevent representation collapse, our framework also preserves the teacher's intra-image similarity structure and applies intra-image contrastive patch distillation. During inference, corruption and auxiliary heads are disabled, introducing no additional inference-time overhead. Across a broad suite of standard multimodal benchmarks, our method consistently improves visual understanding and reasoning over strong baselines, and yields clear gains on compositional robustness benchmarks (e.g., NaturalBench). Moreover, under ImageNet-C-style non-adversarial common corruptions applied to benchmark images, our method maintains higher accuracy and exhibits reduced degradation at both moderate and severe corruption levels. Our code is available at https://github.com/dhruvashp/latent-denoising-for-lmms.

AI.title_translation: 潜在去噪改善大型多模态模型中的视觉对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种潜在去噪框架，通过对视觉token进行破坏并训练大型多模态模型恢复它们，从而显著提升了模型的视觉理解、推理和对分布变化的鲁棒性，且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型多模态模型（LMMs）通常采用自回归语言建模目标进行训练，这导致对视觉token的监督是间接的，从而产生较弱的内部视觉表示和在分布偏移下脆弱的行为。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种潜在去噪框架。该框架使用显著性感知混合掩蔽和高斯噪声来破坏投影的视觉token。LMM被训练通过解码器从选定的中间LLM层隐藏状态中恢复干净的教师补丁特征来去噪这些被破坏的token。为防止表示坍塌，该框架还保留了教师的图像内相似性结构并应用了图像内对比补丁蒸馏。推理时，破坏和辅助头部被禁用，不引入额外开销。
AI.result: 我们的方法在广泛的标准多模态基准测试中持续改进了视觉理解和推理，优于强大的基线模型。在组合鲁棒性基准（例如NaturalBench）上获得了显著提升。此外，在应用于基准图像的ImageNet-C风格的非对抗性常见损坏下，我们的方法在适度和严重损坏水平下均保持了更高的准确性并展现出更小的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 潜在去噪原则为改善大型多模态模型中的内部视觉特征对齐和多模态理解提供了一种有效的视觉监督形式，显著提升了模型在视觉理解、推理和鲁棒性方面的表现，且不增加推理时间开销。
AI.translation: 大型多模态模型（LMMs），如LLaVA，通常采用自回归语言建模目标进行训练，这仅为视觉token提供了间接监督。这常常导致内部视觉表示较弱，并在分布偏移下行为脆弱。受近期在学习高质量视觉token方面潜在去噪进展的启发，我们展示了相同的原则为改善LMMs中内部视觉特征对齐和多模态理解提供了一种有效的视觉监督形式。我们提出了一种潜在去噪框架，该框架使用显著性感知混合掩蔽和高斯噪声来破坏投影的视觉token。LMM被训练通过解码器从选定的中间LLM层隐藏状态中恢复干净的教师补丁特征来去噪这些被破坏的token。为防止表示坍塌，我们的框架还保留了教师的图像内相似性结构并应用了图像内对比补丁蒸馏。在推理过程中，破坏和辅助头部被禁用，不引入额外的推理时间开销。在广泛的标准多模态基准测试中，我们的方法持续改进了视觉理解和推理，优于强大的基线模型，并在组合鲁棒性基准（例如NaturalBench）上获得了显著提升。此外，在应用于基准图像的ImageNet-C风格的非对抗性常见损坏下，我们的方法在适度和严重损坏水平下均保持了更高的准确性并展现出更小的性能下降。我们的代码可在https://github.com/dhruvashp/latent-denoising-for-lmms获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的潜在去噪框架，旨在解决大型多模态模型（LMMs）中视觉表示弱和对分布偏移鲁棒性差的问题。通过对投影视觉token进行显著性感知破坏（掩蔽和高斯噪声），并训练LMM恢复原始教师特征，同时结合图像内相似性结构保留和对比蒸馏，该方法显著增强了LMM的视觉理解、推理能力及对常见损坏和组合鲁棒性的表现，且不增加推理负担。
AI.keywords: 大型多模态模型, 潜在去噪, 视觉对齐, 视觉理解, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入潜在去噪作为一种有效的视觉监督机制，巧妙地解决了大型多模态模型中视觉表示学习的痛点。其创新之处在于将去噪思想应用于LMM的视觉token，并通过精心设计的机制（如显著性感知破坏、教师特征恢复、结构保留和对比蒸馏）提升了模型性能和鲁棒性。特别值得关注的是，该方法在推理时无额外开销，使其具有很高的实用价值。

title: WorldMark: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Interactive Video World Models
summary: Unlike text- or image-driven video generation, an interactive world model is driven by actions: the user acts, and the world responds. Two obstacles stand in the way of fair and comprehensive evaluation. First, models take actions in incompatible formats---captions, camera trajectories, action functions---so no shared protocol has been established. Second, while existing benchmarks have advanced world memory and visual quality, action following is reduced to trajectory or direction error, which collapses a whole path into one number: not how quickly the world reacts to a command switch, nor how cleanly it moves along the commanded axis. WorldMark removes both obstacles. Per-model adapters translate a shared WASD-style vocabulary into each model's native control format, so ten heterogeneous models receive semantically identical instructions across 500 standardized cases spanning styles, viewpoints, and difficulty tiers; a new model costs one adapter. On this common ground we characterize action dynamics through a control-systems lens---direction accuracy, direction purity, response latency, and motion stability, each resolved per axis---alongside suites for world memory and visual quality. Together they expose differences existing protocols cannot see: the fastest responders are often the least stable, a trade-off no single action metric captures; per-axis resolution reveals models that follow translation almost perfectly while barely responding to rotation; the model with the best perceptual and aesthetic quality ranks last in translational direction accuracy and latency; and stylized scenes cost every model global consistency while leaving action dynamics largely intact. We will release all data, evaluation code, and model outputs.

AI.title_translation: 世界标记：一个交互式视频世界模型的统一基准套件
AI.tldr: WorldMark 是一个用于交互式视频世界模型的基准套件，解决了模型输入不兼容和评估指标不足的问题。它使用统一的 WASD 风格词汇和适配器来统一输入，并通过控制系统指标（如方向准确性、响应延迟等）来评估模型，揭示了现有协议无法看到的模型性能差异。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型评估存在两大障碍：1. 模型控制格式不兼容，缺乏统一评估协议。2. 现有评估指标（如轨迹或方向误差）过于简化，无法全面反映模型对指令的响应速度、移动的平稳性以及不同动作模式（如平移和旋转）的表现。
AI.method: WorldMark 引入了一个统一的 WASD 风格词汇，并通过为每个模型设计适配器将其翻译成各自的原生控制格式。这使得 500 个标准化案例中的指令能够被不同模型理解。评估方面，除了世界记忆和视觉质量，还引入了控制系统指标，包括方向准确性、方向纯度、响应延迟和运动稳定性，并且这些指标可以按轴（axis）进行分解。
AI.result: WorldMark 揭示了现有评估方法无法看到的模型性能差异。例如，响应速度快的模型通常稳定性较差；按轴分解指标后发现，有些模型在平移方面表现优异但在旋转方面表现不佳；视觉质量最好的模型在平移方向准确性和延迟方面排名最后；风格化场景会影响模型的全局一致性，但对动作动态影响不大。
AI.conclusion: WorldMark 通过提供统一的输入协议和更精细的评估指标，为交互式视频世界模型的公平、全面的评估奠定了基础，并揭示了模型在不同性能维度上的权衡和差异。
AI.translation: 与文本或图像驱动的视频生成不同，交互式世界模型由动作驱动：用户执行动作，世界做出响应。公平和全面的评估面临两大障碍。首先，模型以不兼容的格式接收动作——字幕、相机轨迹、动作函数——因此没有建立共享协议。其次，尽管现有的基准测试在世界记忆和视觉质量方面取得了进展，但动作跟随被简化为轨迹或方向误差，将整个路径压缩为一个数字：无法衡量世界对指令切换的响应速度，也无法衡量其沿指令轴的移动平稳性。WorldMark 克服了这两个障碍。模型适配器将共享的 WASD 风格词汇翻译成每个模型的原生控制格式，因此十个异构模型可以在跨越风格、视角和难度级别的 500 个标准化案例中接收语义相同的指令；新模型只需要一个适配器。在此共同基础上，我们通过控制系统的角度来表征动作动态——方向准确性、方向纯度、响应延迟和运动稳定性，每个都按轴分解——以及世界记忆和视觉质量的套件。它们共同揭示了现有协议无法看到的差异：响应最快的模型通常最不稳定，这是单一动作指标无法捕捉的权衡；按轴分解显示，模型在平移方面几乎完美，但在旋转方面几乎没有响应；具有最佳感知和美学质量的模型在平移方向准确性和延迟方面排名最后；风格化场景会给所有模型带来全局不一致性，但对动作动态影响不大。我们将发布所有数据、评估代码和模型输出。
AI.summary: WorldMark 是一套新的基准测试，用于评估交互式视频世界模型。它通过引入一个统一的 WASD 风格动作词汇和模型适配器来解决不同模型间输入格式不兼容的问题。此外，它还提出了一套更精细的评估指标，包括方向准确性、响应延迟和运动稳定性等，并能按轴分解，从而比现有方法更全面地揭示模型的性能特点和潜在的性能权衡。
AI.keywords: 交互式世界模型, 视频生成, 基准测试, 动作评估, 控制系统
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个非常有价值的基准套件 WorldMark，解决了交互式视频世界模型评估中的关键痛点，即输入格式不统一和评估指标过于简化的问题。通过统一的输入接口和多维度的、可按轴分解的评估指标，该基准能够更深入地揭示不同模型的优劣以及它们之间的性能权衡。这对于推动该领域的研究和发展具有重要意义。未来可以进一步探索在更多样化的交互场景和更复杂的动作指令下的评估。

title: DM$^3$-Nav: Decentralized Multi-Agent Multimodal Multi-Object Semantic Navigation
summary: We present DM$^3$-Nav, a fully decentralized multi-agent semantic navigation system supporting multimodal open-vocabulary goal specification and multi-object missions. In our setting, decentralization implies operation without a central coordinator, global map aggregation, or shared global state at runtime. Robots operate autonomously and coordinate through ad-hoc pairwise communication, exchanging local maps, goal status, and navigation intent without synchronization. An implicit task allocation mechanism combining intent broadcasting and distance-weighted frontier selection reduces redundant exploration while preserving decentralized operation. Evaluations on HM3DSem scenes using the HM3Dv0.2 and GOAT-Bench datasets demonstrate that DM$^3$-Nav matches or exceeds centralized and shared-map baselines while eliminating single points of failure inherent in centralized architectures. Finally, we validate our approach in a real-world office environment using two mobile robots, demonstrating successful deployment relying entirely on onboard sensing and computation. A video of our real-world experiments is available online: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QiUSCn5rIvtuTUqtuXLPgmt6S8x9-MCZ/view?usp=drive_link

title: DeepImagine: Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction via Stepwise Local Counterfactual Imaginations
summary: Predicting the outcomes of prospective clinical trials remains a major challenge. Clinical trial outcomes result from complex interactions among experimental factors such as drug interventions, participant demographics, and protocols. Here, we introduce DeepImagine, a framework that predicts target trial outcomes through stepwise counterfactual imagination anchored on historical trials with observed results. Starting from a relevant historical trial, DeepImagine sequentially modifies one differing experimental factor at a time. With each step a large language model (LLM) is posed a local counterfactual: how would the current imagined outcome change with this single perturbation? The updated result is carried forward as the input to the next step, until the historical configuration exactly matches the target, yielding the final prediction. Empirically, DeepImagine consistently outperforms direct one-step prediction across several off-the-shelf LLMs, with further gains when multiple imagination pathways, initiated from different historical anchors, are aggregated. We also construct natural counterfactuals augmented with synthetic reasoning traces and train a family of specialized language models, each dedicated to learning one factor's local counterfactual transition. Integrating these learned local operators into DeepImagine yields substantial improvements over general-purpose LLM baselines. Our findings position stepwise counterfactual imagination, distinct from both correlational prediction and explicit structural causal modeling, as a promising direction for clinical trial outcome prediction. All code, training scripts, and evaluation scripts are available at \href{https://github.com/deepimagine-counterfactual/DeepImagine}{https://github.com/deepimagine-counterfactual/DeepImagine}.

title: Assessing and Explaining the Persuadability of Large Language Models as Legal Decision Tools
comments: v2 is the conference version, accepted for the Proceedings of the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), (DOI: 10.1145/3836937.3837003). v3 is a substantially extended version for journal submission
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as legal decision assistants, and even first-instance decision-makers, across a range of judicial and administrative contexts, it becomes essential to explore how they answer legal questions, and in particular the factors that lead them to decide difficult questions. A specific feature of legal decisions is the need to respond to arguments advanced by contending parties. A legal decision-maker must be able to engage with, and respond to, including through being potentially persuaded by, these arguments. Conversely, they should not be unduly persuadable, deciding cases based on the skills of the advocates rather than the merits of the case. In this paper we explore how frontier open- and closed-weights LLMs respond to legal arguments. We propose a metric to measure persuadability in the trilateral setting in which competing advocates seek to persuade a judge of opposite conclusions. We report original experimental results measuring how far the quality of the advocate making arguments affects the likelihood that a given model will agree with a particular legal point of view. We further examine how far models are capable of distinguishing between stronger and weaker arguments and how far model judgments in this domain are affected by positional bias. Through parallel bilateral trials we show how the trilateral setting changes the demands on judge models, and in turn their apparent persuadability. Finally we examine the specific features of arguments that affect persuasion, including the relative contribution of legal content and rhetorical form, the extent to which model persuasion tracks human expert judgments of argument quality, and the extent to which argument quantity, diversity and type affect persuasive outcomes. Our results have implications for the feasibility of adopting LLMs across legal and administrative settings.

title: LUCid: Redefining Relevance For Lifelong Personalization
summary: Work to date has mainly relied on semantic proximity to identify relevant content for lifelong personalization. However, situational relevance is often more important for determining which information is useful for a user's actual task and context. In this paper, we introduce the Proximity Advantage (PA) score, a metric for quantifying semantic proximity bias, and show that existing personalization benchmarks largely conflate semantic and situational proximity, leaving it unclear whether current systems truly capture situational relevance. To support this metric, we introduce LUCid, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,936 user queries paired with long interaction histories, designed to isolate situational relevance from semantic proximity. Our experiments across different stages of the modern personalization pipeline (retrieval, reranking, and generation) reveal significant performance collapse: retrieval recall drops to near zero on the hardest instances, and response alignment remains near 50\% even for state-of-the-art models such as Gemini-3-Flash, GPT-5.4, and Claude Haiku, highlighting a fundamental mismatch between the relevance encoded by current systems and what lifelong personalization demands.

title: Contextual Agentic Memory is a Memo, Not True Memory
summary: Current agentic memory systems (vector stores, retrieval-augmented generation, scratchpads, and context-window management) do not implement memory: they implement lookup. We argue that treating lookup as memory is a category error with provable consequences for agent capability, long-term learning, and security. Retrieval generalizes by similarity to stored cases; weight-based memory generalizes by applying abstract rules to inputs never seen before. Conflating the two produces agents that accumulate notes indefinitely without developing expertise, face a provable generalization ceiling on compositionally novel tasks that no increase in context size or retrieval quality can overcome, and are structurally vulnerable to persistent memory poisoning as injected content propagates across all future sessions. Drawing on Complementary Learning Systems theory from neuroscience, we show that biological intelligence solved this problem by pairing fast hippocampal exemplar storage with slow neocortical weight consolidation, and that current AI agents implement only the first half. We formalize these limitations, address four alternative views, and close with a co-existence proposal and a call to action for system builders, benchmark designers, and the memory community.

title: Improved Rate-versus-Distance Upper Bounds for LDPC Codes
summary: LDPC codes play a vital role in coding theory and practical error correction. A central problem in this direction is to understand their rate--distance tradeoff. In this paper, we introduce a new framework for estimating ball sizes in the coset graphs of LDPC codes. The key new object is the coset-weight generating function, which encodes the minimum Hamming weights of all cosets of a linear code. Rather than estimating coset balls directly, we upper-bound this generating function through a local growth analysis for codes spanned by low-weight vectors. This framework sharpens the previous ball-size estimate of Iceland and Samorodnitsky. Combined with a general method of Friedman and Tillich that relates balls in coset graphs to sizes of error-correcting codes, it further improves the upper bounds on the rate of LDPC codes for a significant range of relative distances.

title: Stable GFlowNets with TV Monitoring and Probabilistic Guarantees
summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn to sample states proportional to an unnormalized reward. Despite their theoretical promise, practical training is often unstable, exhibiting severe loss spikes and mode collapse. To tackle this, we first assess the sensitivity of GFlowNet objectives, demonstrating that a small Total Variation (TV) distance between the learned and target distributions does not preclude unbounded training loss. Motivated by this mismatch, we establish converse guarantees by deriving loss-to-TV bounds that certify global fidelity from bounded trajectory balance losses. Lastly, we propose Stable GFlowNets, an algorithm that leverages our theoretical results to stabilize training, and empirically demonstrate improved training behavior and superior distributional fidelity.

title: IConFace: Fine-Grained Identity Conditioning for Reference-Aware Face Restoration
summary: Severe face degradation can remove person-specific evidence, making restoration underdetermined. A generative prior may recover a sharp, plausible face yet miss localized traits that persist across images of the same person. Same-identity references supply this missing evidence, while the degraded observation anchors target structure. We propose \textbf{IConFace}, a fine-grained identity-conditioned framework that optionally conditions restoration on up to three same-identity references. Its hybrid concat backbone retains degraded and reference observations as dense visual tokens, preserving localized reference evidence. An identity pathway provides compact multi-reference guidance, while a degraded-structure pathway injects full-field and local-residual memories to reinforce target-aligned structure. We also introduce a human-audited benchmark that measures whether persistent localized identity details survive restoration. IConFace achieves leading reference compatibility, especially under severe degradation, and the highest observed preservation rate on this benchmark. Without references, it achieves leading learned perceptual quality across five blind-restoration benchmarks. Joint reference-based and paired-target evaluations show that reference-supported identity recovery and exact target agreement are complementary.

title: AegisTS: An Agent-Driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning System for Multivariate Time Series Data Cleaning
summary:
Multivariate time series (MTS) are frequently affected by co-occurring quality issues, such as missing values, outliers, and constraint violations, which significantly undermine downstream analytics. Existing cleaning approaches fix only a limited set of such issues, making them ill-suited for scenarios where multiple quality problems arise simultaneously. Furthermore, these methods commonly depend on the availability of ground truth data or domain-specific rules, both of which are rarely accessible in real-world applications.
  In this paper, we introduce AegisTS, an agent system with reinforcement learning designed to clean multiple data quality issues in MTS. We cast the cleaning process as a joint optimization problem that simultaneously handles quality issue order and cleaning model selection, allowing efficient navigation of the large space of possible cleaning pipelines. Our framework relies on a hierarchical agent architecture, where a high-level agent determines the order in which data quality issues should be processed, while a low-level agent identifies the most suitable cleaning method for each issue. To guide the agent toward an optimal cleaning pipeline, we propose a dual-stage reward mechanism that couples upstream (cleaning) and downstream performance, enabling effective optimization without relying on ground truth. Our experimental results show that AegisTS consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 96% improvement in data cleaning quality and 27% improvement in downstream performance.

title: A Constant-Factor Approximation for Continuous Dynamic Time Warping in 2D
comments: Appearing in ICALP 2026; made minor clarity and consistency improvements, mainly in sections 3.1 and 4.1
summary:
Continuous Dynamic Time Warping (CDTW) is a robust similarity measure for polygonal curves that has recently found a variety of applications. Despite its practical use, not much is known about the algorithmic complexity of computing it in 2D, especially when one requires either an exact solution or strong approximation guarantees. We fill this gap by introducing a $5$-approximation algorithm with running time $O(n^5)$ under the 1-norm.
  This is the first constant-factor approximation for 2D CDTW with polynomial running time. We extend our algorithm to all polygonal norms on $\mathbb{R}^2$, which we subsequently use in order to achieve a $(5+\varepsilon)$-approximation with time complexity $O(n^5 / \varepsilon^{1/2})$ for CDTW in 2D under any fixed norm. The latter result in particular includes the usual Euclidean 2-norm.

title: LLM-Based Educational Simulation: Evaluating Temporal Student Persona Stability Across ADHD Profiles
summary: Student simulation with Large language models (LLMs) offers a scalable alternative for educational research and teacher training. Yet, its validity depends on whether models maintain stable personas across extended interactions. We test this prerequisite using a dual-assessment framework measuring self-reported characteristics and observer-rated behavioral expressions. Across two experiments testing four clinically-grounded ADHD persona conditions, five LLMs, and three prompt designs, we quantify between-conversation stability (N=4,968) and within-conversation stability (N=3,952 across 9 turns). Self-reported characteristics remain stable for high intensities, constituting a necessary prerequisite for valid behavioral simulation. Observer-rated behavioral expression reveals selective instability: within-conversation drift occurs in unscripted dialog for high and moderate ADHD personas. Scripted interactions with explicit task prompts eliminate this drift entirely. Stable, persona-aligned simulated learners benefit from a structured interaction design to maintain behavioral coherence, which holds significant implications for teacher training, adaptive tutoring, and any application requiring sustained, path-dependent learner interactions.

title: Online Goal Recognition using Path Signature and Dynamic Time Warping
comments: Accepted as part of the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Online goal recognition in continuous domains poses two central challenges: efficiently encoding large trajectories and effectively comparing them. Recent work addresses these challenges by using custom state-space representations and metrics to compare observations against hypotheses. However, these approaches often overlook well-established encoding techniques used in other domains that offer substantial advantages. This paper introduces a novel method for online goal recognition that leverages path signatures, a compact, expressive representation of rough path theory that efficiently captures key semantic features of trajectories, enabling more meaningful comparisons between them. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms the state of the art in predictive accuracy and online planning efficiency, while remaining competitive offline.

title: SACK : Safe Active Continual Koopman Learning for Uncertain Systems with Contractive Guarantees
summary: Koopman operator theory provides a powerful framework for representing nonlinear dynamics through a linear operator acting on lifted observables, enabling the use of linear control techniques for nonlinear systems. However, Koopman models are typically learned from data and often degrade in performance under model uncertainty and distributional shifts between training and deployment. Although several works have explored online adaptation to address this issue, many rely on neural network-based updates that introduce significant computational overhead and lack formal safety guarantees, limiting their suitability for real-time and safety-critical robotic applications. In this work, we propose SACK, a unified framework for continual adaptive Koopman learning that enables safe and efficient online refinement of learned models during task execution. A Koopman model is first learned offline and subsequently refined online through a contractive adaptation law, which provides theoretical convergence guarantees under distributional shifts and model uncertainty. To improve data efficiency and accelerate model refinement, the adaptation mechanism is integrated with an active learning strategy that drives the system to collect informative data while accomplishing task objectives. The resulting control problem is formulated as a nonconvex optimization problem incorporating both active learning objectives and safety constraints. We further derive theoretical bounds on model approximation error and show how these bounds can be incorporated within a robust Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework to provide formal safety guarantees. To reduce conservatism in practice, we also introduce a conformal prediction-based tightening mechanism that calibrates safety margins online from observed residuals. Extensive simulation and experimental studies demonstrate efficacy of the proposed scheme.

title: LLMs are the Ideal Candidate for Mixed-Initiative Game Design Pillar Workflows
comments: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. 6 pages appendix, 13 tables
summary: Game Design Pillars are natural language artifacts commonly used in game development to communicate a project's core vision and ensure a coherent player experience. Their linguistic nature aligns well with the strengths of Large Language Models (LLMs), which excel at generating and interpreting natural language, making them strong candidates for supporting mixed-initiative workflows centered on design pillars. In this study, we introduce a formal definition of game design pillars, present an initial prototype -- SPINE -- and investigate the utility of LLMs in the creation and decision-making processes associated with pillar-driven workflows. We begin with a pre-study to identify an appropriate model, comparing \texttt{gemini-2.0-flash} and \texttt{GPT-4o-mini}. Results show that Gemini is better suited to our tasks due to its greater output variety and consistency. We then conduct a case study by deploying the tool at a local game jam. Findings indicate positive reception and clear value in integrating SPINE into early-stage development. Finally, we interview four experts, demonstrating the tool and allowing them to experiment with it in a controlled environment. While individual perspectives vary, the overall perception is encouraging and supports our intuition: LLMs can meaningfully contribute to game design pillar workflows. These early findings highlight the potential of formalizing pillar-driven design as a research space and point toward several promising avenues for future work.

title: CIDR: A Large-Scale Industrial Source Code Dataset for Software Engineering Research
comments: 60 pages, 13 figures, 8 appendices. Dataset access: https://fermatix.ai/#Contact. Anonymization tool: https://github.com/Fermatix/repo-sanitizer. Metadata utility: https://github.com/Fermatix/repo_metadata_cli
summary: We present the Curated Industrial Developer Repository (CIDR), a large-scale dataset of real-world software repositories collected from industrial partners. The dataset comprises 4,225 repositories spanning 75 programming languages, totaling 832 million raw lines of code (581 million logical lines), along with structured metadata at the repository level, full version control history, and engineering-practice attributes such as continuous integration usage and the presence of automated tests. All repositories were collected, filtered, and anonymized through a multi-stage pipeline developed specifically for this purpose. We additionally report an exploratory fine-tuning study that adapts a 3-billion-parameter code language model to CIDR and quantifies the effect on held-out enterprise code. CIDR is intended to support research in code intelligence, software quality analysis, developer tooling, and related software engineering tasks. Access to CIDR is provided under a restricted license; details on eligibility and terms are available at https://fermatix.ai/#Contact.

title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Code Language Models for Security Patch Detection
summary: Automated detection of vulnerability-fixing commits (\vfcs) is critical for timely security patch deployment, as advisory databases lag patch releases by a median of 25 days and many fixes never receive advisories. Code language models are increasingly adopted for identifying VFCs, yet whether they can recognize a security fix from the code change itself remains unclear, as reported performance is shaped by commit messages, project-level data leakage, and uncertain data quality. We present a rigorous re-evaluation that jointly controls these factors through a unified framework consolidating 20 fragmented datasets spanning more than 180000 commits. Training 270 models from 125M to 80B parameters, we isolate the code signal under group-stratified code-only evaluation and assess the impact of model capacity and additional code context, ranging from intra-procedural enrichment to inter-procedural repository context. Model capacity yields clear but insufficient gains, and the evaluated context signals provide no reliable improvement under strict false positive budgets. At a false positive rate of 0.5%, every evaluated fine-tuned code-only model misses at least 80% of vulnerability fixes. A manual expert audit further shows that label error concentrates in commits lacking CVE association and primarily distorts evaluation. We derive concrete recommendations for evaluating on aggregated VFC datasets and release our unified framework and evaluation suite.

title: Stable Attention Response for Reliable Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting remains challenging due to the highly localized, rapidly evolving, and heterogeneous nature of atmospheric dynamics. Although recent methods increasingly adopt attention-based architectures in both unimodal and multimodal settings, they mainly emphasize stronger representation learning and prediction capacity, while paying less attention to the stability of attention responses across samples. In this work, we show that cross-sample instability of attention-response energy is an important and previously underexplored source of forecasting unreliability. Empirically, inaccurate forecasts are associated with larger attention-response energy variance across heads and layers. Theoretically, we show that cross-sample variability can propagate through self-attention, and enlarge a lower bound on prediction error. Based on this insight, we propose HARECast, a Head-wise Attention Response Energy-regulated framework for precipitation nowcasting. HARECast explicitly models head-wise attention-response energy and stabilizes it through a group-wise regularization objective that reduces cross-sample fluctuations. The proposed formulation is generic and applicable to both unimodal and multimodal nowcasting architectures. We instantiate HARECast in a standard forecasting pipeline with reconstruction branches and a diffusion-based predictor, and evaluate it on commonly used benchmarks--SEVIR and MeteoNet. Experimental results demonstrate that HARECast achieves state-of-the-art performance.

title: CogniFold: Always-On Proactive Memory via Cognitive Folding
summary: Existing agent memory remains predominantly reactive and retrieval-based, lacking the capacity to autonomously organize experience into persistent cognitive structure. Toward genuinely autonomous agents, we introduce CogniFold, a brain-inspired "always-on" agent memory designed for the next generation of proactive assistants. CogniFold continuously folds fragmented event streams into self-emerging cognitive structures, bootstrapping progressively higher-level cognition from incoming events and accumulated knowledge. We ground this by extending Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory from two layers (hippocampus, neocortex) to three, adding a prefrontal intent layer. Emulating the prefrontal cortex as the locus of intentional control and decision-making, CogniFold achieves this through graph-topology self-organization: cognitive structures proactively assemble under the stream, merge when semantically similar, decay when stale, relink through associative recall, and surface intents when concept-cluster density crosses a threshold. We evaluate structural formation using CogEval-Bench, demonstrating that CogniFold uniquely produces memory structures that match cognitive expectations and concept emergence. Furthermore, across eight downstream benchmarks -- two probing long-term conversational memory (LoCoMo, LongMemEval) and six spanning other cognitive domains -- we validate that CogniFold simultaneously performs robustly on conventional memory tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenNorve/CogniFold.

title: Learning Direct Control Policies with Flow Matching for Autonomous Driving
comments: 16 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026)
summary: We present a flow-matching planner for autonomous driving that directly outputs actionable control trajectories defined by acceleration and curvature profiles. The model is conditioned on a bird's-eye-view (BEV) raster of the surrounding scene and generates control sequences in a small number of Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE) integration steps, enabling low-latency inference suitable for real-time closed-loop re-planning. We train exclusively on urban scenarios (real urban city streets, intersections and roundabouts of the city of Parma, Italy) collected from a 2D traffic simulator with reactive agents, and evaluate in closed-loop on both in-distribution and markedly out-of-distribution environments, including multi-lane highways and unseen urban scenarios. Our results show that the model generalizes reliably to these unseen conditions, maintaining stable closed-loop control and successfully completing scenarios that differ substantially from the training distribution. We attribute this to the BEV representation, which provides a geometry-centric view of the scene that is inherently less sensitive to distributional shifts, and to the flow-matching formulation, which learns a smooth vector field that degrades gracefully under distribution shift. We provide video demonstrations of closed-loop behavior at https://marcelloceresini.github.io/DirectControlFlowMatching.

title: Co-Design Optimization for Data Center Cooling System via Digital Twin
summary: Liquid-cooled exascale supercomputers dissipate heat through cooling plants organized as multiple parallel subloops, but how to allocate coolant distribution units (CDUs) across subloops and how to distribute flow among them has not been systematically addressed for facilities at this scale. This paper presents a three-layer optimization framework that jointly determines the integer partition of CDUs across subloops, the continuous flow fraction allocation, and the per-timestep co-design optimization of total flow rate and supply temperature subject to per-subloop thermal safety constraints. The Modelica simulation model is built based on the data of the Frontier exascale supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. By developing a reduced-order surrogate model, all 611 feasible partitions of 25 CDUs are evaluated across the full year operational dataset of 49,353 timesteps. Three progressively richer operational strategies are compared, ranging from flow control optimization to full three-layer co-design optimization with dynamically adjusted flow fractions. The optimal design within the surrogate optimization problem is a two-subloop plant achieving 35.48% annual cooling energy savings, only 0.18% above the current three-subloop design at 35.30%. Most of the savings are delivered by supervisory co-optimization of total flow rate and supply temperature; the distinct role of flow fraction optimization is design robustness rather than additional raw savings. Flow fraction optimization compensates for any feasible CDU-to-subloop assignment, reducing the design sensitivity by 93% and providing a low-cost software-only pathway to near-optimal performance on the existing Frontier hardware. The framework is transferable to other liquid-cooled high-performance computing plants.

AI.title_translation: 基于数字孪生的数据中心冷却系统协同设计优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个三层协同设计优化框架，通过数字孪生和降阶替代模型系统性优化超算冷却系统的CDU划分、流量分配与运行参数，在降低93%设计敏感度的同时实现了超过35%的年度冷却节能。
AI.motivation: 液冷百亿亿次（Exascale）超级计算机通过多平行子回路的冷却系统进行散热，但在该规模下，如何在子回路间合理分配冷却液分配单元（CDU）以及如何在各子回路间分配流量，尚缺乏系统性的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了一个三层优化框架，联合确定CDU在子回路间的整数划分、连续流量比例分配，以及在各子回路热安全约束下的实时总流量与供水温度协同优化。基于Oak Ridge国家实验室的Frontier百亿亿次超算数据构建了Modelica仿真模型，并开发了降阶替代模型（Surrogate Model），对25个CDU的所有611种可行划分方案在全年49,353个时间步的运行数据上进行了评估和对比。
AI.result: 优化后的双子回路设计实现了35.48%的年度冷却能效提升（略高于当前三子回路设计的35.30%）。此外，流量比例优化弥补了硬件配置的不足，使设计敏感度降低了93%，为在现有Frontier硬件上提升性能提供了一条低成本的纯软件解决途径。
AI.conclusion: 大部分节能来自总流量与供水温度的实时协同优化，而流量分配优化主要起到了增强系统设计鲁棒性（降低93%设计敏感度）的作用。该协同设计与优化框架具有良好的可移植性，适用于其他液冷高性能计算数据中心。

AI.summary: 本文针对百亿亿次超算液冷系统的CDU配置与流量分配难题，基于Frontier超算实际数据构建了数字孪生与降阶替代模型，提出了三层协同设计优化框架。该框架将硬件划分、流量调配与实时运行参数优化相结合，实现了高达35.48%的年度冷却能耗节省，并显著提升了系统设计的鲁棒性。
